    (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    groupAlgebraActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma x = groupAlgebraAction rho sigma x

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraAction_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupAlgebraAction_single
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (m : Multiplicative M) (a : L) :
    groupAlgebraAction rho sigma (MonoidAlgebra.single m a) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single (Multiplicative.ofAdd (rho sigma m.toAdd)) (sigma a)

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraAction_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupAlgebraAction_smul
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (a : L) (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    groupAlgebraAction rho sigma (a • x) =
      sigma a • groupAlgebraAction rho sigma x

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_map_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_map_mul
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (x y : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M) ⊗[L]
      MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma (x * y) =
      groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma x *

theorem groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_map_one

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_mul

    groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho (sigma * tau) t =
      groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma
        (groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho tau t)

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_one
statement:

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_smul
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (a : L)
    (t : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M) ⊗[L]
      MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma (a • t) =
      sigma a • groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma t

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv_tmul
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)

    groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma (x ⊗ₜ[L] y) =

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraInvariantsComul_apply
statement:

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.mem_groupAlgebraInvariants_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_groupAlgebraInvariants_iff
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    x ∈ groupAlgebraInvariants rho ↔
      ∀ sigma, groupAlgebraAction rho sigma x = x

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.mem_groupAlgebraInvariants_iff_coeff
statement:
theorem mem_groupAlgebraInvariants_iff_coeff
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    x ∈ groupAlgebraInvariants rho ↔
      ∀ (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) (m : Multiplicative M),
        sigma (x.coeff (Multiplicative.ofAdd (rho sigma⁻¹ m.toAdd))) = x.coeff m

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.mem_groupAlgebraTensorInvariants_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_groupAlgebraTensorInvariants_iff
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M)
    (t : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M) ⊗[L]
      MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    t ∈ groupAlgebraTensorInvariants rho ↔
      ∀ sigma, groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma t = t

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.single_mem_groupAlgebraInvariants
statement:
theorem single_mem_groupAlgebraInvariants
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M)

    (hm : ∀ sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L, rho sigma m.toAdd = m.toAdd)

lemma mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℕ) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (ζ : rootsOfUnity n A) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative (ZMod n))) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) n).symm ζ) =

    (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative (ZMod n))) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) n).symm ζ)).ofConv

    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H') →ₐ[R] A)) (g : G') :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1.ofConv (single g (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single (g, (1 : H')) 1)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue {B : Type*} [CommSemiring B] [Algebra R B] (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H') →ₐ[R] A)) :
    prodPointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H')) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G') φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R H') φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G' × H') →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H') :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2.ofConv (single h (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single ((1 : G'), h) 1)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
    (f₁ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G' →ₐ[R] A)) (f₂ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R H' →ₐ[R] A))
    (g : G') (h : H') :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv.symm (f₁, f₂)).ofConv (single (g, h) (1 : R)) =
      f₁.ofConv (single g 1) * f₂.ofConv (single h 1)

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_fst_ofConv_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_fst_ofConv_single
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G × H) →ₐ[R] A)) (g : G) :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1.ofConv (single g (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single (g, (1 : H)) 1)

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G × H) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    prodPointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R (G × H)) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G) φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R H) φ (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2)

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_snd_ofConv_single
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (G × H) →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H) :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv f).2.ofConv (single h (1 : R)) =
      f.ofConv (single ((1 : G), h) 1)

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodPointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv_single
    (f₁ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) (f₂ : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R H →ₐ[R] A))
    (g : G) (h : H) :
    (prodPointsMulEquiv.symm (f₁, f₂)).ofConv (single (g, h) (1 : R)) =
      f₁.ofConv (single g 1) * f₂.ofConv (single h 1)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mapValue_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem mapValue_quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : WithConv (K →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal) χ
        ((quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A).symm g) =
      (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf (CommAlgCat.of R B)).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) χ g)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : WithConv (H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal →ₐ[R] A)) :
    quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A g =
      AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
        ((kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf).symm :
          K →ₐc[R] H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal) g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_mapValue {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : WithConv (H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal →ₐ[R] A)) :
    quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf (CommAlgCat.of R B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal) χ g) =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := K) χ (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A g)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem quotientKerPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (A : CommAlgCat.{x} R)
    (g : WithConv (K →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (quotientKerPointsMulEquiv f hf A).symm g =
      AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
        (kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf : H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal →ₐc[R] K) g

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.comp_pointConjugationAlgHom
statement:
theorem comp_pointConjugationAlgHom {A : Type w} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) (x : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    WithConv.toConv (x.ofConv.comp (pointConjugationAlgHom g)) =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) (Algebra.ofId R A) g * x *
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) (Algebra.ofId R A) g)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.mapDomain_pointConjugationBialgEquiv
statement:
theorem mapDomain_pointConjugationBialgEquiv {A : Type w} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) (x : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A) (pointConjugationBialgEquiv g).toBialgHom x =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) (Algebra.ofId R A) g * x *
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) (Algebra.ofId R A) g)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.pointConjugationAlgHom_mul
statement:
theorem pointConjugationAlgHom_mul (g h : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    pointConjugationAlgHom (g * h) =
      (pointConjugationAlgHom h).comp (pointConjugationAlgHom g)

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.pointConjugationAlgHom_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointConjugationAlgHom_one :
    pointConjugationAlgHom (1 : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) = AlgHom.id R H

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.pointConjugationBialgEquiv_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointConjugationBialgEquiv_toAlgHom (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    ((pointConjugationBialgEquiv g : H →ₐc[R] H) : H →ₐ[R] H) =
      pointConjugationAlgHom g

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.pointConjugationFiniteTypeIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointConjugationFiniteTypeIso_hom (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom (pointConjugationFiniteTypeIso g).hom =
      (pointConjugationBialgEquiv g).toBialgHom

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.toConv_pointConjugationAlgHom
statement:
theorem toConv_pointConjugationAlgHom (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    WithConv.toConv (pointConjugationAlgHom g) =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) (Algebra.ofId R H) g *
        WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.id R H) *
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) (Algebra.ofId R H) g)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizerIdeal_comm
statement:
theorem equalizerIdeal_comm (f g : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    equalizerIdeal f g = equalizerIdeal g f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizerIdeal_le_iff
statement:
theorem equalizerIdeal_le_iff {f g : H →ₐc[R] K} {J : Ideal K} :
    equalizerIdeal f g ≤ J ↔ ∀ a, f a - g a ∈ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizerIdeal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem equalizerIdeal_le_ker_iff {A : Type*} [Ring A] {f g : H →ₐc[R] K} (φ : K →+* A) :
    equalizerIdeal f g ≤ RingHom.ker φ ↔ ∀ a, φ (f a) = φ (g a)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizerIdeal_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equalizerIdeal_self (f : H →ₐc[R] K) : equalizerIdeal f f = ⊥

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizer_comm
statement: theorem equalizer_comm : equalizer f g = equalizer g f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizer_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem equalizer_eq_bot_iff : equalizer f g = ⊥ ↔ f = g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizer_le_iff
statement:
theorem equalizer_le_iff {J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    equalizer f g ≤ J ↔ ∀ a, f a - g a ∈ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizer_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem equalizer_le_ker_iff {A : Type*} [Ring A] (φ : K →+* A) :
    (equalizer f g).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker φ ↔ ∀ a, φ (f a) = φ (g a)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizer_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equalizer_self (f : H →ₐc[R] K) : equalizer f f = ⊥

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.equalizer_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equalizer_toIdeal : (equalizer f g).toIdeal = equalizerIdeal f g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_equalizer
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_equalizer {x : K} : x ∈ equalizer f g ↔ x ∈ equalizerIdeal f g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.sub_mem_equalizer
statement: theorem sub_mem_equalizer (a : H) : f a - g a ∈ equalizer f g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.sub_mem_equalizerIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_mem_equalizerIdeal (f g : H →ₐc[R] K) (a : H) :

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelLift_hom_ext
statement:
theorem commonKernelLift_hom_ext {Y : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (p : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i)
    (u v : Y ⟶ quotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal p))
    (h : ∀ i, u ≫ commonKernelLift p i = v ≫ commonKernelLift p i) : u = v

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.comp_mkQuotient_equalizerHopfIdeal
statement:
theorem comp_mkQuotient_equalizerHopfIdeal (f g : H ⟶ K) :

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.equalizerHopfIdeal_def
statement:
theorem equalizerHopfIdeal_def (f g : H ⟶ K) :
    equalizerHopfIdeal f g = HopfIdeal.equalizer f.hom g.hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.equalizerHopfIdeal_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equalizerHopfIdeal_eq_bot_iff (f g : H ⟶ K) :
    equalizerHopfIdeal f g = ⊥ ↔ f = g

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.equalizerHopfIdeal_le_iff
statement:
theorem equalizerHopfIdeal_le_iff {f g : H ⟶ K} {J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    equalizerHopfIdeal f g ≤ J ↔ ∀ a : H, f.hom a - g.hom a ∈ J

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.equalizerHopfIdeal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem equalizerHopfIdeal_le_ker_iff {A : Type*} [Ring A] (f g : H ⟶ K) (φ : K →+* A) :
    (equalizerHopfIdeal f g).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker φ ↔ ∀ a : H, φ (f.hom a) = φ (g.hom a)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.equalizerHopfIdeal_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equalizerHopfIdeal_toIdeal (f g : H ⟶ K) :
    (equalizerHopfIdeal f g).toIdeal = HopfIdeal.equalizerIdeal f.hom g.hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.equalizerHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem equalizerHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_iff (f g : H ⟶ K) (p : K ⟶ T) :
    (equalizerHopfIdeal f g).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker p.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom ↔
      f ≫ p = g ≫ p

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_ext_of_commonKernelHopfIdeal_eq_bot
TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_ext_of_le_iff_forall_toIdeal_le_ker
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_le_iff_forall_toIdeal_le_ker {I : HopfIdeal R H} {p : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i}
    (hI : ∀ J : HopfIdeal R H,
      J ≤ I ↔ ∀ i, J.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (p i).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom)
    {c : ∀ i, quotient H I ⟶ K i} (hc : ∀ i, mkQuotient H I ≫ c i = p i)
    {Y : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} (u v : Y ⟶ quotient H I)
    (h : ∀ i, u ≫ c i = v ≫ c i) : u = v

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftEqualizer_unique
statement:
theorem liftEqualizer_unique {f g : H ⟶ K} (p : K ⟶ T) (hp : f ≫ p = g ≫ p)
    (q : quotient K (equalizerHopfIdeal f g) ⟶ T)
    (hq : mkQuotient K (equalizerHopfIdeal f g) ≫ q = p) :
    q = liftEqualizer p hp

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mem_equalizerHopfIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_equalizerHopfIdeal {f g : H ⟶ K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ equalizerHopfIdeal f g ↔ x ∈ HopfIdeal.equalizerIdeal f.hom g.hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_liftEqualizer
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkQuotient_comp_liftEqualizer {f g : H ⟶ K} (p : K ⟶ T) (hp : f ≫ p = g ≫ p) :
    mkQuotient K (equalizerHopfIdeal f g) ≫ liftEqualizer p hp = p

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.sub_mem_equalizerHopfIdeal
statement:
theorem sub_mem_equalizerHopfIdeal (f g : H ⟶ K) (a : H) :
    f.hom a - g.hom a ∈ equalizerHopfIdeal f g

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_of_comp_commonKernelLift
statement:
theorem commonKernelHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_of_comp_commonKernelLift
    (ψ : H ⟶ quotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f))
    (hgen : ∀ i, (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).toIdeal ≤
      RingHom.ker (ψ ≫ commonKernelLift f i).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker ψ.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem commonKernelHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_of_comp_eq
    (ψ : H ⟶ quotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f)) (s : ι → ι) (m : ∀ i, K (s i) ⟶ K i)
    (hgen : ∀ i, ψ ≫ commonKernelLift f i = f (s i) ≫ m i) :
    (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker ψ.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelSpecRestrict_comp_quotientSpecι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem commonKernelSpecRestrict_comp_quotientSpecι {H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R}
    {K : ι → _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R} {f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i}
    (ψ : H ⟶ quotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f))
    (hψ : (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker ψ.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    commonKernelSpecRestrict ψ hψ ≫ quotientSpecι H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f) =
      (hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).map ψ.op

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelSpecRestrict_def
TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelSpecRestrict_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem commonKernelSpecRestrict_eq_of_comp_eq {H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R}
    {K : ι → _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R} {f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i}
    (ψ ψ' : H ⟶ quotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f))
    (hψ : (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker ψ.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom)
    (hψ' : (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker ψ'.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom)
    (hgen : ∀ i, ψ ≫ commonKernelLift f i = ψ' ≫ commonKernelLift f i) :
    commonKernelSpecRestrict ψ hψ = commonKernelSpecRestrict ψ' hψ'

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_conjugate_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_conjugate_inv (I : HopfIdeal R H) (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    (I.conjugate g⁻¹).conjugate g = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_eq_comapOfSurjective
statement:
theorem conjugate_eq_comapOfSurjective (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    I.conjugate g =
      I.comapOfSurjective (HopfAlgebra.pointConjugationBialgEquiv g).toBialgHom
        (by
          simpa only [BialgEquiv.toBialgHom_eq_coe, BialgEquiv.coe_toBialgHom] using
            EquivLike.surjective (HopfAlgebra.pointConjugationBialgEquiv g))

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_eq_conjugate_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_eq_conjugate_iff (I J : HopfIdeal R H)
    (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) : I.conjugate g = J.conjugate g ↔ I = J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_inv_conjugate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_inv_conjugate (I : HopfIdeal R H) (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    (I.conjugate g).conjugate g⁻¹ = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_le_conjugate_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_le_conjugate_iff (I J : HopfIdeal R H)
    (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) : I.conjugate g ≤ J.conjugate g ↔ I ≤ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_mono
statement:
theorem conjugate_mono (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (h : I ≤ J) :
    I.conjugate g ≤ J.conjugate g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_mul
statement:
theorem conjugate_mul (I : HopfIdeal R H) (g h : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) :
    I.conjugate (g * h) = (I.conjugate h).conjugate g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conjugate_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_one (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    I.conjugate (1 : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_conjugate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_conjugate {I : HopfIdeal R H} {g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)} {x : H} :
    x ∈ I.conjugate g ↔ HopfAlgebra.pointConjugationAlgHom g x ∈ I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.smul_eq_conjugate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_eq_conjugate (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] R)) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    g • I = I.conjugate g

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.conormalSubspace_mono
statement:
theorem conormalSubspace_mono {I J : HopfIdeal k H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    conormalSubspace I ≤ conormalSubspace J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_conormalSubspace_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_conormalSubspace_iff (I : HopfIdeal k H)
    (x : Bialgebra.CotangentSpace k H) :
    x ∈ conormalSubspace I ↔
      ∃ y : H, y ∈ I.toIdeal ∧ Bialgebra.cotangentMap k H y = x

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientCotangentMap_cotangentMap
statement:
theorem quotientCotangentMap_cotangentMap (I : HopfIdeal k H) (x : H) :
    quotientCotangentMap I (Bialgebra.cotangentMap k H x) =
      Bialgebra.cotangentMap k (H ⧸ I.toIdeal) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I.toIdeal x)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.quotientCotangentMap_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientCotangentMap_toCotangent (I : HopfIdeal k H)
    (x : Bialgebra.AugmentationIdeal k H) :
    quotientCotangentMap I
        ((Bialgebra.AugmentationIdeal k H).toCotangent x) =
      (Bialgebra.AugmentationIdeal k (H ⧸ I.toIdeal)).toCotangent
        ⟨algebraMap H (H ⧸ I.toIdeal) x, by
          have hx : Coalgebra.counit (R := k) (x : H) = 0 := x.property
          rw [Bialgebra.AugmentationIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker]
          simpa only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
            Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, Bialgebra.counitAlgHom_apply,
            Bialgebra.Quotient.counit_mk] using hx⟩

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_normalCore_le
statement:
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_normalCore_le (J : HopfIdeal k H) :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J.normalCore ≤
      (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).normalCore

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.isNormal_baseChangeHopfIdeal
statement:
theorem isNormal_baseChangeHopfIdeal {J : HopfIdeal k H} (hJ : J.IsNormal) :
    (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).IsNormal

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.isNormal_normalCommonKernelHopfIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNormal_normalCommonKernelHopfIdeal (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) :
    (normalCommonKernelHopfIdeal f).IsNormal

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.le_normalCommonKernelHopfIdeal_iff_of_isNormal
statement:
theorem le_normalCommonKernelHopfIdeal_iff_of_isNormal
    (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    (hI : I.IsNormal) :
    I ≤ normalCommonKernelHopfIdeal f ↔
      ∀ i, I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (f i).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_normalCommonKernelLift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkQuotient_comp_normalCommonKernelLift (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (i : ι) :
    mkQuotient H (normalCommonKernelHopfIdeal f) ≫ normalCommonKernelLift f i = f i

    (hq : q ≫ (hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).map f.op =

    (hq : q ≫ (hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).map f.op =

    (m : (hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).obj (Opposite.op Y) ⟶ equalizerSpec f g)

      (Limits.pullbackSymmetry
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of H) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))

      (Limits.pullbackSymmetry
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of H) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ≪≫
          pullbackSpecIso' R S H).inv

name: TauCeti.AffineGroupSchemeCat.hopfSpecBaseChangeIso_hom_hom
statement:

lemma hopfSpecBaseChangeIso_hom_hom (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R) :
    (hopfSpecBaseChangeIso H).hom.hom =
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).mapGrp.map
          ((commHopfAlgCatOpEquivAffineGroupSchemeCat.functorCompιIso
            (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.app (.op H)) ≫
        (hopfSpecBaseChangeGrpIso H).hom ≫
        (commHopfAlgCatOpEquivAffineGroupSchemeCat.functorCompιIso
          (CommRingCat.of S)).inv.app
            (.op (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChange (K := S) H))

statement:

lemma hopfSpecBaseChangeIso_inv_hom (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R) :
    (hopfSpecBaseChangeIso H).inv.hom =
      (commHopfAlgCatOpEquivAffineGroupSchemeCat.functorCompιIso
          (CommRingCat.of S)).hom.app
            (.op (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChange (K := S) H)) ≫
        (hopfSpecBaseChangeGrpIso H).inv ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).mapGrp.map
          ((commHopfAlgCatOpEquivAffineGroupSchemeCat.functorCompιIso
            (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.app (.op H))

          ((hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).map f.op) ≫
        (hopfSpecBaseChangeGrpIso (R := R) (S := S) H).hom =
        (hopfSpecBaseChangeGrpIso (R := R) (S := S) K).hom ≫
        (hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of S)).map
          (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap (K := S) f).op

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.card_center_subgroupOf_eq_one_iff
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`, tested: `simpNF` rejects it because the left-hand side is already reducible —
-- `Subgroup.card_eq_one` then `Subgroup.subgroupOf_eq_bot` rewrite
-- `Nat.card (center.subgroupOf Γ) = 1` to `Disjoint (center _) Γ`, so it is not in simp-normal
-- form. The `= 2` companion below has no such reduction and does carry the attribute.
-- `disjoint_center_iff_neg_one_notMem` is the simp-reachable form: it states the same fact at the
-- normal form this one reduces to, so a goal that simp has already rewritten to `Disjoint` is
-- still closed.
theorem card_center_subgroupOf_eq_one_iff [NoZeroDivisors R] [NeZero (2 : R)]
    (Γ : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) R)) :
    Nat.card ((Subgroup.center (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) R)).subgroupOf Γ) = 1 ↔
      (-1 : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) R) ∉ Γ

-- left-hand side to the transvection product first.
theorem coe_differenceShortRootUnit_eq_one_add_single_sub_single {i j : Fin m} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (c : R) :

name: TauCeti.Symplectic.relationMatrix_def

theorem baseChangeMap_coordinateMap_comp_coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso_hom :

name: TauCeti.Symplectic.coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso_hom_relationMatrix

name: TauCeti.Symplectic.finiteTypeCoordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso_hom

          (finiteTypeCoordinateHopfAlgebra_obj R m)) ≪≫
        coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso R K m ≪≫
        eqToIso
          (finiteTypeCoordinateHopfAlgebra_obj K m).symm).hom

name: TauCeti.Symplectic.groupSchemePointMulEquiv_apply_left
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`: `groupScheme` is a reducible specialization of the constant-form construction,
-- so the linter normalizes the target object before it can use this higher-level equation.
lemma groupSchemePointMulEquiv_apply_left
    (f : WithConv (coordinateHopfAlgebra R m →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (groupSchemePointMulEquiv m A f).left =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.ofConv) ≫
        eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R m).symm

    (x : (RingHom.ker (f : H →+* k)).Cotangent) :

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski_toCotangent (a : RingHom.ker (f : H →+* k)) :
    kernelCotangentLinearEquivZariski f
        ((RingHom.ker (f : H →+* k)).toCotangent a) =
      (maximalIdeal
          ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (kernelPoint f))).toCotangent
        ⟨algebraMap H
            ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (kernelPoint f)) a,
          by
            rw [← Ideal.mem_under,
              IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal
                ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (kernelPoint f))
                (RingHom.ker (f : H →+* k))]
            exact a.2⟩

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.cotangentLinearEquivZariski_toCotangent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cotangentLinearEquivZariski_toCotangent (a : AugmentationIdeal k H) :
    cotangentLinearEquivZariski k H ((AugmentationIdeal k H).toCotangent a) =
      (maximalIdeal
          ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (augmentationPoint k H))).toCotangent
        ⟨algebraMap H
            ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (augmentationPoint k H)) a,
          by
            let _ : (AugmentationIdeal k H).IsMaximal :=
              AlgHom.kernelIsMaximal (_root_.Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k H)
            let _ : IsLocalization.AtPrime
                ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (augmentationPoint k H))
                (AugmentationIdeal k H) :=
              AlgHom.kernelStalkIsLocalization (_root_.Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k H)
            rw [← Ideal.mem_under,
              IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal
                ((Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).presheaf.stalk (augmentationPoint k H))
                (AugmentationIdeal k H)]
            exact a.2⟩

name: TauCeti.galoisLatticeProperty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisLatticeProperty_iff (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (M : Rep.{u} ℤ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k)) :
    galoisLatticeProperty k M ↔
      (@Module.Free ℤ M _ _ M.hV2 ∧ @Module.Finite ℤ M _ _ M.hV2) ∧
        ∀ x : M, IsOpen {sigma | M.ρ sigma x = x}

name: TauCeti.galoisLatticeProperty_ofMulDistribMulAction
statement:
theorem galoisLatticeProperty_ofMulDistribMulAction (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (G : Type u) [CommGroup G] [MulDistribMulAction (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) G]
    [DistribMulAction (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) (Additive G)]
    [free : Module.Free ℤ (Additive G)] [finite : Module.Finite ℤ (Additive G)]
    (hρ : ∀ (sigma : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) (x : Additive G),
      (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) G).ρ sigma x = sigma • x)
    (hopen : ∀ x : Additive G,
      IsOpen (MulAction.stabilizer (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) x :
        Set (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k))) :
    galoisLatticeProperty k
      (Rep.ofMulDistribMulAction (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) G)

name: TauCeti.galoisLatticeProperty_contragredient
statement:
theorem galoisLatticeProperty_contragredient
    {W : Type u} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℤ W]
    (ρ : Representation ℤ (Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) V)

    (e : W ≃ₗ[ℤ] Module.Dual ℤ V)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isMaximalTorus_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isMaximalTorus_iff (k : Type u) [Field k] (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k)
    [Algebra.FiniteType k H] (I : HopfIdeal k H) :
    IsMaximalTorus k H I ↔
      torusCommHopfAlgProperty k
          (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotient
            ⟨H, (finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff H).2 inferInstance⟩ I) ∧
        ∀ J : HopfIdeal k H,
          torusCommHopfAlgProperty k
              (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotient
                ⟨H, (finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff H).2 inferInstance⟩ J) →
            J ≤ I → I ≤ J

theorem isMaximalTorus_of_baseChange {k : Type u} [Field k]

    [Algebra.FiniteType (AlgebraicClosure k) H']
    (I : HopfIdeal k H) (I' : HopfIdeal (AlgebraicClosure k) H')
    (e : CommHopfAlgCat.baseChange (K := AlgebraicClosure k) H ≅ H')
    (hI : torusCommHopfAlgProperty k
      (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotient
        ⟨H, (finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff H).2 inferInstance⟩ I))
    (hmap : (CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := AlgebraicClosure k) I).map e.hom.hom = I')
    (hmax : IsMaximalTorus (AlgebraicClosure k) H' I') :
    IsMaximalTorus k H I

      DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty k

    (hcontainJ :
      DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty k

          J) →

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.comul_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_X (ij : Index m) :
    comul R m (MvPolynomial.X ij) =
      ∑ k : m,
        genericMatrix R m ij.1.1 k ⊗ₜ[R]
          genericMatrix R m k ij.1.2

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.comul_coassoc
statement:
theorem comul_coassoc :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc R R R
        (CoordinateRing R m) (CoordinateRing R m) (CoordinateRing R m)).toAlgHom.comp
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (comul R m) (.id R (CoordinateRing R m))).comp
        (comul R m)) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id R (CoordinateRing R m)) (comul R m)).comp
        (comul R m)

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.comul_genericMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_genericMatrix_apply (i j : m) :
    comul R m (genericMatrix R m i j) =
      ∑ k : m, genericMatrix R m i k ⊗ₜ[R] genericMatrix R m k j

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.comul_lTensor_counit
statement:
theorem comul_lTensor_counit :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (.id R (CoordinateRing R m)) (counit R m)).comp
        (comul R m) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid R R (CoordinateRing R m)).symm

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.comul_rTensor_counit
statement:
theorem comul_rTensor_counit :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (counit R m) (.id R (CoordinateRing R m))).comp
        (comul R m) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid R (CoordinateRing R m)).symm

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.counit_X
statement:

theorem counit_X (ij : Index m) : counit R m (MvPolynomial.X ij) = 0

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.counit_genericMatrix_apply
statement:

theorem counit_genericMatrix_apply (i j : m) :

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.genericMatrix_apply_diag

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.map_comul_genericMatrix
statement:

theorem map_comul_genericMatrix :

      (genericMatrix R m).map
          (includeLeft : CoordinateRing R m →ₐ[R]
            CoordinateRing R m ⊗[R] CoordinateRing R m) *
        (genericMatrix R m).map
          (includeRight : CoordinateRing R m →ₐ[R]
            CoordinateRing R m ⊗[R] CoordinateRing R m)

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.map_counit_genericMatrix
statement:

theorem map_counit_genericMatrix : (genericMatrix R m).map (counit R m) = 1

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.antipode_X

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coordinateHopfAlgebra_algHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem coordinateHopfAlgebra_algHom_ext {T : Type*} [Semiring T] [Algebra R T]

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coordinateHopfAlgebra_antipode_genericMatrix_apply

statement:

theorem coordinateHopfAlgebra_comul_X (ij : Index m) :

      ∑ k : m,
        coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m (genericMatrix R m ij.1.1 k) ⊗ₜ[R]

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coordinateHopfAlgebra_comul_apply
statement:
@[simp low]
theorem coordinateHopfAlgebra_comul_apply (x : CoordinateRing R m) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := coordinateHopfAlgebra R m)
        (coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m x) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m).toAlgHom

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coordinateHopfAlgebra_comul_genericMatrix_apply

      ∑ k : m,
        coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m (genericMatrix R m i k) ⊗ₜ[R]
          coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m (genericMatrix R m k j)

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coordinateHopfAlgebra_counit_X

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coordinateHopfAlgebra_counit_apply
statement:
@[simp low]
theorem coordinateHopfAlgebra_counit_apply (x : CoordinateRing R m) :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := coordinateHopfAlgebra R m)

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coordinateHopfAlgebra_counit_genericMatrix_apply
statement:

theorem coordinateHopfAlgebra_counit_genericMatrix_apply (i j : m) :

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.coe_pointToUpperUnitriangular
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_pointToUpperUnitriangular
    (f : WithConv (coordinateHopfAlgebra R m →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (((pointToUpperUnitriangular R m f : upperUnitriangularGroup m A) :

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : upperUnitriangularGroup m A) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := coordinateHopfAlgebra R m) φ ((pointsMulEquiv R m).symm g) =

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.pointToUpperUnitriangular_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointToUpperUnitriangular_apply
    (f : WithConv (coordinateHopfAlgebra R m →ₐ[R] A)) (i j : m) :

        Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup m A) i j =
      f.ofConv (coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m (genericMatrix R m i j))

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.pointToUpperUnitriangular_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem pointToUpperUnitriangular_apply_of_lt
    (f : WithConv (coordinateHopfAlgebra R m →ₐ[R] A)) {i j : m} (h : i < j) :

      f.ofConv (coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R m
        (MvPolynomial.X (show Index m from ⟨(i, j), h⟩)))

statement:
theorem pointToUpperUnitriangular_mapValue {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]

    pointToUpperUnitriangular R m
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := coordinateHopfAlgebra R m) φ f) =
      UpperUnitriangularGroup.map φ.toRingHom (pointToUpperUnitriangular R m f)

statement:

statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointsNatIso_hom_app_apply (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := coordinateHopfAlgebra R m) A) :
    (eqToHom (upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj (R := R) m A)
      ((pointsNatIso (R := R) m).hom.app A f)).down = pointsMulEquiv R m f

statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointsNatIso_inv_app_apply (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : ULift.{u, max v w} (upperUnitriangularGroup m A)) :
    (pointsNatIso (R := R) m).inv.app A
        (eqToHom (upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj (R := R) m A).symm g) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) m).symm g.down

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.upperUnitriangularFunctor_map
statement:
theorem upperUnitriangularFunctor_map {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (φ : A ⟶ B) :
    (upperUnitriangularFunctor (R := R) m).map φ =
      eqToHom (upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj (R := R) m A) ≫
        GrpCat.ofHom
          (MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom.comp
            ((UpperUnitriangularGroup.map φ.hom.toRingHom).comp
              MulEquiv.ulift.toMonoidHom)) ≫
        eqToHom (upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj (R := R) m B).symm

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.upperUnitriangularFunctor_map_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperUnitriangularFunctor_map_apply_apply {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (φ : A ⟶ B)
    (g : ULift.{u, max v w} (upperUnitriangularGroup m A)) (i j : m) :
    (eqToHom (upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj (R := R) m B)
      ((upperUnitriangularFunctor (R := R) m).map φ
        (eqToHom (upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj (R := R) m A).symm g))).down.val i j =
      φ.hom (g.down.val i j)

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem upperUnitriangularFunctor_obj (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) :
    (upperUnitriangularFunctor (R := R) m).obj A =
      GrpCat.of (ULift.{u, max v w} (upperUnitriangularGroup m A))

@[simp]
theorem upperUnitriangularToPoint_pointToUpperUnitriangular

statement:
theorem mapValue_inclusionPoints {B : Type w} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (f : WithConv (coordinateHopfAlgebra R (Fin n) →ₐ[R] A)) :

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.pointToGeneralLinear_inclusionPoints
statement:

theorem pointToGeneralLinear_inclusionPoints

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.schemePointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (p : (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶ (groupScheme R m).X) :

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.schemePointsMulEquiv_groupSchemePointMulEquiv

@[simp]
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_groupSchemePointMulEquiv

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.schemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶ (groupScheme R m).X) :
    schemePointsMulEquiv m B
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).asOver

name: TauCeti.UpperUnitriangular.schemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (g : upperUnitriangularGroup m A) :

theorem groupLikeBaseChange_map {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [Bialgebra R B]

    groupLikeBaseChange (K := K) (GroupLike.map f g) =

theorem one_tmul_val_groupLikeBaseChangeEquiv_symm
    (hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range (_root_.GroupLike.val (R := R) (A := A))) = ⊤)

name: TauCeti.groupLikeScalarTowerEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem groupLikeScalarTowerEquiv_smul
    (hspan : Submodule.span L
      (Set.range (_root_.GroupLike.val (R := L) (A := L ⊗[k] A))) = ⊤)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (τ : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (hστ : ∀ a, σ (algebraMap L K a) = algebraMap L K (τ a))
    (x : _root_.GroupLike L (L ⊗[k] A)) :
    groupLikeScalarTowerEquiv (K := K) hspan (τ • x) =
      σ • groupLikeScalarTowerEquiv (K := K) hspan x

name: TauCeti.val_groupLikeScalarTowerEquiv

    [AddCommMonoid M] (F : l × l → M) (hdiag : ∀ a, F (a, a) = 0) :
    ∑ ij : l × l, F ij =
      ∑ ij ∈ {ij : l × l | ij.1 < ij.2}, (F ij + F ij.swap)

name: TauCeti.sum_mul_swap
statement:
theorem sum_mul_swap {ι M : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [AddCommMonoid M] [Mul M] (f g : ι → M)
    {s : Finset ι} {x y : ι} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) (hne : x ≠ y) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, f k * g (Equiv.swap x y k)) + (f x * g x + f y * g y) =
      (∑ k ∈ s, f k * g k) + (f x * g y + f y * g x)

    (hS : E.Conflation S) (h₁ : E.isInjective S.X₁) :
    (E.splittingOfInjective hS h₁).r =
      h₁.factorThru (E.isInflation_f hS) (𝟙 S.X₁)

name: TauCeti.ExactStructure.splittingOfInjective_s

theorem splittingOfInjective_s (E : ExactStructure C) {S : ShortComplex C}
    (hS : E.Conflation S) (h₁ : E.isInjective S.X₁) :
    (E.splittingOfInjective hS h₁).s = (E.isKernelCokernelPair S hS).desc
      (𝟙 S.X₂ - h₁.factorThru (E.isInflation_f hS) (𝟙 S.X₁) ≫ S.f) (by simp)

name: TauCeti.ModuleCat.submoduleCocone_ι_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem submoduleCocone_ι_app (K : ι → Submodule R M) (hK : Monotone K)
    (T : Submodule R M) (hT : ⨆ i, K i = T) (i : ι) :
    eqToHom (submoduleFunctor_obj K hK i).symm ≫
        (submoduleCocone K hK T hT).ι.app i ≫
      eqToHom (submoduleCocone_pt K hK T hT) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.inclusion ((le_iSup K i).trans hT.le))

name: TauCeti.ModuleCat.submoduleFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem submoduleFunctor_map (K : ι → Submodule R M) (hK : Monotone K)
    {i j : ι} (f : i ⟶ j) :
    eqToHom (submoduleFunctor_obj K hK i).symm ≫
        (submoduleFunctor K hK).map f ≫
      eqToHom (submoduleFunctor_obj K hK j) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (Submodule.inclusion (hK (leOfHom f)))

theorem comp_conj_mapQ {X₁ X₂ : Type u} [AddCommGroup X₁] [Module R X₁] [AddCommGroup X₂]
    [Module R X₂] {p₁ : Submodule R X₁} {p₂ : Submodule R X₂} {A₁ A₂ : ModuleCat.{u} R}
    (e₁ : A₁ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (X₁ ⧸ p₁)) (e₂ : A₂ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (X₂ ⧸ p₂))
    {π₁ : ModuleCat.of R X₁ ⟶ A₁} {π₂ : ModuleCat.of R X₂ ⟶ A₂}
    (hπ₁ : π₁ ≫ e₁.hom = ModuleCat.ofHom p₁.mkQ) (hπ₂ : π₂ ≫ e₂.hom = ModuleCat.ofHom p₂.mkQ)
    (f : X₁ →ₗ[R] X₂) (hf : p₁ ≤ p₂.comap f) :
    π₁ ≫ e₁.hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (p₁.mapQ p₂ f hf) ≫ e₂.inv = ModuleCat.ofHom f ≫ π₂

name: TauCeti.SheafOfModules.overTensorProductIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem overTensorProductIso_hom (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringCatSheaf R)) (X : D)
    [(K.over X).HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u})]
    [HasWeakSheafify (K.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [(K.over X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}] :
    (overTensorProductIso R M N X).hom =
      (pushforwardModule (J := K.over X) (K := K) (Over.forget X) R).map
          (tensorProductIso R M N).hom ≫
        (pushforwardSheafificationIso (J := K.over X) (K := K) (Over.forget X)
            (ringCatSheaf R) (M.val ⊗ N.val)).hom ≫
        (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf (R.over X)).obj)).map
            (Functor.Monoidal.μIso
              (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat (Over.forget X) R.obj)
              M.val N.val).inv ≫
        (tensorProductIso (R.over X) (M.over X) (N.over X)).inv

name: TauCeti.SheafOfModules.pushforwardTensorProductIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pushforwardTensorProductIso_hom (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringCatSheaf R)) :
    (pushforwardTensorProductIso (J := J) (K := K) F R M N).hom =
      (pushforwardModule (J := J) (K := K) F R).map (tensorProductIso R M N).hom ≫
        (pushforwardSheafificationIso F (ringCatSheaf R) (M.val ⊗ N.val)).hom ≫
        (PresheafOfModules.sheafification
          (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf (pushforwardCommRing (J := J) (K := K) F R)).obj)).map
            (Functor.Monoidal.μIso
              (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat F R.obj) M.val N.val).inv ≫
        (tensorProductIso (pushforwardCommRing (J := J) (K := K) F R)
          ((pushforwardModule (J := J) (K := K) F R).obj M)
          ((pushforwardModule (J := J) (K := K) F R).obj N)).inv

name: TauCeti.SheafOfModules.LocalTrivializations.tensorProduct_iso
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tensorProduct_iso (tM : LocalTrivializations.{u, v₁, u₁} M)
    (tN : LocalTrivializations.{u, v₁, u₁} N) (i : (tensorProduct tM tN).I) :
    (tensorProduct tM tN).iso i =
      let r := CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.CoversTop.commonRefinement
        tM.coversTop tN.coversTop
      let j := (tensorProduct_I tM tN).mp i
      let F : SheafOfModules.{u, v₁, max u₁ v₁} (ringCatSheaf (R.over (r.X j))) :=
        _root_.SheafOfModules.free (R := ringCatSheaf (R.over (r.X j))) (PUnit.{u + 1})
      cast (by
        dsimp only [r]
        dsimp only [j]
        dsimp only [F]
        rw [tensorProduct_X]
        rfl)
        ((SheafOfModules.tensorProductFreePUnitIsoLeft (R.over (r.X j)) F).symm ≪≫
          SheafOfModules.tensorProductCongrLeft (R.over (r.X j))
            (tM.isoOver (r.leftIndex j) (r.left j)) ≪≫
          SheafOfModules.tensorProductCongrRight (R.over (r.X j))
            (tN.isoOver (r.rightIndex j) (r.right j)) ≪≫
          (SheafOfModules.overTensorProductIso R M N (r.X j)).symm)

statement:
theorem tensorProductAssoc_hom (M N P : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringCatSheaf R)) :
    (tensorProductAssoc R M N P).hom =
      (tensorProductIso R (tensorProduct R M N) P).hom ≫
        (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).map
          ((_root_.SheafOfModules.forget _).map (tensorProductIso R M N).hom ▷ P.val) ≫
        (asIso ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).map
          ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).unit.app
            (M.val ⊗ N.val) ▷ P.val))).inv ≫
        (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).map
          (α_ M.val N.val P.val).hom ≫
        (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).map
          (M.val ◁ (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).unit.app
            (N.val ⊗ P.val)) ≫
        (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)).map
          (M.val ◁ (_root_.SheafOfModules.forget _).map (tensorProductIso R N P).inv) ≫
        (tensorProductIso R M (tensorProduct R N P)).inv

name: TauCeti.ihomIsoTensorLeft_hom_app_comp_whiskerRight_leftAdjointMate
statement:
theorem ihomIsoTensorLeft_hom_app_comp_whiskerRight_leftAdjointMate {Y Y' : C} [HasLeftDual Y]
    [HasLeftDual Y'] [Closed Y] [Closed Y'] (f : Y ⟶ Y') (Z : C) :
    (ihomIsoTensorLeft (ᘁY') Y').hom.app Z ≫ (ᘁf) ▷ Z =
      (pre f).app Z ≫ (ihomIsoTensorLeft (ᘁY) Y).hom.app Z

name: TauCeti.ihomIsoTensorLeft_inv_app
statement:
theorem ihomIsoTensorLeft_inv_app (Z : C) :
    (ihomIsoTensorLeft D Y).inv.app Z =

name: TauCeti.ihomUnitIso_hom
statement:
theorem ihomUnitIso_hom :

      (λ_ _).inv ≫ η_ D Y ▷ _ ≫ (α_ D Y _).hom ≫ D ◁ (ihom.ev Y).app (𝟙_ C) ≫ (ρ_ D).hom

name: TauCeti.ihomUnitIso_inv
statement: theorem ihomUnitIso_inv : (ihomUnitIso D Y).inv = curry (ε_ D Y)

name: TauCeti.tensorHom_ihomUnitIso_inv_comp_ev

theorem tensorHom_ihomUnitIso_inv_comp_ev {M N : C} (f : M ⟶ Y) (g : N ⟶ D) :
    (f ⊗ₘ (g ≫ (ihomUnitIso D Y).inv)) ≫ (ihom.ev Y).app (𝟙_ C) = (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ ε_ D Y

name: TauCeti.whiskerLeft_ihomIsoTensorLeft_hom_app_comp_evaluation

theorem whiskerLeft_ihomIsoTensorLeft_hom_app_comp_evaluation (Z : C) :
    Y ◁ (ihomIsoTensorLeft D Y).hom.app Z ≫ (α_ Y D Z).inv ≫ ε_ D Y ▷ Z ≫ (λ_ Z).hom =
      (ihom.ev Y).app Z

name: TauCeti.whiskerLeft_ihomIsoTensorLeft_inv_app_comp_ev
statement:

theorem whiskerLeft_ihomIsoTensorLeft_inv_app_comp_ev (Z : C) :
    Y ◁ (ihomIsoTensorLeft D Y).inv.app Z ≫ (ihom.ev Y).app Z =

name: TauCeti.whiskerLeft_ihomUnitIso_inv_comp_ev

theorem whiskerLeft_ihomUnitIso_inv_comp_ev :

name: SheafOfModules.overTensorIso_inv_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.SheafOfModules.overTensorIso_inv_eq
    (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringCatSheaf R)) :
    (M.overTensorIso N X).inv =
        (((_root_.SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringCatSheaf R) X).map
              (sheafificationIso (ringCatSheaf R) M).symm.hom ≫
            (pushforwardSheafificationIso (J := J.over X) (K := J) (Over.forget X)
              (ringCatSheaf R) M.val).hom) ⊗ₘ
          ((_root_.SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringCatSheaf R) X).map
              (sheafificationIso (ringCatSheaf R) N).symm.hom ≫
            (pushforwardSheafificationIso (J := J.over X) (K := J) (Over.forget X)
              (ringCatSheaf R) N.val).hom)) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ
          (PresheafOfModules.pushforward (F := Over.forget X)
              (pushforwardRingIso (J := J.over X) (K := J) (Over.forget X)
                (ringCatSheaf R)).inv ⋙
            PresheafOfModules.sheafification
              (𝟙 ((ringCatSheaf R).over X).obj)) M.val N.val ≫
        (pushforwardSheafificationIso (J := J.over X) (K := J) (Over.forget X)
          (ringCatSheaf R) (M.val ⊗ N.val)).inv ≫
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringCatSheaf R) X).map
          (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ
              (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)) M.val N.val ≫
            ((sheafificationIso (ringCatSheaf R) M).symm.inv ⊗ₘ
              (sheafificationIso (ringCatSheaf R) N).symm.inv))

name: SheafOfModules.overUnitIso_inv_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.SheafOfModules.overUnitIso_inv_eq :
    (_root_.SheafOfModules.overUnitIso (R := R) X).inv =
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε
        (PresheafOfModules.pushforward (F := Over.forget X)
            (pushforwardRingIso (J := J.over X) (K := J) (Over.forget X)
              (ringCatSheaf R)).inv ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.sheafification
            (𝟙 ((ringCatSheaf R).over X).obj)) ≫
      (pushforwardSheafificationIso (J := J.over X) (K := J) (Over.forget X)
        (ringCatSheaf R) (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules (ringCatSheaf R).obj))).inv ≫
      (_root_.SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringCatSheaf R) X).map
        (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η
          (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (ringCatSheaf R).obj)))

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.coev_ihomComparison
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem coev_ihomComparison (A B : C) [Closed A] [Closed (F.obj A)] :
    F.map ((ihom.coev A).app B) ≫
        (ihomComparison F A).natTrans.app (A ⊗ B) =
      (ihom.coev (F.obj A)).app (F.obj B) ≫
        (ihom (F.obj A)).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F A B)

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.ihomComparison_ev
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem ihomComparison_ev (A B : C) [Closed A] [Closed (F.obj A)] :
    F.obj A ◁ (ihomComparison F A).natTrans.app B ≫
        (ihom.ev (F.obj A)).app (F.obj B) =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F A ((ihom A).obj B) ≫ F.map ((ihom.ev A).app B)

name: CategoryTheory.Functor.ihomComparison_whiskerLeft
statement:
theorem ihomComparison_whiskerLeft {A A' : C} [Closed A] [Closed A']
    [Closed (F.obj A)] [Closed (F.obj A')] (f : A' ⟶ A) :
    (ihomComparison F A).whiskerBottom (pre (F.map f)) =
      (ihomComparison F A').whiskerTop (pre f)

name: SheafOfModules.overIhomComparison_ev
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem _root_.SheafOfModules.overIhomComparison_ev
    (M N : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (ringCatSheaf R)) :
    (M.over X) ◁ (M.overIhomComparison R X).natTrans.app N ≫
        (ihom.ev (M.over X)).app (N.over X) =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ
          (_root_.SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringCatSheaf R) X)
          M ((ihom M).obj N) ≫
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringCatSheaf R) X).map
          ((ihom.ev M).app N)

name: TauCeti.Quaternion.commute_iff
statement:
theorem commute_iff :
    Commute x y ↔
      2 * (x.imJ * y.imK - x.imK * y.imJ) = 0 ∧
        2 * (x.imK * y.imI - x.imI * y.imK) = 0 ∧
        2 * (x.imI * y.imJ - x.imJ * y.imI) = 0

name: TauCeti.Quaternion.commute_iff'

    Commute x y ↔
      x.imJ * y.imK = x.imK * y.imJ ∧
        x.imK * y.imI = x.imI * y.imK ∧
        x.imI * y.imJ = x.imJ * y.imI

theorem tensorProductMap_frobeniusAlgHom_pow_apply (n : ℕ) (z : S ⊗[K] T) :

      cofreeEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (P := P) φ
        = (TensorProduct.rid R M).toLinearMap ∘ₗ

theorem cofreeUnit_apply [Comodule R C P] (p : P) :
    cofreeUnit (R := R) (C := C) P p = coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P) p

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.cofreeUnit_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cofreeUnit_toLinearMap [Comodule R C P] :
    (cofreeUnit (R := R) (C := C) P).toLinearMap = coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := P)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofree_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cofree_coact :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] C)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M

name: TauCeti.Comodule.cofree_coact_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cofree_coact_tmul (m : M) (c : C) :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] C) (m ⊗ₜ c)
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).symm (m ⊗ₜ Coalgebra.comul c)

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.cofree_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cofree_coact :

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.cofree_coact_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cofree_coact_tmul (m : M) (c : C) :

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.cofree_toSemimoduleCat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cofree_toSemimoduleCat : (cofree R C M).toSemimoduleCat = SemimoduleCat.of R (M ⊗[R] C)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.dualCoact_coassoc
statement:
theorem dualCoact_coassoc :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (Module.Dual R M) H H ∘ₗ
        (dualCoact (R := R) (H := H) (M := M)).rTensor H ∘ₗ
          dualCoact (R := R) (H := H) (M := M) =
      (Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := H)).lTensor (Module.Dual R M) ∘ₗ
        dualCoact (R := R) (H := H) (M := M)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.dualCoact_counit
statement:
theorem dualCoact_counit : (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := H)).lTensor (Module.Dual R M) ∘ₗ
        dualCoact (R := R) (H := H) (M := M) =
      (TensorProduct.mk R (Module.Dual R M) R).flip 1

name: TauCeti.Comodule.dualTensorHom_dualCoact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualTensorHom_dualCoact (φ : Module.Dual R M) :
    dualTensorHom R M H (dualCoact (R := R) (H := H) (M := M) φ) =
      (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := H)).comp
        (matrixCoefficientBilinear (R := R) (C := H) (M := M) φ)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.dualTensorHom_dualCoact_apply
statement:
theorem dualTensorHom_dualCoact_apply (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    dualTensorHom R M H (dualCoact (R := R) (H := H) (M := M) φ) m =
      HopfAlgebra.antipode R
        (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := H) φ m)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.dual_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dual_coact :
    coact (R := R) (C := H) (M := Module.Dual R M) =
      dualCoact (R := R) (H := H) (M := M)

name: Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation_one_tmul_baseChange
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation_one_tmul_baseChange
    {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (φ : Module.Dual R N) (t : A ⊗[R] M) :
    baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := N) (A := A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] φ) (f.baseChange A t) =
      baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] (φ.comp f)) t

name: TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluationEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeEvaluationEquiv_apply (z : A ⊗[R] Module.Dual R M) :
    baseChangeEvaluationEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (M := M) z =
      baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A) z

name: TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation_one_tmul
statement:
theorem baseChangeEvaluation_one_tmul (φ : Module.Dual R M) :
    baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] φ) =
      Module.Dual.baseChange A φ

name: TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeEvaluation_tmul (a b : A) (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A) (a ⊗ₜ[R] φ) (b ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      a * b * algebraMap R A (φ m)

name: TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChange_coord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChange_coord {ι : Type*} (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (i : ι) (z : A ⊗[R] M) :
    ((TensorProduct.isBaseChange R M A).basis b).repr z i =
      Module.Dual.baseChange A (b.coord i) z

name: TauCeti.Module.Dual.eq_of_baseChange_eq
TauCeti.Comodule.baseChangeEvaluation_dual_endOfPoint
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeEvaluation_dual_endOfPoint (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))
    (ξ : A ⊗[R] Module.Dual R M) (z : A ⊗[R] M) :
    TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)
        (endOfPoint (Module.Dual R M) g.ofConv ξ) z =
      TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A) ξ
        (endOfPoint M (g⁻¹).ofConv z)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.baseChangeEvaluation_dual_endOfPoint_invariant
statement:
-- Prefer invariance before adjointness simplifies the first action.
@[simp↓]
theorem baseChangeEvaluation_dual_endOfPoint_invariant (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))
    (ξ : A ⊗[R] Module.Dual R M) (z : A ⊗[R] M) :
    TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)
        (endOfPoint (Module.Dual R M) g.ofConv ξ) (endOfPoint M g.ofConv z) =
      TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A) ξ z

name: TauCeti.Comodule.baseChangeEvaluation_dual_endOfPoint_tmul
statement:
-- Prefer the characteristic evaluation formula before the dual action itself is simplified.
@[simp↓]
theorem baseChangeEvaluation_dual_endOfPoint_tmul (g : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))
    (a b : A) (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)
        (endOfPoint (Module.Dual R M) g.ofConv (a ⊗ₜ[R] φ)) (b ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      a * b * (g⁻¹).ofConv (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := H) φ m)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.baseChangeEvaluation_endOfPoint_tmul
statement:
-- Prefer the characteristic evaluation formula before `endOfPoint_tmul` expands the inner action.
@[simp↓]
theorem baseChangeEvaluation_endOfPoint_tmul (g : H →ₐ[R] A)
    (a b : A) (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    TauCeti.Module.Dual.baseChangeEvaluation (R := R) (M := M) (A := A) (a ⊗ₜ[R] φ)
        (endOfPoint M g (b ⊗ₜ[R] m)) =
      a * b * g (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := H) φ m)

name: Module.Basis.coordinateSpanIsStable_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateSpanIsStable_iff (b : Basis ι R M) (s : Set ι) :
    b.coordinateSpanIsStable (C := C) s ↔
      ∀ i, i ∉ s → ∀ j, j ∈ s → coefficientMatrix (C := C) b i j = 0

name: Module.Basis.coordinateSpanSubcomodule_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateSpanSubcomodule_toSubmodule (b : Basis ι R M) (s : Set ι)
    [Finite ι] (h : b.coordinateSpanIsStable (C := C) s) :
    (b.coordinateSpanSubcomodule s h).toSubmodule = Submodule.span R (b '' s)

name: Module.Basis.exists_subcomodule_toSubmodule_eq_span_iff_coordinateSpanIsStable
statement:
theorem exists_subcomodule_toSubmodule_eq_span_iff_coordinateSpanIsStable [Finite ι]
    (b : Basis ι R M) (s : Set ι) :
    (∃ N : Subcomodule R C M, N.toSubmodule = Submodule.span R (b '' s)) ↔
      b.coordinateSpanIsStable (C := C) s

name: Module.Basis.mem_coordinateSpanSubcomodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coordinateSpanSubcomodule (b : Basis ι R M) (s : Set ι)
    [Finite ι] (h : b.coordinateSpanIsStable (C := C) s) (m : M) :
    m ∈ b.coordinateSpanSubcomodule s h ↔ m ∈ Submodule.span R (b '' s)

name: Module.Basis.mem_weightCoordinateSpanSubcomodule
statement:

theorem mem_weightCoordinateSpanSubcomodule (b : Basis ι R M) (weight : ι → α) (r : α)
    [Finite ι]
    (h : (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b).BlockTriangular (OrderDual.toDual ∘ weight)) (m : M) :
    m ∈ b.weightCoordinateSpanSubcomodule weight r h ↔
      m ∈ Submodule.span R (b '' {i | r ≤ weight i})

name: Module.Basis.weightCoordinateSpanIsStable_iff_blockTriangular
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightCoordinateSpanIsStable_iff_blockTriangular (b : Basis ι R M) (weight : ι → α) :
    b.weightCoordinateSpanIsStable (C := C) weight ↔
      (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b).BlockTriangular (OrderDual.toDual ∘ weight)

name: Module.Basis.weightCoordinateSpanSubcomodule_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightCoordinateSpanSubcomodule_toSubmodule (b : Basis ι R M) (weight : ι → α) (r : α)
    [Finite ι]
    (h : (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b).BlockTriangular (OrderDual.toDual ∘ weight)) :
    (b.weightCoordinateSpanSubcomodule weight r h).toSubmodule =
      Submodule.span R (b '' {i | r ≤ weight i})

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.liftQ_unique

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coact_basis_mem_flag
statement:
theorem coact_basis_mem_flag (b : Basis (Fin n) k M)
    (h : (coefficientMatrix (C := H) b).IsUpperTriangular)
    {i : Fin n} {r : Fin (n + 1)} (hir : i.castSucc < r) :
    coact (C := H) (b i) ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (TensorProduct.map (b.flag r).subtype (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[k] H))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coefficientMatrix_isUpperTriangular_and_diag_iff
statement:
theorem coefficientMatrix_isUpperTriangular_and_diag_iff (b : Basis (Fin n) k M) (c : Fin n → H) :
    ((coefficientMatrix (C := H) b).IsUpperTriangular ∧
        ∀ i : Fin n, coefficientMatrix (C := H) b i i = c i) ↔
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        TensorProduct.map (b.flag i.castSucc).mkQ (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[k] H)
            (coact (C := H) (b i)) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (b i) ⊗ₜ[k] c i

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coefficientMatrix_isUpperUnitriangular_iff
statement:
theorem coefficientMatrix_isUpperUnitriangular_iff [One H] (b : Basis (Fin n) k M) :
    (coefficientMatrix (C := H) b).IsUpperUnitriangular ↔
      ∀ i : Fin n,
        TensorProduct.map (b.flag i.castSucc).mkQ (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[k] H)
            (coact (C := H) (b i)) =
          Submodule.Quotient.mk (b i) ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : H)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.quotientCoact_flagSubcomodule_mk_basis
statement:

    [One H]
    (b : Basis (Fin n) k M)
    (h : (coefficientMatrix (C := H) b).IsUpperUnitriangular) (i : Fin n) :
    let N := flagSubcomodule (H := H) b h.isUpperTriangular i.castSucc
    N.quotientCoact (Submodule.Quotient.mk (b i)) =

statement:
theorem exists_isGroupLikeElem_coact_eq_tmul_of_mem_range {v : M} (hv : v ≠ 0)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Prod_coact
statement:

name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodCoact_apply (x : M × N) :
    prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) x =
      TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.inl R M N) LinearMap.id
          (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) x.1) +
        TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.inr R M N) LinearMap.id
          (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) x.2)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_coassoc
statement:
theorem prodCoact_coassoc :

        (prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C ∘ₗ
          prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M × N) ∘ₗ
        prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.prodCoact_counit
statement:
theorem prodCoact_counit :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M × N) ∘ₗ
        prodCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      (TensorProduct.mk R (M × N) R).flip 1

        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) n)

-- `Monoid.End` is definitionally a bundled `MonoidHom`; the `show` picks its composition monoid
-- structure before the power is elaborated.
theorem Monoid.End.pow_eq_of_add_eq_comp (f : ℕ → M →* M) (h0 : f 0 = MonoidHom.id M)
    (hadd : ∀ a b, f (a + b) = (f a).comp (f b)) (k m : ℕ) :
    (show Monoid.End M from f k) ^ m = f (k * m)

name: TauCeti.freeCommMonoidCharEquiv_apply

name: TauCeti.freeCommMonoidCharEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem freeCommMonoidCharEquiv_comp {N : Type*} [CommMonoid N] (ψ : M →* N)
    (χ : Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℕ) →* M) (i : σ) :
    freeCommMonoidCharEquiv (ψ.comp χ) i = ψ (freeCommMonoidCharEquiv χ i)

name: TauCeti.freeCommMonoidCharEquiv_symm_apply_ofAdd

theorem freeCommMonoidCharEquiv_symm_apply_ofAdd (c : σ → M) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (freeCommMonoidCharEquiv (M := M)).symm c (Multiplicative.ofAdd m) =
      m.prod fun i n => c i ^ n

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) : (normalizerEquivMap H e g : K) = e (g : G)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_refl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerEquivMap_refl (H : Subgroup G) (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerEquivMap H (MulEquiv.refl G) g =
      ⟨(g : G), by simp [g.2]⟩

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    ((normalizerEquivMap H e).symm k : G) = e.symm (k : K)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe' (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) e.symm k : G) = e.symm (k : K)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_trans_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerEquivMap_trans_apply_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) (f : K ≃* L)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f (normalizerEquivMap H e g) : L) =
      f (e (g : G))

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K))
        (normalizerEquivMap H e g)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk_coe
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_mk_coe (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K))
        ⟨e (g : G), by
          rw [← normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe H e g]
          exact (normalizerEquivMap H e g).2⟩

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap H (MulEquiv.refl G) (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk (H.map ((MulEquiv.refl G : G ≃* G) : G →* G))
        ⟨(g : G), by simp [g.2]⟩

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk_congr
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_refl_mk_congr (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientCongr
        (by rw [MulEquiv.coe_monoidHom_refl, _root_.Subgroup.map_id] :
          H.map ((MulEquiv.refl G : G ≃* G) : G →* G) = H)
      (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H (MulEquiv.refl G) (normalizerQuotientMk H g)) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H g

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e).symm (normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K)) k) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H ((normalizerEquivMap H e).symm k)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_symm_mk' (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K)
    (k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) e.symm
        (normalizerQuotientMk (H.map (e : G →* K)) k) =
      normalizerQuotientMk ((H.map (e : G →* K)).map (e.symm : K →* G))
        (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) e.symm k)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) (f : K ≃* L)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f
        (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g)) =
      normalizerQuotientMk ((H.map (e : G →* K)).map (f : K →* L))
        (normalizerEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f (normalizerEquivMap H e g))

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk_congr
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivMap_trans_mk_congr (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) (f : K ≃* L)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientCongr
        (by rw [_root_.Subgroup.map_map, ← MulEquiv.coe_monoidHom_trans] :
          (H.map (e : G →* K)).map (f : K →* L) =
            H.map ((e.trans f : G ≃* L) : G →* L))
      (normalizerQuotientEquivMap (H.map (e : G →* K)) f
        (normalizerQuotientEquivMap H e (normalizerQuotientMk H g))) =
      normalizerQuotientEquivMap H (e.trans f) (normalizerQuotientMk H g)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.subgroupOf_map_normalizerEquivMap
statement:
lemma subgroupOf_map_normalizerEquivMap (H : Subgroup G) (e : G ≃* K) :
    (H.subgroupOf (_root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G))).map ((normalizerEquivMap H e :
          _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) ≃*
            _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) :
          _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →*
            _root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K)) =
      (H.map (e : G →* K)).subgroupOf
        (_root_.Subgroup.normalizer ((H.map (e : G →* K)) : Set K))

name: Subgroup.zpowers_mk_self_eq_top

@[to_additive (attr := simp)

statement:
@[simp]
lemma orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_bot_eq (H : Subgroup G) :
    Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ H)) =
      (fun x : X => (Quotient.mk'' x : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X)) ∘
        orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv (G := G) (X := X)

name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_bot_eq_iff
statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotientMapOfLE_bot_eq_iff (H : Subgroup G)
    (x y : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (⊥ : Subgroup G) X) :
    Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ H)) x =
        Setoid.map_of_le (orbitRel_le_of_subgroup_le (G := G) (X := X)
          (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ H)) y ↔
      orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv (G := G) (X := X) x ∈
        _root_.MulAction.orbit H (orbitRelQuotientBotEquiv (G := G) (X := X) y)

statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_mul_inv_mem [IsCancelSMul G X] (H : Subgroup G)
    (x : X) (g k : G) : (Quotient.mk'' (g • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
        Quotient.mk'' (k • x) ↔
      g * k⁻¹ ∈ H

name: TauCeti.MulAction.orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_normalizerQuotientMk_inv_eq
statement:
lemma orbitRelQuotient_smul_eq_smul_iff_normalizerQuotientMk_inv_eq [IsCancelSMul G X]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.Normal] (x : X) (g k : G) :
    (Quotient.mk'' (g • x) : _root_.MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient H X) =
        Quotient.mk'' (k • x) ↔
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H
          ⟨g⁻¹, by simp [_root_.Subgroup.normalizer_eq_top (H := H)]⟩ =
        Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H
          ⟨k⁻¹, by simp [_root_.Subgroup.normalizer_eq_top (H := H)]⟩

name: HomologicalComplex.ι_tensorObj_d
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma ι_tensorObj_d (X Y : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (p q j : ℤ)
    (hpq : p + q = j) :
    ιTensorObj X Y p q j hpq ≫ (X ⊗ Y).d j (j + 1) =
      ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{v} R)).map (X.d p (p + 1))).app (Y.X q) ≫
        ιTensorObj X Y (p + 1) q (j + 1) (by omega) +
      p.negOnePow •
        ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{v} R)).obj (X.X p)).map (Y.d q (q + 1)) ≫
          ιTensorObj X Y p (q + 1) (j + 1) (by omega)

name: TauCeti.dgRightModuleCochainCompTensor_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgRightModuleCochainCompTensor_tmul (p q j : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = j)
    (g : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳN) (ℳN := ℳP) p)
    (f : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) q) :
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom
        (A := ModuleCat.of R
            (dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳN) (ℳN := ℳP) p) ⊗
          ModuleCat.of R
            (dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) q))
        (B := ModuleCat.of R
          (dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳP) j))
        (dgRightModuleCochainCompTensor (hM := hM) (hN := hN) (hP := hP) p q j hpq)
        (g ⊗ₜ f) = dgRightModuleCochains.comp g f hpq

name: TauCeti.dgRightModuleCochains.add_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_comp {p q j : ℤ}
    (g g' : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳN) (ℳN := ℳP) p)
    (f : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) q)

theorem comp_add {p q j : ℤ}

statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply {p q j : ℤ}
    (g : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳN) (ℳN := ℳP) p)

name: TauCeti.dgRightModuleCochains.comp_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_assoc {Q : Type u} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [Module Aᵐᵒᵖ Q]
    [IsScalarTower R Aᵐᵒᵖ Q]
    {ℳQ : ℤ → Submodule R Q}
    {r p q j : ℤ}
    (k : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳP) (ℳN := ℳQ) r)
    (g : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳN) (ℳN := ℳP) p)
    (f : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) q)
    (hrpq : (r + p) + q = j) :
    comp (comp k g rfl) f hrpq = comp k (comp g f rfl) (by omega)

name: TauCeti.dgRightModuleCochains.comp_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_id {p : ℤ}
    (f : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) p) :

name: TauCeti.dgRightModuleCochains.comp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_smul {p q j : ℤ} (r : R)
    (g : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳN) (ℳN := ℳP) p)
    (f : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) q)

name: TauCeti.dgRightModuleCochains.comp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_zero {p q j : ℤ}

    (hpq : p + q = j) :
    comp g (0 : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) q)
      hpq = 0

name: TauCeti.dgRightModuleCochains.differential_comp
statement:
theorem differential_comp {p q : ℤ}
    (g : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳN) (ℳN := ℳP) p)
    (f : dgRightModuleCochains (R := R) (A := A) (ℳ := ℳ) (ℳN := ℳN) q) :
    differential (hM := hM) (hN := hP) (p + q) (comp g f rfl) =
      comp (differential (hM := hN) (hN := hP) p g) f (by omega) +
        p.negOnePow • comp g (differential (hM := hM) (hN := hN) q f) (by omega)

@[simp]
theorem smul_comp {p q j : ℤ} (r : R)

statement:

name: HomologicalComplex.ι_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma ι_whiskerLeft (X : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ)
    {Y Z : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ} (g : Y ⟶ Z) (p q j : ℤ) (h : p + q = j) :
    ιTensorObj X Y p q j h ≫ (X ◁ g).f j = (X.X p ◁ g.f q) ≫ ιTensorObj X Z p q j h

name: HomologicalComplex.ι_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma ι_whiskerRight {X Y : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (Z : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (p q j : ℤ) (h : p + q = j) :
    ιTensorObj X Z p q j h ≫ (f ▷ Z).f j = (f.f p ▷ Z.X q) ≫ ιTensorObj Y Z p q j h

name: HomologicalComplex.ι_ι_associator_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ι_ι_associator_hom (X Y Z : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (p q r j : ℤ)
    (h : p + q + r = j) :
    (ιTensorObj X Y p q (p + q) rfl ▷ Z.X r) ≫
        ιTensorObj (X ⊗ Y) Z (p + q) r j h ≫ (α_ X Y Z).hom.f j =
      (α_ (X.X p) (Y.X q) (Z.X r)).hom ≫ (X.X p ◁ ιTensorObj Y Z q r (q + r) rfl) ≫
        ιTensorObj X (Y ⊗ Z) p (q + r) j (by omega)

name: TauCeti.add_dgComp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_dgComp {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (f f' : DGHom R p X Y) (g : DGHom R q Y Z)
    (h : p + q = n) : dgComp R (f + f') g h = dgComp R f g h + dgComp R f' g h

name: TauCeti.dgCompMap_def
statement:
theorem dgCompMap_def (X Y Z : C) (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) :
    dgCompMap R X Y Z p q n h =
      ιTensorObj (dgHomComplex R X Y) (dgHomComplex R Y Z) p q n h ≫
        (eComp (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) X Y Z).f n

name: TauCeti.dgCompMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgCompMap_tmul {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (h : p + q = n) (f : DGHom R p X Y)
    (g : DGHom R q Y Z) :
    (dgCompMap R X Y Z p q n h).hom (f ⊗ₜ g) = dgComp R f g h

name: TauCeti.dgComp_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgComp_add {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p X Y) (g g' : DGHom R q Y Z)
    (h : p + q = n) : dgComp R f (g + g') h = dgComp R f g h + dgComp R f g' h

name: TauCeti.dgComp_assoc
statement:
theorem dgComp_assoc {W X Y Z : C} {p q r pq qr n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p W X) (g : DGHom R q X Y)
    (k : DGHom R r Y Z) (hpq : p + q = pq) (hqr : q + r = qr) (hn : p + q + r = n) :
    dgComp R (dgComp R f g hpq) k (by omega : pq + r = n) =
      dgComp R f (dgComp R g k hqr) (by rw [← hqr, ← hn, add_assoc])

name: TauCeti.dgComp_dgId
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgComp_dgId {X Y : C} {p : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p X Y) :
    dgComp R f (dgId R Y) (add_zero p) = f

name: TauCeti.dgComp_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgComp_neg {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p X Y) (g : DGHom R q Y Z)
    (h : p + q = n) : dgComp R f (-g) h = -dgComp R f g h

name: TauCeti.dgComp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgComp_smul {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (r : R) (f : DGHom R p X Y) (g : DGHom R q Y Z)
    (h : p + q = n) : dgComp R f (r • g) h = r • dgComp R f g h

name: TauCeti.dgComp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgComp_zero {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p X Y) (h : p + q = n) :
    dgComp R f (0 : DGHom R q Y Z) h = 0

name: TauCeti.dgDifferential_dgComp
statement:
theorem dgDifferential_dgComp {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p X Y) (g : DGHom R q Y Z)
    (h : p + q = n) :
    dgDifferential R n (dgComp R f g h) =
      dgComp R (dgDifferential R p f) g (by omega) +
        p.negOnePow • dgComp R f (dgDifferential R q g) (by omega)

name: TauCeti.dgDifferential_dgDifferential
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgDifferential_dgDifferential {X Y : C} {n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R n X Y) :

name: TauCeti.dgDifferential_dgId

theorem dgDifferential_dgId (X : C) : dgDifferential R 0 (dgId R X) = 0

name: TauCeti.dgId_dgComp

name: TauCeti.neg_dgComp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_dgComp {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (f : DGHom R p X Y) (g : DGHom R q Y Z)

name: TauCeti.smul_dgComp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_dgComp {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (r : R) (f : DGHom R p X Y) (g : DGHom R q Y Z)

name: TauCeti.zero_dgComp

theorem zero_dgComp {X Y Z : C} {p q n : ℤ} (g : DGHom R q Y Z) (h : p + q = n) :

name: TauCeti.DGCategoryData.ofKeller_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofKeller_comp {X Y Z : C} (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (f : (hom X Y).X p)
    (g : (hom Y Z).X q) :
    (ofKeller hom comp id d_comp comp_assoc comp_id id_comp).comp p q n h f g =
      (p * q).negOnePow • comp q p n (by omega) g f

name: TauCeti.DGCategoryData.ofKeller_hom

    (ρ_ (D.hom X Y)).inv ≫ D.hom X Y ◁ D.enrichedId Y ≫ D.enrichedComp X Y Y = 𝟙 _

name: TauCeti.DGHomotopyCategory.homOf_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_add {X Y : C} (f g : DGHom R 0 X Y)
    (hf : f ∈ dgCycles R X Y) (hg : g ∈ dgCycles R X Y) :
    homOf R (f + g) ((dgCycles R X Y).add_mem hf hg) = homOf R f hf + homOf R g hg

name: TauCeti.DGHomotopyCategory.homOf_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_comp {X Y Z : C} (f : DGHom R 0 X Y) (g : DGHom R 0 Y Z)
    (hf : f ∈ dgCycles R X Y) (hg : g ∈ dgCycles R Y Z) :
    homOf R f hf ≫ homOf R g hg =
      homOf R (dgCompZero R f g) (dgCompZero_mem_dgCycles R hf hg)

name: TauCeti.DGHomotopyCategory.homOf_dgId
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_dgId (X : C) :
    homOf R (dgId R X) ((mem_dgCycles R).mpr (dgDifferential_dgId R X)) = 𝟙 (of R X)

name: TauCeti.DGHomotopyCategory.homOf_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_eq_iff {X Y : C} {f g : DGHom R 0 X Y}
    (hf : f ∈ dgCycles R X Y) (hg : g ∈ dgCycles R X Y) :
    homOf R f hf = homOf R g hg ↔ f - g ∈ dgBoundaries R X Y

name: TauCeti.DGHomotopyCategory.homOf_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOf_eq_zero_iff {X Y : C} {f : DGHom R 0 X Y} (hf : f ∈ dgCycles R X Y) :
    homOf R f hf = 0 ↔ f ∈ dgBoundaries R X Y

name: TauCeti.DGHomotopyCategory.homOf_zero
statement:

theorem homOf_zero (X Y : C) :
    homOf R (0 : DGHom R 0 X Y) (dgCycles R X Y).zero_mem = 0

theorem coe_dgCyclesComp {X Y Z : C} (f : dgCycles R X Y) (g : dgCycles R Y Z) :

statement:

name: TauCeti.dgCompZero_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dgCompZero_add {X Y Z : C} (f : DGHom R 0 X Y) (g g' : DGHom R 0 Y Z) :

name: TauCeti.dgCompZero_def
statement:
theorem dgCompZero_def {X Y Z : C} (f : DGHom R 0 X Y) (g : DGHom R 0 Y Z) :
