name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldMap_section_bijective
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_section_bijective (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) :
    Function.Bijective (s.residueFieldMap y)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.residueFieldRingEquivOfSection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma residueFieldRingEquivOfSection_apply (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 (Spec (.of K)))
    (z : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)))) :
    residueFieldRingEquivOfSection hs z =
      X.descResidueField (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo s) z

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.section_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma section_apply (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (y : S) : f (s y) = y

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.stalkClosedPointTo_surjective_of_section
statement:
lemma stalkClosedPointTo_surjective_of_section (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 (Spec (.of K))) :
    Function.Surjective (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo s)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.algebraMap_zeroResidueField
statement:
@[simp]
lemma algebraMap_zeroResidueField (A : AbelianVariety K) (k : K) :
    algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (A.toScheme.presheaf.stalk A.zeroPoint)) k =
      A.zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv.symm k

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_dim
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_dim (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).dim =
      topologicalKrullDim
        (Limits.pullback A.toOver.hom
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) : Scheme.{u})

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_inv (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    ι[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map ι[A.toOver]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_mul (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    μ[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ⊗ₘ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L)) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) A.toOver A.toOver ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map μ[A.toOver]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_one (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    η[(A.baseChange L).toOver] ≫ eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map η[A.toOver]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_toOver
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_toOver (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).toOver =
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).obj A.toOver

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChange_toScheme
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_toScheme (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    (A.baseChange L).toScheme =
      Limits.pullback A.toOver.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.commGrpMk_baseChange_toOver
statement:
lemma commGrpMk_baseChange_toOver (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    CommGrp.mk (A.baseChange L).toOver =
      (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).mapCommGrp.obj
        (CommGrp.mk A.toOver)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_def
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dim_def (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    A.dim = topologicalKrullDim A.toScheme

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_inv (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    ι[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) =
      eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) ≫ ι[G]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_mul (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    μ[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) =
      (eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) ⊗ₘ
          eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G)) ≫ μ[G]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_one (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] :
    η[(ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver] ≫
        eqToHom (ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver G) = η[G]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofGeometricallyIntegral_toOver (G : Over (Spec (.of K))) [GrpObj G]
    [IsProper G.hom] [GeometricallyIntegral G.hom] : (ofGeometricallyIntegral G).toOver = G

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.toOver_hom_zeroPoint
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toOver_hom_zeroPoint (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    A.toOver.hom A.zeroPoint = IsLocalRing.closedPoint K

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.zeroPoint_def
statement:
lemma zeroPoint_def (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    A.zeroPoint = A.zeroSection (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv_apply (A : AbelianVariety K)
    (z : IsLocalRing.ResidueField (A.toScheme.presheaf.stalk A.zeroPoint)) :
    A.zeroResidueFieldRingEquiv z =
      A.toScheme.descResidueField (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo A.zeroSection)
        (A.zeroPoint_def ▸ z)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom
statement:
lemma zeroSection_comp_toOver_hom (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    A.zeroSection ≫ A.toOver.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of K))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.ext
TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.inv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma Hom.inv_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    ι[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f = Hom.toOverHom f ≫ ι[B.toOver]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma Hom.mul_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    μ[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f =
      (Hom.toOverHom f ⊗ₘ Hom.toOverHom f) ≫ μ[B.toOver]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.one_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma Hom.one_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    η[A.toOver] ≫ Hom.toOverHom f = η[B.toOver]

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma Hom.toOverHom_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Hom.toOverHom (f ≫ g) = Hom.toOverHom f ≫ Hom.toOverHom g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_id
statement: lemma Hom.toOverHom_id (A : AbelianVariety K) : Hom.toOverHom (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 A.toOver

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_injective
statement:
lemma Hom.toOverHom_injective {A B : AbelianVariety K} {f g : A ⟶ B}
    (h : Hom.toOverHom f = Hom.toOverHom g) : f = g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_mk'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.toOverHom_mk' {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver)
    (one_f : η[A.toOver] ≫ f = η[B.toOver] := by cat_disch)
    (mul_f : μ[A.toOver] ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ μ[B.toOver] := by cat_disch) :
    Hom.toOverHom (Hom.mk' f one_f mul_f) = f

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.toSchemeFunctor_map {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (Hom.toSchemeFunctor (K := K)).map f =
      eqToHom (Hom.toSchemeFunctor_obj A) ≫ Hom.toSchemeHom f ≫
        eqToHom (Hom.toSchemeFunctor_obj B).symm

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.toSchemeFunctor_obj (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    (Hom.toSchemeFunctor (K := K)).obj A = A.toScheme

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (f ≫ g) = Hom.toSchemeHom f ≫ Hom.toSchemeHom g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`: `CategoryTheory.Over.w` is already a simp lemma and discharges this goal.
@[reassoc]
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom f ≫ B.toOver.hom = A.toOver.hom

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_id (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 A.toScheme

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_mk'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_mk' {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A.toOver ⟶ B.toOver)
    (one_f : η[A.toOver] ≫ f = η[B.toOver] := by cat_disch)
    (mul_f : μ[A.toOver] ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ μ[B.toOver] := by cat_disch) :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (Hom.mk' f one_f mul_f) = f.left

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_div
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_div {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g h : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ (g / h) = (f ≫ g) / (f ≫ h)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_inv
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_inv {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ g⁻¹ = (f ≫ g)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_mul
statement:
@[simp, reassoc] lemma comp_mul {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g h : B ⟶ C) :
    f ≫ (g * h) = f ≫ g * f ≫ h

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_one {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    f ≫ (1 : B ⟶ C) = 1

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.comp_zpow
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_zpow {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (n : ℤ) :
    f ≫ (g ^ n) = (f ≫ g) ^ n

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.div_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma div_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (f / g) ≫ h = (f ≫ h) / (g ≫ h)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.homMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homMulEquiv_apply (f : A ⟶ B) :
    homMulEquiv A B f = f.hom.hom

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.inv_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma inv_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    f⁻¹ ≫ h = (f ≫ h)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.leftComp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma leftComp_apply {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    leftComp C f g = f ≫ g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.mul_comp
statement:
@[simp, reassoc] lemma mul_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B) (h : B ⟶ C) :
    (f * g) ≫ h = f ≫ h * g ≫ h

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.one_comp
statement: @[simp] lemma one_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (h : B ⟶ C) : (1 : A ⟶ B) ≫ h = 1

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.rightComp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightComp_apply {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    rightComp A g f = f ≫ g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_div
statement:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_div (f g : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom (f / g) = toOverHom f / toOverHom g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_inv
statement:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_inv (f : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom f⁻¹ = (toOverHom f)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_mul (f g : A ⟶ B) :
    toOverHom (f * g) = toOverHom f * toOverHom g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma toOverHom_one :
    toOverHom (1 : A ⟶ B) = 1

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.zpow_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma zpow_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (n : ℤ) :
    (f ^ n) ≫ g = (f ≫ g) ^ n

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {x y : End A} (h : toHom x = toHom y) : x = y

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.ofHom_toHom
statement: @[simp] lemma ofHom_toHom (x : End A) : ofHom (toHom x) = x

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_inj
statement: @[simp] lemma toHom_inj {x y : End A} : toHom x = toHom y ↔ x = y

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_injective
statement: lemma toHom_injective : Function.Injective (toHom : End A → (A ⟶ A))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_intCast
statement: lemma toHom_intCast (n : ℤ) : toHom (n : End A) = 𝟙 A ^ n

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_natCast
statement: lemma toHom_natCast (n : ℕ) : toHom (n : End A) = 𝟙 A ^ n

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.End.toHom_ofHom
statement: @[simp] lemma toHom_ofHom (f : A ⟶ A) : toHom (ofHom f) = f

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom_apply {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChangeMonoidHom A B L f = Hom.baseChange f L

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChange_comp {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f ≫ g) L = Hom.baseChange f L ≫ Hom.baseChange g L

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_div
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChange_div {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f / g) L = Hom.baseChange f L / Hom.baseChange g L

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChange_id (A : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (𝟙 A) L = 𝟙 (A.baseChange L)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChange_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange f⁻¹ L = (Hom.baseChange f L)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChange_mul {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f g : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f * g) L = Hom.baseChange f L * Hom.baseChange g L

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChange_one (A B : AbelianVariety K) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (1 : A ⟶ B) L = 1

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.baseChange_zpow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.baseChange_zpow {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.baseChange (f ^ n) L = Hom.baseChange f L ^ n

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toOverHom_baseChange
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.toOverHom_baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.toOverHom (Hom.baseChange f L) =
      eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map
          (Hom.toOverHom f) ≫
        eqToHom (baseChange_toOver B L).symm

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.Hom.toSchemeHom_baseChange
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_baseChange {A B : AbelianVariety K} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Hom.toSchemeHom (Hom.baseChange f L) =
      (eqToHom (baseChange_toOver A L) ≫
        (Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))).map
          (Hom.toOverHom f) ≫
        eqToHom (baseChange_toOver B L).symm).left

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChangeFunctor_map {A B : AbelianVariety K} (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    (f : A ⟶ B) : (baseChangeFunctor L).map f =
      eqToHom (baseChangeFunctor_obj L A) ≫ Hom.baseChange f L ≫
        eqToHom (baseChangeFunctor_obj L B).symm

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.baseChangeFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChangeFunctor_obj (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    (baseChangeFunctor L).obj A = A.baseChange L

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_eq_of_iso
statement:
lemma dim_eq_of_iso {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    A.dim = B.dim

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToOver_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToOver e).hom = Hom.toOverHom e.hom

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToOver_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToOver e).inv = Hom.toOverHom e.inv

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_refl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToOver_refl (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    isoToOver (Iso.refl A) = Iso.refl A.toOver

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToOver_symm {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    isoToOver e.symm = (isoToOver e).symm

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToOver_trans
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToOver_trans {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ≅ C) :
    isoToOver (e.trans f) = (isoToOver e).trans (isoToOver f)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToScheme_hom {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToScheme e).hom = Hom.toSchemeHom e.hom

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToScheme_inv {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    (isoToScheme e).inv = Hom.toSchemeHom e.inv

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_refl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToScheme_refl (A : AbelianVariety K) :
    isoToScheme (Iso.refl A) = Iso.refl A.toScheme

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_symm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToScheme_symm {A B : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) :
    isoToScheme e.symm = (isoToScheme e).symm

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.isoToScheme_trans
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isoToScheme_trans {A B C : AbelianVariety K} (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ≅ C) :
    isoToScheme (e.trans f) = (isoToScheme e).trans (isoToScheme f)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.IsIsogeny.baseChange
statement:
lemma baseChange (hf : IsIsogeny f) (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianVariety.dim_baseChange_trivial
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`: `baseChange_dim` already rewrites the left-hand side. It does not, however,
-- prove this lemma: `baseChange_dim` computes no dimension, it only replaces the left-hand side
-- by `topologicalKrullDim (pullback (trivial K).toOver.hom (Spec.map (algebraMap K L)))`, a goal
-- that neither `dim_trivial` nor the simp set can discharge. The content below is that base
-- change preserves the terminal object, via `baseChangeTrivialIso`.
lemma dim_baseChange_trivial (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    ((trivial K).baseChange L).dim = 0

name: TauCeti.ValuationSpectrum.range_toPatch_eq
statement:
lemma range_toPatch_eq :
    Set.range (toPatch (A := A)) =
      {g : A × A → Bool |
        (∀ x y : A, g (x, y) = true ∨ g (y, x) = true) ∧
        (∀ x y z : A, g (x, y) = true → g (y, z) = true → g (x, z) = true) ∧
        (∀ x y z : A, g (x, z) = true → g (y, z) = true → g (x + y, z) = true) ∧
        (∀ x y z : A, g (x, y) = true → g (x * z, y * z) = true) ∧
        (∀ x y z : A, g (z, 0) = false → g (x * z, y * z) = true → g (x, y) = true) ∧
        (g (1, 0) = false) ∧
        (∀ x y : A, g (x * y, y * x) = true)}

name: Valuation.restrictToConvex_apply_of_mem
statement:
-- Deliberately not `@[simp]`, unlike its three siblings: its right-hand side is a coercion of a
-- subtype element, which is not a normal form. Tagging it rewrites `v.restrictToConvex H hH 1`
-- to `↑⟨1, _⟩` instead of to `1`, which breaks `one_le_restrictToConvex` below.
theorem restrictToConvex_apply_of_mem (v : Valuation R Γ₀) (H : ConvexSubgroup Γ₀ˣ)
    (hH : ∀ a : R, ∀ ha : v a ≠ 0, 1 ≤ v a → Units.mk0 (v a) ha ∈ H)
    {r : R} (hr : v r ≠ 0) (hm : Units.mk0 (v r) hr ∈ H) :
    v.restrictToConvex H hH r = ((⟨Units.mk0 (v r) hr, hm⟩ : H.toSubgroup) : WithZero _)

theorem restrictToConvex_apply_of_notMem (v : Valuation R Γ₀) (H : ConvexSubgroup Γ₀ˣ)

statement:

theorem restrictToConvex_eq_zero_iff (v : Valuation R Γ₀) (H : ConvexSubgroup Γ₀ˣ)

    v.restrictToConvex H hH r = 0 ↔ v r = 0 ∨ ∃ hr : v r ≠ 0, Units.mk0 (v r) hr ∉ H

statement:

theorem restrictToConvex_le_iff (v : Valuation R Γ₀) (H : ConvexSubgroup Γ₀ˣ)

    v.restrictToConvex H hH r ≤ v.restrictToConvex H hH s ↔
      v.restrictToConvex H hH r = 0 ∨ v.restrictToConvex H hH s ≠ 0 ∧ v r ≤ v s

    {r s : R} (hr : v r ≠ 0) (hs : v s ≠ 0)
    (hmr : Units.mk0 (v r) hr ∈ H) (hms : Units.mk0 (v s) hs ∈ H) :
    v.restrictToConvex H hH r ≤ v.restrictToConvex H hH s ↔ v r ≤ v s

    v.restrictToIdeal I hfg a ≤ v.restrictToIdeal I hfg b ↔

    (h0a : v a ≠ 0) (h0b : v b ≠ 0)
    (hma : valueGroup.mk (.ofClass v) 1 a (by simp) h0a ∈ characteristicSubgroupOfIdeal v I hfg)
    (hmb : valueGroup.mk (.ofClass v) 1 b (by simp) h0b ∈ characteristicSubgroupOfIdeal v I hfg) :

name: Valuation.restrictToIdeal_lt_coe_iff

      (characteristicSubgroupOfIdeal v I hfg)).toSubgroup) :

statement:
theorem restrictToIdeal_ne_zero_of_isAdmissible (v : Valuation A Γ₀) (I : Ideal A)

@[simp]
lemma additiveUnitsFunctor_map_app_apply {F G : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}} (f : F ⟶ G)
    (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : Additive ((F.obj.obj U : CommRingCat.{u})ˣ)) :
    (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (Additive ((F.obj.obj U : CommRingCat.{u})ˣ)))
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (Additive ((G.obj.obj U : CommRingCat.{u})ˣ)))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.existsUnique_transitionUnit
statement:
theorem existsUnique_transitionUnit (D : CartierDivisor X) {U V : X.Opens}
    (f : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op U))ˣ))
    (g : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op V))ˣ))
    (hf : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom f = D |_ U)
    (hg : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op V)).hom g = D |_ V) :
    ∃! r : Additive (((X.presheaf.obj (op (U ⊓ V))) : Type u)ˣ),
      ((toRationalUnitSheaf X).hom.app (op (U ⊓ V))).hom r =
        f |_ (U ⊓ V) - g |_ (U ⊓ V)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.exists_local_equation_cover

    ∃ (U : X → X.Opens)
      (f : ∀ x, Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op (U x)))ˣ)),
      (∀ x, x ∈ U x) ∧ (⨆ x, U x) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ x,
        ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op (U x))).hom (f x) = D |_ (U x)

theorem existsUnique_regularUnit_sub_of_toCartierDivisorSheaf_app_eq {U : X.Opens}

    ∃! r : Additive (((X.presheaf.obj (op U)) : Type u)ˣ),
      ((toRationalUnitSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom r = f - g

    (D : ((cartierDivisorSheaf X).obj.obj (op U) : Type u)) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :

      ∃ f : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op V))ˣ),
        ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op V)).hom f = D |_ V

theorem toCartierDivisorSheaf_app_eq_iff {U : X.Opens}

    ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom f =
        ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom g ↔
      ∃ r : Additive (((X.presheaf.obj (op U)) : Type u)ˣ),
        ((toRationalUnitSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom r = f - g

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.transitionUnit_cocycle
statement:
lemma transitionUnit_cocycle (D : CartierDivisor X) {U V W T : X.Opens}
    (f : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op U))ˣ))
    (g : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op V))ˣ))
    (h : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op W))ˣ))
    (hf : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom f = D |_ U)
    (hg : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op V)).hom g = D |_ V)
    (hh : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op W)).hom h = D |_ W)
    (hT : T ≤ U ⊓ V ⊓ W) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (regularUnitSheaf X).presheaf)
        (transitionUnit D f h hf hh) T (by
          exact le_inf
            (le_trans (le_trans hT inf_le_left) inf_le_left)
            (le_trans hT inf_le_right)) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (regularUnitSheaf X).presheaf)
        (transitionUnit D f g hf hg) T (le_trans hT inf_le_left) +
        TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (regularUnitSheaf X).presheaf)
          (transitionUnit D g h hg hh) T (by
            exact le_inf
              (le_trans (le_trans hT inf_le_left) inf_le_right)
              (le_trans hT inf_le_right))

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.transitionUnit_eq_of_spec
statement:
lemma transitionUnit_eq_of_spec (D : CartierDivisor X) {U V : X.Opens}
    (f : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op U))ˣ))
    (g : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op V))ˣ))
    (hf : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom f = D |_ U)
    (hg : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op V)).hom g = D |_ V)
    {r : Additive (((X.presheaf.obj (op (U ⊓ V))) : Type u)ˣ)}
    (hr : ((toRationalUnitSheaf X).hom.app (op (U ⊓ V))).hom r =
      f |_ (U ⊓ V) - g |_ (U ⊓ V)) :
    r = transitionUnit D f g hf hg

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.transitionUnit_restrict_spec
statement:
@[simp]
lemma transitionUnit_restrict_spec (D : CartierDivisor X) {U V W : X.Opens}
    (f : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op U))ˣ))
    (g : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op V))ˣ))
    (hf : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom f = D |_ U)
    (hg : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op V)).hom g = D |_ V)
    (hW : W ≤ U ⊓ V) :
    ((toRationalUnitSheaf X).hom.app (op W)).hom
        (TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (regularUnitSheaf X).presheaf)
          (transitionUnit D f g hf hg) W hW) = f |_ W - g |_ W

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.transitionUnit_self

lemma transitionUnit_self (D : CartierDivisor X) {U : X.Opens}

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.transitionUnit_spec
statement:
@[simp]
lemma transitionUnit_spec (D : CartierDivisor X) {U V : X.Opens}
    (f : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op U))ˣ))
    (g : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op V))ˣ))
    (hf : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom f = D |_ U)
    (hg : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op V)).hom g = D |_ V) :
    ((toRationalUnitSheaf X).hom.app (op (U ⊓ V))).hom
        (transitionUnit D f g hf hg) = f |_ (U ⊓ V) - g |_ (U ⊓ V)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierDivisor.transitionUnit_symm_restrict
statement:
lemma transitionUnit_symm_restrict (D : CartierDivisor X) {U V W : X.Opens}
    (f : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op U))ˣ))
    (g : Additive (((rationalFunctionsRing X).presheaf.obj (op V))ˣ))
    (hf : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op U)).hom f = D |_ U)
    (hg : ((toCartierDivisorSheaf X).hom.app (op V)).hom g = D |_ V)
    (hW : W ≤ U ⊓ V) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (regularUnitSheaf X).presheaf)
        (transitionUnit D g f hg hf) W (by simpa [inf_comm] using hW) =
      -(TopCat.Presheaf.restrictOpen (F := (regularUnitSheaf X).presheaf)
        (transitionUnit D f g hf hg) W hW)

statement:
@[simp]
lemma mayerVietorisSequence_def (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    mayerVietorisSequence M U V n₀ n₁ h =
      ComposableArrows.mk₅
        (biprod.lift (cohomologyOnRes M n₀ (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V))
          (cohomologyOnRes M n₀ (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V)))
        (biprod.desc (cohomologyOnRes M n₀ (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))
          (-cohomologyOnRes M n₀ (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)))
        (mayerVietorisδ M U V n₀ n₁ h)
        (biprod.lift (cohomologyOnRes M n₁ (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V))
          (cohomologyOnRes M n₁ (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V)))
        (biprod.desc (cohomologyOnRes M n₁ (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))
          (-cohomologyOnRes M n₁ (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)))

theorem dotProduct_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_of_mulVec_eq_zero {A : Matrix C C K} (hA : A.IsSymm)
    (hnonneg : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → 0 ≤ A i j)
    (hconnected : ∀ i j, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j ↦ i ≠ j ∧ 0 < A i j) i j)

theorem two_mul_dotProduct_mulVec_eq_neg_sum [Field K] {A : Matrix C C K} (hA : A.IsSymm)
    {m : C → K} (hm : ∀ i, m i ≠ 0) (hAm : A *ᵥ m = 0) (x : C → K) :

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.dotProduct_intersection_mulVec_of_support_subset
TauCeti.NumericalType.intersection_det_four_pos
statement:
theorem intersection_det_four_pos (hcard : 4 < Fintype.card T.Component)
    {i j k l : T.Component} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hil : i ≠ l) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hjl : j ≠ l) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    0 < T.intersection i i * T.intersection j j * T.intersection k k * T.intersection l l -
          T.intersection i i * T.intersection j j * T.intersection k l ^ 2 -
        T.intersection i i * T.intersection k k * T.intersection j l ^ 2 -
      T.intersection i i * T.intersection l l * T.intersection j k ^ 2 +
        2 * T.intersection i i * T.intersection j k * T.intersection j l *
          T.intersection k l -
      T.intersection j j * T.intersection k k * T.intersection i l ^ 2 -
        T.intersection j j * T.intersection l l * T.intersection i k ^ 2 +
      2 * T.intersection j j * T.intersection i k * T.intersection i l *
        T.intersection k l -
      T.intersection k k * T.intersection l l * T.intersection i j ^ 2 +
        2 * T.intersection k k * T.intersection i j * T.intersection i l *
          T.intersection j l +
      2 * T.intersection l l * T.intersection i j * T.intersection i k *
        T.intersection j k +
      T.intersection i j ^ 2 * T.intersection k l ^ 2 -
        2 * T.intersection i j * T.intersection i k * T.intersection j l *
          T.intersection k l -
      2 * T.intersection i j * T.intersection i l * T.intersection j k *
        T.intersection k l +
      T.intersection i k ^ 2 * T.intersection j l ^ 2 -
        2 * T.intersection i k * T.intersection i l * T.intersection j k *
          T.intersection j l +
      T.intersection i l ^ 2 * T.intersection j k ^ 2

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.intersection_det_triple_neg
statement:
theorem intersection_det_triple_neg (hcard : 3 < Fintype.card T.Component)
    {i j k : T.Component} (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    T.intersection i i * T.intersection j j * T.intersection k k -
          T.intersection i i * T.intersection j k ^ 2 -
        T.intersection j j * T.intersection i k ^ 2 -
      T.intersection k k * T.intersection i j ^ 2 +
        2 * T.intersection i j * T.intersection i k * T.intersection j k < 0

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.intersection_five_neg
statement:
theorem intersection_five_neg (hcard : 5 < Fintype.card T.Component)
    {c₁ c₂ c₃ c₄ c₅ : T.Component}
    (h₁₂ : c₁ ≠ c₂) (h₁₃ : c₁ ≠ c₃) (h₁₄ : c₁ ≠ c₄) (h₁₅ : c₁ ≠ c₅)
    (h₂₃ : c₂ ≠ c₃) (h₂₄ : c₂ ≠ c₄) (h₂₅ : c₂ ≠ c₅)
    (h₃₄ : c₃ ≠ c₄) (h₃₅ : c₃ ≠ c₅) (h₄₅ : c₄ ≠ c₅)
    {y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ y₅ : ℤ} (hy : ¬(y₁ = 0 ∧ y₂ = 0 ∧ y₃ = 0 ∧ y₄ = 0 ∧ y₅ = 0)) :
    T.intersection c₁ c₁ * y₁ ^ 2 + T.intersection c₂ c₂ * y₂ ^ 2 +
          T.intersection c₃ c₃ * y₃ ^ 2 + T.intersection c₄ c₄ * y₄ ^ 2 +
        T.intersection c₅ c₅ * y₅ ^ 2 +
      2 * (T.intersection c₁ c₂ * y₁ * y₂ + T.intersection c₁ c₃ * y₁ * y₃ +
        T.intersection c₁ c₄ * y₁ * y₄ + T.intersection c₁ c₅ * y₁ * y₅ +
        T.intersection c₂ c₃ * y₂ * y₃ + T.intersection c₂ c₄ * y₂ * y₄ +
        T.intersection c₂ c₅ * y₂ * y₅ + T.intersection c₃ c₄ * y₃ * y₄ +
        T.intersection c₃ c₅ * y₃ * y₅ + T.intersection c₄ c₅ * y₄ * y₅) < 0

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.intersection_six_neg
statement:
theorem intersection_six_neg (hcard : 6 < Fintype.card T.Component)
    {c₁ c₂ c₃ c₄ c₅ c₆ : T.Component}
    (h₁₂ : c₁ ≠ c₂) (h₁₃ : c₁ ≠ c₃) (h₁₄ : c₁ ≠ c₄) (h₁₅ : c₁ ≠ c₅) (h₁₆ : c₁ ≠ c₆)
    (h₂₃ : c₂ ≠ c₃) (h₂₄ : c₂ ≠ c₄) (h₂₅ : c₂ ≠ c₅) (h₂₆ : c₂ ≠ c₆)
    (h₃₄ : c₃ ≠ c₄) (h₃₅ : c₃ ≠ c₅) (h₃₆ : c₃ ≠ c₆)
    (h₄₅ : c₄ ≠ c₅) (h₄₆ : c₄ ≠ c₆) (h₅₆ : c₅ ≠ c₆)
    {y₁ y₂ y₃ y₄ y₅ y₆ : ℤ}
    (hy : ¬(y₁ = 0 ∧ y₂ = 0 ∧ y₃ = 0 ∧ y₄ = 0 ∧ y₅ = 0 ∧ y₆ = 0)) :
    T.intersection c₁ c₁ * y₁ ^ 2 + T.intersection c₂ c₂ * y₂ ^ 2 +
          T.intersection c₃ c₃ * y₃ ^ 2 + T.intersection c₄ c₄ * y₄ ^ 2 +
        T.intersection c₅ c₅ * y₅ ^ 2 + T.intersection c₆ c₆ * y₆ ^ 2 +
      2 * (T.intersection c₁ c₂ * y₁ * y₂ + T.intersection c₁ c₃ * y₁ * y₃ +
        T.intersection c₁ c₄ * y₁ * y₄ + T.intersection c₁ c₅ * y₁ * y₅ +
        T.intersection c₁ c₆ * y₁ * y₆ + T.intersection c₂ c₃ * y₂ * y₃ +
        T.intersection c₂ c₄ * y₂ * y₄ + T.intersection c₂ c₅ * y₂ * y₅ +
        T.intersection c₂ c₆ * y₂ * y₆ + T.intersection c₃ c₄ * y₃ * y₄ +
        T.intersection c₃ c₅ * y₃ * y₅ + T.intersection c₃ c₆ * y₃ * y₆ +
        T.intersection c₄ c₅ * y₄ * y₅ + T.intersection c₄ c₆ * y₄ * y₆ +
        T.intersection c₅ c₆ * y₅ * y₆) < 0

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.exists_intersection_ratio_chain_five_mem
statement:
theorem exists_intersection_ratio_chain_five_mem (hcard : 5 < Fintype.card T.Component)
    {h i j k l : T.Component}
    (hh : T.intersection h h = -(2 * (T.weight h : ℤ)))
    (hi : T.intersection i i = -(2 * (T.weight i : ℤ)))
    (hj : T.intersection j j = -(2 * (T.weight j : ℤ)))
    (hk : T.intersection k k = -(2 * (T.weight k : ℤ)))
    (hl : T.intersection l l = -(2 * (T.weight l : ℤ)))
    (hhj : h ≠ j) (hhk : h ≠ k) (hhl : h ≠ l) (hik : i ≠ k) (hil : i ≠ l) (hjl : j ≠ l)
    (hhi : 0 < T.intersection h i) (hij : 0 < T.intersection i j)
    (hjk : 0 < T.intersection j k) (hkl : 0 < T.intersection k l) :
    ∃ p₁ q₁ p₂ q₂ p₃ q₃ p₄ q₄ : ℤ,
      T.intersection h i = (T.weight h : ℤ) * p₁ ∧
      T.intersection h i = (T.weight i : ℤ) * q₁ ∧
      T.intersection i j = (T.weight i : ℤ) * p₂ ∧
      T.intersection i j = (T.weight j : ℤ) * q₂ ∧
      T.intersection j k = (T.weight j : ℤ) * p₃ ∧
      T.intersection j k = (T.weight k : ℤ) * q₃ ∧
      T.intersection k l = (T.weight k : ℤ) * p₄ ∧
      T.intersection k l = (T.weight l : ℤ) * q₄ ∧
      (p₁ * q₁, p₂ * q₂, p₃ * q₃, p₄ * q₄) ∈
        ({(1, 1, 1, 1), (1, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 1)} : Set (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ))

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.exists_intersection_ratio_chain_four_mem
statement:
theorem exists_intersection_ratio_chain_four_mem (hcard : 4 < Fintype.card T.Component)
    {i j k l : T.Component}
    (hi : T.intersection i i = -(2 * (T.weight i : ℤ)))
    (hj : T.intersection j j = -(2 * (T.weight j : ℤ)))
    (hk : T.intersection k k = -(2 * (T.weight k : ℤ)))
    (hl : T.intersection l l = -(2 * (T.weight l : ℤ)))

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.isMinusOneIndex_iff
statement:
lemma isMinusOneIndex_iff {i : T.Component} :
    T.IsMinusOneIndex i ↔ T.genus i = 0 ∧ T.intersection i i = -(T.weight i : ℤ)

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.isMinusOneIndex_reindex

lemma isMinusOneIndex_reindex (i : C) :
    (T.reindex e).IsMinusOneIndex i ↔ T.IsMinusOneIndex (e.symm i)

statement:
lemma isMinusTwoIndex_iff {i : T.Component} :
    T.IsMinusTwoIndex i ↔ T.genus i = 0 ∧ T.intersection i i = -(2 * (T.weight i : ℤ))

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.isMinusTwoIndex_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isMinusTwoIndex_reindex (i : C) :
    (T.reindex e).IsMinusTwoIndex i ↔ T.IsMinusTwoIndex (e.symm i)

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.one_half_le_genusContribution
TauCeti.NumericalType.ContractHalvesWeight.two_dvd_weight
statement:
lemma ContractHalvesWeight.two_dvd_weight {i : {i // i ≠ e}} (h : T.ContractHalvesWeight e i) :
    2 ∣ (T.weight i : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.arithmeticGenus_contract
statement: theorem arithmeticGenus_contract : (T.contract he).arithmeticGenus = T.arithmeticGenus

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contractGenus_eq
statement:
lemma contractGenus_eq {i : {i // i ≠ e}} :
    (T.contractGenus e i : ℚ) =
      (T.weight i / T.contractWeight e i : ℚ) * ((T.genus i : ℚ) - 1) + 1 +
        ((T.intersection i e : ℚ) ^ 2 - T.weight e * T.intersection i e) /
          (2 * T.contractWeight e i * T.weight e)

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contractIntersection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contractIntersection_apply (i j : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    T.contractIntersection e i j =
      T.intersection i j + T.intersection i e * T.intersection j e / T.weight e

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contractIntersection_isSymm
statement: lemma contractIntersection_isSymm : (T.contractIntersection e).IsSymm

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contractIntersection_pos
statement:
lemma contractIntersection_pos {i j : {i // i ≠ e}} (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : 0 < T.intersection i e)
    (hj : 0 < T.intersection j e) : 0 < T.contractIntersection e i j

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contractWeight_dvd_weight
statement:
lemma contractWeight_dvd_weight (i : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    (T.contractWeight e i : ℤ) ∣ T.weight i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contractWeight_of_not
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contractWeight_of_not {i : {i // i ≠ e}} (h : ¬ T.ContractHalvesWeight e i) :
    T.contractWeight e i = T.weight i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contract_genus
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_genus (i : {i // i ≠ e}) : (T.contract he).genus i = T.contractGenus e i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contract_intersection
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_intersection (i j : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    (T.contract he).intersection i j = T.contractIntersection e i j

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contract_multiplicity
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_multiplicity (i : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    (T.contract he).multiplicity i = T.multiplicity i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.contract_weight
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contract_weight (i : {i // i ≠ e}) : (T.contract he).weight i = T.contractWeight e i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.exists_contractIntersection_pos
statement:
lemma exists_contractIntersection_pos (s : Set {i // i ≠ e}) (hne : s.Nonempty)
    (hs : s ≠ Set.univ) : ∃ i ∈ s, ∃ j ∉ s, i ≠ j ∧ 0 < T.contractIntersection e i j

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.genusContribution_contract
statement:
lemma genusContribution_contract (i : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    (T.contract he).genusContribution i =
      T.genusContribution i - T.multiplicity i * T.intersection i e / 2

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.intersection_le_contractIntersection
statement:
lemma intersection_le_contractIntersection (i j : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    T.intersection i j ≤ T.contractIntersection e i j

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.sum_multiplicity_mul_contractIntersection
statement:
lemma sum_multiplicity_mul_contractIntersection
    (he : T.intersection e e = -(T.weight e : ℤ)) (i : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    ∑ j : {i // i ≠ e}, (T.multiplicity j : ℤ) * T.contractIntersection e i j = 0

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.two_mul_contractWeight
statement:
lemma two_mul_contractWeight {i : {i // i ≠ e}} (h : T.ContractHalvesWeight e i) :
    2 * (T.contractWeight e i : ℤ) = T.weight i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.weight_mul_contractIntersection
statement:
lemma weight_mul_contractIntersection (i j : {i // i ≠ e}) :
    (T.weight e : ℤ) * T.contractIntersection e i j =
      T.weight e * T.intersection i j + T.intersection i e * T.intersection j e

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.intersectionGraph_adj_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma intersectionGraph_adj_iff {i j : T.Component} :
    T.intersectionGraph.Adj i j ↔ T.Adj i j

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.intersectionGraph_connected
statement: lemma intersectionGraph_connected : T.intersectionGraph.Connected

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.topologicalGenus_def
statement:
lemma topologicalGenus_def :
    T.topologicalGenus =
      1 - (Nat.card T.Component : ℤ) + (T.intersectionGraph.edgeSet.ncard : ℤ)

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.topologicalGenus_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem topologicalGenus_eq_zero_iff :
    T.topologicalGenus = 0 ↔ T.intersectionGraph.IsTree

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.topologicalGenus_nonneg
statement: theorem topologicalGenus_nonneg : 0 ≤ T.topologicalGenus

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.genusDefect_def
statement:
lemma genusDefect_def (i : T.Component) :
    T.genusDefect i =
      (T.multiplicity i : ℚ) * (T.weight i : ℚ) *
          (-1 + T.genus i + T.normalizedValence i / 2) -
        (-1 + (T.intersectionGraph.neighborSet i).ncard / 2)

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.genusDefect_nonneg_of_genus_pos_or_two_le_valence_or_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem genusDefect_nonneg_of_genus_pos_or_two_le_valence_or_mul_eq_one (i : T.Component)
    (h : 0 < T.genus i ∨ 2 ≤ (T.intersectionGraph.neighborSet i).ncard ∨
      T.multiplicity i * T.weight i = 1) :
    0 ≤ T.genusDefect i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.normalizedValence_def
statement:
lemma normalizedValence_def (i : T.Component) :
    T.normalizedValence i =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (T.intersection i j : ℚ) / (T.weight i : ℚ)

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.normalizedValence_nonneg
statement:
lemma normalizedValence_nonneg (i : T.Component) :
    0 ≤ T.normalizedValence i

name: TauCeti.NumericalType.valence_le_normalizedValence
statement:
lemma valence_le_normalizedValence (i : T.Component) :
    ((T.intersectionGraph.neighborSet i).ncard : ℚ) ≤ T.normalizedValence i

WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Y_sub_Y_mul_Y_add_Y_eq
statement:
theorem Y_sub_Y_mul_Y_add_Y_eq (h₁ : W.Equation x₁ y₁) (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) :
    (y₁ - y₂) * (y₁ + y₂ + W.a₁ * x₁ + W.a₃) =
      (x₁ - x₂) * (x₁ ^ 2 + x₁ * x₂ + x₂ ^ 2 + W.a₂ * (x₁ + x₂) + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Y_sub_Y_mul_Y_sub_negY_eq
statement:
theorem Y_sub_Y_mul_Y_sub_negY_eq (h₁ : W.Equation x₁ y₁) (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) :
    (y₁ - y₂) * (y₁ - W.negY x₂ y₂) =
      (x₁ - x₂) * (x₁ ^ 2 + x₁ * x₂ + x₂ ^ 2 + W.a₂ * (x₁ + x₂) + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y₁)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Equation.derivation_Y_eq_smul_derivation_X
statement:
theorem Equation.derivation_Y_eq_smul_derivation_X {x y : K} (h : (W⁄K).toAffine.Equation x y)
    (hu : (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x y ≠ 0) :
    D y = (-(W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialX.evalEval x y / (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x y) •
      D x

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Equation.evalEval_polynomialX_smul_add_evalEval_polynomialY_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Equation.evalEval_polynomialX_smul_add_evalEval_polynomialY_smul_eq_zero {x y : K}
    (h : (W⁄K).toAffine.Equation x y) :
    (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialX.evalEval x y • D x +
      (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x y • D y = 0

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivation_addX
statement:
theorem derivation_addX (x₁ x₂ ℓ : K) :
    D ((W⁄K).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ℓ) = (2 * ℓ + (W⁄K).toAffine.a₁) • D ℓ - D x₁ - D x₂

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivation_addX_slope
statement:
theorem derivation_addX_slope [DecidableEq K] {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : K} (h₁ : (W⁄K).toAffine.Equation x₁ y₁)
    (h₂ : (W⁄K).toAffine.Equation x₂ y₂) (hxy : ¬(x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = (W⁄K).toAffine.negY x₂ y₂))
    (hu₁ : x₁ ≠ x₂ → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₁ y₁ ≠ 0)
    (hu₂ : x₁ ≠ x₂ → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₂ y₂ ≠ 0) :
    D ((W⁄K).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂)) =
      (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval
          ((W⁄K).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂))
          ((W⁄K).toAffine.addY x₁ x₂ y₁ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂)) •
        (((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₁ y₁)⁻¹ • D x₁ +
          ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₂ y₂)⁻¹ • D x₂)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivation_evalEval_polynomialX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivation_evalEval_polynomialX (x y : K) :
    D ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialX.evalEval x y) =
      (W⁄K).toAffine.a₁ • D y - (6 * x + 2 * (W⁄K).toAffine.a₂) • D x

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivation_evalEval_polynomialY
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivation_evalEval_polynomialY (x y : K) :
    D ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x y) = 2 • D y + (W⁄K).toAffine.a₁ • D x

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivation_slope_of_X_ne
statement:
theorem derivation_slope_of_X_ne [DecidableEq K] {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : K} (hx : x₁ ≠ x₂) :
    D ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂) =
      (x₁ - x₂)⁻¹ ^ 2 • ((x₁ - x₂) • (D y₁ - D y₂) - (y₁ - y₂) • (D x₁ - D x₂))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivation_slope_self_of_Y_ne
statement:
theorem derivation_slope_self_of_Y_ne [DecidableEq K] {x y : K}
    (hy : y ≠ (W⁄K).toAffine.negY x y) :
    D ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x x y y) =
      ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x y)⁻¹ ^ 2 •
        ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x y • D (-(W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialX.evalEval x y) -
          (-(W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialX.evalEval x y) •
            D ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x y))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.evalEval_polynomialY_ne_zero_of_Y_ne
statement:
theorem evalEval_polynomialY_ne_zero_of_Y_ne {x y : K} (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    W.polynomialY.evalEval x y ≠ 0

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.inv_smul_derivation_addX_slope
statement:
theorem inv_smul_derivation_addX_slope [DecidableEq K] {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : K}
    (h₁ : (W⁄K).toAffine.Equation x₁ y₁) (h₂ : (W⁄K).toAffine.Equation x₂ y₂)
    (hxy : ¬(x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = (W⁄K).toAffine.negY x₂ y₂))
    (hu₁ : x₁ ≠ x₂ → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₁ y₁ ≠ 0)
    (hu₂ : x₁ ≠ x₂ → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₂ y₂ ≠ 0)
    (hu₃ : (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval
      ((W⁄K).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂))
      ((W⁄K).toAffine.addY x₁ x₂ y₁ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂)) ≠ 0) :
    ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval
        ((W⁄K).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂))
        ((W⁄K).toAffine.addY x₁ x₂ y₁ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂)))⁻¹ •
      D ((W⁄K).toAffine.addX x₁ x₂ ((W⁄K).toAffine.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂)) =
      ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₁ y₁)⁻¹ • D x₁ +
        ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval x₂ y₂)⁻¹ • D x₂

name: IntermediateField.extendRight_eq_map
statement:
-- Load-bearing rather than a cosmetic unfolding: `extendRight` is defined through
-- `Algebra.algHom`, while the `map` lemmas that meet it here are stated with
-- `IsScalarTower.toAlgHom`. The two are one term but not one piece of syntax, and
-- `relfinrank_map_map` will not unify across them.
theorem extendRight_eq_map (F : IntermediateField K L) :
    F.extendRight M = F.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K L M)

name: IntermediateField.extendRight_le_iff
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`: it and `extendRight_adjoin_simple_le_iff` below cannot both be, since this
-- rewrites that one's left-hand side and `simpNF` rejects the pair. The simple-extension form
-- is the one worth reaching automatically, so it keeps the attribute and this is used by name.
theorem extendRight_le_iff {F : IntermediateField K L} {E : IntermediateField K M} :
    F.extendRight M ≤ E ↔ ∀ x ∈ F, algebraMap L M x ∈ E

-- left-hand side to the raw `cast` first, so `simpNF` reports the statement is not in
-- simp-normal form and the lemma could never fire. It is used by `rw`, which is syntactic.
lemma cast_some {V V' : WeierstrassCurve F} (h : V = V') {x y : F}
    (hns : V.toAffine.Nonsingular x y) :
    AddEquiv.cast (M := fun V : WeierstrassCurve F ↦ V.toAffine.Point) h (some x y hns)
      = some x y (h ▸ hns)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.derivation_xCoord_add
statement:
theorem derivation_xCoord_add (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (h : P + Q ≠ 0)
    (huP : xCoord P ≠ xCoord Q → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord P) (yCoord P) ≠ 0)
    (huQ : xCoord P ≠ xCoord Q → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord Q) (yCoord Q) ≠ 0) :
    D (xCoord (P + Q)) =
      (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord (P + Q)) (yCoord (P + Q)) •
        (((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord P) (yCoord P))⁻¹ • D (xCoord P) +
          ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord Q) (yCoord Q))⁻¹ • D (xCoord Q))

    (huP : xCoord P ≠ xCoord Q → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord P) (yCoord P) ≠ 0)
    (huQ : xCoord P ≠ xCoord Q → (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord Q) (yCoord Q) ≠ 0)
    (hu : (W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord (P + Q)) (yCoord (P + Q)) ≠ 0) :
    ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord (P + Q)) (yCoord (P + Q)))⁻¹ •
        D (xCoord (P + Q)) =
      ((W⁄K).toAffine.polynomialY.evalEval (xCoord P) (yCoord P))⁻¹ • D (xCoord P) +

    atom W c d * atomRel W m n r s =

        + atom W s d * atomRel W m n r c
      + atom W n c * atomRel W m r s d - atom W r c * atomRel W m n s d
        + atom W s c * atomRel W m n r d
      + atom W n r * atomRel W m s c d - atom W n s * atomRel W m r c d
        + atom W r s * atomRel W m n c d

name: isEllipticNet_iff
statement:
theorem isEllipticNet_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {W : ℤ → R} (odd : W.Odd) (zero : W 0 = 0)
    (one : W 1 ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) (two : W 2 ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) :
    IsEllipticNet W ↔
      (∀ m : ℤ, 2 ≤ m → W (2 * m + 1) * W 1 ^ 3 = W (m + 2) * W m ^ 3 - W (m - 1) * W (m + 1) ^ 3)
        ∧ ∀ m : ℤ, 3 ≤ m → W (2 * m) * W 2 * W 1 ^ 2 =
            W m * (W (m - 1) ^ 2 * W (m + 2) - W (m - 2) * W (m + 1) ^ 2)

name: isEllipticSequence_iff
statement:
theorem isEllipticSequence_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {W : ℤ → R} (odd : W.Odd) (zero : W 0 = 0)
    (one : W 1 ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) (two : W 2 ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) :
    IsEllipticSequence W ↔
      (∀ m : ℤ, 2 ≤ m → W (2 * m + 1) * W 1 ^ 3 = W (m + 2) * W m ^ 3 - W (m - 1) * W (m + 1) ^ 3)
        ∧ ∀ m : ℤ, 3 ≤ m → W (2 * m) * W 2 * W 1 ^ 2 =
            W m * (W (m - 1) ^ 2 * W (m + 2) - W (m - 2) * W (m + 1) ^ 2)

statement:
lemma chord_point_add {q₁ q₂ w₁ w₂ Λ N T₃ wT : F}
    (hw₁ : w₁ = q₁ ^ 3 + W.a₁ * q₁ * w₁ + W.a₂ * q₁ ^ 2 * w₁ + W.a₃ * w₁ ^ 2 +
      W.a₄ * q₁ * w₁ ^ 2 + W.a₆ * w₁ ^ 3)
    (hw₂ : w₂ = q₂ ^ 3 + W.a₁ * q₂ * w₂ + W.a₂ * q₂ ^ 2 * w₂ + W.a₃ * w₂ ^ 2 +
      W.a₄ * q₂ * w₂ ^ 2 + W.a₆ * w₂ ^ 3)
    (hslope : Λ * (q₂ - q₁) = w₂ - w₁)
    (hN : N = w₁ - Λ * q₁)
    (hT₃ : (1 + W.a₂ * Λ + W.a₄ * Λ ^ 2 + W.a₆ * Λ ^ 3) * (T₃ + q₁ + q₂) =
      -(W.a₁ * Λ + W.a₂ * N + W.a₃ * Λ ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₄ * Λ * N + 3 * W.a₆ * Λ ^ 2 * N))
    (hwT : wT = Λ * T₃ + N)
    (hA : (1 + W.a₂ * Λ + W.a₄ * Λ ^ 2 + W.a₆ * Λ ^ 3) ≠ 0)
    (hw₁0 : w₁ ≠ 0) (hw₂0 : w₂ ≠ 0) (hwT0 : wT ≠ 0)
    (hx : q₁ * w₂ - q₂ * w₁ ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : W.toAffine.Nonsingular (q₁ / w₁) (-1 / w₁))
    (h₂ : W.toAffine.Nonsingular (q₂ / w₂) (-1 / w₂)) :
    ∃ h₃ : W.toAffine.Nonsingular (T₃ / wT) ((1 - W.a₁ * T₃ - W.a₃ * wT) / wT),
      Affine.Point.some _ _ h₁ + Affine.Point.some _ _ h₂ = Affine.Point.some _ _ h₃

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.coe_trivializationGeneratorRationalUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_trivializationGeneratorRationalUnit (M : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opens}
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (hU : Dense (U : Set X))
    (t : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M.over V)
    [Nonempty V] :
    (trivializationGeneratorRationalUnit M e hU t : X.functionField) =
      rationalFunction M e hU V (trivializationGenerator M t)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_rationalFunction_trivializationGenerator_eq_mul
statement:
theorem exists_rationalFunction_trivializationGenerator_eq_mul (M : X.Modules)
    {U V₁ V₂ W : X.Opens}
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (hU : Dense (U : Set X))
    (t₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V₁) PUnit ≅ M.over V₁)
    (t₂ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V₂) PUnit ≅ M.over V₂)
    (i₁ : W ⟶ V₁) (i₂ : W ⟶ V₂) [Nonempty W] :
    ∃ r : Γ(X, W)ˣ,
      rationalFunction M e hU W (M.presheaf.map i₁.op (trivializationGenerator M t₁)) =
        X.germToFunctionField W (r : Γ(X, W)) *
          rationalFunction M e hU W (M.presheaf.map i₂.op (trivializationGenerator M t₂))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isUnit_rationalFunction_trivializationGenerator

theorem isUnit_rationalFunction_trivializationGenerator (M : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opens}
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (hU : Dense (U : Set X))
    (t : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M.over V)
    [Nonempty V] :
    IsUnit (rationalFunction M e hU V (trivializationGenerator M t))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.range_rationalFunction
statement:
theorem range_rationalFunction (M : X.Modules) {U V W : X.Opens}
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (hU : Dense (U : Set X))
    (t : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M.over V) (i : W ⟶ V)
    [Nonempty W] :
    Set.range (rationalFunction M e hU W) =
      {q | ∃ r : Γ(X, W), q = X.germToFunctionField W r *
        rationalFunction M e hU W (M.presheaf.map i.op (trivializationGenerator M t))}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.range_rationalTrivializationHom_app
statement:
theorem range_rationalTrivializationHom_app (M : X.Modules) {U V W : X.Opens}
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (hU : Dense (U : Set X))
    (t : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M.over V) (i : W ⟶ V) :
    Set.range (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (rationalTrivializationHom M e hU) W) =
      {q | ∃ r : Γ(X, W), q = r • Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (rationalTrivializationHom M e hU) W
        (M.presheaf.map i.op (trivializationGenerator M t))}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rationalFunction_map
statement:

theorem rationalFunction_map (M : X.Modules) {U V T : X.Opens}
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) (i : V ⟶ T) [Nonempty V] [Nonempty T] (s : Γ(M, T)) :
    rationalFunction M e hU V (M.presheaf.map i.op s) = rationalFunction M e hU T s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rationalFunction_smul
statement:

theorem rationalFunction_smul (M : X.Modules) {U : X.Opens}
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) (V : X.Opens) [Nonempty V] (r : Γ(X, V)) (s : Γ(M, V)) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rationalFunctionsEquiv_rationalTrivializationHom_app
statement:

theorem rationalFunctionsEquiv_rationalTrivializationHom_app (M : X.Modules)

lemma mem_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {c : S.ClassGroup} :

lemma mem_principalSubgroup {D : WeilDivisor X} :

lemma principalDivisor_mem_principalSubgroup (g : G) :

statement:

lemma principalDivisor_neg (g : G) : S.principalDivisor (-g) = -S.principalDivisor g

statement:
lemma principalDivisor_sub (g₁ g₂ : G) :
    S.principalDivisor (g₁ - g₂) = S.principalDivisor g₁ - S.principalDivisor g₂

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.principalDivisor_zero

lemma principalDivisor_zero : S.principalDivisor 0 = 0

@[simp]
lemma unweightedDegreeClass_divisorClass (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (D : WeilDivisor X) :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    weightedDegreeClass w h (S.divisorClass D) = weightedDegree w D

statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_weightedAbelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) : (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_base (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x₀ = 0

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {x y : X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x = S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y ↔
      S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x) =
        S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ y)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {x y : X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x = S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)
        (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ y)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀ c =
      (⟨S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c, S.degreeCorrection_mem_picZero w h hx₀ c⟩,
        weightedDegreeClass w h c)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_picZero
statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (p : picZero w h) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀ (p : S.ClassGroup) = (p, 0)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (p : picZero w h) (n : ℤ) :
    (S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀).symm (p, n) =
      (p : S.ClassGroup) + n • S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degreeCorrection_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X)
    (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c =
      c - (weightedDegreeClass w h c) • S.divisorClass (ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_change_base
statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_change_base (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ y₀ : X) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h y₀ c =
      S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c +
        weightedDegreeClass w h c • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_coe_picZero
statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_coe_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) (p : picZero w h) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ (p : S.ClassGroup) = p

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_divisorClass
statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) (x₀ : X)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ (S.divisorClass D) =
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_eq_self_of_mem_picZero
statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_eq_self_of_mem_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    (x₀ : X) {c : S.ClassGroup} (hc : c ∈ picZero w h) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c = c

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_mem_picZero
statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_mem_picZero (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ c ∈ picZero w h

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degreeSection_apply (x₀ : X) (n : ℤ) :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSection_injective
statement:
lemma degreeSection_injective (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSection_one

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeSplitInverse_degreeSplitForward
statement:
lemma degreeSplitInverse_degreeSplitForward (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (c : S.ClassGroup) :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_comp_degreeSection

lemma weightedDegreeClass_comp_degreeSection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)

lemma weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection_of_weight_one
statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_degreeSection_of_weight_one (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass_ofPoint
statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_divisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeClass_surjective
statement:
lemma weightedDegreeClass_surjective (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_weightedAbelJacobiClass
statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_coe_weightedAbelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_ofPoint
statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_weightedPointBaseDifference
statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass_weightedPointBaseDifference
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀
        (S.divisorClass (weightedPointBaseDifference w x₀ x)) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x, 0)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiClass
statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    (S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀).symm (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x, w x) =
      S.divisorClass (ofPoint x)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.degreeCorrection_divisorClass_ofPoint
statement:
lemma degreeCorrection_divisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.degreeCorrection w h x₀ (S.divisorClass (ofPoint x)) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass
statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀ (S.divisorClass D) =
      (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D, weightedDegree w D)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass
statement:
lemma classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt_symm_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (S.classGroupAddEquivPicZeroProdInt w h hx₀).symm
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D, weightedDegree w D) =
      S.divisorClass D

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_apply (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_add (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (D + E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀) =
        S.divisorClass (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)
        (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_weightedDegree_eq
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_weightedDegree_eq
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : weightedDegree w D = weightedDegree w E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent D E

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hlin : S.LinearlyEquivalent D E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ E

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_sum
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_sum (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      D.sum fun x n => n • S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (ofPoint x) =

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_ofPoint_base (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_degree_eq
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_one_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent_of_degree_eq
    (h : S.IsUnweightedDegreeZero) (x₀ : X) {D E : WeilDivisor X} (hDE : degree D = degree E) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass (fun _ : X => (1 : ℤ)) h (x₀ := x₀) rfl E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent D E

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_principalDivisor
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_principalDivisor (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (g : G) :

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_zsmul (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (n : ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ (n • D) =
      n • S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D

statement:

lemma ofFinsetWithMultiplicity_insert [DecidableEq X] {s : Finset X} {x : X}

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.mem_principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero
statement:

lemma mem_principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero {w : X → ℤ} {D : weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w} :
    D ∈ S.principalSubgroupOfWeightedDegreeZero w ↔
      (D : WeilDivisor X) ∈ S.principalSubgroup

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply
statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_apply {w : X → ℤ} (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)

    S.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom w h D =
      ⟨S.divisorClass (D : WeilDivisor X), by
        rw [divisorClass_mem_picZero]
        exact weightedDegree_coe_weightedDegreeZeroSubgroup w D⟩

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_eq_zero_iff

lemma weightedDegreeZeroClassHom_eq_zero_iff {w : X → ℤ}

      (D : WeilDivisor X) ∈ S.principalSubgroup

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_add
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_add (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D E : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (D + E) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D +
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_divisorClass
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_divisorClass (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E ↔
      S.divisorClass (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀) =
        S.divisorClass (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_iff_linearlyEquivalent
    (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) {D E : WeilDivisor X} :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
        S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ E ↔
      S.LinearlyEquivalent (D - weightedDegree w D • ofPoint x₀)
        (E - weightedDegree w E • ofPoint x₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_sum
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_eq_sum (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
      D.sum fun x n => n • S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_mk (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor w hx₀ D)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint_base
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint_base (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x₀) = 0

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_principalDivisor
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_principalDivisor (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (g : G) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (S.principalDivisor g) = 0

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_zsmul
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_zsmul (w : X → ℤ) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)
    (n : ℤ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (n • D) =
      n • S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ D) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint
statement:
lemma weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero_weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass_ofPoint
    (w : X → ℤ) (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedDegreeZeroQuotientEquivPicZero w h
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiQuotientClass w hx₀ (ofPoint x)) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w h hx₀ x

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.coe_weightedBasepointChangeClass
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_weightedBasepointChangeClass (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) : (S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_change_base
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_change_base (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x +
      w x • S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_oldBase_eq_basepointChangeClass
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_oldBase_eq_basepointChangeClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x₀ =
      S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_change_base_coe
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_change_base_coe (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) (x : X) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) =
      w x • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_coe
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiClass_sub_coe (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ x y : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hxy : w x = w y) :
    (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ x : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hx₀ y : S.ClassGroup) =
      S.divisorClass (pointDifference x y)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_add
statement:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_add (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ z₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) (hyz : w y₀ = w z₀) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy +
        S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hyz =
      S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hxy.trans hyz)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_eq_abelJacobiClass
statement:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_eq_abelJacobiClass (w : X → ℤ)
    (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm) =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiClass w hdeg hy₀ x₀

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_self (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ : X} :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg (x₀ := x₀) rfl = 0

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedBasepointChangeClass_swap
statement:
lemma weightedBasepointChangeClass_swap (w : X → ℤ) (hdeg : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w)
    {x₀ y₀ : X} (hxy : w x₀ = w y₀) :
    S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy.symm =
      -S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w hdeg hxy

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_change_base
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_change_base (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D +
        weightedDegree w D • S.weightedBasepointChangeClass w h (hx₀.trans hy₀.symm)

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_eq_of_weightedDegree_eq_zero (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    {D : WeilDivisor X} (hD : weightedDegree w D = 0) :
    S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D =
      S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D

name: TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.WeilDivisor.OrderSystem.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_sub_change_base_coe
statement:
lemma weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass_sub_change_base_coe (w : X → ℤ)
    (h : S.IsWeightedDegreeZero w) {x₀ y₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1) (hy₀ : w y₀ = 1)
    (D : WeilDivisor X) : (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hy₀ D : S.ClassGroup) -
        (S.weightedAbelJacobiDivisorClass w h hx₀ D : S.ClassGroup) =
      weightedDegree w D • S.divisorClass (pointDifference x₀ y₀)
