name: TauCeti.Contour.IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exists_int_windingNumber_eq_add_card_div_two
statement:
theorem IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exists_int_windingNumber_eq_add_card_div_two
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} {s : ℂ} {T : Finset ℝ}
    (h_imm : IsPwC1ImmersionOn γ a b) (hab : a ≤ b) (hclosed : γ a = γ b) (hbase : γ a ≠ s)
    (hT : ∀ t, t ∈ T ↔ t ∈ Icc a b ∧ γ t = s)
    (hsmooth : ∀ t ∈ T, crossingAngle γ t = Real.pi) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, windingNumber γ a b s = k + (T.card : ℂ) / 2

name: TauCeti.Contour.IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exists_int_windingNumber_eq_add_sum_crossingAngle
statement:
theorem IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exists_int_windingNumber_eq_add_sum_crossingAngle
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} {s : ℂ} {T : Finset ℝ}
    (h_imm : IsPwC1ImmersionOn γ a b) (hab : a ≤ b) (hclosed : γ a = γ b) (hbase : γ a ≠ s)
    (hT : ∀ t, t ∈ T ↔ t ∈ Icc a b ∧ γ t = s) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, windingNumber γ a b s
      = k + ((∑ t ∈ T, crossingAngle γ t : ℝ) : ℂ) / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))

name: TauCeti.Contour.IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exists_int_windingNumber_eq_add_sum_crossingAngle_toFinset
statement:
theorem IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exists_int_windingNumber_eq_add_sum_crossingAngle_toFinset
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} {s : ℂ}
    (h_imm : IsPwC1ImmersionOn γ a b) (hab : a ≤ b) (hclosed : γ a = γ b) (hbase : γ a ≠ s) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, windingNumber γ a b s
      = k + ((∑ t ∈ (h_imm.finite_crossings (z₀ := s)).toFinset, crossingAngle γ t : ℝ) : ℂ)
          / (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ))

name: TauCeti.Contour.IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exp_two_pi_I_mul_windingNumber_eq_exp_sum_crossingAngle
statement:
theorem IsPwC1ImmersionOn.exp_two_pi_I_mul_windingNumber_eq_exp_sum_crossingAngle
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ} {s : ℂ} {T : Finset ℝ}
    (h_imm : IsPwC1ImmersionOn γ a b) (hab : a ≤ b) (hclosed : γ a = γ b) (hbase : γ a ≠ s)
    (hT : ∀ t, t ∈ T ↔ t ∈ Icc a b ∧ γ t = s) :
    Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * windingNumber γ a b s)
      = Complex.exp (((∑ t ∈ T, crossingAngle γ t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

name: TauCeti.Contour.exp_log_norm_add_arg_eq_mul_exp_crossingAngle
statement:
theorem exp_log_norm_add_arg_eq_mul_exp_crossingAngle {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {t₀ : ℝ} {L_R L_L w_L w_R : ℂ}
    (hL_L : L_L ≠ 0) (hL_R : L_R ≠ 0) (hw_L : w_L ≠ 0) (hw_R : w_R ≠ 0)
    (h_R : Tendsto (deriv γ) (𝓝[>] t₀) (𝓝 L_R))
    (h_L : Tendsto (deriv γ) (𝓝[<] t₀) (𝓝 L_L)) :
    Complex.exp (((Real.log ‖w_R‖ - Real.log ‖w_L‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        ((((-L_L) / w_L).arg + (w_R / L_R).arg : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      = w_R / w_L * Complex.exp ((crossingAngle γ t₀ : ℂ) * Complex.I)

name: TauCeti.Contour.exists_isBounded_image_realWindingIntegrand_of_lipschitzOnWith_derivWithin_corner
statement:
theorem exists_isBounded_image_realWindingIntegrand_of_lipschitzOnWith_derivWithin_corner
    {γ : ℝ → ℂ} {w : ℂ} {c t₀ d : ℝ} {KR KL : ℝ≥0} (hct : c < t₀) (htd : t₀ < d)
    (hdiffR : DifferentiableOn ℝ γ (Icc t₀ d))
    (hlipR : LipschitzOnWith KR (derivWithin γ (Icc t₀ d)) (Icc t₀ d))
    (hdiffL : DifferentiableOn ℝ γ (Icc c t₀))
    (hlipL : LipschitzOnWith KL (derivWithin γ (Icc c t₀)) (Icc c t₀)) (h_eq : γ t₀ = w)
    (hvelR : derivWithin γ (Icc t₀ d) t₀ ≠ 0) (hvelL : derivWithin γ (Icc c t₀) t₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ρ > 0, ρ < min (d - t₀) (t₀ - c) ∧ Bornology.IsBounded
      ((fun t => realWindingIntegrand (γ t - w) (deriv γ t)) '' Icc (t₀ - ρ) (t₀ + ρ))

name: TauCeti.Contour.exists_isBounded_image_realWindingIntegrand_of_lipschitzOnWith_derivWithin_left

name: TauCeti.Contour.exists_isBounded_image_realWindingIntegrand_of_lipschitzOnWith_derivWithin_right
statement:
theorem exists_isBounded_image_realWindingIntegrand_of_lipschitzOnWith_derivWithin_right

statement:
theorem windingNumber_eq_sum_range_of_ae {n : ℕ} {t : ℕ → ℝ} (piece : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ)
    (heq : ∀ k < n, piece k =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (t k) (t (k + 1)))] γ)
    (hderiv : ∀ k < n, ∀ᵐ s ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.uIoc (t k) (t (k + 1))),
      piece k s ≠ z₀ → deriv (piece k) s = deriv γ s)
    (hpv : ∀ k < n, CauchyPVExistsAt (piece k) (t k) (t (k + 1)) κ[z₀] z₀) :
    windingNumber γ (t 0) (t n) z₀ =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, windingNumber (piece k) (t k) (t (k + 1)) z₀

name: TauCeti.Contour.exists_forall_windingNumber_eq_add_one_of_eqOn_segment
statement:
theorem exists_forall_windingNumber_eq_add_one_of_eqOn_segment {Γ : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hΓ : IsPiecewiseC1On Γ a c) (hclosed : Γ a = Γ c) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (hseg : EqOn Γ (fun t : ℝ ↦ v * (t : ℂ) + z₀) (Icc a b)) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hs : s ∈ Ioo a b)
    (hp : v * s + z₀ ∉ Γ '' Icc b c) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ w₁ ∈ ball (v * s + z₀) r, ∀ w₂ ∈ ball (v * s + z₀) r,
      0 < ((w₁ - (v * s + z₀)) / v).im → ((w₂ - (v * s + z₀)) / v).im < 0 →
        windingNumber Γ a c w₁ = windingNumber Γ a c w₂ + 1

name: TauCeti.Contour.windingNumber_eq_real_integral_of_closed

    (hγ_diff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (min a b) (max a b) \ P, DifferentiableAt ℝ γ t)
    (h_avoid : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc a b, γ t ≠ w)
    (h_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ (γ t - w)⁻¹ * deriv γ t) MeasureTheory.volume a b) :

          * ∫ t in a..b, realWindingIntegrand (γ t - w) (deriv γ t) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: TauCeti.levelSetChartAt_apply
statement:
theorem levelSetChartAt_apply
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ {x | f x = c}, HasStrictFDerivAt f (D x) x)
    (hFred : ∀ x ∈ {x | f x = c}, ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm (D x))
    (hsurj : ∀ x ∈ {x | f x = c}, Function.Surjective (D x))
    (hindex : ∀ x ∈ {x | f x = c}, ContinuousLinearMap.index (D x) = n)
    (z w : ↥{x | f x = c}) :
    levelSetChartAt hf hFred hsurj hindex z w =
      (D z.1).kerModelEquiv (hFred z.1 z.2).finite_ker
        (finrank_ker_eq_of_mem_levelSet hsurj hindex z.2)
        (levelSetChart (hf z.1 z.2) (LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 (hsurj z.1 z.2))
          (hFred z.1 z.2).closedComplemented_ker z.2 w)

      IsNowhereDense (levelSetParameterMap hf hD (hD₁.closedComplemented_ker_coprod hD) hxl ''

    {n : ℕ∞ω} {U : Set (D₁.coprod D₂).ker}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f (D₁.coprod D₂) (x, l))
    (hcont : ContDiffAt ℝ n f (x, l))
    (hD₁ : ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm D₁)
    (hD : Surjective (D₁.coprod D₂))
    (hxl : f (x, l) = c)
    (hn : ((finrank ℝ D₁.ker * finrank ℝ D₁.ker + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ n)
    (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : (D₁.coprod D₂).ker)) :
    ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : (D₁.coprod D₂).ker),
      N ⊆ U ∩ (levelSetChart hf (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hD)
        (hD₁.closedComplemented_ker_coprod hD) hxl).target ∧
      IsClosed (levelSetParameterMap hf hD (hD₁.closedComplemented_ker_coprod hD) hxl ''
        (N ∩ {k | ¬ Surjective ((fderiv ℝ f
          (((levelSetChart hf (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hD)
              (hD₁.closedComplemented_ker_coprod hD) hxl).symm k : ↥{z | f z = c}) :
            E × Λ)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E Λ))})) ∧
      IsNowhereDense (levelSetParameterMap hf hD (hD₁.closedComplemented_ker_coprod hD) hxl ''
        (N ∩ {k | ¬ Surjective ((fderiv ℝ f
          (((levelSetChart hf (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hD)
              (hD₁.closedComplemented_ker_coprod hD) hxl).symm k : ↥{z | f z = c}) :
            E × Λ)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E Λ))}))

    [BorelSpace β] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [SecondCountableTopologyEither α E]
    [SecondCountableTopologyEither β E] {μ : Measure α} {μb : Measure β} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [IsFiniteMeasure μb] {p : ℝ≥0∞} [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (𝕜 : Type*) [NormedRing 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 E]
    [IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 E] (F : C(β, E)) (φ : C(α, β)) (hφ : MeasurePreserving φ μ μb) :
    compMeasurePreserving φ hφ (ContinuousMap.toLp p μb 𝕜 F) =
      ContinuousMap.toLp p μ 𝕜 (F.comp φ)

    {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
    (𝕜 : Type*) [NormedRing 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 E] [IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 E] [Fact (1 ≤ p)]
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μb) (hg : MeasurePreserving g μb μ)
    (hfg : f ∘ g =ᵐ[μb] id) (x : Lp E p μb) :
    compMeasurePreservingₗᵢEquiv 𝕜 hf hg hfg x = compMeasurePreserving f hf x

    {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
    (𝕜 : Type*) [NormedRing 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 E] [IsBoundedSMul 𝕜 E] [Fact (1 ≤ p)]
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f μ μb) (hg : MeasurePreserving g μb μ)
    (hfg : f ∘ g =ᵐ[μb] id) (x : Lp E p μ) :

    (hcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) (hc : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → 0 ≤ c x)

    (hfcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x)
    (hgcd : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x) (hc : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → 0 ≤ c x)
    (hlap : ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ interior K → Δ f x - c x * f x = Δ g x - c x * g x)

theorem weightL2Isometry_apply (hwpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ)
    (f : Lp 𝕜 2 (μ.withDensity fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))) :
    weightL2Isometry μ w hwpos hwm f =ᵐ[μ] fun x => Real.sqrt (w x) • (f : α → 𝕜) x

name: TauCeti.coeFn_bareNormalizedLp
statement:
theorem coeFn_bareNormalizedLp {μ : Measure α}
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (n : ℕ) :
    ⇑(bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem n)
      =ᵐ[μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x))]
        fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))

name: TauCeti.coeFn_hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem
statement:
theorem coeFn_hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem {μ : Measure α}
    (hwpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (hcomplete :
      (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥) (n : ℕ) :
    ⇑(hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem f w c hwpos hwm hc horth hmem hcomplete n)
      =ᵐ[μ] fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x * Real.sqrt (w x) / Real.sqrt (c n))

name: TauCeti.coe_hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem
statement:
theorem coe_hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem {μ : Measure α}
    (hwpos : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (hcomplete :
      (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥) (n : ℕ) :
    hilbertBasisOfOrthogonalSystem f w c hwpos hwm hc horth hmem hcomplete n
      = weightL2Isometry μ w hwpos hwm (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem n)

name: TauCeti.coe_hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure
statement:
theorem coe_hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure {μ : Measure α}
    (hwnn : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) (hwm : AEMeasurable w μ) (hc : ∀ n, 0 < c n)
    (horth : ∀ m n, (∫ x, f m x * f n x * w x ∂μ) = if m = n then c n else 0)
    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (hcomplete :
      (Submodule.span 𝕜 (Set.range (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem)))ᗮ = ⊥) :
    ⇑(hilbertBasisOfWeightedMeasure f w c hwnn hwm hc horth hmem hcomplete)
      = bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem

    (hmem : ∀ n, MemLp (fun x => (algebraMap ℝ 𝕜) (f n x / Real.sqrt (c n))) 2
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (w x)))) (m n : ℕ) :
    inner 𝕜 (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem m) (bareNormalizedLp (𝕜 := 𝕜) f w c hmem n)

statement:
theorem exists_hilbertBasis_forall_apply_eq_smul_inner (hB : IsCoercive B) {J : V →L[ℝ] H}
    (hJ : IsCompactOperator J) (hJdense : DenseRange J) (hsymm : ∀ u v : V, B u v = B v u) :
    ∃ (s : Set H) (b : HilbertBasis s ℝ H) (kappa : s → ℝ) (u : s → V),
      ⇑b = ((↑) : s → H) ∧ (∀ x : s, 0 < kappa x) ∧ (∀ x : s, u x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ x : s, J (u x) = (x : H)) ∧
      (∀ (x : s) (v : V), B (u x) v = kappa x * ⟪J (u x), J v⟫_ℝ) ∧
      ∀ h : H, HasSum (fun x : s => (kappa x)⁻¹ • b.repr h x • b x)
        (hB.formSolutionOperator J h)

name: TauCeti.PDE.mul_sq_mul_norm_sq_le_matrixBilinearForm_add
statement:
theorem mul_sq_mul_norm_sq_le_matrixBilinearForm_add {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {lam Lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (z w : ℝ) (g q : EuclideanSpace ℝ n)
    (hlower : lam * ‖g‖ ^ 2 ≤ A.toQuadraticForm' g)
    (hupper : |q ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ g)| ≤ Lam * ‖q‖ * ‖g‖) :
    lam * (z ^ 2 * ‖g‖ ^ 2) ≤
      matrixBilinearForm A (z • (z • g + w • q) + (z * w) • q) g
        + lam / 2 * (z ^ 2 * ‖g‖ ^ 2) + 2 * Lam ^ 2 / lam * (‖q‖ ^ 2 * w ^ 2)

name: TauCeti.PDE.garding_energyIntegrand_self_of_bounds
statement:
lemma garding_energyIntegrand_self_of_bounds (hlam : 0 < lam)
    {A : Matrix n n ℝ} {b₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ n} {c₀ : ℝ}

    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖b x‖ ≤ beta) (hc : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, mu ≤ c x) (hlower : Integrable
      (fun x ↦ lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 + (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * (U x).1 ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable (fun x ↦ energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (U x)) μ) :
    ∫ x, (lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 +
        (mu - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam)) * (U x).1 ^ 2) ∂μ
      ≤ energyFormIntegral μ a b c U U

    (hlower : Integrable (fun x ↦ lam / 2 * ‖(U x).2‖ ^ 2 - beta ^ 2 / (2 * lam) * (U x).1 ^ 2) μ)
    (henergy : Integrable (fun x ↦ energyIntegrand (a x) (b x) (c x) (U x) (U x)) μ) :

name: TauCeti.laplaceFourierTransform_add_measure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laplaceFourierTransform_add_measure [OpensMeasurableSpace V] (μ ν : Measure (ℝ≥0 × V))

    laplaceFourierTransform (μ + ν) x =
      laplaceFourierTransform μ x + laplaceFourierTransform ν x

name: TauCeti.laplaceFourierTransform_apply
statement:
theorem laplaceFourierTransform_apply (μ : Measure (ℝ≥0 × V)) (x : ℝ≥0 × V) :
    laplaceFourierTransform μ x = ∫ y, laplaceAtom x.1 y.1 * fourierAtom x.2 y.2 ∂μ

name: TauCeti.laplaceFourierTransform_apply_exp
statement:
theorem laplaceFourierTransform_apply_exp (μ : Measure (ℝ≥0 × V)) (t : ℝ≥0) (a : V) :
    laplaceFourierTransform μ (t, a) =
      ∫ y, (Real.exp (-(t : ℝ) * (y.1 : ℝ)) : ℂ) *
        Complex.exp (-2 * ((Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I * ((inner ℝ a y.2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∂μ

theorem swapCompProd_prod (μ : Measure V) [SFinite μ] (κ : Kernel V Ω)

    swapCompProd μ κ (A ×ˢ B) = ∫⁻ q in B, κ q A ∂μ

name: TauCeti.exists_representsLaplaceFourier_iff_exists_timeKernel
statement:
theorem exists_representsLaplaceFourier_iff_exists_timeKernel
    (hFpd : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, IsPositiveDefiniteSub fun a => F (t, a))
    (hFcont : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, Continuous fun a => F (t, a)) :
    (∃ μ : Measure (ℝ≥0 × V), RepresentsLaplaceFourier μ F) ↔
      ∃ κ : Kernel V ℝ≥0, IsMarkovKernel κ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        (bochnerMeasure fun a => F (0, a)).withDensity (Kernel.laplaceTransform κ t)
          = bochnerMeasure fun a => F (t, a)

name: TauCeti.representsLaplaceFourier_swapCompProd
statement:
theorem representsLaplaceFourier_swapCompProd
    (hFpd : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, IsPositiveDefiniteSub fun a => F (t, a))
    (hFcont : ∀ t : ℝ≥0, Continuous fun a => F (t, a)) (κ : Kernel V ℝ≥0)

theorem StronglyContinuousSemigroup.generator_eq_of_tendsto

    (h : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => (1 / t) • (S.realOperator t x - x))

      rw [S.generator_domain]
      exact S.integral_orbit_mem_domain x ht⟩
      = S.realOperator t x - x

      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
      (nhds (S.generator ⟨(x : X), by
        rw [S.generator_domain]
        exact x.property⟩))

        rw [S.generator_domain]
        exact x.property⟩))

name: TauCeti.Semigroups.StronglyContinuousSemigroup.slope_apply_realOperator_eq
statement:
theorem slope_apply_realOperator_eq (S : StronglyContinuousSemigroup X) (F : ℝ → X →L[ℝ] X)
    (x : X) {s u : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hu : s ≤ u) :
    slope (fun v : ℝ => F v (S.realOperator v x)) s u =
      F u ((u - s)⁻¹ • (S.realOperator (u - s) (S.realOperator s x) - S.realOperator s x)) +
        slope (fun v : ℝ => F v (S.realOperator s x)) s u

    ∑ b ∈ univ.filter (a ≤ ·), ∑ c ∈ univ.filter (b ≤ ·), f b c =
      ∑ c, ∑ b ∈ univ.filter (fun b => a ≤ b ∧ b ≤ c), f b c

    (hstep : ∀ i ∈ P, ∀ t ∈ (P.erase i).powerset, g i t = g i (insert i t) + h i (insert i t)) :
    ∑ T ∈ P.powerset, (-1 : R) ^ T.card * (∑ i ∈ P, g i T + ∑ i ∈ T, h i T) = 0

theorem sum_piecewise_eq_sum_update_of_card_eq_succ {ι : Type*} {α : ι → Type*} {M : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [AddCommMonoid M] {m : ℕ} (hm : Fintype.card ι = m + 1)

statement:
theorem resolvent_comm (S : StronglyContinuousSemigroup X) {omegaLambda MLambda omegaMu MMu : ℝ}
    [CompleteSpace X] (hbLambda : S.HasGrowthBound omegaLambda MLambda)
    (hbMu : S.HasGrowthBound omegaMu MMu) (lambda mu : ℝ)
    (hlambda : omegaLambda < lambda) (hmu : omegaMu < mu) :
    S.resolvent hbLambda lambda hlambda ∘L S.resolvent hbMu mu hmu =
      S.resolvent hbMu mu hmu ∘L S.resolvent hbLambda lambda hlambda

name: TauCeti.Semigroups.StronglyContinuousSemigroup.resolvent_sub_resolvent
statement:
theorem resolvent_sub_resolvent (S : StronglyContinuousSemigroup X)
    {omegaLambda MLambda omegaMu MMu : ℝ} [CompleteSpace X]
    (hbLambda : S.HasGrowthBound omegaLambda MLambda)
    (hbMu : S.HasGrowthBound omegaMu MMu) (lambda mu : ℝ)
    (hlambda : omegaLambda < lambda) (hmu : omegaMu < mu) :
    S.resolvent hbLambda lambda hlambda - S.resolvent hbMu mu hmu =
      (mu - lambda) •
        (S.resolvent hbLambda lambda hlambda ∘L S.resolvent hbMu mu hmu)

name: TauCeti.Semigroups.StronglyContinuousSemigroup.resolvent_sub_resolvent_apply
statement:
theorem resolvent_sub_resolvent_apply (S : StronglyContinuousSemigroup X)
    {omegaLambda MLambda omegaMu MMu : ℝ} [CompleteSpace X]
    (hbLambda : S.HasGrowthBound omegaLambda MLambda)
    (hbMu : S.HasGrowthBound omegaMu MMu) (lambda mu : ℝ)
    (hlambda : omegaLambda < lambda) (hmu : omegaMu < mu) (x : X) :
    S.resolvent hbLambda lambda hlambda x - S.resolvent hbMu mu hmu x =
      (mu - lambda) •
        S.resolvent hbLambda lambda hlambda (S.resolvent hbMu mu hmu x)

    (hcomm : ∀ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ S.generator.domain),

name: TauCeti.lintegral_indicator_le_ofReal_rpow_Ioi
statement:
theorem lintegral_indicator_le_ofReal_rpow_Ioi (hs : s < -1) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (a : ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        {t : ℝ | a ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * t)}.indicator (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ s)) t =
      ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ (-(s + 1)) / (-(s + 1))) * a ^ (s + 1)

name: TauCeti.lintegral_indicator_ofReal_rpow_Ioi
statement:
theorem lintegral_indicator_ofReal_rpow_Ioi (hs : -1 < s) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (a : ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        {t : ℝ | ENNReal.ofReal (c * t) < a}.indicator (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ s)) t =
      ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ (-(s + 1)) / (s + 1)) * a ^ (s + 1)

name: TauCeti.lintegral_ofReal_rpow_Ioi

theorem lintegral_ofReal_rpow_Ioi (s : ℝ) :

theorem lintegral_ofReal_rpow_Ioo (hs : -1 < s) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :

name: TauCeti.lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_ofReal_lt_mul
statement:
theorem lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_ofReal_lt_mul (ν : Measure β) {u : β → ℝ≥0∞}

name: TauCeti.setLIntegral_Ioc_ite_rpow_le
statement:
theorem setLIntegral_Ioc_ite_rpow_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {r D : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∫⁻ t in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, (if r ≤ t * D then ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 1)) else 0) ≤

name: TauCeti.setLIntegral_Ioc_rpow_mul_ite_le

    ∫⁻ t in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-(n : ℝ) - 1)) *

      ENNReal.ofReal (D ^ n / n) * (a * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ (1 - (n : ℝ)))

name: TauCeti.enorm_sub_setAverage_le_of_convex
statement:
theorem enorm_sub_setAverage_le_of_convex [CompleteSpace F] (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩc : Convex ℝ Ω)

name: TauCeti.lintegral_comp_add_smul_sub_mul_ite
statement:
theorem lintegral_comp_add_smul_sub_mul_ite (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    (g : E → ℝ≥0∞) (x : E) (D : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫⁻ y, g (x + t • (y - x)) * (if ‖x - y‖ ≤ D then ENNReal.ofReal ‖x - y‖ else 0) ∂μ =
      ∫⁻ w, ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (-(finrank ℝ E : ℝ) - 1)) *
        (g w * if ‖x - w‖ ≤ t * D then ENNReal.ofReal ‖x - w‖ else 0) ∂μ

theorem contDiff_iteratedGradientChain {f : F → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (iteratedGradientChain f j)
  | 0 => by
      rw [iteratedGradientChain_zero]
      exact (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ F).symm.contDiff.comp
        (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).2
  | j + 1 => by
      rw [iteratedGradientChain_succ]
      exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp (contDiff_iteratedGradientChain hf j)).2

  | 0 => by
      rw [iteratedGradientChain_zero]
      exact (hf.fderiv ℝ).comp_left (map_zero _)
  | j + 1 => by
      rw [iteratedGradientChain_succ]
      exact (hasCompactSupport_iteratedGradientChain hf j).fderiv ℝ

theorem trace_symmetricEntry_mul_mul_symmetricEntry_mul (i j k l : Fin p)
    {S : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ} (hS : S.IsHermitian) :
    (((symmetricEntry i j : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)) :

name: TauCeti.prod_lowerTriangle_diag_rpow_mul_exp_neg_sq
statement:
theorem prod_lowerTriangle_diag_rpow_mul_exp_neg_sq (x : lowerTriangle p → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i : Fin p, 0 < x ⟨(i, i), le_rfl⟩) (d q : ℝ) (c : Fin p → ℝ) (b : ℝ) :
    ∏ ij : lowerTriangle p,
        (if ij.1.1 = ij.1.2 then
            c ij.1.1 * x ⟨(ij.1.1, ij.1.1), le_rfl⟩ ^
              (2 * d + p - ((ij.1.1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
          else b) * Real.exp (-q * x ij ^ 2) =
      (∏ i : Fin p, c i * b ^ (i : ℕ)) *
        ((lowerTriangleMatrix p x * (lowerTriangleMatrix p x)ᵀ).det ^ d *
          (∏ i : Fin p, x ⟨(i, i), le_rfl⟩ ^ (p - (i : ℕ))) *
            Real.exp (-q * (lowerTriangleMatrix p x * (lowerTriangleMatrix p x)ᵀ).trace))

name: TauCeti.integrableOn_lowerTriangle_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace
statement:
theorem integrableOn_lowerTriangle_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace
    (ha : ((p : ℝ) - 1) / 2 < a) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : lowerTriangle p → ℝ ↦
        ((lowerTriangleMatrix p x * (lowerTriangleMatrix p x)ᵀ).det ^ (a - ((p : ℝ) + 1) / 2) *
            exp (-(lowerTriangleMatrix p x * (lowerTriangleMatrix p x)ᵀ).trace)) *
          (2 ^ p * ∏ i : Fin p, x ⟨(i, i), le_rfl⟩ ^ (p - (i : ℕ))))
      {x : lowerTriangle p → ℝ | ∀ i : Fin p, 0 < x ⟨(i, i), le_rfl⟩}

name: TauCeti.integral_lowerTriangle_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace
statement:
theorem integral_lowerTriangle_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace
    (ha : ((p : ℝ) - 1) / 2 < a) :
    ∫ x in {x : lowerTriangle p → ℝ | ∀ i : Fin p, 0 < x ⟨(i, i), le_rfl⟩},
        ((lowerTriangleMatrix p x * (lowerTriangleMatrix p x)ᵀ).det ^ (a - ((p : ℝ) + 1) / 2) *
            exp (-(lowerTriangleMatrix p x * (lowerTriangleMatrix p x)ᵀ).trace)) *
          (2 ^ p * ∏ i : Fin p, x ⟨(i, i), le_rfl⟩ ^ (p - (i : ℕ))) =
      multivariateGamma p a

statement:
theorem lintegral_posDef_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace_mul_eq_top (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hBpd : ¬ B.PosDef) (ha : ((p : ℝ) - 1) / 2 ≤ a) :

name: Matrix.det_one_add_smul_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem det_one_add_smul_transpose_mul_mul {m n R : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] (c : R) (B : Matrix m m R)
    (M : Matrix m n R) (A : Matrix n n R) :
    det (1 + c • ((Mᵀ * B * M) * A)) = det (1 + c • (B * (M * A * Mᵀ)))

name: Matrix.det_one_sub_smul_transpose_mul_mul
statement:
theorem det_one_sub_smul_transpose_mul_mul {m n R : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] (c : R) (B : Matrix m m R)
    (M : Matrix m n R) (A : Matrix n n R) :
    det (1 - c • ((Mᵀ * B * M) * A)) = det (1 - c • (B * (M * A * Mᵀ)))

name: Matrix.submatrix_one_mul_mul_submatrix_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem submatrix_one_mul_mul_submatrix_one {m n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    [NonAssocSemiring R] (f : m → n) (A : Matrix n n R) :
    (1 : Matrix n n R).submatrix f id * A * (1 : Matrix n n R).submatrix id f =
      A.submatrix f f

name: Matrix.trace_mul_congruence
statement:
theorem trace_mul_congruence {m n R : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [NonUnitalCommSemiring R]
    (B : Matrix m m R) (M : Matrix m n R) (A : Matrix n n R) :
    (B * (M * A * Mᵀ)).trace = ((Mᵀ * B * M) * A).trace

name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.integral_posDef_symmetricCongruence
statement:
theorem integral_posDef_symmetricCongruence {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (f : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) → E) :
    ∫ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
        (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef}, f (symmetricCongruence C A)
        ∂symmetricLebesgue p =
      (|Matrix.det (C : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)| ^ (p + 1))⁻¹ •
        ∫ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
          (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef}, f A ∂symmetricLebesgue p

name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.lintegral_posDef_symmetricCongruence
statement:
theorem lintegral_posDef_symmetricCongruence
    (f : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∫⁻ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
        (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef}, f (symmetricCongruence C A)
        ∂symmetricLebesgue p =
      (ENNReal.ofReal |Matrix.det (C : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)| ^ (p + 1))⁻¹ *
        ∫⁻ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
          (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef}, f A ∂symmetricLebesgue p

      (ENNReal.ofReal |Matrix.det (C : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)| ^ (p + 1))⁻¹ •
        (symmetricLebesgue p).restrict {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
          (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef}

name: Matrix.PosDef.integral_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace_inv_mul
statement:
theorem integral_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace_inv_mul (hT : T.PosDef) (a : ℝ) :
    ∫ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
        (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef},
      (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).det ^ (a - ((p : ℝ) + 1) / 2) *
        exp (-(T⁻¹ * (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)).trace) ∂symmetricLebesgue p =
      T.det ^ a *
        ∫ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
            (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef},
          (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).det ^ (a - ((p : ℝ) + 1) / 2) *
            exp (-(A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).trace) ∂symmetricLebesgue p

        exp (-(S⁻¹ * (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ)).trace / 2) ∂symmetricLebesgue p =
      2 ^ ((p : ℝ) * a) * S.det ^ a *
        ∫ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |
            (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).PosDef},
          (A : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ).det ^ (a - ((p : ℝ) + 1) / 2) *

name: Matrix.PosDef.lintegral_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace_inv_mul
statement:
theorem lintegral_det_rpow_mul_exp_neg_trace_inv_mul (hT : T.PosDef) (a : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ A in {A : selfAdjoint.submodule ℝ (Matrix (Fin p) (Fin p) ℝ) |

statement:
theorem heights_nonneg_of_monotone_turning {n i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) {H φ : ℕ → ℝ} {Hinf : ℝ}
    (hmono : ∀ l m, l ≤ m → m ≤ n → φ l ≤ φ m) (hlow : ∀ l ≤ n, -2 * Real.pi < φ l)
    (hlast : φ n = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ l < n, ∃ d, 0 ≤ d ∧ H (l + 1) - H l = d * Real.sin (φ l - φ i))
    (hclose₁ : ∃ r, 0 ≤ r ∧ Hinf - H n = r * Real.sin (-φ i))
    (hclose₂ : ∃ r, 0 ≤ r ∧ H 0 - Hinf = r * Real.sin (-φ i)) (hHi : H i = 0) :
    (∀ k ≤ n, 0 ≤ H k) ∧ 0 ≤ Hinf

TauCeti.eqToHom_conjugate_square
statement:
theorem eqToHom_conjugate_square {C : Type*} [Category* C] {X X' Y Y' Z Z' W W' : C}
    (hX : X = X') (hY : Y = Y') (hZ : Z = Z') (hW : W = W')
    (f : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Z') (f' : X' ⟶ W') (g' : W' ⟶ Z') :
    (eqToHom hX ≫ f ≫ eqToHom hY.symm) ≫ eqToHom hY ≫ g ≫ eqToHom hZ.symm =
        (eqToHom hX ≫ f' ≫ eqToHom hW.symm) ≫ eqToHom hW ≫ g' ≫ eqToHom hZ.symm ↔
      f ≫ g = f' ≫ g'

name: TauCeti.eqToHom_conjugate_vertical_square_of_horizontal_square
statement:
theorem eqToHom_conjugate_vertical_square_of_horizontal_square {C : Type*} [Category* C]
    {A A' B B' D D' E E' : C} (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (hD : D = D') (hE : E = E')
    (p : A' ⟶ B') (q : E' ⟶ D') (f : B ⟶ D) (g : A ⟶ E)
    (h : (eqToHom hA ≫ p ≫ eqToHom hB.symm) ≫ f = g ≫ eqToHom hE ≫ q ≫ eqToHom hD.symm) :
    p ≫ (eqToHom hB.symm ≫ f ≫ eqToHom hD) = (eqToHom hA.symm ≫ g ≫ eqToHom hE) ≫ q

statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_commShift {F : C ⥤ D} {H : D ⥤ K} [F.Additive] [H.Additive]
    (h : GradedConflationExact E E' F) (h' : GradedConflationExact E' E'' H) :
    (h.comp h').commShift =
      (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerRight h.commShift H ≪≫
        Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerLeft F h'.commShift ≪≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm

name: TauCeti.GradedExactEquiv.symm_commShift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_commShift (h : GradedExactEquiv E E') :
    HEq h.symm.commShift
      ((Functor.leftUnitor (E'.shift.functor ⋙ h.equiv.inverse)).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight h.equiv.counitIso.symm
          (E'.shift.functor ⋙ h.equiv.inverse) ≪≫
        Functor.associator h.equiv.inverse h.equiv.functor
          (E'.shift.functor ⋙ h.equiv.inverse) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft h.equiv.inverse
          (Functor.associator h.equiv.functor E'.shift.functor h.equiv.inverse).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft h.equiv.inverse
          (Functor.isoWhiskerRight h.commShift.symm h.equiv.inverse) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft h.equiv.inverse
          (Functor.associator E.shift.functor h.equiv.functor h.equiv.inverse) ≪≫
        (Functor.associator h.equiv.inverse E.shift.functor
          (h.equiv.functor ⋙ h.equiv.inverse)).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (h.equiv.inverse ⋙ E.shift.functor) h.equiv.unitIso.symm ≪≫
        Functor.associator h.equiv.inverse E.shift.functor (𝟭 C) ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft h.equiv.inverse (Functor.rightUnitor E.shift.functor))

name: TauCeti.GradedExactEquiv.symm_equiv
statement:

theorem mapNatIso_hom (I : MorphismIdeal C) (J : MorphismIdeal D) {F G : C ⥤ D}
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (hF : I ≤ J.comap F) (hG : I ≤ J.comap G) (α : F ≅ G) :
    (I.mapNatIso J hF hG α).hom = I.mapNatTrans J hF hG α.hom

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.mapNatIso_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapNatIso_inv (I : MorphismIdeal C) (J : MorphismIdeal D) {F G : C ⥤ D}
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (hF : I ≤ J.comap F) (hG : I ≤ J.comap G) (α : F ≅ G) :
    (I.mapNatIso J hF hG α).inv = I.mapNatTrans J hG hF α.inv

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.mapNatTrans_app_quotientFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapNatTrans_app_quotientFunctor_obj (I : MorphismIdeal C) (J : MorphismIdeal D)
    {F G : C ⥤ D} [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (hF : I ≤ J.comap F) (hG : I ≤ J.comap G)
    (α : F ⟶ G) (X : C) :
    eqToHom (I.map_obj_quotientFunctor_obj J F hF X).symm ≫
        (I.mapNatTrans J hF hG α).app (I.quotientFunctor.obj X) ≫
          eqToHom (I.map_obj_quotientFunctor_obj J G hG X) =
      J.quotientFunctor.map (α.app X)

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.mapNatTrans_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapNatTrans_id (I : MorphismIdeal C) (J : MorphismIdeal D) (F : C ⥤ D)
    [F.Additive] (hF : I ≤ J.comap F) :
    I.mapNatTrans J hF hF (𝟙 F) = 𝟙 (I.map J F hF)

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.map_comp
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`: the intermediate ideal `J` does not occur in the left-hand side, so simp could
-- never instantiate it (the `simpNF` linter rejects the attribute).
theorem map_comp (I : MorphismIdeal C) (J : MorphismIdeal D) (K : MorphismIdeal E)
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ E) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (hF : I ≤ J.comap F) (hG : J ≤ K.comap G) :
    I.map K (F ⋙ G) (I.le_comap_comp J K F G hF hG) =
      I.map J F hF ⋙ J.map K G hG

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (I : MorphismIdeal C) :
    I.map I (𝟭 C) (by simp) = 𝟭 I.Quotient

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.map_map_quotientFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_map_quotientFunctor_map (I : MorphismIdeal C) (J : MorphismIdeal D) (F : C ⥤ D)
    [F.Additive] (hF : I ≤ J.comap F) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (I.map J F hF).map (I.quotientFunctor.map f) ≫
        eqToHom (I.map_obj_quotientFunctor_obj J F hF Y) =
      eqToHom (I.map_obj_quotientFunctor_obj J F hF X) ≫
        J.quotientFunctor.map (F.map f)

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.map_obj_quotientFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_obj_quotientFunctor_obj (I : MorphismIdeal C) (J : MorphismIdeal D) (F : C ⥤ D)
    [F.Additive] (hF : I ≤ J.comap F) (X : C) :
    (I.map J F hF).obj (I.quotientFunctor.obj X) = J.quotientFunctor.obj (F.obj X)

name: TauCeti.MorphismIdeal.comap_functor_comap_inverse

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableEquivalence_functor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stableEquivalence_functor (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive] [e.inverse.Additive]
    (hF : StableConflationExact E E' e.functor)
    (hG : StableConflationExact E' E e.inverse)
    (hE : E.IsFrobenius) (hE' : E'.IsFrobenius) :
    (stableEquivalence e hF hG hE hE').functor = hF.stableFunctor hE

statement:

theorem stableEquivalence_inverse (e : C ≌ D) [e.functor.Additive] [e.inverse.Additive]
    (hF : StableConflationExact E E' e.functor)
    (hG : StableConflationExact E' E e.inverse)
    (hE : E.IsFrobenius) (hE' : E'.IsFrobenius) :
    (stableEquivalence e hF hG hE hE').inverse = hG.stableFunctor hE'

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableFunctor_comp
statement:
theorem stableFunctor_comp {F : Functor C D} {G : Functor D K} [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (hF : StableConflationExact E E' F) (hG : StableConflationExact E' E'' G)
    (hE : E.IsFrobenius) (hE' : E'.IsFrobenius) :
    (hF.comp hG).stableFunctor hE = hF.stableFunctor hE ⋙ hG.stableFunctor hE'

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableFunctor_id

theorem stableFunctor_id (hE : E.IsFrobenius) :

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableFunctor_map_projectiveStableFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stableFunctor_map_projectiveStableFunctor_map {F : Functor C D} [F.Additive]
    (hF : StableConflationExact E E' F) (hE : E.IsFrobenius) {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (hF.stableFunctor hE).map (E.projectiveStableFunctor.map f) ≫
        eqToHom (hF.stableFunctor_obj_projectiveStableFunctor_obj hE Y) =
      eqToHom (hF.stableFunctor_obj_projectiveStableFunctor_obj hE X) ≫
        E'.projectiveStableFunctor.map (F.map f)

theorem stableFunctor_obj_projectiveStableFunctor_obj {F : Functor C D} [F.Additive]

    (hF.stableFunctor hE).obj (E.projectiveStableFunctor.obj X) =
      E'.projectiveStableFunctor.obj (F.obj X)

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableNatIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stableNatIso_hom {F G : Functor C D} [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (hF : StableConflationExact E E' F) (hG : StableConflationExact E E' G)
    (hE : E.IsFrobenius) (α : F ≅ G) :
    (stableNatIso hF hG hE α).hom = stableNatTrans hF hG hE α.hom

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableNatIso_inv
statement:

theorem stableNatIso_inv {F G : Functor C D} [F.Additive] [G.Additive]

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableNatTrans_app_projectiveStableFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stableNatTrans_app_projectiveStableFunctor_obj {F G : Functor C D}
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (hF : StableConflationExact E E' F)
    (hG : StableConflationExact E E' G) (hE : E.IsFrobenius) (α : F ⟶ G) (X : C) :
    eqToHom (hF.stableFunctor_obj_projectiveStableFunctor_obj hE X).symm ≫
        (stableNatTrans hF hG hE α).app (E.projectiveStableFunctor.obj X) ≫
          eqToHom (hG.stableFunctor_obj_projectiveStableFunctor_obj hE X) =
      E'.projectiveStableFunctor.map (α.app X)

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableNatTrans_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stableNatTrans_comp {F G H : Functor C D} [F.Additive] [G.Additive] [H.Additive]
    (hF : StableConflationExact E E' F) (hG : StableConflationExact E E' G)
    (hH : StableConflationExact E E' H) (hE : E.IsFrobenius)
    (α : F ⟶ G) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    stableNatTrans hF hG hE α ≫ stableNatTrans hG hH hE β =
      stableNatTrans hF hH hE (α ≫ β)

name: TauCeti.StableConflationExact.stableNatTrans_id

theorem stableNatTrans_id {F : Functor C D} [F.Additive]

name: CategoryTheory.SplitEpi.eq_pullback_section
statement:
lemma eq_pullback_section (h : SplitEpi f) {T : C} (g : T ⟶ S) [HasPullback f g]
    (t : T ⟶ Limits.pullback f g) (hfst : t ≫ Limits.pullback.fst f g = g ≫ h.section_)
    (hsnd : t ≫ Limits.pullback.snd f g = 𝟙 T) :
    t = (h.pullback g).section_

name: CategoryTheory.SplitEpi.pullback_section_def
statement:
lemma pullback_section_def (h : SplitEpi f) {T : C} (g : T ⟶ S) [HasPullback f g] :
    (h.pullback g).section_ =
      Limits.pullback.lift (g ≫ h.section_) (𝟙 T) (by simp)

name: CategoryTheory.SplitEpi.pullback_section_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma pullback_section_fst (h : SplitEpi f) {T : C} (g : T ⟶ S) [HasPullback f g] :
    (h.pullback g).section_ ≫ Limits.pullback.fst f g = g ≫ h.section_

name: CategoryTheory.SplitEpi.pullback_section_map
statement:
lemma pullback_section_map (h : SplitEpi f) {T T' : C} (g : T ⟶ S) (k : T' ⟶ T)
    [HasPullback f g] [HasPullback f (k ≫ g)] : (h.pullback (k ≫ g)).section_ ≫
        Limits.pullback.map f (k ≫ g) f g (𝟙 X) k (𝟙 S) (by simp) (by simp) =
      k ≫ (h.pullback g).section_

name: CategoryTheory.SplitEpi.pullback_section_naturality
statement:
lemma pullback_section_naturality {Y : C} {f' : Y ⟶ S} (h : SplitEpi f)
    (h' : SplitEpi f') (i : X ⟶ Y) (hi : f = i ≫ f')
    (hsection : h.section_ ≫ i = h'.section_) {T : C} (g : T ⟶ S)
    [HasPullback f g] [HasPullback f' g] : (h.pullback g).section_ ≫
        Limits.pullback.map f g f' g i (𝟙 T) (𝟙 S) (by simp [hi]) (by simp) =
      (h'.pullback g).section_

      composeDiagram (capCup (σ a) (σ b)) (permToBrauer σ)

name: TauCeti.eq_capCup_iff
statement:

    D = capCup a b ↔ D.val (Sum.inl a) = Sum.inl b ∧ D.val (Sum.inr a) = Sum.inr b ∧
      ∀ i, i ≠ a → i ≠ b → D.val (Sum.inl i) = Sum.inr i

        (L.law (k + l)).map
            (fun G => (SimpleGraph.comap (Fin.castAdd l) G, SimpleGraph.comap (Fin.natAdd k) G))
          = (L.law k).prod (L.law l)

      ((L.law (k + l)).map
          (fun G => (SimpleGraph.comap (Fin.castAdd l) G, SimpleGraph.comap (Fin.natAdd k) G))
        (Set.Ici F₁ ×ˢ Set.Ici F₂)).toReal

      ∀ (k l : ℕ) (F₁ : SimpleGraph (Fin k)) (F₂ : SimpleGraph (Fin l)),
        L.upperMass ((F₁ ⊕g F₂).map finSumFinEquiv.toEmbedding) =
          L.upperMass F₁ * L.upperMass F₂

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_apply_eq_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uniformOn_apply_eq_apply [Finite ι] [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass κ] [Nonempty κ]
    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (ι → κ)) {x | x i = x j} =
      1 / (Fintype.card κ : ℝ≥0∞)

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_injective_le_add
statement:
theorem uniformOn_injective_le_add [Finite ι] [Finite κ] [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass κ]
    (A : Set (ι → κ)) :
    uniformOn {x : ι → κ | Function.Injective x} A ≤
      uniformOn Set.univ A + uniformOn Set.univ {x : ι → κ | ¬Function.Injective x}

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_injective_le_add_choose_two_div
statement:
theorem uniformOn_injective_le_add_choose_two_div [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass κ] (A : Set (ι → κ)) :
    uniformOn {x : ι → κ | Function.Injective x} A ≤
      uniformOn Set.univ A + (Fintype.card ι).choose 2 / Fintype.card κ

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_le_univ_add_compl
statement:
theorem uniformOn_le_univ_add_compl {Ω : Type*} [Finite Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass Ω] (E A : Set Ω) :
    uniformOn E A ≤ uniformOn Set.univ A + uniformOn Set.univ Eᶜ

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_not_injective_le
statement:
theorem uniformOn_not_injective_le [MeasurableSpace κ] [MeasurableSingletonClass κ] :
    uniformOn (Set.univ : Set (ι → κ)) {x | ¬Function.Injective x} ≤
      (Fintype.card ι).choose 2 / Fintype.card κ

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_toReal
statement:
theorem uniformOn_toReal {Ω : Type*} [Finite Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass Ω] (S T : Set Ω) :
    (uniformOn S T).toReal =
      (Nat.card {x : Ω // x ∈ S ∩ T} : ℝ) /
        (Nat.card {x : Ω // x ∈ S} : ℝ)

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_univ_le_add_compl
statement:
theorem uniformOn_univ_le_add_compl {Ω : Type*} [Finite Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass Ω] (E A : Set Ω) :
    uniformOn Set.univ A ≤ uniformOn E A + uniformOn Set.univ Eᶜ

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_univ_le_injective_add
statement:
theorem uniformOn_univ_le_injective_add [Finite ι] [Finite κ] [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass κ]
    (A : Set (ι → κ)) :
    uniformOn Set.univ A ≤ uniformOn {x : ι → κ | Function.Injective x} A +
      uniformOn Set.univ {x : ι → κ | ¬Function.Injective x}

name: TauCeti.Probability.uniformOn_univ_le_injective_add_choose_two_div
statement:
theorem uniformOn_univ_le_injective_add_choose_two_div [MeasurableSpace κ]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass κ] (A : Set (ι → κ)) :
    uniformOn Set.univ A ≤ uniformOn {x : ι → κ | Function.Injective x} A +
      (Fintype.card ι).choose 2 / Fintype.card κ

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.sampleIntegrand_def
statement:
theorem sampleIntegrand_def (x : Fin n → Ω) :
    sampleIntegrand W G x =
      (∏ e ∈ G.edgeFinset, edgeFactor W x e) *
        ∏ e ∈ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeFinset \ G.edgeFinset,
          (1 - edgeFactor W x e)

      (if e ∈ G.edgeFinset then edgeFactor W x e else 1 - edgeFactor W x e)

      (p : ℝ) ^ G.edgeFinset.card *
        (1 - (p : ℝ)) ^ (n.choose 2 - G.edgeFinset.card)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.sum_sampleIntegrand_inter_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sampleIntegrand_inter_eq (A B : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)))
    (hA : A ⊆ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeFinset) (hBA : B ⊆ A) (x : Fin n → Ω) :
    ∑ H ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun H : SimpleGraph (Fin n) => H.edgeFinset ∩ A = B),
        sampleIntegrand W H x =
      (∏ e ∈ B, edgeFactor W x e) * ∏ e ∈ A \ B, (1 - edgeFactor W x e)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.sum_sampleIntegrand_superset_eq_prod_edgeFactor
statement:
theorem sum_sampleIntegrand_superset_eq_prod_edgeFactor (T : Finset (Sym2 (Fin n)))
    (hT : T ⊆ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)).edgeFinset) (x : Fin n → Ω) :
    ∑ H ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun H => (T : Set (Sym2 (Fin n))) ⊆ H.edgeSet),
        sampleIntegrand W H x =
      ∏ e ∈ T, edgeFactor W x e

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.abs_integral_homDensityFin_sub_integral_injHomDensity_le
statement:
theorem abs_integral_homDensityFin_sub_integral_injHomDensity_le {V W : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [Fintype W] (F : SimpleGraph V) (ν : Measure (SimpleGraph W)) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] :
    |(∫ G, homDensityFin F G ∂ν) - ∫ G, injHomDensity F G ∂ν| ≤

    (hVW : Fintype.card V ≤ Fintype.card W) (h : ∀ f : V ↪ W, ν.real {G | F.map f ≤ G} = c) :
    ∫ G, injHomDensity F G ∂ν = c

    ∫ G, injHomDensity F G ∂ν =
      (∑ f : V ↪ W, ν.real {G | F.map f ≤ G}) /
        ((Fintype.card W).descFactorial (Fintype.card V) : ℝ)

    (h₂ : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => u₂ p.1 * v p.2 * K p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ)) :

      (⊤ : MeasurableSpace (P.parts × P.parts))]
      (fun z : Ω × Ω => stepGraphon (μ := μ) P hP val hsymm z.1 z.2)

    {Ω ι E : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace ι] [Countable ι]
    [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ι} (hX : Measurable X)

    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hg : Integrable g μ)
    (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.comap X ‹MeasurableSpace ι›] g μ)
    (hfg : ∀ i, ∫ x in X ⁻¹' {i}, g x ∂μ = ∫ x in X ⁻¹' {i}, f x ∂μ) :

    (htriv : ∀ s, MeasurableSet[m'] s → μ s = 0 ∨ μ s = 1) {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : Ω → E} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    μ[f | m'] =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => ∫ x, f x ∂μ

name: TauCeti.MeasureTheory.condExp_ae_eq_of_forall_condExp_ae_eq_of_tendsto_eLpNorm
statement:
-- Stated for an arbitrary conditioning σ-algebra `F` (no `F ≤ m₀`, no `[SigmaFinite (μ.trim)]`):
-- the bound goes through Mathlib's Lᵖ contraction `eLpNorm_condExp_le_eLpNorm`, which holds at
-- every `F` via the `condExp = 0` convention — whereas `condExpL1CLM` would require both. Proof:
-- bound `‖μ[Xlim|F] - Y‖₁` by `‖Xlim - Xn n‖₁` (triangle + `condExp_sub` + the contraction + the
-- vanishing `μ[Xn n|F] - Y` term), then let `n → ∞`. Consumed by the reverse-martingale
-- Lévy-downward theorem `MeasureTheory.tendsto_ae_condExp_iInf`.
lemma condExp_ae_eq_of_forall_condExp_ae_eq_of_tendsto_eLpNorm
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    {F : MeasurableSpace Ω} {Xlim Y : Ω → ℝ} {Xn : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
    (hXlimint : Integrable Xlim μ) (hXn_int : ∀ n, Integrable (Xn n) μ)
    (h_condExp : ∀ n, μ[Xn n | F] =ᵐ[μ] Y)
    (hL1 : Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (Xlim - Xn n) 1 μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    μ[Xlim | F] =ᵐ[μ] Y

name: TauCeti.MeasureTheory.condExp_comp_ae_eq_of_pair_law_eq
statement:
theorem condExp_comp_ae_eq_of_pair_law_eq {Ω α β : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [MeasurableSpace α] [mβ : MeasurableSpace β] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (Y Y' : Ω → α) (Z : Ω → β) (hY : Measurable Y) (hY' : Measurable Y') (hZ : Measurable Z)
    (hpair : μ.map (fun ω => (Y ω, Z ω)) = μ.map (fun ω => (Y' ω, Z ω)))
    {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) :
    μ[fun ω => f (Y ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap Z mβ]
      =ᵐ[μ] μ[fun ω => f (Y' ω) | MeasurableSpace.comap Z mβ]

theorem l2sq_smul (c : ℝ) (K : SymmKernel Ω μ) : l2sq μ (c • K) = c ^ 2 * l2sq μ K

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.l2sq_sub
statement:
theorem l2sq_sub (K L : SymmKernel Ω μ) :
    l2sq μ (K - L) = l2sq μ K - 2 * l2inner μ K L + l2sq μ L

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.l2sq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem l2sq_zero : l2sq μ (0 : SymmKernel Ω μ) = 0

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.sq_rectIntegral_le_l2sq
statement:
theorem sq_rectIntegral_le_l2sq [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (K : SymmKernel Ω μ) (S T : Set Ω) :
    (K.rectIntegral μ S T) ^ 2 ≤ l2sq μ K

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.sq_rectIntegral_le_measureReal_mul_l2sq
statement:
theorem sq_rectIntegral_le_measureReal_mul_l2sq (K : SymmKernel Ω μ) (S T : Set Ω) :
    (K.rectIntegral μ S T) ^ 2 ≤ (μ.prod μ).real (S ×ˢ T) * l2sq μ K

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_eq
statement:
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_eq (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W = l2sq μ (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_eq_sum
statement:
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_eq_sum (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W
      = ∑ pq : P.parts × P.parts, W.toSymmKernel.rectIntegral μ (pq.1 : Set Ω) (pq.2 : Set Ω)
        * ⨍ z in (pq.1 : Set Ω) ×ˢ (pq.2 : Set Ω), W z.1 z.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_increment
statement:
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_increment (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p)
    (hQ : ∀ r ∈ Q.parts, MeasurableSet r) (href : Q ≤ P) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    graphonPartitionEnergy μ Q hQ W
      = graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W
        + l2sq μ ((stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) Q hQ W).toSymmKernel
          - (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_le_l2sq
statement:
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_le_l2sq (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W ≤ l2sq μ W.toSymmKernel

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_le_one
statement:
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_le_one (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W ≤ 1

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_mono
statement:
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_mono (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p)
    (hQ : ∀ r ∈ Q.parts, MeasurableSet r) (href : Q ≤ P) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W ≤ graphonPartitionEnergy μ Q hQ W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_nonneg
statement:
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_nonneg (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    0 ≤ graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphonPartitionEnergy_stepGraphonAvg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphonPartitionEnergy_stepGraphonAvg (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p)
    (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W)
      = graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.l2inner_graphon_stepGraphonAvg
statement:
theorem l2inner_graphon_stepGraphonAvg (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    l2inner μ W.toSymmKernel (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel
      = graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.l2inner_stepGraphonAvg_eq_sum
statement:
theorem l2inner_stepGraphonAvg_eq_sum (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ)
    (K : SymmKernel Ω μ) :
    l2inner μ K (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel
      = ∑ pq : P.parts × P.parts, K.rectIntegral μ (pq.1 : Set Ω) (pq.2 : Set Ω)
        * ⨍ z in (pq.1 : Set Ω) ×ˢ (pq.2 : Set Ω), W z.1 z.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.l2inner_stepGraphonAvg_of_le
statement:
theorem l2inner_stepGraphonAvg_of_le (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p)
    (hQ : ∀ r ∈ Q.parts, MeasurableSet r) (href : Q ≤ P) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    l2inner μ (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) Q hQ W).toSymmKernel
        (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel
      = graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.l2sq_sub_stepGraphonAvg
statement:
theorem l2sq_sub_stepGraphonAvg (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    l2sq μ (W.toSymmKernel - (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel)
      = l2sq μ W.toSymmKernel - graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.stepGraphonAvg_rectIntegral_of_le_of_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stepGraphonAvg_rectIntegral_of_le_of_le {P R Q : Finpartition (Set.univ : Set Ω)}
    (p : P.parts) (r : R.parts) (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q.parts, MeasurableSet q)
    (hQP : Q ≤ P) (hQR : Q ≤ R)
    (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) Q hQ W).toSymmKernel.rectIntegral μ (p : Set Ω) (r : Set Ω)
      = W.toSymmKernel.rectIntegral μ (p : Set Ω) (r : Set Ω)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.exists_graphon_tendsto_cutNorm_of_cauchy_cutNorm
statement:
theorem exists_graphon_tendsto_cutNorm_of_cauchy_cutNorm (V : ℕ → Graphon Ω μ)
    (hV : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N,
      cutNorm μ ((V m).toSymmKernel - (V n).toSymmKernel) < ε) :
    ∃ U : Graphon Ω μ,
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ cutNorm μ ((V n).toSymmKernel - U.toSymmKernel)) atTop (𝓝 0)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.exists_ofMatrix_eq_comap_of_factorsThrough
statement:
theorem exists_ofMatrix_eq_comap_of_factorsThrough (W : Graphon Ω μ) {g : Ω → κ}

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.edgeFactor_comap
statement:

theorem edgeFactor_comap (W : Graphon Ω μ) {f : Ω' → Ω} (hf : Measurable f) (x : V → Ω')

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.homDensity_comap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homDensity_comap (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj] (W : Graphon Ω μ) {f : Ω' → Ω}
    (hf : MeasurePreserving f ν μ) :
    homDensity F (W.comap f hf.measurable ν) = homDensity F W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.homDensity_cycleGraph_four
statement:
theorem homDensity_cycleGraph_four (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    homDensity (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph 4) W =
      ∫ p : (Ω × Ω) × (Ω × Ω),
        W p.1.1 p.2.1 * W p.2.1 p.1.2 * W p.1.2 p.2.2 * W p.2.2 p.1.1
          ∂((μ.prod μ).prod (μ.prod μ))

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.homDensity_fin_four
statement:
theorem homDensity_fin_four (F : SimpleGraph (Fin 4)) [DecidableRel F.Adj] (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    homDensity F W =
      ∫ p : (Ω × Ω) × (Ω × Ω),
        ∏ e ∈ F.edgeFinset,
          edgeFactor W ![p.1.1, p.2.1, p.1.2, p.2.2] e
          ∂((μ.prod μ).prod (μ.prod μ))

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.homDensity_fin_three
statement:
theorem homDensity_fin_three (F : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) [DecidableRel F.Adj] (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    homDensity F W
      = ∫ p : Ω × Ω × Ω, ∏ e ∈ F.edgeFinset, edgeFactor W ![p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2] e
          ∂(μ.prod (μ.prod μ))

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.homDensity_fin_two
statement:
theorem homDensity_fin_two (F : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) [DecidableRel F.Adj] (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    homDensity F W
      = ∫ p : Ω × Ω, ∏ e ∈ F.edgeFinset, edgeFactor W ![p.1, p.2] e ∂(μ.prod μ)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.homDensity_top_fin_three
statement:
theorem homDensity_top_fin_three (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    homDensity (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) W
      = ∫ p : Ω × Ω × Ω, W p.1 p.2.1 * W p.1 p.2.2 * W p.2.1 p.2.2 ∂(μ.prod (μ.prod μ))

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.homDensity_top_fin_two
statement:
theorem homDensity_top_fin_two (W : Graphon Ω μ) :
    homDensity (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) W = ∫ p : Ω × Ω, W p.1 p.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)

theorem mapRestrictDensity_def (f : Ω' → Ω) (ν : Measure Ω') (μ : Measure Ω)

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.SymmKernel.rectIntegral_comap_eq_testIntegral

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.LabeledGraph.glue_adj_inl
statement:
theorem glue_adj_inl (G₁ G₂ : LabeledGraph k) (a b : Fin G₁.n) :
    (G₁.glue G₂).graph.Adj (G₁.glueInl G₂ a) (G₁.glueInl G₂ b) ↔
      G₁.graph.Adj a b ∨
        ∃ i j, a = G₁.label i ∧ b = G₁.label j ∧ G₂.graph.Adj (G₂.label i) (G₂.label j)

      (∃ j, b = G₂.label j ∧ G₁.graph.Adj a (G₁.label j)) ∨
        ∃ i, a = G₁.label i ∧ G₂.graph.Adj (G₂.label i) b

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.eq_graphParamMobius_iff

theorem eq_graphParamMobius_iff (f : GraphParam) {n : ℕ} (g : SimpleGraph (Fin n) → ℝ) :

      ∀ F : SimpleGraph (Fin n), ∑ G ∈ univ.filter (fun G ↦ F ≤ G), g G = f n F

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphParamMobius_apply

      ∑ G ∈ univ.filter (fun G : SimpleGraph (Fin n) ↦ F ≤ G),
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ (Nat.card G.edgeSet - Nat.card F.edgeSet) * f n G

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.graphParamMobius_sum_comap

    (G : SimpleGraph (Fin k)) :
    graphParamMobius f k G =
      ∑ H ∈ univ.filter (fun H : SimpleGraph (Fin n) ↦ H.comap ⇑e = G),
        graphParamMobius f n H

statement:
theorem exists_refinement_energy_add_sq_le (P : Finpartition (Set.univ : Set Ω))
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p) (W : Graphon Ω μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hbad : ε < cutNorm μ (W.toSymmKernel - (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel)) :
    ∃ (Q : Finpartition (Set.univ : Set Ω)) (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q.parts, MeasurableSet q),
      Q ≤ P ∧ Q.parts.card ≤ 4 * P.parts.card ∧
        graphonPartitionEnergy μ P hP W + ε ^ 2 ≤ graphonPartitionEnergy μ Q hQ W

name: TauCeti.DenseGraphLimits.weak_regularity_frieze_kannan
statement:
theorem weak_regularity_frieze_kannan (W : Graphon Ω μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (P : Finpartition (Set.univ : Set Ω)) (hP : ∀ p ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet p),
      P.parts.card ≤ 4 ^ (Nat.ceil (1 / ε ^ 2) + 1) ∧
      cutNorm μ (W.toSymmKernel - (stepGraphonAvg (μ := μ) P hP W).toSymmKernel) ≤ ε

    ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : List α), l.length = n + 1 →
      ∏ i : Fin n, p (l.getD i.val d) (l.getD (i.val + 1) d) =
        (l.consecutivePairs.map fun q => p q.1 q.2).prod

    obtain rfl : n = 0

name: TauCeti.PermSubgroupWreathProduct.card
statement:
theorem card (Q : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm ι)) [Finite ι] :
    Nat.card (PermSubgroupWreathProduct D ι Q) =
      Nat.card D ^ Nat.card ι * Nat.card Q

name: TauCeti.PermSubgroupWreathProduct.mul_left

theorem mul_left (Q : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm ι)) (a b : PermSubgroupWreathProduct D ι Q) (i : ι) :

name: TauCeti.WreathProduct.card
statement:
theorem card [Finite ι] :
    Nat.card (WreathProduct D ι) =
      Nat.card D ^ Nat.card ι * (Nat.card ι).factorial

name: TauCeti.WreathProduct.congr_left
statement:

theorem congr_left (e : ι ≃ κ) (w : WreathProduct D ι) (i : κ) :

theorem congr_right (e : ι ≃ κ) (w : WreathProduct D ι) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem congr_trans {μ : Type*} (e : ι ≃ κ) (e' : κ ≃ μ) :
    (congr (D := D) e).trans (congr (D := D) e') = congr (D := D) (e.trans e')

@[simp] theorem orbitActionHom_apply (t : PermutationTriple n) (O : MonodromyOrbit t)

    (Finite.equivFinOfCardEq (Nat.card_coe_set_eq O.orbit)).symm
        (t.orbitActionHom O g i) =
      g • (Finite.equivFinOfCardEq (Nat.card_coe_set_eq O.orbit)).symm i

      ∑ Cₖ : ConjClasses G, (structureConstant Cᵢ Cⱼ Cₖ : k) • classSum k Cₖ

statement:

name: TauCeti.structureConstant_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem structureConstant_mk (Cᵢ Cⱼ : ConjClasses G) (g : G) :
    structureConstant Cᵢ Cⱼ (ConjClasses.mk g) =
      ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter
        fun p : Cᵢ.carrier × Cⱼ.carrier => (p.1.1 : G) * p.2.1 = g).card

name: TauCeti.structureConstant_mk_eq_card_filter
statement:
theorem structureConstant_mk_eq_card_filter (Cᵢ Cⱼ : ConjClasses G) (g : G) :
    structureConstant Cᵢ Cⱼ (ConjClasses.mk g) =
      {q ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (G × G)) |
        ConjClasses.mk q.1 = Cᵢ ∧ ConjClasses.mk q.2 = Cⱼ ∧ q.1 * q.2 = g}.card

name: TauCeti.structureConstant_mk_one_left

theorem structureConstant_mk_one_left (Cⱼ Cₖ : ConjClasses G) :

name: TauCeti.structureConstant_mk_one_right

name: TauCeti.card_productOneTriples_eq_sum_characterTable
statement:
theorem card_productOneTriples_eq_sum_characterTable (C0 C1 Cinf : ConjClasses G) :
    ((productOneTriples C0 C1 Cinf).card : k) =
      (Nat.card C0.carrier : k) * Nat.card C1.carrier * Nat.card Cinf.carrier / Nat.card G *
        ∑ l, characterTable k G l C0 * characterTable k G l C1 * characterTable k G l Cinf /
          (characterDegree k l : k)

name: TauCeti.mem_productOneTriples
statement:

theorem mem_productOneTriples {C0 C1 Cinf : ConjClasses G} {p : G × G × G} :
    p ∈ productOneTriples C0 C1 Cinf ↔
      ConjClasses.mk p.1 = C0 ∧ ConjClasses.mk p.2.1 = C1 ∧ ConjClasses.mk p.2.2 = Cinf ∧
        p.2.2 * p.2.1 * p.1 = 1

        ∑ l, characterTable k G l Ci * characterTable k G l Cj * characterTable k G l Ck⁻¹ /
          (characterDegree k l : k)

name: TauCeti.sum_characterTable_threeCycle_transposition

    [CharZero k] [Invertible (Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : k)] :
    ∑ l, characterTable k (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) l (ConjClasses.mk (finRotate 3)) *
        characterTable k (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) l (ConjClasses.mk (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1)) *
        characterTable k (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) l (ConjClasses.mk (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1)) /
      (characterDegree k l : k) = 2

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.benderKnuth_apply_of_not_inBlock
statement:
theorem benderKnuth_apply_of_not_inBlock (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ)
    {i j : ℕ} (h : ¬ T.InBlock v i j) : benderKnuth T v i j = T i j

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.benderKnuth_benderKnuth
statement:
@[simp]
theorem benderKnuth_benderKnuth (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) :
    benderKnuth (benderKnuth T v) v = T

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.benderKnuth_involutive
statement:
theorem benderKnuth_involutive (μ : YoungDiagram) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.Involutive fun T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ => benderKnuth T v

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_benderKnuth
statement:
@[simp]
theorem content_benderKnuth (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v x : ℕ) :
    content (benderKnuth T v) x = content T (Equiv.swap v (v + 1) x)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_benderKnuth_of_ne
statement:
theorem content_benderKnuth_of_ne (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) (hx : x ≠ v)
    (hx' : x ≠ v + 1) : content (benderKnuth T v) x = content T x

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_benderKnuth_self
statement:
theorem content_benderKnuth_self (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) :
    content (benderKnuth T v) v = content T (v + 1)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_benderKnuth_succ
statement:
theorem content_benderKnuth_succ (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) :
    content (benderKnuth T v) (v + 1) = content T v

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_eq_sum
statement:
theorem content_eq_sum (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) :
    content T v
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0), (rowCountLt T i (v + 1) - rowCountLt T i v)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_recut
statement:
theorem content_recut (hcut : IsCut T v cut) :
    content (recut T v cut hcut) v
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0), (cut i - rowCountLt T i v)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_recut_add
statement:
theorem content_recut_add (hcut : IsCut T v cut) :
    content (recut T v cut hcut) v + content (recut T v cut hcut) (v + 1)
      = content T v + content T (v + 1)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_recut_of_ne
statement:
theorem content_recut_of_ne (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (hx : x ≠ v) (hx' : x ≠ v + 1) :
    content (recut T v cut hcut) x = content T x

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_recut_succ
statement:
theorem content_recut_succ (hcut : IsCut T v cut) :
    content (recut T v cut hcut) (v + 1)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0), (rowCountLt T i (v + 2) - cut i)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.content_succ_eq_sum
statement:
theorem content_succ_eq_sum (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) :
    content T (v + 1)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (μ.colLen 0), (rowCountLt T i (v + 2) - rowCountLt T i (v + 1))

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.filter_lt_eq_range
statement:
theorem filter_lt_eq_range (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (i x : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range (μ.rowLen i)).filter fun j => T i j < x) = Finset.range (rowCountLt T i x)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.filter_recut_eq
statement:
theorem filter_recut_eq (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (i : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range (μ.rowLen i)).filter fun j => recut T v cut hcut i j = v)
      = Finset.Ico (rowCountLt T i v) (cut i)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.filter_recut_eq_succ
statement:
theorem filter_recut_eq_succ (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (i : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.range (μ.rowLen i)).filter fun j => recut T v cut hcut i j = v + 1)
      = Finset.Ico (cut i) (rowCountLt T i (v + 2))

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.inBlock_benderKnuth_iff
statement:
theorem inBlock_benderKnuth_iff (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v i j : ℕ) :
    (benderKnuth T v).InBlock v i j ↔ T.InBlock v i j

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.inBlock_iff
statement:
theorem inBlock_iff (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) {i j : ℕ} (v : ℕ)
    (hj : ((i, j) : ℕ × ℕ) ∈ μ) :
    T.InBlock v i j ↔ (rowCountLt T i v ≤ j ∧ j < rowCountLt T i (v + 2))

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.inBlock_recut_iff
statement:
theorem inBlock_recut_iff (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (i j : ℕ) :
    (recut T v cut hcut).InBlock v i j ↔ T.InBlock v i j

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.isCut_rowCountLt
statement:
theorem isCut_rowCountLt (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) :
    IsCut T v fun i => rowCountLt T i (v + 1)

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.lt_rowCountLt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_rowCountLt_iff (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) {i j x : ℕ} (hj : j < μ.rowLen i) :
    j < rowCountLt T i x ↔ T i j < x

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.not_inBlock_of_notMem
statement:
theorem not_inBlock_of_notMem {T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ} {v i j : ℕ}
    (hj : ((i, j) : ℕ × ℕ) ∉ μ) : ¬ T.InBlock v i j

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.recut_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem recut_apply (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (i j : ℕ) :
    recut T v cut hcut i j =
      if T.InBlock v i j then (if j < cut i then v else v + 1) else T i j

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.recut_apply_of_inBlock
statement:
theorem recut_apply_of_inBlock (hcut : IsCut T v cut) {i j : ℕ} (h : T.InBlock v i j) :
    recut T v cut hcut i j = if j < cut i then v else v + 1

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.recut_apply_of_not_inBlock
statement:
theorem recut_apply_of_not_inBlock (hcut : IsCut T v cut) {i j : ℕ} (h : ¬ T.InBlock v i j) :
    recut T v cut hcut i j = T i j

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.recut_recut
statement:
theorem recut_recut {cut' : ℕ → ℕ} (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (hcut' : IsCut T v cut') :
    recut (recut T v cut hcut) v cut' (hcut.recut hcut') = recut T v cut' hcut'

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.recut_rowCountLt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem recut_rowCountLt (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v : ℕ) :
    recut T v (fun i => rowCountLt T i (v + 1)) (isCut_rowCountLt T v) = T

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_benderKnuth_of_ge
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_benderKnuth_of_ge (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v i : ℕ)
    (hx : v + 2 ≤ x) : rowCountLt (benderKnuth T v) i x = rowCountLt T i x

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_benderKnuth_of_le
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_benderKnuth_of_le (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (v i : ℕ) (hx : x ≤ v) :
    rowCountLt (benderKnuth T v) i x = rowCountLt T i x

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_eq_zero_of_colLen_le
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_eq_zero_of_colLen_le (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : μ.colLen 0 ≤ i) (x : ℕ) : rowCountLt T i x = 0

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_le_rowLen
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_le_rowLen (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (i x : ℕ) :
    rowCountLt T i x ≤ μ.rowLen i

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_mono
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_mono (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (i : ℕ) {x y : ℕ} (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    rowCountLt T i x ≤ rowCountLt T i y

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_recut_of_ge
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_recut_of_ge (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (i : ℕ) (hx : v + 2 ≤ x) :
    rowCountLt (recut T v cut hcut) i x = rowCountLt T i x

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_recut_of_le
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_recut_of_le (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (i : ℕ) (hx : x ≤ v) :
    rowCountLt (recut T v cut hcut) i x = rowCountLt T i x

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_recut_succ
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_recut_succ (hcut : IsCut T v cut) (i : ℕ) :
    rowCountLt (recut T v cut hcut) i (v + 1) = cut i

name: SemistandardYoungTableau.rowCountLt_succ_le
statement:
theorem rowCountLt_succ_le (T : SemistandardYoungTableau μ) (i x : ℕ) :
    rowCountLt T (i + 1) (x + 1) ≤ rowCountLt T i x

name: YoungDiagram.betaNumber_def
statement:
theorem betaNumber_def (μ : YoungDiagram) (r i : ℕ) :
    μ.betaNumber r i = μ.rowLen i + (r - 1 - i)

name: YoungDiagram.betaNumber_lt_betaNumber
statement:
theorem betaNumber_lt_betaNumber (μ : YoungDiagram) (hij : i < j) (hj : j < r) :
    μ.betaNumber r j < μ.betaNumber r i

name: YoungDiagram.cast_prod_betaNumber_sub
statement:
theorem cast_prod_betaNumber_sub (μ : YoungDiagram) (r : ℕ) :
    ((∏ k ∈ range r, ∏ l ∈ Ico (k + 1) r, (μ.betaNumber r k - μ.betaNumber r l) : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = ∏ k ∈ range r, ∏ l ∈ Ico (k + 1) r,
          ((μ.betaNumber r k : ℤ) - (μ.betaNumber r l : ℤ))

name: YoungDiagram.injOn_betaNumber
statement:
theorem injOn_betaNumber (μ : YoungDiagram) (r : ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (μ.betaNumber r) (Set.Iio r)

name: YoungDiagram.strictAntiOn_betaNumber
statement:
theorem strictAntiOn_betaNumber (μ : YoungDiagram) (r : ℕ) :
    StrictAntiOn (μ.betaNumber r) (Set.Iio r)

statement:

theorem card_ofRowLens (a : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ) :

statement:

statement:
theorem isRowLowerSet_iff [LT ι] {D : Finset (ι × κ)} :

name: TauCeti.CellDiagram.isRowLowerSet_ofRowLens
statement:
theorem isRowLowerSet_ofRowLens [Preorder ι] {a : ι → ℕ} (ha : Antitone a) (m : ℕ) :

name: TauCeti.CellDiagram.mem_ofRowLens_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ofRowLens_iff {a : ι → ℕ} {m : ℕ} {p : ι × Fin m} :
    p ∈ ofRowLens a m ↔ (p.2 : ℕ) < a p.1

name: TauCeti.CellDiagram.rowLen_eq_card_filter
statement:
theorem rowLen_eq_card_filter (D : Finset (ι × κ)) (i : ι) :
    rowLen D i = (D.filter fun p => p.1 = i).card

name: TauCeti.CellDiagram.rowLen_eq_card_filter_mem
statement:
theorem rowLen_eq_card_filter_mem [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (D : Finset (ι × κ)) (i : ι) :
    rowLen D i = (Finset.univ.filter fun c : κ => (i, c) ∈ D).card

name: TauCeti.CellDiagram.rowLen_ofRowLens
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rowLen_ofRowLens (a : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ) (i : ι) :
    rowLen (ofRowLens a m) i = min (a i) m

name: TauCeti.CellDiagram.rowLen_ofRowLens_of_le
statement:
theorem rowLen_ofRowLens_of_le {a : ι → ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : ∀ i, a i ≤ m) (i : ι) :
    rowLen (ofRowLens a m) i = a i

theorem card_filter_rowIndex_lt (t : YoungTableau μ) (k : ℕ) :

name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colFiberEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem colFiberEquiv_apply_coe (t : YoungTableau μ) (j : ℕ)
    (k : {k : Fin μ.card // colIndex t k = j}) :
    (colFiberEquiv t j k : ℕ × ℕ) = (t.symm k.1 : ℕ × ℕ)

name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.colFiberEquiv_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem colFiberEquiv_symm_apply_coe (t : YoungTableau μ) (j : ℕ) (c : ↥(μ.col j)) :

name: TauCeti.YoungTableau.rowIndex_def

name: TauCeti.Nat.primePowerProd_mul_eq_sum_divisors_gcd
statement:
theorem primePowerProd_mul_eq_sum_divisors_gcd
    (hppow : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ∀ r s : ℕ, r ≤ s →
      primePowerProd D (p ^ r) * primePowerProd D (p ^ s) =
        ∑ i ∈ range (r + 1), (p ^ i : ℕ) • (primePowerProd S (p ^ i) *
          primePowerProd D (p ^ (r + s - 2 * i))))
    {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    primePowerProd D m * primePowerProd D n =
      ∑ d ∈ (Nat.gcd m n).divisors,
        (d : ℕ) • (primePowerProd S d * primePowerProd D (m * n / d ^ 2))

statement:
-- Not a `simp` lemma: `simpNF` rejects it. Normalising the left-hand side sends `simp` after
-- `Fintype Gal(M/M ^ ⟨σ⟩)`, and with only `Finite (Subgroup.zpowers σ)` in scope that instance
-- search exhausts its heartbeat budget instead of failing, so the lemma could never fire.
theorem card_algEquiv_fixedField_zpowers (σ : M ≃ₐ[K] M) [Finite (Subgroup.zpowers σ)] :
    Nat.card (M ≃ₐ[IntermediateField.fixedField (Subgroup.zpowers σ)] M) = orderOf σ

name: Polynomial.Gal.mem_range_restrictProd_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.Polynomial.Gal.mem_range_restrictProd_iff (hp : p.Separable) (hq : q.Separable)
    [Fact ((p.map (algebraMap F (p * q).SplittingField)).Splits)]
    [Fact ((q.map (algebraMap F (p * q).SplittingField)).Splits)] (σ : p.Gal) (τ : q.Gal) :
    (σ, τ) ∈ (Gal.restrictProd p q).range ↔
      ∀ (x : p.SplittingField) (y : q.SplittingField),
        algebraMap p.SplittingField (p * q).SplittingField x =
            algebraMap q.SplittingField (p * q).SplittingField y →
          algebraMap p.SplittingField (p * q).SplittingField (σ x) =
            algebraMap q.SplittingField (p * q).SplittingField (τ y)

    [Fact ((q.map (algebraMap F (p * q).SplittingField)).Splits)] :
    Gal.restrictProd p q = (Gal.restrict p (p * q).SplittingField).prod

name: TauCeti.esymm_fin_four
statement:
theorem esymm_fin_four {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] :
    MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin 4) R 1 =
        MvPolynomial.X 0 + MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 2 + MvPolynomial.X 3 ∧
      MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin 4) R 2 =
        MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 + MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 2 +
          MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 3 + MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 2 +
          MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 3 + MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 3 ∧
      MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin 4) R 3 =
        MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 2 +
          MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 3 +
          MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 3 +
          MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 3 ∧
      MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin 4) R 4 =
        MvPolynomial.X 0 * MvPolynomial.X 1 * MvPolynomial.X 2 * MvPolynomial.X 3

statement:
theorem fiberSubgroupMulEquivPiPerm_trans_piCongrRight_apply (f : α → ι)
    (e : ∀ i, {a // f a = i} ≃ β i) (σ : fiberSubgroup f) (i : ι) (a : {a // f a = i}) :
    (fiberSubgroupMulEquivPiPerm f).trans
        (MulEquiv.piCongrRight fun i => (e i).permCongrHom) σ i (e i a) =
      e i ⟨(σ : Equiv.Perm α) a, (mem_fiberSubgroup.mp σ.2 a).trans a.2⟩

name: TauCeti.fiberSubgroupMulEquivPiPerm_trans_piCongrRight_symm_apply
statement:
theorem fiberSubgroupMulEquivPiPerm_trans_piCongrRight_symm_apply (f : α → ι)
    (e : ∀ i, {a // f a = i} ≃ β i) (σ : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm (β i)) (a : α) :
    ((((fiberSubgroupMulEquivPiPerm f).trans
        (MulEquiv.piCongrRight fun i => (e i).permCongrHom)).symm σ : Equiv.Perm α) a : α) =
      ((e (f a)).symm (σ (f a) (e (f a) ⟨a, rfl⟩)) : α)

name: TauCeti.fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer_apply_unop_coe
statement:
-- This is the defining equation of `fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer`: its `toFun` is literally
-- `fun σ => MulOpposite.op ⟨DomMulAct.mk σ, _⟩`, so after `unop` and the subtype coercion the two
-- sides are the same term and `rfl` proves it.  The definition is deliberately not `@[expose]`d, so
-- the pre-bump `simp [fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer]` has nothing to unfold; the parentheses in
-- `(rfl)` keep the definitional step inside this module, leaving this lemma and
-- `fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer_symm_apply_coe` as the whole interface for importers.
@[simp]
theorem fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer_apply_unop_coe (f : α → ι) (σ : fiberSubgroup f) :
    ((fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer f σ).unop : (Equiv.Perm α)ᵈᵐᵃ) =
      DomMulAct.mk (σ : Equiv.Perm α)

name: TauCeti.fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer_symm_apply_coe (f : α → ι)
    (g : (MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm α)ᵈᵐᵃ f)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    (((fiberSubgroupMulEquivStabilizer f).symm g : fiberSubgroup f) : Equiv.Perm α) =
      DomMulAct.mk.symm (g.unop : (Equiv.Perm α)ᵈᵐᵃ)

    {g : C^n⟮modelWithCornersSelf k E, E; modelWithCornersSelf k F, F⟯} :
    Tendsto f l (nhds g) ↔
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n), Tendsto

    Tendsto f l (nhds g) ↔
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) (K : Set E), IsCompact K →
        ∀ (U : Set (E [×m]→L[k] F)), IsOpen U →

name: ContMDiffMap.mem_chartJetSet
statement:

theorem mem_chartJetSet [IsManifold I n M] [IsManifold J n N]

    {f : C^n⟮I, M; J, N⟯} :
    f ∈ chartJetSet x y m K V ↔
      ∀ z ∈ K, f ((extChartAt I x).symm z) ∈ (extChartAt J y).source ∧

name: TauCeti.Hodge.Conjugation.map_prod
statement:
theorem Conjugation.map_prod {W : Type*} {W' : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    [AddCommGroup W'] [Module ℂ W'] {ω : Conjugation W} {ω' : Conjugation W'}
    {Ω : Conjugation (W × W')}
    (hΩ : ∀ x : W × W', Ω.toEquiv x = (ω.toEquiv x.1, ω'.toEquiv x.2))
    (U : Submodule ℂ W) (U' : Submodule ℂ W') :
    (U.prod U').map Ω.toEquiv.toLinearMap =
      (U.map ω.toEquiv.toLinearMap).prod (U'.map ω'.toEquiv.toLinearMap)

name: TauCeti.Hodge.Conjugation.map_restrict_comap_subtype

    (hU : ∀ x ∈ U, ω.toEquiv x ∈ U) (A : Submodule ℂ W) :
    (A.comap U.subtype).map (ω.restrict hU).toEquiv.toLinearMap =
      (A.map ω.toEquiv.toLinearMap).comap U.subtype
