name: TauCeti.Sporadic.ruPresentation_transcriptionNotes
statement:
theorem ruPresentation_transcriptionNotes :
    ruPresentation.transcriptionNotes = "Prepend the implicit relators v^2 and t^2 to the ten \
      words in the source's fifth section. The third-section words t, u, and \
      ((uvu)^-1*t*u*v*u*v*t*v*[t,u]^2*v*t*v)^2 only generate the subgroup used for enumeration \
      over twisted F4(2), so they are metadata rather than relations. The fourth section is empty \
      and hence supplies no Coxeter relations. An independent line-by-line read-through against \
      the pinned source and its tcfrontend.c parser found exact equality after its documented \
      involution normalization: in the parser output alphabet 1 is u, 2 is both v and v^-1, 3 is \
      both t and t^-1, and 4 is u^-1. FiniteSimpleGroups does not cover Ru, so its separate \
      permutation-group cross-check does not apply."

name: TauCeti.Sporadic.suzPresentation_transcriptionNotes

@[simp]
theorem suzPresentation_transcriptionNotes :
    suzPresentation.transcriptionNotes = "Expand the paths a5b3c8d3e and b3f4g3b to seven square \
      relations, seven labeled-edge relations, and fourteen omitted-edge relations. Append the \
      five words in presdef[3], compiling the two equalities by the source's MakeWordList decoder, \
      and the one word in presdef[4]. The latter is present because \
      InitializeGroupPresentationGPL includes presdef[4] when GPL_PCE is true, as it is by default \
      in version 1.0. The expected relator count and total length are derived from this exact \
      expansion. An independent read-through of GPLTable.Suz.1 and its DeCoxList, MakeWordList, \
      and InitializeGroupPresentationGPL decoders checked the generator order, both paths, all six \
      appended relations, and the compiled signed letters; the itemized comparison is recorded in \
      this module's independent audit section. GAP 4.15.1 enumerates 1782 cosets of the subgroup \
      generated by a through f, which the source labels G2(4). An independent comparison \
      transports the resulting 1782-point action to the graph in finite-simple-groups-lean at \
      commit 7f09e33a9ceef6b59ce03e34cd4f0558c763e325 and checks mutual generator membership with \
      that construction of Suz; the comparison is recorded in this module's independent audit \
      section."

    (f : (ι → R) → M) :

      Fintype.card C • ∑ y : euclideanDual C, f (y : ι → R)

statement:
@[simp]
theorem orthogonalQuotientEquiv_orthogonalQuotientMk (f : Isometry A B)
    {H : AddSubgroup A} {K : AddSubgroup B} (h : H.map f.toAddEquiv = K)
    (x : A.orthogonalComplement H) :
    f.orthogonalQuotientEquiv h (A.orthogonalQuotientMk H x) =
      B.orthogonalQuotientMk K
        ⟨f (x : A), Isometry.map_mem_orthogonalComplement_of_map_eq A f h x.2⟩

name: TauCeti.FiniteBilinearModule.Isometry.orthogonalQuotientEquiv_symm_orthogonalQuotientMk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orthogonalQuotientEquiv_symm_orthogonalQuotientMk (f : Isometry A B)
    {H : AddSubgroup A} {K : AddSubgroup B} (h : H.map f.toAddEquiv = K)
    (y : B.orthogonalComplement K) :
    (f.orthogonalQuotientEquiv h).symm (B.orthogonalQuotientMk K y) =
      A.orthogonalQuotientMk H
        ⟨f.symm (y : B), by
          rw [A.mem_orthogonalComplement_iff]
          intro x hx
          rw [← f.map_pairing, f.apply_symm_apply]
          exact (B.mem_orthogonalComplement_iff K (y : B)).mp y.2 (f x)
            (h ▸ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)⟩

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.Isometry.orthogonalQuotientEquiv_orthogonalQuotientMk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orthogonalQuotientEquiv_orthogonalQuotientMk (f : Isometry A B)
    {H : AddSubgroup A} {K : AddSubgroup B} (hH : A.IsIsotropic H)
    (h : H.map f.toAddEquiv = K)
    (x : A.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement H) :
    f.orthogonalQuotientEquiv hH h (A.orthogonalQuotientMk H hH x) =
      B.orthogonalQuotientMk K (f.isIsotropic_of_map_eq hH h)
        ⟨f (x : A), by
          apply FiniteBilinearModule.Isometry.map_mem_orthogonalComplement_of_map_eq
            A.toFiniteBilinearModule f.toFiniteBilinearModule (K := K) (x := (x : A))
          · simpa only [toFiniteBilinearModule_toAddEquiv] using h
          · exact x.2⟩

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.Isometry.orthogonalQuotientEquiv_symm_orthogonalQuotientMk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orthogonalQuotientEquiv_symm_orthogonalQuotientMk (f : Isometry A B)
    {H : AddSubgroup A} {K : AddSubgroup B} (hH : A.IsIsotropic H)
    (h : H.map f.toAddEquiv = K)
    (y : B.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement K) :
    (f.orthogonalQuotientEquiv hH h).symm
        (B.orthogonalQuotientMk K (f.isIsotropic_of_map_eq hH h) y) =
      A.orthogonalQuotientMk H hH
        ⟨f.symm (y : B), by
          apply (AddSubgroup.mem_map_equiv (f := f.toAddEquiv) (K :=
            A.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement H) (x := (y : B))).mp
          have hcomp :
              (A.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement H).map f.toAddEquiv =
                B.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement (H.map f.toAddEquiv) := by
            simpa only [toFiniteBilinearModule_toAddEquiv] using
              f.toFiniteBilinearModule.map_orthogonalComplement (H := H)
          -- `mem_map_equiv` leaves the additive equivalence coerced through its monoid hom;
          -- normalize that coercion before rewriting with the subgroup equality.
          change (y : B) ∈
            (A.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement H).map f.toAddEquiv
          rw [hcomp, h]
          exact y.2⟩

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.orthogonalQuotientCongr_orthogonalQuotientMk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orthogonalQuotientCongr_orthogonalQuotientMk {H K : AddSubgroup A} (hH : A.IsIsotropic H)
    (hK : A.IsIsotropic K) (h : H = K)
    (x : A.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement H) :
    A.orthogonalQuotientCongr hH hK h (A.orthogonalQuotientMk H hH x) =
      A.orthogonalQuotientMk K hK ⟨x.1, h ▸ x.2⟩

theorem orthogonalQuotientMk_eq_iff (H : AddSubgroup A) (hH : A.IsIsotropic H)
    (x y : A.toFiniteBilinearModule.orthogonalComplement H) :
    A.orthogonalQuotientMk H hH x = A.orthogonalQuotientMk H hH y ↔ (x : A) - y ∈ H

theorem Isometry.coordinatePower_toFiniteBilinearModule (f : Isometry A B)

    (f.coordinatePower ι).toFiniteBilinearModule =
      f.toFiniteBilinearModule.coordinatePower ι

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.coordinatePower_pairing
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_pairing (ι : Type v) [Fintype ι] (x y : ι → A) :
    (A.coordinatePower ι).toFiniteBilinearModule.pairing x y =
      ∑ i, A.toFiniteBilinearModule.pairing (x i) (y i)

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.coordinatePower_quadratic
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_quadratic (ι : Type v) [Fintype ι] (x : ι → A) :
    (A.coordinatePower ι).quadratic x = ∑ i, A.quadratic (x i)

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.coordinatePower_toFiniteBilinearModule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinatePower_toFiniteBilinearModule (ι : Type v) [Fintype ι] :
    (A.coordinatePower ι).toFiniteBilinearModule =
      A.toFiniteBilinearModule.coordinatePower ι

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_iff (ι : Type v) [Fintype ι]
    (C : AddSubgroup (ι → A)) :
    (A.coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic C ↔
      ∀ x ∈ C, ∑ i, A.quadratic (x i) = 0

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.cyclicIsometryOfGenerator_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclicIsometryOfGenerator_apply {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (q : QuadraticMap ℤ (ZMod m) (AddCircle (1 : ℚ)))
    (r : QuadraticMap ℤ A (AddCircle (1 : ℚ))) (e : ZMod m ≃+ A)
    (h : r (e 1) = q 1) (x : ZMod m) :
    cyclicIsometryOfGenerator m q r e h x = e x

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.cyclicIsometryOfGenerator_toAddEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclicIsometryOfGenerator_toAddEquiv {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (q : QuadraticMap ℤ (ZMod m) (AddCircle (1 : ℚ)))
    (r : QuadraticMap ℤ A (AddCircle (1 : ℚ))) (e : ZMod m ≃+ A)
    (h : r (e 1) = q 1) :
    (cyclicIsometryOfGenerator m q r e h).toAddEquiv = e

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.cyclicMap_intCast
statement:
theorem cyclicMap_intCast (k : ℤ) :
    cyclicMap m a hq hp (k : ZMod m) = (k * k) • a

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.cyclicMap_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclicMap_one : cyclicMap m a hq hp 1 = a

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.cyclic_pairing
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclic_pairing [NeZero m] (x y : ZMod m) :
    (cyclic m a hq hp).toFiniteBilinearModule.pairing x y =
      QuadraticMap.polar (cyclicMap m a hq hp) x y

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.cyclic_quadratic
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclic_quadratic [NeZero m] (x : ZMod m) :
    (cyclic m a hq hp).quadratic x = cyclicMap m a hq hp x

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.polar_cyclicMap_intCast
statement:
theorem polar_cyclicMap_intCast (j k : ℤ) :
    QuadraticMap.polar (cyclicMap m a hq hp) (j : ZMod m) (k : ZMod m) = (2 * (j * k)) • a

name: TauCeti.FiniteBilinearModule.isNondegenerate_zmodStandard
statement: theorem isNondegenerate_zmodStandard : (zmodStandard m).IsNondegenerate

name: TauCeti.FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard_pairing
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zmodStandard_pairing (x y : ZMod m) :
    (zmodStandard m).pairing x y = ZMod.toRatAddCircle m (x * y)

name: TauCeti.FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard_pairing_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zmodStandard_pairing_eq_zero_iff (x y : ZMod m) :
    (zmodStandard m).pairing x y = 0 ↔ x * y = 0

name: TauCeti.FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard_pairing_intCast
statement:
theorem zmodStandard_pairing_intCast (j k : ℤ) :
    (zmodStandard m).pairing (j : ZMod m) (k : ZMod m) =
      ((j * k / m : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard_pairing_val
statement:
theorem zmodStandard_pairing_val (x y : ZMod m) :
    (zmodStandard m).pairing x y = ((x.val * y.val / m : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.isNondegenerate_zmodStandard
statement: theorem isNondegenerate_zmodStandard : (zmodStandard m hm).IsNondegenerate

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.polar_zmodStandardMap
statement:
theorem polar_zmodStandardMap (x y : ZMod m) :
    QuadraticMap.polar (zmodStandardMap m hm) x y =
      (FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).pairing x y

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandardMap_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zmodStandardMap_intCast (k : ℤ) :
    zmodStandardMap m hm (k : ZMod m) = ((k ^ 2 / (2 * m) : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandardMap_val
statement:
theorem zmodStandardMap_val (x : ZMod m) :
    zmodStandardMap m hm x = ((x.val ^ 2 / (2 * m) : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard_quadratic
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zmodStandard_quadratic (x : ZMod m) :
    (zmodStandard m hm).quadratic x = zmodStandardMap m hm x

name: TauCeti.FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard_toFiniteBilinearModule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zmodStandard_toFiniteBilinearModule :
    (zmodStandard m hm).toFiniteBilinearModule = FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m

name: TauCeti.coordinatePower_zmodStandard_pairing
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_zmodStandard_pairing (x y : ι → ZMod m) :
    ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).pairing x y =
      ZMod.toRatAddCircle m (x ⬝ᵥ y)

name: TauCeti.coordinatePower_zmodStandard_pairing_eq_zero_iff
statement:
-- Not a `simp` lemma: the coordinate power and the alphabet are both reducible, so `simp` takes
-- the left-hand side apart into the summed coordinate pairings before this could fire.
theorem coordinatePower_zmodStandard_pairing_eq_zero_iff (x y : ι → ZMod m) :
    ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).pairing x y = 0 ↔ x ⬝ᵥ y = 0

name: TauCeti.coordinatePower_zmodStandard_pairing_intCast
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_zmodStandard_pairing_intCast (a b : ι → ℤ) :
    ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).pairing
        (fun i ↦ (a i : ZMod m)) (fun i ↦ (b i : ZMod m)) =
      (((∑ i, (a i : ℚ) * (b i : ℚ)) / m : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic (x : ι → ZMod m) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard m hm).coordinatePower ι).quadratic x =
      (((∑ i, ((x i).val : ℚ) ^ 2) / (2 * m) : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_intCast
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_intCast (z : ι → ℤ) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard m hm).coordinatePower ι).quadratic
        (fun i ↦ ((z i : ZMod m))) =
      (((∑ i, (z i : ℚ) ^ 2) / (2 * m) : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_intCast_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_intCast_eq_zero_iff (z : ι → ℤ) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard m hm).coordinatePower ι).quadratic
        (fun i ↦ ((z i : ZMod m))) = 0 ↔ (2 * m : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i, z i ^ 2

name: TauCeti.coordinatePower_zmodStandard_two_quadratic
statement:
theorem coordinatePower_zmodStandard_two_quadratic (x : ι → ZMod 2) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard 2 even_two).coordinatePower ι).quadratic x =
      (((hammingNorm x : ℚ) / 4 : ℚ) : AddCircle (1 : ℚ))

name: TauCeti.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι) :
    ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic C ↔
      ∀ x ∈ C, ∀ y ∈ C, x ⬝ᵥ y = 0

name: TauCeti.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff_le_euclideanDual
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff_le_euclideanDual
    (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι) :
    ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic C ↔
      AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule m C ≤ (AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule m C).euclideanDual

name: TauCeti.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_iff
    (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard m hm).coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic C ↔
      ∀ x ∈ C, 2 * m ∣ ∑ i, (x i).val ^ 2

name: TauCeti.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_iff_euclideanWeight
statement:
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_iff_euclideanWeight
    (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard m hm).coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic C ↔
      ∀ x ∈ C, 2 * m ∣ euclideanWeight x

name: TauCeti.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_intCast_iff
statement:
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_quadratic_intCast_iff
    (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard m hm).coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic C ↔
      ∀ z : ι → ℤ, (fun i ↦ ((z i : ZMod m))) ∈ C → (2 * m : ℤ) ∣ ∑ i, z i ^ 2

name: TauCeti.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_two_iff
statement:
-- Not a `simp` lemma: `FiniteQuadraticModule.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_iff` already simplifies
-- the left-hand side, so the `simpNF` linter rejects this declaration as a simp lemma.
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_two_iff (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod 2) ι) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard 2 even_two).coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic C ↔
      ∀ x ∈ C, 4 ∣ hammingNorm x

name: TauCeti.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_two_iff_isDoublyEven
statement:
-- Not a `simp` lemma: `FiniteQuadraticModule.isIsotropic_coordinatePower_iff` already simplifies
-- the left-hand side, so the `simpNF` linter rejects this declaration as a simp lemma.
theorem isIsotropic_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_two_iff_isDoublyEven
    (C : LinearCode (ZMod 2) ι) :
    ((FiniteQuadraticModule.zmodStandard 2 even_two).coordinatePower ι).IsIsotropic
        C.toAddSubgroup ↔ BinaryCode.IsDoublyEven C

name: TauCeti.isLagrangian_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isLagrangian_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι) :
    ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).IsLagrangian C ↔
      AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule m C = (AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule m C).euclideanDual

name: TauCeti.mem_orthogonalComplement_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff
statement:
theorem mem_orthogonalComplement_coordinatePower_zmodStandard_iff (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι)
    (x : ι → ZMod m) :
    x ∈ ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).orthogonalComplement C ↔
      ∀ y ∈ C, x ⬝ᵥ y = 0

name: TauCeti.orthogonalComplement_coordinatePower_zmodStandard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orthogonalComplement_coordinatePower_zmodStandard (C : AdditiveCode (ZMod m) ι) :
    ((FiniteBilinearModule.zmodStandard m).coordinatePower ι).orthogonalComplement C =
      (AddSubgroup.toZModSubmodule m C).euclideanDual.toAddSubgroup

name: RingEquiv.nondegenerate_sesquilinearForm
statement:
theorem nondegenerate_sesquilinearForm (σ : R ≃+* R) :
    (sesquilinearForm σ (ι := ι)).Nondegenerate

name: RingEquiv.sesquilinearForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sesquilinearForm_apply (σ : R ≃+* R) (x y : ι → R) :
    sesquilinearForm σ x y = ∑ i, x i * σ (y i)

name: RingEquiv.sesquilinearForm_flip_bijective
statement:
theorem sesquilinearForm_flip_bijective (σ : R ≃+* R) :
    Function.Bijective (sesquilinearForm σ (ι := ι)).flip

name: RingEquiv.sesquilinearForm_swap
statement:
theorem sesquilinearForm_swap (σ : R ≃+* R) (hσ : Function.Involutive σ) (x y : ι → R) :
    sesquilinearForm σ y x = σ (sesquilinearForm σ x y)

name: RingEquiv.sesquilinearForm_symm_swap
statement:
theorem sesquilinearForm_symm_swap (σ : R ≃+* R) (x y : ι → R) :
    sesquilinearForm σ.symm y x = σ.symm (sesquilinearForm σ x y)

name: RingEquiv.finrank_add_finrank_galoisDual
statement:
theorem finrank_add_finrank_galoisDual (σ : K ≃+* K) (C : Submodule K (ι → K)) :
    finrank K C + finrank K (galoisDual σ C) = Fintype.card ι

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_antitone
statement:
theorem galoisDual_antitone (σ : R ≃+* R) :
    Antitone (galoisDual σ (ι := ι))

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisDual_bot (σ : R ≃+* R) :
    galoisDual σ (⊥ : Submodule R (ι → R)) = ⊤

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_def
statement:
theorem galoisDual_def (σ : R ≃+* R) (C : Submodule R (ι → R)) :
    galoisDual σ C = C.orthogonalBilin (sesquilinearForm σ)

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_galoisDual
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisDual_galoisDual (σ : K ≃+* K) (hσ : Function.Involutive σ)
    (C : Submodule K (ι → K)) : galoisDual σ (galoisDual σ C) = C

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_inf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisDual_inf (σ : K ≃+* K) (C D : Submodule K (ι → K)) :
    galoisDual σ (C ⊓ D) = galoisDual σ C ⊔ galoisDual σ D

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_range_vecMulLinear
statement:
theorem galoisDual_range_vecMulLinear (σ : R ≃+* R)
    {ρ : Type*} [Fintype ρ] (G : Matrix ρ ι R) :
    galoisDual σ (LinearMap.range G.vecMulLinear) =
      LinearMap.ker (G.map σ.symm).mulVecLin

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_range_vecMulLinear_of_involutive
statement:
theorem galoisDual_range_vecMulLinear_of_involutive (σ : R ≃+* R)
    (hσ : Function.Involutive σ) {ρ : Type*} [Fintype ρ] (G : Matrix ρ ι R) :
    galoisDual σ (LinearMap.range G.vecMulLinear) =
      LinearMap.ker (G.map σ).mulVecLin

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisDual_sup (σ : R ≃+* R) (C D : Submodule R (ι → R)) :
    galoisDual σ (C ⊔ D) = galoisDual σ C ⊓ galoisDual σ D

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_symm_galoisDual
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisDual_symm_galoisDual (σ : K ≃+* K)
    (C : Submodule K (ι → K)) : galoisDual σ.symm (galoisDual σ C) = C

name: RingEquiv.galoisDual_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisDual_top (σ : R ≃+* R) :
    galoisDual σ (⊤ : Submodule R (ι → R)) = ⊥

name: RingEquiv.le_galoisDual_galoisDual
statement:
theorem le_galoisDual_galoisDual (σ : R ≃+* R) (hσ : Function.Involutive σ)
    (C : Submodule R (ι → R)) : C ≤ galoisDual σ (galoisDual σ C)

name: RingEquiv.le_galoisDual_symm_galoisDual
statement:
theorem le_galoisDual_symm_galoisDual (σ : R ≃+* R)
    (C : Submodule R (ι → R)) : C ≤ galoisDual σ.symm (galoisDual σ C)

name: RingEquiv.mem_galoisDual
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_galoisDual (σ : R ≃+* R) (C : Submodule R (ι → R)) (y : ι → R) :
    y ∈ galoisDual σ C ↔ ∀ x ∈ C, ∑ i, x i * σ (y i) = 0

name: RingEquiv.range_vecMulLinear_eq_iff_ker_map_eq_galoisDual
statement:
theorem range_vecMulLinear_eq_iff_ker_map_eq_galoisDual (σ : K ≃+* K)
    {ρ : Type*} [Fintype ρ] (G : Matrix ρ ι K) (C : Submodule K (ι → K)) :
    LinearMap.range G.vecMulLinear = C ↔
      LinearMap.ker (G.map σ.symm).mulVecLin = galoisDual σ C

name: RingEquiv.range_vecMulLinear_eq_iff_ker_map_eq_galoisDual_of_involutive
statement:
theorem range_vecMulLinear_eq_iff_ker_map_eq_galoisDual_of_involutive (σ : K ≃+* K)
    (hσ : Function.Involutive σ) {ρ : Type*} [Fintype ρ]
    (G : Matrix ρ ι K) (C : Submodule K (ι → K)) :
    LinearMap.range G.vecMulLinear = C ↔
      LinearMap.ker (G.map σ).mulVecLin = galoisDual σ C

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.checkedBy_map_frobenius_generatorMatrix
statement:
theorem checkedBy_map_frobenius_generatorMatrix :

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.code_def
statement: theorem code_def (ω : F) : code ω = (generatorMatrix ω).generatedBy

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.code_inf_code_sq
statement:
theorem code_inf_code_sq [CharP F 2] {ω : F} (hω : ω ^ 2 + ω + 1 = 0) :
    code ω ⊓ code (ω ^ 2) = LinearMap.range (LinearMap.const : F →ₗ[F] (Fin 6 → F))

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.code_ne_code_sq
statement:
theorem code_ne_code_sq [CharP F 2] {ω : F} (hω : ω ^ 2 + ω + 1 = 0) :

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.coe_encodingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_encodingEquiv_apply (ω : F) (a : Fin 3 → F) :
    (encodingEquiv ω a : Fin 6 → F) = a ᵥ* generatorMatrix ω

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.conjugatePerm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugatePerm_apply (i : Fin 6) : conjugatePerm i = ![0, 1, 3, 5, 2, 4] i

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.conjugatePerm_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugatePerm_symm_apply (i : Fin 6) :
    conjugatePerm.symm i = ![0, 1, 4, 2, 5, 3] i

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.encodingEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem encodingEquiv_symm_apply (ω : F) (x : code ω) :
    (encodingEquiv ω).symm x = ![x.val 0, x.val 1, x.val 2]

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.finrank_code
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finrank_code (ω : F) : Module.finrank F (code ω) = 3

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.finrank_galoisFieldCode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finrank_galoisFieldCode : Module.finrank (GaloisField 2 2) galoisFieldCode = 3

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.galoisDual_code
statement:
theorem galoisDual_code [Finite F] (hF : Nat.card F = 4) :

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.galoisDual_galoisFieldCode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galoisDual_galoisFieldCode :
    (frobeniusEquiv (GaloisField 2 2) 2).galoisDual galoisFieldCode = galoisFieldCode

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.galoisFieldCode_def
statement: theorem galoisFieldCode_def : galoisFieldCode = code omega

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.galoisFieldCode_ne_code_omega_sq
statement: theorem galoisFieldCode_ne_code_omega_sq : galoisFieldCode ≠ code (omega ^ 2)

theorem generatorMatrix_def (ω : F) :

      !![1, 0, 0, 1, ω, ω; 0, 1, 0, ω, 1, ω; 0, 0, 1, ω, ω, 1]

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.generatorMatrix_mul_map_frobenius_transpose_eq_zero
statement:
theorem generatorMatrix_mul_map_frobenius_transpose_eq_zero :
    generatorMatrix ω * ((generatorMatrix ω).map (frobenius F 2))ᵀ = 0

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.generatorMatrix_mul_transpose_ne_zero

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.isPermutationEquivalent_code_sq
statement:
theorem isPermutationEquivalent_code_sq [CharP F 2] {ω : F}
    (hω : ω ^ 2 + ω + 1 = 0) : IsPermutationEquivalent (code (ω ^ 2)) (code ω)

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.map_code_omega_sq_conjugatePerm
statement:
theorem map_code_omega_sq_conjugatePerm :
    (code (omega ^ 2)).map
      (LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft (GaloisField 2 2) (GaloisField 2 2) conjugatePerm).toLinearMap =
        galoisFieldCode

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.map_code_sq_conjugatePerm
statement:
theorem map_code_sq_conjugatePerm [CharP F 2] {ω : F} (hω : ω ^ 2 + ω + 1 = 0) :

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.map_generatorMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_generatorMatrix {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : F →+* K) (ω : F) :
    (generatorMatrix ω).map f = generatorMatrix (f ω)

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.mem_code
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_code (ω : F) (x : Fin 6 → F) :
    x ∈ code ω ↔ x 3 = x 0 + ω * x 1 + ω * x 2 ∧
      x 4 = ω * x 0 + x 1 + ω * x 2 ∧ x 5 = ω * x 0 + ω * x 1 + x 2

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.mem_code_inf_code_sq
statement:
@[simp↓]
theorem mem_code_inf_code_sq [CharP F 2] {ω : F} (hω : ω ^ 2 + ω + 1 = 0)
    (x : Fin 6 → F) : x ∈ code ω ⊓ code (ω ^ 2) ↔ ∀ i, x i = x 0

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.mem_code_sq_iff
statement:
@[simp↓]
theorem mem_code_sq_iff [CharP F 2] (ω : F) (x : Fin 6 → F) :
    (fun i ↦ x i ^ 2) ∈ code (ω ^ 2) ↔ x ∈ code ω

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.mem_galoisFieldCode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_galoisFieldCode (x : Fin 6 → GaloisField 2 2) :
    x ∈ galoisFieldCode ↔ x 3 = x 0 + omega * x 1 + omega * x 2 ∧
      x 4 = omega * x 0 + x 1 + omega * x 2 ∧
      x 5 = omega * x 0 + omega * x 1 + x 2

name: TauCeti.Hexacode.natCard_code
statement:
@[simp↓]
theorem natCard_code (ω : F) : Nat.card (code ω) = Nat.card F ^ 3

statement:

theorem semilinearMonomialEquiv_symm_apply (u : ι → Rˣ) (e : ι ≃ κ) (σ : R ≃+* R)
    (y : κ → R) (i : ι) :
    (semilinearMonomialEquiv u e σ).symm y i = σ.symm ((↑(u i)⁻¹ : R) * y (e i))

name: TauCeti.semilinearMonomialEquiv_symm_apply_eq_apply
statement:
theorem semilinearMonomialEquiv_symm_apply_eq_apply (u : ι → Rˣ) (e : ι ≃ κ) (σ : R ≃+* R)
    (y : κ → R) :
    (semilinearMonomialEquiv u e σ).symm y =
      semilinearMonomialEquiv
        (fun j ↦ Units.map σ.symm.toMonoidHom (u (e.symm j))⁻¹) e.symm σ.symm y

name: TauCeti.semilinearMonomialEquiv_trans_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem semilinearMonomialEquiv_trans_apply (u : ι → Rˣ) (v : κ → Rˣ)
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (f : κ ≃ μ) (σ τ : R ≃+* R) (x : ι → R) :
    semilinearMonomialEquiv v f τ (semilinearMonomialEquiv u e σ x) =
      semilinearMonomialEquiv
        (fun i ↦ v (e i) * Units.map τ.toMonoidHom (u i)) (e.trans f) (σ.trans τ) x

statement:

statement:

    (hwN : w ᵥ* N = w) (hN : IsUnit N.det) (hu : IsUnit (u (Fin.last n)))

theorem burauAlexander_one_strand (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup 1) :
    burauAlexander (R := R) ⟨0, b⟩ t = 1

name: TauCeti.MarkovBraid.burauAlexander_sigma_pow_three
statement:
theorem burauAlexander_sigma_pow_three (t : Rˣ) :
    burauAlexander (R := R) ⟨1, BraidGroup.sigma 0 ^ 3⟩ t =
      -(t : R) * ((t : R) ^ 2 - (t : R) + 1)

name: TauCeti.MarkovBraid.burauAlexander_sigma_pow_three_neg_one
statement:
theorem burauAlexander_sigma_pow_three_neg_one :
    burauAlexander (R := ℤ) ⟨1, BraidGroup.sigma 0 ^ 3⟩ (-1) = 3

name: TauCeti.MarkovBraid.burauAlexander_stabilize
statement:
theorem burauAlexander_stabilize (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup (n + 1)) :
    burauAlexander (R := R) ⟨n + 1, BraidGroup.strandIncl b * BraidGroup.sigma (Fin.last n)⟩ t =
      -(t : R) * burauAlexander (R := R) ⟨n, b⟩ t

name: TauCeti.MarkovBraid.burauAlexander_stabilizeInv
statement:
theorem burauAlexander_stabilizeInv (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup (n + 1)) :
    burauAlexander (R := R)
        ⟨n + 1, BraidGroup.strandIncl b * (BraidGroup.sigma (Fin.last n))⁻¹⟩ t =
      -burauAlexander (R := R) ⟨n, b⟩ t

name: TauCeti.MarkovEquiv.associated_burauAlexander
statement:
theorem MarkovEquiv.associated_burauAlexander {β γ : MarkovBraid} (h : MarkovEquiv β γ) (t : Rˣ) :
    Associated (β.burauAlexander t) (γ.burauAlexander t)

name: TauCeti.not_markovEquiv_sigma_pow_three_one
statement:
theorem not_markovEquiv_sigma_pow_three_one :
    ¬ MarkovEquiv ⟨1, BraidGroup.sigma 0 ^ 3⟩ ⟨0, 1⟩

name: TauCeti.coe_oneSubVecMulVecGL
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_oneSubVecMulVecGL (t : Rˣ) (u v : α → R) (h : v ⬝ᵥ u = (t : R) + 1) :
    (oneSubVecMulVecGL t u v h : Matrix α α R) = 1 - vecMulVec u v

name: TauCeti.det_one_sub_vecMulVec
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_one_sub_vecMulVec (u v : α → R) : (1 - vecMulVec u v).det = 1 - v ⬝ᵥ u

name: TauCeti.inv_one_sub_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem inv_one_sub_vecMulVec (t : Rˣ) {u v : α → R} (h : v ⬝ᵥ u = (t : R) + 1) :
    (1 - vecMulVec u v)⁻¹ = 1 - ((t⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • vecMulVec u v

name: TauCeti.one_sub_vecMulVec_braid
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_braid {u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : α → R}
    (h₁ : v₁ ⬝ᵥ u₁ = 1 + (v₁ ⬝ᵥ u₂) * (v₂ ⬝ᵥ u₁))
    (h₂ : v₂ ⬝ᵥ u₂ = 1 + (v₁ ⬝ᵥ u₂) * (v₂ ⬝ᵥ u₁)) :
    (1 - vecMulVec u₁ v₁) * (1 - vecMulVec u₂ v₂) * (1 - vecMulVec u₁ v₁) =
      (1 - vecMulVec u₂ v₂) * (1 - vecMulVec u₁ v₁) * (1 - vecMulVec u₂ v₂)

name: TauCeti.one_sub_vecMulVec_inv_mul
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_inv_mul (t : Rˣ) {u v : α → R} (h : v ⬝ᵥ u = (t : R) + 1) :
    (1 - ((t⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • vecMulVec u v) * (1 - vecMulVec u v) = 1

name: TauCeti.one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_comm
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_comm {u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : α → R} (h₁₂ : v₁ ⬝ᵥ u₂ = 0)
    (h₂₁ : v₂ ⬝ᵥ u₁ = 0) :
    (1 - vecMulVec u₁ v₁) * (1 - vecMulVec u₂ v₂) =
      (1 - vecMulVec u₂ v₂) * (1 - vecMulVec u₁ v₁)

name: TauCeti.one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_inv
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_inv (t : Rˣ) {u v : α → R} (h : v ⬝ᵥ u = (t : R) + 1) :
    (1 - vecMulVec u v) * (1 - ((t⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • vecMulVec u v) = 1

name: TauCeti.one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_one_sub_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_one_sub_vecMulVec (u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : α → R) :
    (1 - vecMulVec u₁ v₁) * (1 - vecMulVec u₂ v₂) =
      1 - vecMulVec u₁ v₁ - vecMulVec u₂ v₂ + (v₁ ⬝ᵥ u₂) • vecMulVec u₁ v₂

name: TauCeti.one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_self
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_mul_self (t : R) {u v : α → R} (h : v ⬝ᵥ u = t + 1) :
    (1 - vecMulVec u v) * (1 - vecMulVec u v) = (1 - t) • (1 - vecMulVec u v) + t • 1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.braidHomOfOneSubVecMulVec_sigma
statement:
@[simp]
theorem braidHomOfOneSubVecMulVec_sigma (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (u v : Fin (n - 1) → α → R)
    (hself : ∀ i, v i ⬝ᵥ u i = (t : R) + 1)
    (hcomm : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ i →
      v i ⬝ᵥ u j = 0)
    (hforward : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 1 = j → v i ⬝ᵥ u j = -(t : R))
    (hreverse : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 1 = j → v j ⬝ᵥ u i = -1)
    (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    braidHomOfOneSubVecMulVec n t u v hself hcomm hforward hreverse
        (BraidGroup.sigma i) = oneSubVecMulVecGL t (u i) (v i) (hself i)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.det_braidHomOfOneSubVecMulVec
statement:
theorem det_braidHomOfOneSubVecMulVec (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (u v : Fin (n - 1) → α → R)
    (hself : ∀ i, v i ⬝ᵥ u i = (t : R) + 1)
    (hcomm : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ i →
      v i ⬝ᵥ u j = 0)
    (hforward : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 1 = j → v i ⬝ᵥ u j = -(t : R))
    (hreverse : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 1 = j → v j ⬝ᵥ u i = -1)
    (b : BraidGroup n) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det
        (braidHomOfOneSubVecMulVec n t u v hself hcomm hforward hreverse b) =
      (-t) ^ Multiplicative.toAdd (ArtinGroup.exponentSum (CoxeterMatrix.A (n - 1)) b)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.one_sub_vecMulVec_braid_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem one_sub_vecMulVec_braid_of_adjacent (t : R) (u v : Fin (n - 1) → α → R)
    (hself : ∀ i, v i ⬝ᵥ u i = t + 1)
    (hforward : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 1 = j → v i ⬝ᵥ u j = -t)
    (hreverse : ∀ {i j : Fin (n - 1)}, (i : ℕ) + 1 = j → v j ⬝ᵥ u i = -1)
    {i j : Fin (n - 1)} (h : (i : ℕ) + 1 = j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 1 = i) :
    (1 - vecMulVec (u i) (v i)) * (1 - vecMulVec (u j) (v j)) * (1 - vecMulVec (u i) (v i)) =
      (1 - vecMulVec (u j) (v j)) * (1 - vecMulVec (u i) (v i)) * (1 - vecMulVec (u j) (v j))

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauColMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem burauColMatrix_apply (n : ℕ) (t : R) (a : Fin n) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    burauColMatrix n t a i = burauCol t i a

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauColMatrix_col
statement:
@[simp]
theorem burauColMatrix_col (n : ℕ) (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (burauColMatrix n t).col i = burauCol t i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauColMatrix_mulVec_burauCoordMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem burauColMatrix_mulVec_burauCoordMatrix_mulVec (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (x : Fin n → R)
    (hx : (fun k : Fin n => (t : R) ^ (k : ℕ)) ⬝ᵥ x = 0) :
    burauColMatrix n (t : R) *ᵥ (burauCoordMatrix n t *ᵥ x) = x

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauColMatrix_mulVec_mem_reducedBurauSpace
statement:
theorem burauColMatrix_mulVec_mem_reducedBurauSpace (n : ℕ) (t : R)
    (c : Fin (n - 1) → R) :
    burauColMatrix n t *ᵥ c ∈ reducedBurauSpace n t

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauColMatrix_mulVec_single
statement:
theorem burauColMatrix_mulVec_single (n : ℕ) (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    burauColMatrix n t *ᵥ Pi.single i 1 = burauCol t i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauCoordMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem burauCoordMatrix_apply (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (i : Fin (n - 1)) (a : Fin n) :
    burauCoordMatrix n t i a =
      if (a : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) then ((t⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) ^ ((i : ℕ) + 1 - (a : ℕ)) else 0

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauCoordMatrix_mul_burauColMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem burauCoordMatrix_mul_burauColMatrix (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) :
    burauCoordMatrix n t * burauColMatrix n (t : R) = 1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauMatrix_mul_burauColMatrix
statement:
theorem burauMatrix_mul_burauColMatrix (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    burauMatrix t i * burauColMatrix n t = burauColMatrix n t * reducedBurauColMatrix t i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauRepresentation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem burauRepresentation_apply (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup n) (x : Fin n → R) :
    burauRepresentation n t b x = (burau n t b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) *ᵥ x

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burauRow_vecMul_burauColMatrix
statement:
theorem burauRow_vecMul_burauColMatrix (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    burauRow R i ᵥ* burauColMatrix n t = reducedBurauColRow t i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.burau_mul_burauColMatrix
statement:
theorem burau_mul_burauColMatrix (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup n) :
    (burau n t b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) * burauColMatrix n (t : R) =
      burauColMatrix n (t : R) *
        (reducedBurauCol n t b : Matrix (Fin (n - 1)) (Fin (n - 1)) R)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.coe_reducedBurauColGL
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_reducedBurauColGL (t : Rˣ) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (reducedBurauColGL t i : Matrix (Fin (n - 1)) (Fin (n - 1)) R) =
      reducedBurauColMatrix (t : R) i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.coe_reducedBurauCol_sigma
statement:
theorem coe_reducedBurauCol_sigma (t : Rˣ) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (reducedBurauCol n t (BraidGroup.sigma i) : Matrix (Fin (n - 1)) (Fin (n - 1)) R) =
      reducedBurauColMatrix (t : R) i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.coe_reducedBurauSubrepresentation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_reducedBurauSubrepresentation_apply (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup n)
    (x : ReducedBurauSpace n (t : R)) :
    (reducedBurauSubrepresentation n t b x : Fin n → R) =
      (burau n t b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) *ᵥ x.1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.det_reducedBurauCol
statement:
theorem det_reducedBurauCol (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup n) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det (reducedBurauCol n t b) =
      (-t) ^ Multiplicative.toAdd (ArtinGroup.exponentSum (CoxeterMatrix.A (n - 1)) b)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.det_reducedBurauColMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_reducedBurauColMatrix (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (reducedBurauColMatrix t i).det = -t

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.geom_vecMul_burauColMatrix_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geom_vecMul_burauColMatrix_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (t : R) :
    (fun k : Fin n => t ^ (k : ℕ)) ᵥ* burauColMatrix n t = 0

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.geometricCovector_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricCovector_apply (n : ℕ) (t : R) (x : Fin n → R) :
    geometricCovector n t x = ∑ i : Fin n, t ^ (i : ℕ) * x i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.geometricCovector_burauRepresentation
statement:
theorem geometricCovector_burauRepresentation (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup n)
    (x : Fin n → R) :
    geometricCovector n (t : R) (burauRepresentation n t b x) =
      geometricCovector n (t : R) x

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.inv_reducedBurauColMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_reducedBurauColMatrix (t : Rˣ) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (reducedBurauColMatrix (t : R) i)⁻¹ =
      1 - ((t⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • vecMulVec (Pi.single i 1) (reducedBurauColRow (t : R) i)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.mem_reducedBurauSpace_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_reducedBurauSpace_iff (n : ℕ) (t : R) (x : Fin n → R) :
    x ∈ reducedBurauSpace n t ↔ ∑ i : Fin n, t ^ (i : ℕ) * x i = 0

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.mul_burauColMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem mul_burauColMatrix_apply {m : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) R) (t : R) (a : Fin m)
    (i : Fin (n - 1)) : (M * burauColMatrix n t) a i = M a ⬝ᵥ burauCol t i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_apply (t : R) (i a b : Fin (n - 1)) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i a b =
      (if a = b then 1 else 0) - (if a = i then 1 else 0) * reducedBurauColRow t i b

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_ne (t : R) {i a : Fin (n - 1)} (h : a ≠ i)
    (b : Fin (n - 1)) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i a b = if a = b then 1 else 0

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_not_adjacent
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_not_adjacent (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)}
    (h : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ i) : reducedBurauColMatrix t i i j = 0

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_succ
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_succ (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)} (h : (i : ℕ) + 1 = j) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i i j = t

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_succ_rev
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_of_succ_rev (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)} (h : (j : ℕ) + 1 = i) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i i j = 1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_apply_self (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i i i = -t

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_braid
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_braid (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)}
    (h : (i : ℕ) + 1 = j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 1 = i) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i * reducedBurauColMatrix t j * reducedBurauColMatrix t i =
      reducedBurauColMatrix t j * reducedBurauColMatrix t i * reducedBurauColMatrix t j

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_def
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_def (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i = 1 - vecMulVec (Pi.single i 1) (reducedBurauColRow t i)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_mul_comm
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_mul_comm (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)}
    (h : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ i) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i * reducedBurauColMatrix t j =
      reducedBurauColMatrix t j * reducedBurauColMatrix t i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_mul_self
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_mul_self (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i * reducedBurauColMatrix t i =
      (1 - t) • reducedBurauColMatrix t i + t • 1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_three_one
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_three_one (t : R) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t (1 : Fin (3 - 1)) = !![1, 0; 1, -t]

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_three_zero
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_three_zero (t : R) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t (0 : Fin (3 - 1)) = !![-t, t; 0, 1]

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColMatrix_two
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColMatrix_two (t : R) (i : Fin (2 - 1)) :
    reducedBurauColMatrix t i = !![-t]

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColRow_of_not_adjacent
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColRow_of_not_adjacent (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)}
    (h : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ i) : reducedBurauColRow t i j = 0

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColRow_of_succ
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColRow_of_succ (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)} (h : (i : ℕ) + 1 = j) :
    reducedBurauColRow t i j = -t

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColRow_of_succ_rev
statement:
theorem reducedBurauColRow_of_succ_rev (t : R) {i j : Fin (n - 1)} (h : (j : ℕ) + 1 = i) :
    reducedBurauColRow t i j = -1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauColRow_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reducedBurauColRow_self (t : R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) : reducedBurauColRow t i i = t + 1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauCol_eq
statement:
theorem reducedBurauCol_eq (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup n) :
    (reducedBurauCol n t b : Matrix (Fin (n - 1)) (Fin (n - 1)) R) =
      burauCoordMatrix n t * (burau n t b : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) *
        burauColMatrix n (t : R)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauCol_sigma
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reducedBurauCol_sigma (t : Rˣ) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    reducedBurauCol n t (BraidGroup.sigma i) = reducedBurauColGL t i

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauSpaceEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reducedBurauSpaceEquiv_apply_coe (n : ℕ) (t : R) (x : Fin n → R) :
    (reducedBurauSpaceEquiv n t x : Fin (n + 1) → R) =
      Fin.cons (-∑ i : Fin n, t ^ ((i : ℕ) + 1) * x i) x

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauSpaceEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reducedBurauSpaceEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℕ) (t : R)
    (x : ReducedBurauSpace (n + 1) t) :
    (reducedBurauSpaceEquiv n t).symm x = Fin.tail x.1

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurauSpace_invariant
statement:
theorem reducedBurauSpace_invariant (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup n) :
    reducedBurauSpace n (t : R) ≤
      (reducedBurauSpace n (t : R)).comap (burauRepresentation n t b)

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurau_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reducedBurau_apply (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (b : BraidGroup (n + 1)) (x : Fin n → R) :
    reducedBurau n t b x = Fin.tail
      ((burau (n + 1) t b : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R) *ᵥ
        (reducedBurauSpaceEquiv n (t : R) x : Fin (n + 1) → R))

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurau_apply_burauColMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem reducedBurau_apply_burauColMatrix_mulVec (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ)
    (b : BraidGroup (n + 1)) (c : Fin (n + 1 - 1) → R) :
    reducedBurau n t b (Fin.tail (burauColMatrix (n + 1) (t : R) *ᵥ c)) =
      Fin.tail (burauColMatrix (n + 1) (t : R) *ᵥ
        ((reducedBurauCol (n + 1) t b :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1 - 1)) (Fin (n + 1 - 1)) R) *ᵥ c))

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurau_sigma
statement:
theorem reducedBurau_sigma (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → R) :
    reducedBurau n t (BraidGroup.sigma i) x = Fin.tail
      (burauMatrix (t : R) i *ᵥ
        (reducedBurauSpaceEquiv n (t : R) x : Fin (n + 1) → R))

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurau_sigma_apply
statement:
theorem reducedBurau_sigma_apply (n : ℕ) (t : Rˣ) (i : Fin n) (x : Fin n → R) (j : Fin n) :
    reducedBurau n t (BraidGroup.sigma i) x j =
      (burauMatrix (n := n + 1) (t : R) i *ᵥ
        (reducedBurauSpaceEquiv n (t : R) x : Fin (n + 1) → R)) j.succ

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.reducedBurau_sigma_zero_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reducedBurau_sigma_zero_apply (t : Rˣ) (x : Fin 1 → R) :
    reducedBurau 1 t (BraidGroup.sigma 0) x 0 = -(t : R) * x 0

name: TauCeti.KnotTheory.vecMul_burauColMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem vecMul_burauColMatrix_apply (t : R) (v : Fin n → R) (i : Fin (n - 1)) :
    (v ᵥ* burauColMatrix n t) i = v ⬝ᵥ burauCol t i

name: TauCeti.Grid.cIco_eq_Ici_union_Iio_of_lt
statement:
theorem cIco_eq_Ici_union_Iio_of_lt {a b : Fin n} (h : b.val < a.val) :
    cIco a b = Finset.Ici a ∪ Finset.Iio b

name: TauCeti.Grid.cIco_eq_Ico_of_lt
statement:
theorem cIco_eq_Ico_of_lt {a b : Fin n} (h : a.val < b.val) :
    cIco a b = Finset.Ico a b

name: TauCeti.Grid.cIco_eq_singleton_iff
statement:

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.ICenter_eq_ICount

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JCenter_def
statement:
theorem JCenter_def (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) :

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JCenter_eq_JMixed

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JCenter_insert_pair_left
statement:
theorem JCenter_insert_pair_left {S P : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)} {a b : Fin n × Fin n}

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JCenter_singleton_left
statement:
theorem JCenter_singleton_left (p : Fin n × Fin n) (t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) :
    JCenter {p} t =
      (((t.filter fun q => p ≤ q ∨ IsSouthWest q p).card : ℕ) : ℚ) / 2

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JCenter_singleton_right
statement:
theorem JCenter_singleton_right (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JCenter_singleton_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem JCenter_singleton_singleton (p q : Fin n × Fin n) :
    JCenter {p} {q} =

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNumCenter_def
statement:
theorem JNumCenter_def (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) :

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNumCenter_singleton_left
statement:

theorem JNumCenter_singleton_right (s : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.JNumCenter_singleton_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem JNumCenter_singleton_singleton (p q : Fin n × Fin n) :

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.J_sub_two_mul_JCenter_add_J_eq_intCast

theorem J_sub_two_mul_JCenter_add_J_eq_intCast (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) :
    GridPoint.J s s - 2 * JCenter s t + GridPoint.J t t =

name: TauCeti.GridPoint.two_mul_JCenter

theorem two_mul_JCenter (s t : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) :

theorem two_mul_JCenter_singleton_left (p : Fin n × Fin n)

name: TauCeti.GridState.ICenter_pointSet_eq_card

theorem ICenter_self_pointSet_eq_I_add_card (x : GridState n) :

name: TauCeti.GridState.JNumCenterAt_def
statement:

name: TauCeti.GridState.JNumCenterAt_eq_card
statement:
theorem JNumCenterAt_eq_card (m : GridState n) (c r : Fin n) :
    m.JNumCenterAt c r =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun d : Fin n => c ≤ d ∧ r ≤ m d).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter fun d : Fin n => d < c ∧ m d < r).card

name: TauCeti.GridState.JNumCenter_pointSet_eq_card
statement:
theorem JNumCenter_pointSet_eq_card (x y : GridState n) :
    GridPoint.JNumCenter x.pointSet y.pointSet =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 ≤ p.2 ∧ x p.1 ≤ y p.2).card +
        (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ y p.1 < x p.2).card

name: TauCeti.GridState.JNumCenter_pointSet_eq_sum
statement:
theorem JNumCenter_pointSet_eq_sum (x m : GridState n) :

name: TauCeti.card_filter_le_eq_card_filter_lt_add_card_of_injective
statement:
theorem card_filter_le_eq_card_filter_lt_add_card_of_injective {n : ℕ} {f : Fin n → Fin n}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 ≤ p.2 ∧ f p.1 ≤ f p.2).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ f p.1 < f p.2).card + n

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alexander_def (x : GridState n) :
    G.alexander x =
      (G.maslovO x - G.maslovX x) / 2 - (((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) / 2

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_eq
statement:
theorem alexander_eq (x : GridState n) :
    G.alexander x =
      (2 * (G.JX x - G.JO x) + (GridState.J G.O G.O - GridState.J G.X G.X) -
        (((n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ)) / 2

statement:
theorem alexander_eq_neg_shift_of_maslov_eq {x : GridState n} (h : G.maslovO x = G.maslovX x) :

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.JO_sub_JO_eq
statement:
theorem JO_sub_JO_eq (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.JO x - G.JO y =
      (GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.OSet +
          GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.top)} G.OSet) -
        (GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.top)} G.OSet +
          GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.OSet)

statement:
theorem JX_sub_JX_eq (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :

          GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.top)} G.XSet) -

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_change_rectangle
statement:
theorem alexander_change_rectangle (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.alexander x - G.alexander y =
      ((GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.XSet +
            GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.top)} G.XSet) -
          (GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.top)} G.XSet +
            GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.XSet)) -
        ((GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.OSet +
            GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.top)} G.OSet) -
          (GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.top)} G.OSet +
            GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.OSet))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.alexander_sub_alexander_eq
statement:
theorem alexander_sub_alexander_eq (x y : GridState n) :
    G.alexander x - G.alexander y = (G.JX x - G.JX y) - (G.JO x - G.JO y)

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_change_rectangle
statement:
theorem maslovO_change_rectangle (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.maslovO x - G.maslovO y =
      2 * ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} {(R.right, R.top)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)) -
            (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} {(R.right, R.bottom)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet))) -
        2 * ((GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.OSet +
              GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.top)} G.OSet) -
          (GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.top)} G.OSet +
            GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.OSet))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovO_sub_maslovO_eq
statement:
theorem maslovO_sub_maslovO_eq (x y : GridState n) :
    G.maslovO x - G.maslovO y =
      (GridState.J x x - GridState.J y y) - 2 * (G.JO x - G.JO y)

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_change_rectangle
statement:
theorem maslovX_change_rectangle (R : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    G.maslovX x - G.maslovX y =
      2 * ((GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} {(R.right, R.top)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet)) -
            (GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} {(R.right, R.bottom)} +
              GridPoint.J {(R.left, R.top)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet) +
              GridPoint.J {(R.right, R.bottom)} (x.pointSet ∩ y.pointSet))) -
        2 * ((GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.bottom)} G.XSet +
              GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.top)} G.XSet) -
          (GridPoint.JCenter {(R.left, R.top)} G.XSet +
            GridPoint.JCenter {(R.right, R.bottom)} G.XSet))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovX_sub_maslovX_eq

name: TauCeti.GridRectangleBetween.J_self_sub_J_self_eq
statement:

    (G.fullyBlockedDecompositions x z).card =
      ∑ y : GridState n,
        (G.fullyBlockedRectangles x y).card * (G.fullyBlockedRectangles y z).card

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDecompositionCount_eq_sum

theorem fullyBlockedDecompositionCount_eq_sum :
    G.fullyBlockedDecompositionCount x z =
      ∑ y : GridState n, G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount x y *
        G.fullyBlockedRectangleCount y z

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedDecompositionCount_eq_zero_iff_even

theorem fullyBlockedDecompositionCount_eq_zero_iff_even :

theorem fullyBlockedDecompositions_eq_empty_of_notMem_twoStep

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedDecompositions
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_fullyBlockedDecompositions (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z) :

      D.first ∈ G.fullyBlockedRectangles x D.middle ∧
        D.second ∈ G.fullyBlockedRectangles D.middle z

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_unblockedDecompositions
statement:

theorem mem_unblockedDecompositions (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z) :

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.sum_unblockedCoefficient_mul_unblockedCoefficient
statement:
theorem sum_unblockedCoefficient_mul_unblockedCoefficient (x z : GridState n) :
    ∑ y : GridState n, G.unblockedCoefficient R x y * G.unblockedCoefficient R y z =
      ∑ D ∈ G.unblockedDecompositions x z, G.unblockedDecompositionWeight R D

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.unblockedDecompositionWeight_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unblockedDecompositionWeight_def {x z : GridState n}
    (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z) :
    G.unblockedDecompositionWeight R D =
      G.OMonomial R D.first.toGridRectangle * G.OMonomial R D.second.toGridRectangle

statement:
theorem mem_twoStepColumnSwapIntermediates_iff_exists_swaps {x y z : GridState n} :

theorem commute_commute (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z) (h : D.HasDisjointSides) :

theorem commute_first_left (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z) (h : D.HasDisjointSides) :

statement:

      (D.first.left = D.second.right ∧ D.first.right ≠ D.second.left) ∨
      (D.first.right = D.second.left ∧ D.first.left ≠ D.second.right) ∨
        (D.first.right = D.second.right ∧ D.first.left ≠ D.second.left)

    ({ left := a, right := b, bottom := u, top := v } : GridRectangle n).coveredSquares ∪

name: TauCeti.GridRectangleDecomposition.exists_isRepartition_of_isEmpty_of_left_eq_left
statement:
theorem exists_isRepartition_of_isEmpty_of_left_eq_left (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z)
    (hleft : D.first.left = D.second.left) (hright : D.first.right ≠ D.second.right)
    (hfirst : D.first.IsEmpty) (hsecond : D.second.IsEmpty) :
    ∃! E : GridRectangleDecomposition x z,
      D.IsRepartition E ∧ E.middle ≠ D.middle ∧ E.first.IsEmpty ∧ E.second.IsEmpty ∧
        E.first.right = D.second.right ∧ E.second.right = D.first.right ∧
          ((D.first.right ∈ Grid.cIoo D.first.left D.second.right ∧
              E.middle = x.swapColumns D.first.right D.second.right ∧
                E.first.left = D.first.right ∧ E.second.left = D.first.left) ∨
            (D.second.right ∈ Grid.cIoo D.first.left D.first.right ∧
              E.middle = x.swapColumns D.first.left D.second.right ∧
                E.first.left = D.first.left ∧ E.second.left = D.second.right))

        E.first.left = D.second.left ∧ E.second.left = D.first.left ∧
          ((D.first.left ∈ Grid.cIoo D.second.left D.first.right ∧
              E.middle = x.swapColumns D.second.left D.first.left ∧
                E.first.right = D.first.left ∧ E.second.right = D.first.right) ∨

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.killCompl_OMonomial_eq_prod_of_notMem

theorem killCompl_OMonomial_eq_prod_of_notMem {i : Fin n} {r : GridRectangle n}
    (hi : i ∉ G.OColumns r) :

      (Subtype.val_injective : Function.Injective

      ∏ c ∈ (G.OColumns r).subtype (· ≠ i), MvPolynomial.X c

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_simplyBlockedRectangles

theorem mem_simplyBlockedRectangles (i : Fin n) {x y : GridState n}
    (r : GridRectangleBetween x y) :
    r ∈ G.simplyBlockedRectangles i x y ↔
      r.IsEmpty ∧ Disjoint r.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares G.XSet ∧
        (i, G.O i) ∉ r.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares

TauCeti.GridPentagonBetween.disjoint_coveredSquares_XSet_iff
statement:
theorem disjoint_coveredSquares_XSet_iff (P : GridPentagonBetween a s x y) (G : GridDiagram n) :
    Disjoint P.coveredSquares G.XSet ↔
      (∀ c, c ≠ a → c ∈ Grid.cIco P.left (finRotate n a) → G.X c ∉ Grid.cIco P.bottom P.top) ∧
        G.X a ∉ Grid.cIoo s P.top ∧ G.X (finRotate n a) ∉ Grid.cIco P.bottom s

statement:
theorem mem_coveredSquares (P : GridPentagonBetween a s x y) (p : Fin n × Fin n) :
    p ∈ P.coveredSquares ↔
      (p.1 ≠ a ∧ p.1 ∈ Grid.cIco P.left (finRotate n a) ∧ p.2 ∈ Grid.cIco P.bottom P.top) ∨
        (p.1 = a ∧ p.2 ∈ Grid.cIoo s P.top) ∨
          (p.1 = finRotate n a ∧ p.2 ∈ Grid.cIco P.bottom s)

        y = x.swapColumns j (finRotate n a)

          (G.pentagonMap R C (Finsupp.single x 1)) ↔
      ∀ z : GridState n,
        (∑ D ∈ G.rectanglePentagonDecompositions C x z,
            G.rectanglePentagonWeight C R D) =

    (x z : GridState n) (D : GridPentagonRectangleDecomposition a s x z) :

    (rectangles : ∀ u v : GridState n, Finset (GridRectangleBetween u v))
    (x z : GridState n)
    (w : ∀ y, GridPentagonBetween a s x y → GridRectangleBetween y z → M) :
    ∑ D ∈ decompositionsOf pentagons rectangles x z, w D.middle D.pentagon D.rectangle =
      ∑ y, ∑ P ∈ pentagons x y, ∑ r ∈ rectangles y z, w y P r

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.maslovOℤ_eq_card
statement:
theorem maslovOℤ_eq_card (x : GridState n) :
    G.maslovOℤ x =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ x p.1 < x p.2).card : ℤ)
        - ((Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 ≤ p.2 ∧ x p.1 ≤ G.O p.2).card
          + (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ G.O p.1 < x p.2).card)
        + (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2 ∧ G.O p.1 < G.O p.2).card + 1

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainEquiv_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bigradedChainEquiv_apply_apply (R : Type*) [Semiring R]
    (c : GridChain R n) (g : ℤ × ℤ) (x : {x : GridState n // G.bidegree x = g}) :
    G.bigradedChainEquiv R c g x = c x

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainEquiv_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bigradedChainEquiv_single (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (x : GridState n) (r : R) :
    G.bigradedChainEquiv R (Finsupp.single x r) =
      DirectSum.lof R (ℤ × ℤ) (fun g => G.BigradedChainPiece R g) (G.bidegree x)
        (DirectSum.lof R {y : GridState n // G.bidegree y = G.bidegree x}
          (fun _ => R) ⟨x, rfl⟩ r)

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainEquiv_symm_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bigradedChainEquiv_symm_apply_apply (R : Type*) [Semiring R]
    (d : ⨁ g : ℤ × ℤ, G.BigradedChainPiece R g) (x : GridState n) :
    (G.bigradedChainEquiv R).symm d x = d (G.bidegree x) ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainInclusion_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bigradedChainInclusion_apply (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (g : ℤ × ℤ)
    (c : G.BigradedChainPiece R g) (x : GridState n) :
    G.bigradedChainInclusion R g c x =
      if h : G.bidegree x = g then c ⟨x, h⟩ else 0

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainInclusion_injective
statement:
theorem bigradedChainInclusion_injective (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (g : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (G.bigradedChainInclusion R g)

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bigradedChainProjection_apply (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (g : ℤ × ℤ)
    (c : GridChain R n) (x : {x : GridState n // G.bidegree x = g}) :
    G.bigradedChainProjection R g c x = c x

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainProjection_bigradedChainInclusion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bigradedChainProjection_bigradedChainInclusion (R : Type*) [Semiring R] (g : ℤ × ℤ)
    (c : G.BigradedChainPiece R g) :
    G.bigradedChainProjection R g (G.bigradedChainInclusion R g c) = c

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.bigradedChainProjection_bigradedChainInclusion_of_ne
statement:

theorem bigradedChainProjection_bigradedChainInclusion_of_ne (R : Type*) [Semiring R]

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.finrank_bigradedChainPiece
statement:
theorem finrank_bigradedChainPiece (R : Type*) [Semiring R] [StrongRankCondition R]

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.finrank_bigradedChainPiece_pos_iff
statement:
theorem finrank_bigradedChainPiece_pos_iff (R : Type*) [Semiring R] [StrongRankCondition R]

statement:
theorem sum_finrank_bigradedChainPiece (R : Type*) [Semiring R] [StrongRankCondition R] :

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.alexanderEulerChar_eq_coeff_smul_T_mul_det_weightMatrix
statement:
theorem alexanderEulerChar_eq_coeff_smul_T_mul_det_weightMatrix (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    [StrongRankCondition R] (a : ℤ) :
    G.alexanderEulerChar R a =
      ((Equiv.Perm.sign G.1.O.toPerm * ((n : ℤ) + 1).negOnePow) •
        (T G.1.alexanderTwoShift * G.1.weightMatrix.det) : ℤ[T;T⁻¹]).coeff (2 * a)

theorem alexanderEulerChar_eq_sum_maslovSupport (R : Type*) [Ring R] [StrongRankCondition R]

    G.alexanderEulerChar R a =
      ∑ m ∈ G.maslovSupport a, (m.negOnePow : ℤ) *
        (Finset.univ.filter fun x : GridState n => G.bidegree x = (m, a)).card

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.alexanderEulerChar_eq_sum_states
statement:
theorem alexanderEulerChar_eq_sum_states (R : Type*) [Ring R] [StrongRankCondition R] (a : ℤ) :
    G.alexanderEulerChar R a =

        ((G.1.maslovOℤ x).negOnePow : ℤ)

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.monomialBidegree_zero

theorem gradedSimplyBlockedDifferential_comp_eq_zero (i : Fin n) (a m : ℤ) :
    (G.gradedSimplyBlockedDifferential R i a m).comp
      (G.gradedSimplyBlockedDifferential R i a (m + 1)) = 0

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.iSupIndep_bigradedChainHatPiece
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_bigradedChainHatPiece (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (i : Fin n) :

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.iSup_bigradedChainHatPiece_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_bigradedChainHatPiece_eq_top (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (i : Fin n) :

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.isInternal_bigradedChainHatPiece
statement:
theorem isInternal_bigradedChainHatPiece (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (i : Fin n) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal (G.bigradedChainHatPiece R i)

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.mem_bigradedChainHatPiece
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bigradedChainHatPiece {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {i : Fin n}
    {g : ℤ × ℤ} {c : GridChainHat R n i} :
    c ∈ G.bigradedChainHatPiece R i g ↔
      ∀ x : GridState n, ∀ e ∈ (c x).support,
        G.bidegree x - (2 * (e.degree : ℤ), (e.degree : ℤ)) = g

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.mem_bigradedChainHatPiece_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_bigradedChainHatPiece_iff_exists {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    {i : Fin n} {g : ℤ × ℤ} {c : GridChainHat R n i} :
    c ∈ G.bigradedChainHatPiece R i g ↔
      ∃ b ∈ G.bigradedChainMinusPiece R g, simplyBlockedSpecialization R i b = c

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.simplyBlockedDifferential_mem_bigradedChainHatPiece
statement:
theorem simplyBlockedDifferential_mem_bigradedChainHatPiece {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    {i : Fin n} {g : ℤ × ℤ} {c : GridChainHat R n i}
    (hc : c ∈ G.bigradedChainHatPiece R i g) :
    G.1.simplyBlockedDifferential R i c ∈ G.bigradedChainHatPiece R i (g - (1, 0))

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.simplyBlockedSpecialization_mem_bigradedChainHatPiece
statement:
theorem simplyBlockedSpecialization_mem_bigradedChainHatPiece {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (i : Fin n) {g : ℤ × ℤ} {c : GridChainMinus R n}
    (hc : c ∈ G.bigradedChainMinusPiece R g) :
    simplyBlockedSpecialization R i c ∈ G.bigradedChainHatPiece R i g

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.single_monomial_mem_bigradedChainHatPiece
statement:
theorem single_monomial_mem_bigradedChainHatPiece (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R]
    (i : Fin n) (x : GridState n) (e : {c : Fin n // c ≠ i} →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    (Finsupp.single x (monomial e a) : GridChainHat R n i) ∈
      G.bigradedChainHatPiece R i
        (G.bidegree x - (2 * (e.degree : ℤ), (e.degree : ℤ)))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_add_two_mul_finrank_range
statement:
theorem finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_add_two_mul_finrank_range
    (hsq : G.fullyBlockedDifferential.comp G.fullyBlockedDifferential = 0) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) G.fullyBlockedHomology +
        2 * Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range G.fullyBlockedDifferential) = n.factorial

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_le_two
statement:
theorem finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_le_two (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) G.fullyBlockedHomology = n.factorial

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_two
statement:
theorem finrank_fullyBlockedHomology_of_two (G : GridDiagram 2) :

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles_eq_comap
statement:
theorem fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles_eq_comap :

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomologyEquivChainOfLeTwo_apply_mk

theorem fullyBlockedHomologyEquivChainOfLeTwo_apply_mk (hn : n ≤ 2) (c : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_iff
statement:
theorem fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_iff (a b : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : G.fullyBlockedHomology) = Submodule.Quotient.mk b ↔
      (a : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) - b ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem fullyBlockedHomology_mk_eq_zero_iff (a : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk a : G.fullyBlockedHomology) = 0 ↔
      (a : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles
statement:

theorem mem_fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles (x : G.fullyBlockedCycles) :

      (x : GridChain (ZMod 2) n) ∈ G.fullyBlockedBoundaries

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.natCard_fullyBlockedHomology_of_le_two
statement:

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.alexanderHomologyEulerChar_eq_alexanderEulerChar
statement:

theorem alexanderHomologyEulerChar_eq_alexanderEulerChar (a : ℤ) :

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.alexanderHomologyEulerChar_eq_finsum_finrank
statement:
theorem alexanderHomologyEulerChar_eq_finsum_finrank (a : ℤ) :
    G.alexanderHomologyEulerChar a =

statement:
theorem alexanderHomologyEulerChar_eq_zero_of_notMem {a : ℤ}

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.gradedHomologyEulerChar_eq_gradedEulerChar
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedHomologyEulerChar_eq_gradedEulerChar :
    G.gradedHomologyEulerChar = G.gradedEulerChar (ZMod 2)

name: TauCeti.OddComponentGridDiagram.gradedHomologyEulerChar_eq_smul_T_mul_det_weightMatrix
statement:
theorem gradedHomologyEulerChar_eq_smul_T_mul_det_weightMatrix :
    G.gradedHomologyEulerChar =
      (Equiv.Perm.sign G.1.O.toPerm * ((n : ℤ) + 1).negOnePow) •
        (T G.1.alexanderTwoShift * G.1.weightMatrix.det)

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.ker_simplyBlockedHomologyClass
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_simplyBlockedHomologyClass (hG : G.IsKnot) (i : Fin n) :
    LinearMap.ker (hG.simplyBlockedHomologyClass R i) = hG.simplyBlockedBoundaries R i

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.mem_simplyBlockedCycles
statement:
theorem mem_simplyBlockedCycles (hG : G.IsKnot) (i : Fin n)
    (c : (G.simplyBlockedComplex R i).X ()) :
    c ∈ hG.simplyBlockedCycles R i ↔
      G.simplyBlockedDifferential R i (G.simplyBlockedChainEquiv R i c) = 0

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.simplyBlockedHomologyClass_eq_iff
statement:
theorem simplyBlockedHomologyClass_eq_iff (hG : G.IsKnot) (i : Fin n)
    (c c' : hG.simplyBlockedCycles R i) :
    hG.simplyBlockedHomologyClass R i c = hG.simplyBlockedHomologyClass R i c' ↔
      c - c' ∈ hG.simplyBlockedBoundaries R i

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.simplyBlockedHomologyClass_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplyBlockedHomologyClass_eq_zero_iff (hG : G.IsKnot) (i : Fin n)
    (c : hG.simplyBlockedCycles R i) :
    hG.simplyBlockedHomologyClass R i c = 0 ↔ c ∈ hG.simplyBlockedBoundaries R i

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.simplyBlockedHomologyClass_surjective
statement:
theorem simplyBlockedHomologyClass_surjective (hG : G.IsKnot) (i : Fin n) :
    Function.Surjective (hG.simplyBlockedHomologyClass R i)

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.simplyBlockedHomologyIsoQuotient_hom_class
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplyBlockedHomologyIsoQuotient_hom_class (hG : G.IsKnot) (i : Fin n)
    (c : hG.simplyBlockedCycles R i) :
    (hG.simplyBlockedHomologyIsoQuotient R i).hom (hG.simplyBlockedHomologyClass R i c) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk c

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XHomotopyCoefficient_def
statement:
theorem XHomotopyCoefficient_def (k : Fin n) (x y : GridState n) :
    G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k x y =
      ∑ r ∈ G.XHomotopyRectangles k x y, G.OMonomial R r.toGridRectangle

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XHomotopyRectangles_subset_emptyRectangles
statement:
theorem XHomotopyRectangles_subset_emptyRectangles (k : Fin n) (x y : GridState n) :
    G.XHomotopyRectangles k x y ⊆ GridRectangleBetween.emptyRectangles x y

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XHomotopy_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem XHomotopy_apply_apply (k : Fin n) (c : GridChainMinus R n) (y : GridState n) :
    G.XHomotopy R k c y = c.sum fun x a => a * G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k x y

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XHomotopy_single
statement:
theorem XHomotopy_single (k : Fin n) (x : GridState n) :
    G.XHomotopy R k (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun y => G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k x y

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.XHomotopy_single_apply
statement:
theorem XHomotopy_single_apply (k : Fin n) (x y : GridState n) :
    G.XHomotopy R k (Finsupp.single x 1) y = G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k x y

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.commute_mem_XHomotopyDecompositions
statement:
theorem commute_mem_XHomotopyDecompositions {k : Fin n} {x z : GridState n}
    {D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z} (h : D.HasDisjointSides)
    (hD : D ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z) :
    D.commute h ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.disjoint_unblockedRectangles_XHomotopyRectangles
statement:
theorem disjoint_unblockedRectangles_XHomotopyRectangles (k : Fin n) (x y : GridState n) :
    Disjoint (G.unblockedRectangles x y) (G.XHomotopyRectangles k x y)

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.isEmpty_of_mem_XHomotopyDecompositions
TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_XHomotopyDecompositions
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_XHomotopyDecompositions (k : Fin n) {x z : GridState n}
    (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z) :
    D ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z ↔
      D.first ∈ G.unblockedRectangles x D.middle ∧
          D.second ∈ G.XHomotopyRectangles k D.middle z ∨
        D.first ∈ G.XHomotopyRectangles k x D.middle ∧
          D.second ∈ G.unblockedRectangles D.middle z

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_XHomotopyDecompositions_iff_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem mem_XHomotopyDecompositions_iff_of_disjoint (k : Fin n) {x z : GridState n}
    (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z)
    (hD : Disjoint D.first.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares
      D.second.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares) :
    D ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z ↔
      D.first.IsEmpty ∧ D.second.IsEmpty ∧
        (D.first.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares ∪ D.second.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares) ∩
          G.XSet = {(k, G.X k)}

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.mem_XHomotopyRectangles
TauCeti.GridDiagram.recut_mem_XHomotopyDecompositions
statement:
theorem recut_mem_XHomotopyDecompositions {k : Fin n} {x z : GridState n}
    {D : GridRectangleDecomposition x z} (hone : D.HasOneCommonSide)
    (hfirst : D.first.IsEmpty) (hsecond : D.second.IsEmpty)
    (hD : D ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z) :
    D.recut hone hfirst hsecond ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.sum_XHomotopyDecompositions
statement:
theorem sum_XHomotopyDecompositions (k : Fin n) (x z : GridState n) :
    ∑ D ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z, G.unblockedDecompositionWeight R D =
      ∑ y : GridState n, (G.unblockedCoefficient R x y * G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k y z +
        G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k x y * G.unblockedCoefficient R y z)

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.sum_XHomotopyDecompositions_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_XHomotopyDecompositions_eq_zero (k : Fin n) {x z : GridState n} (hzx : z ≠ x) :
    ∑ D ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x z, G.unblockedDecompositionWeight R D = 0

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.sum_XHomotopyDecompositions_self
statement:
theorem sum_XHomotopyDecompositions_self (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (hn : 1 < n) (k : Fin n)
    (x : GridState n) :
    ∑ D ∈ G.XHomotopyDecompositions k x x, G.unblockedDecompositionWeight R D =
      MvPolynomial.X k + MvPolynomial.X (G.O.columnOfRow (G.X k))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.unblockedDecompositionWeight_eq_prod_union
statement:
theorem unblockedDecompositionWeight_eq_prod_union (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R]
    {x : GridState n} (D : GridRectangleDecomposition x x) :
    G.unblockedDecompositionWeight R D =
      ∏ p ∈ D.first.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares ∪ D.second.toGridRectangle.coveredSquares,
        if p ∈ G.OSet then MvPolynomial.X p.1 else (1 : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.homologyMap_X_smul_eq
statement:
theorem IsKnot.homologyMap_X_smul_eq {G : GridDiagram n} (hG : G.IsKnot) (c c' : Fin n) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((MvPolynomial.X c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R)) () =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((MvPolynomial.X c' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R)) ()

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.nonempty_homotopy_X_smul
statement:
theorem IsKnot.nonempty_homotopy_X_smul {G : GridDiagram n} (hG : G.IsKnot) (c c' : Fin n) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy ((MvPolynomial.X c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R))
      ((MvPolynomial.X c' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R)))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.homologyMap_X_smul_eq_of_pow_componentPerm_apply
statement:
theorem homologyMap_X_smul_eq_of_pow_componentPerm_apply {c c' : Fin n} (i : ℕ)
    (h : (G.componentPerm ^ i) c = c') :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((MvPolynomial.X c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R)) () =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((MvPolynomial.X c' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R)) ()

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.nonempty_homotopy_X_smul_of_pow_componentPerm_apply
statement:
theorem nonempty_homotopy_X_smul_of_pow_componentPerm_apply {c c' : Fin n} (i : ℕ)
    (h : (G.componentPerm ^ i) c = c') :
    Nonempty (Homotopy ((MvPolynomial.X c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R))
      ((MvPolynomial.X c' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.unblockedComplex R)))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.sum_unblockedCoefficient_mul_XHomotopyCoefficient_add
statement:
theorem sum_unblockedCoefficient_mul_XHomotopyCoefficient_add (k : Fin n) (x z : GridState n) :
    ∑ y : GridState n, (G.unblockedCoefficient R x y * G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k y z +
        G.XHomotopyCoefficient R k x y * G.unblockedCoefficient R y z) =
      if x = z then (MvPolynomial.X k + MvPolynomial.X (G.O.columnOfRow (G.X k)) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) else 0

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.unblockedDifferential_comp_XHomotopy_add_XHomotopy_comp
statement:
theorem unblockedDifferential_comp_XHomotopy_add_XHomotopy_comp (k : Fin n) :
    G.unblockedDifferential R ∘ₗ G.XHomotopy R k + G.XHomotopy R k ∘ₗ G.unblockedDifferential R =
      (MvPolynomial.X k + MvPolynomial.X (G.O.columnOfRow (G.X k)) : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) •
        LinearMap.id

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.IsKnot.X_smul_unblockedHomology

statement:

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.X_smul_unblockedHomology_eq_of_sameCycle
statement:

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.smul_unblockedHomology_eq_rename_smul
statement:

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.homologyMap_X_smul_id
statement:
theorem homologyMap_X_smul_id :

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars_X (j : Unit) :
    (G.simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars R i).X j =
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (simplyBlockedRingHom R i)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (MvPolynomial {c : Fin n // c ≠ i} R) (GridChainHat R n i))

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars_d :
    (G.simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars R i).d () () =
      eqToHom (G.simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars_X R i ()) ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (simplyBlockedRingHom R i)).map
          (ModuleCat.ofHom (G.simplyBlockedDifferential R i)) ≫
        eqToHom (G.simplyBlockedComplexRestrictScalars_X R i ()).symm

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.simplyBlockedShortComplex_f
statement:

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.simplyBlockedSpecializationChainHom_f
statement:

theorem simplyBlockedSpecializationChainHom_f (j : Unit) :
    (G.simplyBlockedSpecializationChainHom R i).f j =
      eqToHom (G.unblockedComplex_X R j) ≫ simplyBlockedSpecializationHom R i ≫

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.simplyBlockedSpecializationHom_comm
statement:
theorem simplyBlockedSpecializationHom_comm :
    simplyBlockedSpecializationHom R i ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (simplyBlockedRingHom R i)).map
          (ModuleCat.ofHom (G.simplyBlockedDifferential R i)) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (G.unblockedDifferential R) ≫ simplyBlockedSpecializationHom R i

name: TauCeti.X_smul_restrictScalars_gridChainHat_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem X_smul_restrictScalars_gridChainHat_eq_zero
    (y : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (simplyBlockedRingHom R i)).obj

    (hcolumns : ∀ {n} (G : GridDiagram n), f n G = f n (G.relabelColumns (finRotate n)))
    (hcomm : ∀ {n} {G G' : GridDiagram n}, GridDiagram.IsCommutation G G' →
      f n G = f n G')
    (hstab : ∀ {n} {G : GridDiagram n} {G' : GridDiagram (n + 1)},
      GridDiagram.IsStabilization G G' → f n G = f (n + 1) G')

    lift f hrows hcolumns hcomm hstab G.toGridLink = f n G

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.unblockedComplexStabilizeXIsoHomotopyCofiber_hom_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unblockedComplexStabilizeXIsoHomotopyCofiber_hom_f :
    (G.unblockedComplexStabilizeXIsoHomotopyCofiber s R).hom.f () =
      (eqToHom ((G.stabilizeX s.castSucc (G.X s).castSucc s).unblockedComplex_X R ()) ≫
          ModuleCat.ofHom (G.stabilizeXCenterProjection s R) ≫
            eqToHom (G.stabilizeXCenterComplex_X s R ()).symm) ≫
        homotopyCofiber.inlX (G.stabilizeXConnectingHom s R) () () (ComplexShape.refl_rel ()) +
      (eqToHom ((G.stabilizeX s.castSucc (G.X s).castSucc s).unblockedComplex_X R ()) ≫
          ModuleCat.ofHom (G.stabilizeXOffCenterProjection s R) ≫
            eqToHom (G.stabilizeXOffCenterComplex_X s R ()).symm) ≫
        homotopyCofiber.inrX (G.stabilizeXConnectingHom s R) ()

name: TauCeti.GridDiagram.unblockedComplexStabilizeXIsoHomotopyCofiber_inv_f
statement:

theorem unblockedComplexStabilizeXIsoHomotopyCofiber_inv_f :

      homotopyCofiber.fstX (G.stabilizeXConnectingHom s R) () () (ComplexShape.refl_rel ()) ≫
          eqToHom (G.stabilizeXCenterComplex_X s R ()) ≫
            ModuleCat.ofHom (G.stabilizeXCenterInclusion s R) ≫
              eqToHom ((G.stabilizeX s.castSucc (G.X s).castSucc s).unblockedComplex_X R ()).symm +
        homotopyCofiber.sndX (G.stabilizeXConnectingHom s R) () ≫
          eqToHom (G.stabilizeXOffCenterComplex_X s R ()) ≫
            ModuleCat.ofHom (G.stabilizeXOffCenterInclusion s R) ≫
              eqToHom ((G.stabilizeX s.castSucc (G.X s).castSucc s).unblockedComplex_X R ()).symm

statement:
theorem nonempty_homotopy_killCompl_X_smul_of_pow_componentPerm_apply (i : Fin n) {c c' : Fin n}
    (m : ℕ) (h : (G.componentPerm ^ m) c = c') :
    Nonempty (Homotopy
      (MvPolynomial.killCompl (σ := {c : Fin n // c ≠ i}) Subtype.val_injective
          (MvPolynomial.X c : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.simplyBlockedComplex R i))
      (MvPolynomial.killCompl (σ := {c : Fin n // c ≠ i}) Subtype.val_injective
          (MvPolynomial.X c' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • 𝟙 (G.simplyBlockedComplex R i)))

statement:

    (i k : Fin n) :
    G.simplyBlockedDifferential R i ∘ₗ G.simplyBlockedXHomotopy R i k +
        G.simplyBlockedXHomotopy R i k ∘ₗ G.simplyBlockedDifferential R i =
      MvPolynomial.killCompl (σ := {c : Fin n // c ≠ i}) Subtype.val_injective
          (MvPolynomial.X k + MvPolynomial.X (G.O.columnOfRow (G.X k)) :
            MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • LinearMap.id
