theorem relabel_crossing (D : PDCode n) (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n)))
    (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (slot : Fin 4) :
    (D.relabel half cross).crossing i slot = half (D.crossing (cross.symm i) slot)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.relabel_crossinglessComponentCount
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabel_crossinglessComponentCount (D : PDCode n)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).crossinglessComponentCount = D.crossinglessComponentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.relabel_edgePair
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabel_edgePair (D : PDCode n) (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n)))
    (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : (D.relabel half cross).edgePair =
      PerfectMatching.congr half D.edgePair

name: TauCeti.PDCode.relabel_halfEdge
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabel_halfEdge (D : PDCode n) (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n)))
    (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) : (D.relabel half cross).halfEdge =
      (crossingBlockPerm cross).equivCongr half D.halfEdge

name: TauCeti.PDCode.relabel_isOver
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relabel_isOver (D : PDCode n) (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n)))
    (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (slot : Fin 4) :
    (D.relabel half cross).isOver i slot = D.isOver (cross.symm i) slot

name: TauCeti.PDCode.relabel_overPair
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabel_overPair (D : PDCode n) (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n)))
    (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) :
    (D.relabel half cross).overPair i = D.overPair (cross.symm i)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.relabel_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relabel_refl (D : PDCode n) :
    D.relabel (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _) = D

name: TauCeti.PDCode.relabel_relabel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relabel_relabel (D : PDCode n)
    (half₁ half₂ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross₁ cross₂ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half₁ cross₁).relabel half₂ cross₂ =
      D.relabel (half₂ * half₁) (cross₂ * cross₁)

name: TauCeti.orientedPDCodeOneCrossingPositive_crossingSign
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orientedPDCodeOneCrossingPositive_crossingSign :
    orientedPDCodeOneCrossingPositive.crossingSign 0 = 1

name: TauCeti.orientedPDCodeUnknot_crossinglessComponents
TauCeti.orientedPDCodeUnknot_ne_empty
statement:
theorem orientedPDCodeUnknot_ne_empty (orientation : Bool) :
    orientedPDCodeUnknot orientation ≠ orientedPDCodeEmpty

name: TauCeti.orientedPDCodeUnknot_true_ne_false
statement:
theorem orientedPDCodeUnknot_true_ne_false :
    orientedPDCodeUnknot true ≠ orientedPDCodeUnknot false

name: TauCeti.orientedPDCodeUnlink_crossinglessComponents
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orientedPDCodeUnlink_crossinglessComponents (orientations : Multiset Bool) :
    (orientedPDCodeUnlink orientations).crossinglessComponents = orientations

name: TauCeti.orientedPDCode_eq_unlink
statement:
theorem orientedPDCode_eq_unlink (D : OrientedPDCode 0) :
    D = orientedPDCodeUnlink D.crossinglessComponents

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.componentPermOutgoing_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPermOutgoing_apply (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // D.orientation h = true}) :
    D.componentPermOutgoing h = ⟨D.toPDCode.componentPerm h, by
      exact (orientation_componentPerm D h).trans h.property⟩

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.componentPermOutgoing_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPermOutgoing_mirror (D : OrientedPDCode n) :
    D.mirror.componentPermOutgoing =
      D.mirrorOutgoingEquiv.permCongr D.componentPermOutgoing

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.componentPermOutgoing_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPermOutgoing_relabel (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).componentPermOutgoing =
      (D.relabelOutgoingEquiv half cross).permCongr D.componentPermOutgoing

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.componentPermOutgoing_reverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPermOutgoing_reverse (D : OrientedPDCode n) :
    D.reverse.componentPermOutgoing =
      D.reverseOutgoingEquiv.permCongr D.componentPermOutgoing⁻¹

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.componentPermOutgoing_symm_apply_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPermOutgoing_symm_apply_val (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // D.orientation h = true}) :
    (D.componentPermOutgoing.symm h).val = D.toPDCode.componentPerm.symm h

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.mirrorOutgoingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mirrorOutgoingEquiv_apply (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // D.orientation h = true}) :
    (D.mirrorOutgoingEquiv h).val = h

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.mirrorOutgoingEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mirrorOutgoingEquiv_symm_apply (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // D.mirror.orientation h = true}) :
    (D.mirrorOutgoingEquiv.symm h).val = h

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.orbitCount_componentPermOutgoing
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbitCount_componentPermOutgoing (D : OrientedPDCode n) :
    orbitCount D.componentPermOutgoing = D.toPDCode.crossingComponentCount

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.orientation_componentPerm
statement:
theorem orientation_componentPerm (D : OrientedPDCode n) (h : Fin (4 * n)) :
    D.orientation (D.toPDCode.componentPerm h) = D.orientation h

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.orientation_crossingTurn
statement:
@[simp] theorem orientation_crossingTurn (D : OrientedPDCode n) (h : Fin (4 * n)) :
    D.orientation (D.crossingTurn h) = !D.orientation h

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.relabelOutgoingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabelOutgoingEquiv_apply (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // D.orientation h = true}) :
    (D.relabelOutgoingEquiv half cross h).val = half h

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.relabelOutgoingEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem relabelOutgoingEquiv_symm_apply (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // (D.relabel half cross).orientation h = true}) :
    ((D.relabelOutgoingEquiv half cross).symm h).val = half.symm h.val

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.reverseOutgoingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reverseOutgoingEquiv_apply (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // D.orientation h = true}) :
    (D.reverseOutgoingEquiv h).val = D.edgePair.val h

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.reverseOutgoingEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reverseOutgoingEquiv_symm_apply (D : OrientedPDCode n)
    (h : {h : Fin (4 * n) // D.reverse.orientation h = true}) :
    (D.reverseOutgoingEquiv.symm h).val = D.edgePair.val h

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentCount_eq
statement:
theorem componentCount_eq (D : PDCode n) :
    D.componentCount = D.crossingComponentCount + D.crossinglessComponentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentCount_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentCount_mirror (D : PDCode n) :
    D.mirror.componentCount = D.componentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentCount_pos
statement: theorem componentCount_pos (D : PDCode n) (hn : n ≠ 0) : 0 < D.componentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentCount_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentCount_relabel (D : PDCode n)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).componentCount = D.componentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentPerm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPerm_apply (D : PDCode n) (h : Fin (4 * n)) :
    D.componentPerm h = D.crossingTurn (D.edgePair.val h)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentPerm_def
statement: theorem componentPerm_def (D : PDCode n) : D.componentPerm = D.crossingTurn * D.edgePair.val

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentPerm_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPerm_mirror (D : PDCode n) :
    D.mirror.componentPerm = D.componentPerm

name: TauCeti.PDCode.componentPerm_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentPerm_relabel (D : PDCode n) (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n)))
    (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).componentPerm = half.permCongr D.componentPerm

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingComponentCount_def
statement:
theorem crossingComponentCount_def (D : PDCode n) :
    D.crossingComponentCount = orbitCount D.componentPerm / 2

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingComponentCount_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossingComponentCount_eq_zero (D : PDCode 0) :
    D.crossingComponentCount = 0

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingComponentCount_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossingComponentCount_mirror (D : PDCode n) :
    D.mirror.crossingComponentCount = D.crossingComponentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingComponentCount_pos
statement:
theorem crossingComponentCount_pos (D : PDCode n) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    0 < D.crossingComponentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingComponentCount_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossingComponentCount_relabel (D : PDCode n)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).crossingComponentCount = D.crossingComponentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingTurn_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossingTurn_apply_apply (D : PDCode n) (h : Fin (4 * n)) :
    D.crossingTurn (D.crossingTurn h) = h

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingTurn_crossing
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossingTurn_crossing (D : PDCode n) (i : Fin n) (slot : Fin 4) :
    D.crossingTurn (D.halfEdge (PDCode.crossingSlotEquiv n (i, slot))) =
      D.crossing i (oppositeCrossingSlot slot)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingTurn_def
statement:
theorem crossingTurn_def (D : PDCode n) :
    D.crossingTurn = D.halfEdge.permCongr
      ((crossingSlotEquiv n).permCongr
        (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl _) oppositeCrossingSlot))

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingTurn_mirror
statement: @[simp] theorem crossingTurn_mirror (D : PDCode n) : D.mirror.crossingTurn = D.crossingTurn

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingTurn_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossingTurn_relabel (D : PDCode n) (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n)))
    (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).crossingTurn = half.permCongr D.crossingTurn

name: TauCeti.PDCode.even_orbitCount_componentPerm
statement:
theorem even_orbitCount_componentPerm (D : PDCode n) :
    Even (orbitCount D.componentPerm)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.isPerfectMatching_crossingTurn
statement:
theorem isPerfectMatching_crossingTurn (D : PDCode n) :
    IsPerfectMatching D.crossingTurn

name: TauCeti.TemperleyLieb.jonesDelta_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem jonesDelta_def (a : Rˣ) :
    jonesDelta a = -((a : R) ^ 2 + ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) ^ 2)

name: TauCeti.TemperleyLieb.jonesDelta_eq_neg_inv_sq_add_sq
statement:
theorem jonesDelta_eq_neg_inv_sq_add_sq (a : Rˣ) :
    jonesDelta a = -((((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)) ^ 2 + (a : R) ^ 2)

name: TauCeti.TemperleyLieb.jonesDelta_inv
statement: theorem jonesDelta_inv (a : Rˣ) : jonesDelta a⁻¹ = jonesDelta a

name: TauCeti.OrientedPDCode.normalizedKauffmanBracket_def
statement:
theorem normalizedKauffmanBracket_def {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (D : OrientedPDCode n) (a : Rˣ) :
    D.normalizedKauffmanBracket a =
      (((-a ^ 3) ^ (-D.writhe) : Rˣ) : R) * D.toPDCode.kauffmanBracket a

name: TauCeti.PDCode.crossingComponentCount_kink
statement: theorem crossingComponentCount_kink : kink.crossingComponentCount = 1

name: TauCeti.PDCode.even_orbitCount_statePerm
statement:
theorem even_orbitCount_statePerm (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    Even (orbitCount (D.statePerm s))

name: TauCeti.PDCode.isPerfectMatching_smoothingTurn
statement:
theorem isPerfectMatching_smoothingTurn (D : PDCode n) (b : Fin n → Bool) :
    IsPerfectMatching (D.smoothingTurn b)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kauffmanBracket_def
statement:
theorem kauffmanBracket_def (D : PDCode n) (a : Rˣ) :
    D.kauffmanBracket a =
      ∑ s : Fin n → Bool, (stateWeight s a : R) * jonesDelta a ^ (D.stateLoopCount s - 1)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kauffmanBracket_eq_jonesDelta_pow
statement:
theorem kauffmanBracket_eq_jonesDelta_pow (D : PDCode 0) (a : Rˣ) :
    D.kauffmanBracket a = jonesDelta a ^ (D.crossinglessComponentCount - 1)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kauffmanBracket_kink
statement:
theorem kauffmanBracket_kink (a : Rˣ) :
    kink.kauffmanBracket a = -((a : R) ^ 3)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kauffmanBracket_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem kauffmanBracket_mirror (D : PDCode n) (a : Rˣ) :
    D.mirror.kauffmanBracket a = D.kauffmanBracket a⁻¹

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kauffmanBracket_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem kauffmanBracket_relabel (D : PDCode n) (a : Rˣ)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).kauffmanBracket a = D.kauffmanBracket a

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kink_crossing
statement:
theorem kink_crossing (i : Fin 1) (t : Fin 4) :
    kink.crossing i t = crossingSlotEquiv 1 (i, t)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kink_crossingTurn
statement:
@[simp] theorem kink_crossingTurn (i : Fin 1) (t : Fin 4) :
    kink.crossingTurn (crossingSlotEquiv 1 (i, t))
      = crossingSlotEquiv 1 (i, oppositeCrossingSlot t)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kink_crossinglessComponentCount
statement: @[simp] theorem kink_crossinglessComponentCount : kink.crossinglessComponentCount = 0

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kink_edgePair_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem kink_edgePair_apply (i : Fin 1) (t : Fin 4) :
    kink.edgePair.val (crossingSlotEquiv 1 (i, t))
      = crossingSlotEquiv 1 (i, slotSmoothing true t)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kink_halfEdge
statement: @[simp] theorem kink_halfEdge : kink.halfEdge = 1

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kink_overPair
statement: @[simp] theorem kink_overPair (i : Fin 1) : kink.overPair i = true

name: TauCeti.PDCode.kink_smoothingTurn
statement:
@[simp] theorem kink_smoothingTurn (b : Fin 1 → Bool) (i : Fin 1) (t : Fin 4) :
    kink.smoothingTurn b (crossingSlotEquiv 1 (i, t))
      = crossingSlotEquiv 1 (i, slotSmoothing (b i) t)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.one_le_stateLoopCount
statement:
theorem one_le_stateLoopCount (D : PDCode n) (hn : n ≠ 0) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    1 ≤ D.stateLoopCount s

name: TauCeti.PDCode.one_le_stateLoopCount_of_componentCount_pos
statement:
theorem one_le_stateLoopCount_of_componentCount_pos (D : PDCode n)
    (h : 0 < D.componentCount) (s : Fin n → Bool) : 1 ≤ D.stateLoopCount s

name: TauCeti.PDCode.slotSmoothing_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem slotSmoothing_apply_apply (b : Bool) (slot : Fin 4) :
    slotSmoothing b (slotSmoothing b slot) = slot

name: TauCeti.PDCode.slotSmoothing_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem slotSmoothing_false :
    slotSmoothing false = Equiv.swap 0 3 * Equiv.swap 1 2

name: TauCeti.PDCode.slotSmoothing_ne
statement: theorem slotSmoothing_ne (b : Bool) (slot : Fin 4) : slotSmoothing b slot ≠ slot

name: TauCeti.PDCode.slotSmoothing_ne_oppositeCrossingSlot
statement:
theorem slotSmoothing_ne_oppositeCrossingSlot (b : Bool) (slot : Fin 4) :
    slotSmoothing b slot ≠ oppositeCrossingSlot slot

name: TauCeti.PDCode.slotSmoothing_ne_slotSmoothing_not
statement: theorem slotSmoothing_ne_slotSmoothing_not (b : Bool) : slotSmoothing b ≠ slotSmoothing !b

name: TauCeti.PDCode.slotSmoothing_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem slotSmoothing_true :
    slotSmoothing true = Equiv.swap 0 1 * Equiv.swap 2 3

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingChoice_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingChoice_mirror (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    D.mirror.smoothingChoice s = D.smoothingChoice fun j ↦ !(s j)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingChoice_of_false
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingChoice_of_false (D : PDCode n) {s : Fin n → Bool} {i : Fin n}
    (hs : s i = false) : D.smoothingChoice s i = !D.overPair i

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingChoice_of_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingChoice_of_true (D : PDCode n) {s : Fin n → Bool} {i : Fin n}
    (hs : s i = true) : D.smoothingChoice s i = D.overPair i

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingChoice_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingChoice_relabel (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).smoothingChoice s = D.smoothingChoice (s ∘ cross) ∘ cross.symm

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingTurn_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingTurn_apply_apply (D : PDCode n) (b : Fin n → Bool) (h : Fin (4 * n)) :
    D.smoothingTurn b (D.smoothingTurn b h) = h

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingTurn_crossing
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingTurn_crossing (D : PDCode n) (b : Fin n → Bool) (i : Fin n)
    (slot : Fin 4) :
    D.smoothingTurn b (D.halfEdge (crossingSlotEquiv n (i, slot))) =
      D.crossing i (slotSmoothing (b i) slot)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingTurn_def
statement:
theorem smoothingTurn_def (D : PDCode n) (b : Fin n → Bool) :
    D.smoothingTurn b = D.halfEdge.permCongr
      ((crossingSlotEquiv n).permCongr (Equiv.prodCongrRight fun i ↦ slotSmoothing (b i)))

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingTurn_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingTurn_mirror (D : PDCode n) (b : Fin n → Bool) :
    D.mirror.smoothingTurn b = D.smoothingTurn b

name: TauCeti.PDCode.smoothingTurn_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem smoothingTurn_relabel (D : PDCode n) (b : Fin n → Bool)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).smoothingTurn b = half.permCongr (D.smoothingTurn (b ∘ cross))

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateLoopCount_def
statement:
theorem stateLoopCount_def (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    D.stateLoopCount s = orbitCount (D.statePerm s) / 2 + D.crossinglessComponentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateLoopCount_eq_crossinglessComponentCount
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateLoopCount_eq_crossinglessComponentCount (D : PDCode 0) (s : Fin 0 → Bool) :
    D.stateLoopCount s = D.crossinglessComponentCount

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateLoopCount_kink_false
statement: theorem stateLoopCount_kink_false : kink.stateLoopCount (fun _ ↦ false) = 1

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateLoopCount_kink_true
statement: theorem stateLoopCount_kink_true : kink.stateLoopCount (fun _ ↦ true) = 2

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateLoopCount_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateLoopCount_mirror (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    D.mirror.stateLoopCount s = D.stateLoopCount fun i ↦ !(s i)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateLoopCount_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateLoopCount_relabel (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).stateLoopCount s = D.stateLoopCount (s ∘ cross)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.statePerm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem statePerm_apply (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool) (h : Fin (4 * n)) :
    D.statePerm s h = D.smoothingTurn (D.smoothingChoice s) (D.edgePair.val h)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.statePerm_def
statement:
theorem statePerm_def (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    D.statePerm s = D.smoothingTurn (D.smoothingChoice s) * D.edgePair.val

name: TauCeti.PDCode.statePerm_mirror
statement:
@[simp] theorem statePerm_mirror (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool) :
    D.mirror.statePerm s = D.statePerm fun i ↦ !(s i)

name: TauCeti.PDCode.statePerm_relabel
statement:
@[simp] theorem statePerm_relabel (D : PDCode n) (s : Fin n → Bool)
    (half : Equiv.Perm (Fin (4 * n))) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (D.relabel half cross).statePerm s = half.permCongr (D.statePerm (s ∘ cross))

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateWeight_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateWeight_comp (s : Fin n → Bool) (a : Rˣ) (cross : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    stateWeight (s ∘ cross) a = stateWeight s a

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateWeight_def
statement:
theorem stateWeight_def (s : Fin n → Bool) (a : Rˣ) :
    stateWeight s a = ∏ i, bif s i then a else a⁻¹

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateWeight_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateWeight_inv (s : Fin n → Bool) (a : Rˣ) :
    stateWeight s a⁻¹ = (stateWeight s a)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateWeight_not
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateWeight_not (s : Fin n → Bool) (a : Rˣ) :
    stateWeight (fun i ↦ !(s i)) a = (stateWeight s a)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.PDCode.stateWeight_snoc
statement:
@[simp] theorem stateWeight_snoc (s : Fin n → Bool) (c : Bool) (a : Rˣ) :
    stateWeight (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ ↦ Bool) s c) a =
      stateWeight s a * bif c then a else a⁻¹

name: TauCeti.FramedOrientedPDCode.crossinglessFramings_adjoinCircle
statement:
@[simp] theorem crossinglessFramings_adjoinCircle (D : FramedOrientedPDCode n)
    (orientation : Bool) (framing : ℤ) :
    (FramedOrientedPDCode.adjoinCircle D orientation framing).crossinglessFramings =
      (orientation, framing) ::ₘ D.crossinglessFramings

name: TauCeti.FramedOrientedPDCode.framing_adjoinCircle
statement:
@[simp] theorem framing_adjoinCircle (D : FramedOrientedPDCode n)
    (orientation : Bool) (framing : ℤ) :
    (FramedOrientedPDCode.adjoinCircle D orientation framing).framing = D.framing

name: TauCeti.FramedOrientedPDCode.mirror_adjoinCircle
statement:
@[simp] theorem mirror_adjoinCircle (D : FramedOrientedPDCode n) (orientation : Bool)
    (framing : ℤ) :
    (FramedOrientedPDCode.adjoinCircle D orientation framing).mirror =
      FramedOrientedPDCode.adjoinCircle D.mirror orientation (-framing)

name: TauCeti.FramedOrientedPDCode.toOrientedPDCode_adjoinCircle
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOrientedPDCode_adjoinCircle (D : FramedOrientedPDCode n)
    (orientation : Bool) (framing : ℤ) :
    (FramedOrientedPDCode.adjoinCircle D orientation framing).toOrientedPDCode =

name: LinearEquiv.autCongr_apply
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`: the pointwise `autCongr_apply_apply` is the simp normal form here, and rewriting
-- `autCongr e f` to the composite first would leave that lemma unable to fire.
theorem _root_.LinearEquiv.autCongr_apply (e : M₁ ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (f : M₁ ≃ₗ[R₁] M₁) :
    LinearEquiv.autCongr e f = (e.symm.trans f).trans e

name: LinearEquiv.autCongr_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.LinearEquiv.autCongr_apply_apply (e : M₁ ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (f : M₁ ≃ₗ[R₁] M₁) (m : M₂) :
    LinearEquiv.autCongr e f m = e (f (e.symm m))

name: LinearEquiv.autCongr_symm_apply
statement:
-- Proved by characterising the inverse rather than unfolding `autCongr` a second time: applying
-- `autCongr e` to both sides reduces it to `autCongr_apply`, so the coercion transport across
-- `toLinearEquiv` happens once, in `autCongr_apply_apply`, and not again here.
theorem _root_.LinearEquiv.autCongr_symm_apply (e : M₁ ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : M₂ ≃ₗ[R₂] M₂) :
    (LinearEquiv.autCongr e).symm g = (e.trans g).trans e.symm

name: LinearEquiv.autCongr_symm_apply_apply

    (c₂ : Module.Basis ι₂' R M₂) :
    ((b₁.toMatrix c₁).map (algebraMap R S))ᵀ * toMatrix₂Aux R (b₁ : ι₁ → M₁) (b₂ : ι₂ → M₂) B *

theorem contractLeft_coord_basis {I : Type w} [LinearOrder I]

    contractLeft (Q := (0 : QuadraticForm R M)) (b.coord i) (b.ExteriorAlgebra s) =
      if i ∈ s then basisEraseSign i s • b.ExteriorAlgebra (s.erase i) else 0

name: TauCeti.ExteriorAlgebra.ι_mul_basis
statement:

theorem ι_mul_basis {I : Type w} [LinearOrder I]

    ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (b i) * b.ExteriorAlgebra s =

      if i ∈ s then b.ExteriorAlgebra s else 0

name: CliffordAlgebra.coe_equivEvenProdOfOddLength_apply_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_equivEvenProdOfOddLength_apply_fst {l : List M} (hl : l.Pairwise Q.IsOrtho)
    (hlen : Odd l.length) (hspan : Submodule.span R {x : M | x ∈ l} = ⊤) {s : R}
    (hs : s * s * ((-1 : R) ^ l.length.choose 2 * (l.map Q).prod) = 1) (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    ((equivEvenProdOfOddLength hl hlen hspan hs x).1 : CliffordAlgebra Q)
      = halfOneAdd R (s • (l.map (ι Q)).prod) * x
        + halfOneAdd R (-(s • (l.map (ι Q)).prod)) * involute x

    (hs : s * s * ((-1 : R) ^ l.length.choose 2 * (l.map Q).prod) = 1) (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    ((equivEvenProdOfOddLength hl hlen hspan hs x).2 : CliffordAlgebra Q)
      = halfOneAdd R (-(s • (l.map (ι Q)).prod)) * x
        + halfOneAdd R (s • (l.map (ι Q)).prod) * involute x

name: TauCeti.pow_card_mul_finrank_iInf_fixedSubmodule
statement:
theorem pow_card_mul_finrank_iInf_fixedSubmodule
    {K V ι : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (p : ι → Module.End K V) (t : Finset ι)
    (hp : ∀ a ∈ t, IsIdempotentElem (p a))
    (hcomm : (t : Set ι).Pairwise fun a b => Commute (p a) (p b))
    (u v : ι → Module.End K V)
    (huS : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ i ∈ t, i ≠ a → Commute (p i) (u a))
    (hvS : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ i ∈ t, i ≠ a → Commute (p i) (v a))
    (hu0 : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ x, p a x = x → p a (u a x) = 0)
    (hv1 : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ x, p a x = 0 → p a (v a x) = v a x)
    (hvu : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ x, p a x = x → v a (u a x) = x)
    (huv : ∀ a ∈ t, ∀ x, p a x = 0 → u a (v a x) = x) :
    2 ^ t.card * finrank K ((⨅ i ∈ t, (p i).fixedSubmodule) : Submodule K V) =
      finrank K V

    [FiniteDimensional K V] [DecidableEq ι]
    (p : ι → Module.End K V) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι) (ha : a ∉ s)
    (hpa : IsIdempotentElem (p a))
    (hcomm : ∀ i ∈ s, Commute (p i) (p a))
    (u v : Module.End K V)
    (huS : ∀ i ∈ s, Commute (p i) u)
    (hvS : ∀ i ∈ s, Commute (p i) v)
    (hu0 : ∀ x, p a x = x → p a (u x) = 0)
    (hv1 : ∀ x, p a x = 0 → p a (v x) = v x)
    (hvu : ∀ x, p a x = x → v (u x) = x)
    (huv : ∀ x, p a x = 0 → u (v x) = x) :
    2 * finrank K ((⨅ i ∈ insert a s, (p i).fixedSubmodule) : Submodule K V) =
      finrank K ((⨅ i ∈ s, (p i).fixedSubmodule) : Submodule K V)

statement:

name: MultilinearMap.oneSlot_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oneSlot_apply {α : Type uα} {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : α ⊕ (Unit ⊕ γ) ↦ M) N)
    (g : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : β ↦ M) M) (x : α ⊕ (β ⊕ γ) → M) :
    oneSlot f g x = f (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ x (.inl i)) <|
      Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ g fun j ↦ x (.inr (.inl j))) (fun i ↦ x (.inr (.inr i))))

name: MultilinearMap.signedOneSlot_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem signedOneSlot_apply {M : Type uM} {N : Type uN} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] {α : Type uα} [Fintype α] {β : Type uβ} {γ : Type uγ}
    (q : ℤ) (d : α → ℤ)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : α ⊕ (Unit ⊕ γ) ↦ M) N)
    (g : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : β ↦ M) M) (x : α ⊕ (β ⊕ γ) → M) :
    signedOneSlot q d f g x = koszulSign (R := R) q d • f (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ x (.inl i)) <|
      Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ g fun j ↦ x (.inr (.inl j))) (fun i ↦ x (.inr (.inr i))))

name: MultilinearMap.suspExp_add
statement:
theorem suspExp_add (a b : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℤ) :
    suspExp (a + b) d =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, ((a : ℤ) + b - 1 - i) * d i) +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, ((b : ℤ) - 1 - j) * d (a + j)

name: MultilinearMap.suspExp_add3
statement:
theorem suspExp_add3 (a b c : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℤ) :
    suspExp (a + b + c) d =
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, ((a : ℤ) + b + c - 1 - i) * d i) +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, ((c : ℤ) + b - 1 - j) * d (a + j)) +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range c, ((c : ℤ) - 1 - j) * d (a + b + j)

name: MultilinearMap.suspExp_congr
statement:
theorem suspExp_congr {k : ℕ} {d e : ℕ → ℤ} (h : ∀ i < k, d i = e i) :

name: MultilinearMap.suspExp_def
statement:
theorem suspExp_def (k : ℕ) (d : ℕ → ℤ) :

statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_shift_const_iff {f : MultilinearMap R M N} {𝒜 : (i : κ) → ι → σM i}
    {ℬ : ι → σN} {q c : ι} :
    IsHomogeneous f (fun i ↦ Graded.shift (𝒜 i) c) (Graded.shift ℬ c) q ↔
      IsHomogeneous f 𝒜 ℬ (q + c - Fintype.card κ • c)

name: TauCeti.MultilinearMap.isHomogeneous_shift_iff

    IsHomogeneous f (fun i ↦ Graded.shift (𝒜 i) (c i)) (Graded.shift ℬ r) q ↔
      IsHomogeneous f 𝒜 ℬ (q + r - ∑ i, c i)

name: TauCeti.MultilinearMap.isHomogeneous_suspend_iff
statement:
theorem isHomogeneous_suspend_iff {k : ℕ} {𝒜 : ℤ → σ} {d : ℕ → ℤ}
    {f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k ↦ M) M} :
    IsHomogeneous (suspend d f) (fun _ ↦ Graded.shift 𝒜 1) (Graded.shift 𝒜 1) 1 ↔
      IsHomogeneous f (fun _ ↦ 𝒜) 𝒜 (2 - k)

    {𝒜 : ℤ → σM} :
    IsHomogeneous f (fun _ ↦ Graded.shift 𝒜 1) (Graded.shift 𝒜 1) 1 ↔
      IsHomogeneous f (fun _ ↦ 𝒜) 𝒜 (2 - n)

name: TauCeti.MultilinearMap.isHomogeneous_suspension_iff
statement:

name: Matrix.associated_invariant_factor_zero_gcd
statement:
theorem associated_invariant_factor_zero_gcd {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S]
    [NormalizedGCDMonoid S] [NeZero n] (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) S) (d : Fin n → S)
    (hd0 : ∀ k, d 0 ∣ d k) (L R : GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) S)
    (h : (L : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) S) * A * (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) S) =

    (hdvd : ∀ e : ℤ, (∀ i j, e ∣ A i j) ↔ ∀ i j, e ∣ B i j) :
    ∃ P Q : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ,
      (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) * A * (Q : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) = B

      (∀ ⦃i j : Fin n⦄, i ≤ j → d i ∣ d j) ∧
      (L : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) * A * (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) =
        Matrix.diagonal d

      (∀ ⦃i j : Fin n⦄, i ≤ j → d i ∣ d j) ∧
      (L : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) * A * (R : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) =
        Matrix.diagonal d

    L.discriminantGroupInvariantFactorsEquiv b (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) i =

name: TauCeti.IntegralLattice.form_ofGramMatrix_basisFun_basisFun

    (ofGramMatrix (Pi.basisFun ℚ ι) G hG).form
        (Pi.basisFun ℚ ι i) (Pi.basisFun ℚ ι j) = ((G i j : ℤ) : ℚ)

    x ∈ (ofGramMatrix (Pi.basisFun ℚ ι) G hG).carrier ↔ ∀ i, ∃ z : ℤ, (z : ℚ) = x i

statement:
theorem jordanDecomposition_map₂
    {W : Type w} {U : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module K U] [FiniteDimensional K U]
    (F : GeneralLinearGroup K V → GeneralLinearGroup K W → GeneralLinearGroup K U)
    (map_mul : ∀ a c b d, F (a * c) (b * d) = F a b * F c d)
    (map_isSemisimple : ∀ {a b}, IsSemisimple a → IsSemisimple b → IsSemisimple (F a b))
    (map_isUnipotent : ∀ {a b}, IsUnipotent a → IsUnipotent b → IsUnipotent (F a b))
    (g : GeneralLinearGroup K V) (h : GeneralLinearGroup K W) :
    jordanDecomposition (F g h) =
      (F (semisimplePart g) (semisimplePart h),
        F (unipotentPart g) (unipotentPart h))

name: LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup.jordanDecomposition_spec

      Commute (jordanDecomposition g).1 (jordanDecomposition g).2 ∧
      g = (jordanDecomposition g).1 * (jordanDecomposition g).2

name: TauCeti.sum_range_chainBEntry_mul
statement:
theorem sum_range_chainBEntry_mul {R : Type*} [NonAssocRing R] {L m a : ℕ} (ha : a < m)
    (g : ℕ → R) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range m, (chainBEntry L a s : R) * g s
      = 2 * g a - (if a = 0 then 0 else g (a - 1))
        - (if a + 1 = m then 0 else (if a + 1 = L then 2 else 1) * g (a + 1))

name: TauCeti.sum_range_chainEntry_mul
statement:
theorem sum_range_chainEntry_mul {R : Type*} [Ring R] {n m : ℕ} (hm : m < n) (g : ℕ → R) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, (chainEntry m s : R) * g (s + 1)
      = 2 * g (m + 1) - (if m = 0 then 0 else g m)
        - (if m + 1 = n then 0 else g (m + 2))

name: TauCeti.sum_range_chainEntry_mul_affine
statement:
theorem sum_range_chainEntry_mul_affine {R : Type*} [Ring R] {n m : ℕ} (hm : m < n)
    (a b : R) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, (chainEntry m s : R) * (a * (s : R) + b) =
      if m = 0 then (if m + 1 = n then 2 * b else b - a)
      else if m + 1 = n then a * (n : R) + b else 0

name: TauCeti.moebiusGL_smul_infty
TauCeti.moebiusGL_smul_some
statement:
lemma moebiusGL_smul_some (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) (h : M.det ≠ 0) (k : K) :
    moebiusGL M h • (k : OnePoint K) =
      if M 1 0 * k + M 0 0 = 0 then ∞
      else ((M 1 1 * k + M 0 1) / (M 1 0 * k + M 0 0) : K)

name: TauCeti.natCast_moebiusFin_of_eq_zero

    (hb : ((M 1 0 : ℤ) : ZMod p) * ((b : ℕ) : ZMod p) + ((M 0 0 : ℤ) : ZMod p) = 0) :
    ((moebiusFin M h b : ℕ) : ZMod p) =

    ∃ (P : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) k) (m : ℕ), ∀ (i : ι) (g : GL (Fin n) k),

    ∃ (P : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) k) (m : ℕ), ∀ (i : ι) (g : GL (Fin n) k),
      f i g = ((g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) k).det ^ m)⁻¹ *

name: Matrix.pairMinor_mul
statement:
theorem pairMinor_mul {l : Type*} [Fintype l] [LinearOrder l] (g : Matrix m l R)
    (h : Matrix l n R) (p : m × m) (q : n × n) :
    pairMinor (g * h) p q =
      ∑ ij ∈ {ij : l × l | ij.1 < ij.2}, pairMinor g p ij * pairMinor h ij q

name: Matrix.pairMinor_mul_fin_four
statement:
theorem pairMinor_mul_fin_four (g : Matrix m (Fin 4) R) (h : Matrix (Fin 4) n R)
    (p : m × m) (q : n × n) :
    pairMinor (g * h) p q =
      pairMinor g p (0, 1) * pairMinor h (0, 1) q +
        pairMinor g p (0, 2) * pairMinor h (0, 2) q +
        pairMinor g p (0, 3) * pairMinor h (0, 3) q +
        pairMinor g p (1, 2) * pairMinor h (1, 2) q +
        pairMinor g p (1, 3) * pairMinor h (1, 3) q +
        pairMinor g p (2, 3) * pairMinor h (2, 3) q

theorem sq_le_four_mul_of_exists_nonneg_pencil_det (hp : p ≠ 1)

      ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime → ℓ ≠ p → ∃ M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod ℓ),
        M.det = (q : ZMod ℓ) ∧ (1 - M).det = ((q + 1 - t : ℤ) : ZMod ℓ) ∧
        ((r : ZMod ℓ) • M - (s : ZMod ℓ) • 1).det = (D : ZMod ℓ)) :

statement:

    (h : ∀ r s : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ r → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ s → ∃ D : ℤ, 0 ≤ D ∧
      ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime → ℓ ≠ p → ∃ M : Matrix (l ⊕ l) (l ⊕ l) (ZMod ℓ),
        Mᵀ * J l (ZMod ℓ) * M = (q : ZMod ℓ) • J l (ZMod ℓ) ∧
        (1 - M)ᵀ * J l (ZMod ℓ) * (1 - M) = ((q + 1 - t : ℤ) : ZMod ℓ) • J l (ZMod ℓ) ∧
        ((r : ZMod ℓ) • M - (s : ZMod ℓ) • 1)ᵀ * J l (ZMod ℓ)

@[simp]
theorem coe_finTwoOfUnit (i half : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (hhalf : 2 * half = 1) (u : Rˣ) :
    (finTwoOfUnit i half hi hhalf u : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) =
      !![half * ((u : R) + (↑u⁻¹ : R)),
          -i * half * ((u : R) - (↑u⁻¹ : R));
        -(-i * half * ((u : R) - (↑u⁻¹ : R))),
          half * ((u : R) + (↑u⁻¹ : R))]

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.coe_finTwoToUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_finTwoToUnit (i : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (M : Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R) :
    (finTwoToUnit i hi M : R) =
      (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 +
        i * (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.coe_inv_finTwoToUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_inv_finTwoToUnit (i : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (M : Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R) :
    (↑(finTwoToUnit i hi M)⁻¹ : R) =
      (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 0 -
        i * (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R) 0 1

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.finTwoMulEquivUnits_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finTwoMulEquivUnits_apply (i half : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (hhalf : 2 * half = 1) (M : Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R) :
    finTwoMulEquivUnits i half hi hhalf M = finTwoToUnit i hi M

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.finTwoMulEquivUnits_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finTwoMulEquivUnits_symm_apply (i half : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (hhalf : 2 * half = 1) (u : Rˣ) :
    (finTwoMulEquivUnits i half hi hhalf).symm u = finTwoOfUnit i half hi hhalf u

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.finTwoOfUnit_finTwoToUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finTwoOfUnit_finTwoToUnit (i half : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (hhalf : 2 * half = 1) (M : Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R) :
    finTwoOfUnit i half hi hhalf (finTwoToUnit i hi M) = M

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.finTwoOfUnit_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finTwoOfUnit_one (i half : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1) (hhalf : 2 * half = 1) :
    finTwoOfUnit i half hi hhalf 1 = 1

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.finTwoToUnit_finTwoOfUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finTwoToUnit_finTwoOfUnit (i half : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (hhalf : 2 * half = 1) (u : Rˣ) :
    finTwoToUnit i hi (finTwoOfUnit i half hi hhalf u) = u

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.finTwoToUnit_map
statement:
theorem finTwoToUnit_map {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (i : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1) (M : Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R) :
    finTwoToUnit (f i)
        (by simpa only [map_pow, map_neg, map_one] using congrArg f hi) (map f M) =
      Units.map f (finTwoToUnit i hi M)

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.finTwoToUnit_mul
statement:
theorem finTwoToUnit_mul (i : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1)
    (M N : Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R) :
    finTwoToUnit i hi (M * N) = finTwoToUnit i hi M * finTwoToUnit i hi N

name: Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.map_finTwoOfUnit
statement:
theorem map_finTwoOfUnit {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (i half : R) (hi : i ^ 2 = -1) (hhalf : 2 * half = 1) (u : Rˣ) :
    map f (finTwoOfUnit i half hi hhalf u) =
      finTwoOfUnit (f i) (f half)
        (by simpa only [map_pow, map_neg, map_one] using congrArg f hi)
        (by simpa only [map_ofNat, map_mul, map_one] using congrArg f hhalf)
        (Units.map f u)

name: TauCeti.map_reflectionPair
statement:

theorem map_reflectionPair (f : R →+* S) {v w : n → R} {c d : R} (hc : c * (v ⬝ᵥ v) = 2)
    (hd : d * (w ⬝ᵥ w) = 2) :
    Matrix.SpecialOrthogonalGroup.map f (reflectionPair v w c d hc hd) =
      reflectionPair (f ∘ v) (f ∘ w) (f c) (f d)
        (by rw [← RingHom.map_dotProduct, ← map_mul, hc, map_ofNat])
        (by rw [← RingHom.map_dotProduct, ← map_mul, hd, map_ofNat])

name: MultilinearMap.sum_neg_one_pow_card_smul_apply_sum_compl

name: Matrix.piTensorProductMap_bivector
statement:
theorem piTensorProductMap_bivector {ι κ R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq κ] [CommSemiring R] (A : Matrix κ ι R) (K : Matrix ι ι R) :
    PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin 2 => Matrix.mulVecLin A)
        (∑ x : ι, ∑ y : ι, K x y •
          PiTensorProduct.tprod R ![Pi.single x (1 : R), Pi.single y (1 : R)]) =
      ∑ p : κ, ∑ q : κ, (A * K * Aᵀ) p q •
        PiTensorProduct.tprod R ![Pi.single p (1 : R), Pi.single q (1 : R)]

name: Matrix.piTensorProductMap_tprod_single
statement:
theorem piTensorProductMap_tprod_single {ι κ R : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq κ] [CommSemiring R] (A : Matrix κ ι R) (x y : ι) :
    PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ : Fin 2 => Matrix.mulVecLin A)
        (PiTensorProduct.tprod R ![Pi.single x (1 : R), Pi.single y (1 : R)]) =
      ∑ p : κ, ∑ q : κ, (A p x * A q y) •
        PiTensorProduct.tprod R ![Pi.single p (1 : R), Pi.single q (1 : R)]

name: TauCeti.equivalent_binary_iff
statement:
theorem equivalent_binary_iff [Invertible (2 : R)] (a b c d : Rˣ) :
    (weightedSumSquares R ![(a : R), (b : R)]).Equivalent
        (weightedSumSquares R ![(c : R), (d : R)]) ↔
      IsSquare (a * b * (c * d)) ∧
        ∃ e : Rˣ, e ∈ unitValueSet (weightedSumSquares R ![(a : R), (b : R)]) ∧
          e ∈ unitValueSet (weightedSumSquares R ![(c : R), (d : R)])

    (hab : e ∈ unitValueSet (weightedSumSquares R ![(a : R), (b : R)]))
    (hcd : e ∈ unitValueSet (weightedSumSquares R ![(c : R), (d : R)])) :
    (weightedSumSquares R ![(a : R), (b : R)]).Equivalent
      (weightedSumSquares R ![(c : R), (d : R)])

name: TauCeti.isometryEquivBinaryNormalForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isometryEquivBinaryNormalForm_apply (a b x y : R) (c : Rˣ)
    (h : a * x ^ 2 + b * y ^ 2 = c) (v : Fin 2 → R) :
    isometryEquivBinaryNormalForm a b x y c h v =
      ![x * v 0 - b * y * v 1, y * v 0 + a * x * v 1]

name: TauCeti.isometryEquivBinaryNormalForm_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isometryEquivBinaryNormalForm_symm_apply (a b x y : R) (c : Rˣ)
    (h : a * x ^ 2 + b * y ^ 2 = c) (v : Fin 2 → R) :
    (isometryEquivBinaryNormalForm a b x y c h).symm v =
      ![(↑c⁻¹ : R) * (a * x * v 0 + b * y * v 1),
        (↑c⁻¹ : R) * (x * v 1 - y * v 0)]

theorem RegularFormClass.liftDiagonal_mk {α : Type v}
    (f : (p : RegularFormPresentation K) → α)
    (hperm : ∀ {n} {w w' : Fin n → Kˣ}, PermutationStep w w' →
      f ⟨n, w⟩ = f ⟨n, w'⟩)
    (hbin : ∀ {n} {w w' : Fin n → Kˣ}, BinaryStep w w' →
      f ⟨n, w⟩ = f ⟨n, w'⟩)
    (hone : ∀ a b : Kˣ, IsSquare (a * b) →
      f ⟨1, fun _ => a⟩ = f ⟨1, fun _ => b⟩) (p : RegularFormPresentation K) :
    RegularFormClass.liftDiagonal f hperm hbin hone (Quotient.mk _ p) = f p

    (hperm : ∀ {n} {w w' : Fin n → Kˣ}, PermutationStep w w' →
      f ⟨n, w⟩ = f ⟨n, w'⟩)
    (hbin : ∀ {n} {w w' : Fin n → Kˣ}, BinaryStep w w' →
      f ⟨n, w⟩ = f ⟨n, w'⟩)
    (hone : ∀ a b : Kˣ, IsSquare (a * b) →
      f ⟨1, fun _ => a⟩ = f ⟨1, fun _ => b⟩)
    (g : RegularFormClass K → α)
    (hg : ∀ p, g (Quotient.mk _ p) = f p) :
    g = RegularFormClass.liftDiagonal f hperm hbin hone

statement:
theorem starCartanMatrix_comp (e : α ≃ β) (ℓ : β → ℕ) :
    starCartanMatrix (ℓ ∘ e) =
      (starCartanMatrix ℓ).submatrix (starIndexCongrArms e ℓ) (starIndexCongrArms e ℓ)

name: TauCeti.starCartanMatrix_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem starCartanMatrix_comp_apply (e : α ≃ β) (ℓ : β → ℕ)
    (v w : StarIndex (ℓ ∘ e)) :
    starCartanMatrix (ℓ ∘ e) v w
      = starCartanMatrix ℓ (starIndexCongrArms e ℓ v) (starIndexCongrArms e ℓ w)

name: TauCeti.starCartanMatrix_none_none
statement: @[simp] lemma starCartanMatrix_none_none : starCartanMatrix ℓ none none = 2

name: TauCeti.starCartanMatrix_none_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma starCartanMatrix_none_some (w : (i : α) × Fin (ℓ i)) :
    starCartanMatrix ℓ none (some w) = if (w.2 : ℕ) = 0 then -1 else 0

name: TauCeti.starCartanMatrix_some_none
statement:
@[simp] lemma starCartanMatrix_some_none (v : (i : α) × Fin (ℓ i)) :
    starCartanMatrix ℓ (some v) none = if (v.2 : ℕ) = 0 then -1 else 0

name: TauCeti.starCartanMatrix_some_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma starCartanMatrix_some_some (v w : (i : α) × Fin (ℓ i)) :
    starCartanMatrix ℓ (some v) (some w) = if v.1 = w.1 then
        if (v.2 : ℕ) = w.2 then 2
        else if (v.2 : ℕ) = w.2 + 1 then -1
        else if (w.2 : ℕ) = v.2 + 1 then -1 else 0
      else 0

name: TauCeti.starCartanMatrix_transpose
statement: @[simp] lemma starCartanMatrix_transpose : (starCartanMatrix ℓ)ᵀ = starCartanMatrix ℓ

name: TauCeti.starIndexCongrArms_none
statement:
@[simp] lemma starIndexCongrArms_none (e : α ≃ β) (ℓ : β → ℕ) :
    starIndexCongrArms e ℓ none = none

name: TauCeti.starIndexCongrArms_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma starIndexCongrArms_some (e : α ≃ β) (ℓ : β → ℕ) (v : (i : α) × Fin (ℓ (e i))) :
    starIndexCongrArms e ℓ (some v) = some ⟨e v.1, v.2⟩

name: TauCeti.starMark_none
statement: @[simp] lemma starMark_none : starMark ℓ none = ∏ i, ((ℓ i : ℚ) + 1)

name: TauCeti.starMark_pos
statement: lemma starMark_pos (v : StarIndex ℓ) : 0 < starMark ℓ v

name: TauCeti.starMark_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma starMark_some (v : (i : α) × Fin (ℓ i)) :
    starMark ℓ (some v) = ((ℓ v.1 : ℚ) - (v.2 : ℕ)) * ∏ j ∈ ({v.1}ᶜ : Finset α), ((ℓ j : ℚ) + 1)

name: TauCeti.sum_starCartanMatrix_mul_starMark_none
statement:
theorem sum_starCartanMatrix_mul_starMark_none :
    ∑ w, (starCartanMatrix ℓ none w : ℚ) * starMark ℓ w
      = ∑ i, (∏ j ∈ ({i}ᶜ : Finset α), ((ℓ j : ℚ) + 1))
        - ((Fintype.card α : ℚ) - 2) * ∏ i, ((ℓ i : ℚ) + 1)

name: TauCeti.sum_starCartanMatrix_mul_starMark_some_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_starCartanMatrix_mul_starMark_some_eq_zero (v : (i : α) × Fin (ℓ i)) :
    ∑ w, (starCartanMatrix ℓ (some v) w : ℚ) * starMark ℓ w = 0

statement:

name: RootPairing.RootPositiveForm.rootLength_weylGroupToPerm
statement:
-- Not a `simp` lemma: `simp` unfolds `P.weylGroupToPerm w i` to `(↑↑w).indexEquiv i` through
-- `MonoidHom.domRestrict_apply` and `RootPairing.Equiv.indexHom_apply`, so this left-hand side is
-- never in normal form. The `reflectionPerm` form below is the usable `simp` lemma.
theorem _root_.RootPairing.RootPositiveForm.rootLength_weylGroupToPerm
    (B : P.RootPositiveForm S) (w : P.weylGroup) (i : ι) :
    B.rootLength (P.weylGroupToPerm w i) = B.rootLength i

    ∃ i ∈ b.support, ∃ w : P.weylGroup, P.weylGroupToPerm w i = j

name: RootPairing.weylGroup.pow_ofIdx_mul_ofIdx_smul
statement:
theorem _root_.RootPairing.weylGroup.pow_ofIdx_mul_ofIdx_smul (n : ℕ) (x : M)
    (t : R := P.pairing i j * P.pairing j i - 2)
    (ht : t = P.pairing i j * P.pairing j i - 2 := by rfl) :
    ((_root_.RootPairing.weylGroup.ofIdx P i *
        _root_.RootPairing.weylGroup.ofIdx P j) ^ n) • x =
      x +
        ((S R ((n - 2) / 2)).eval t * ((S R ((n - 1) / 2)).eval t + (S R ((n - 3) / 2)).eval t)) •
          ((P.pairing i j * P.coroot' i x - P.coroot' j x) • P.root j - P.coroot' i x • P.root i) +
        ((S R ((n - 1) / 2)).eval t * ((S R (n / 2)).eval t + (S R ((n - 2) / 2)).eval t)) •
          ((P.pairing j i * P.coroot' j x - P.coroot' i x) • P.root i -
            P.coroot' j x • P.root j)

name: RootPairing.weylGroup.pow_ofIdx_mul_ofIdx_smul_root
statement:
theorem _root_.RootPairing.weylGroup.pow_ofIdx_mul_ofIdx_smul_root (n : ℕ)
    (t : R := P.pairing i j * P.pairing j i - 2)
    (ht : t = P.pairing i j * P.pairing j i - 2 := by rfl) :
    ((_root_.RootPairing.weylGroup.ofIdx P i *
        _root_.RootPairing.weylGroup.ofIdx P j) ^ n) • P.root i =
      ((S R n).eval t + (S R (n - 1)).eval t) • P.root i +
        ((S R (n - 1)).eval t * -P.pairing i j) • P.root j

lemma twoDoubleEdgeMark_def (s : Fin (m + 3)) :
    twoDoubleEdgeMark m b s =
      if (s : ℕ) = 0 ∨ (b ∧ (s : ℕ) = m + 2) then 1 else 2

name: TauCeti.twoDoubleEdgeMark_interior
statement:
@[simp] lemma twoDoubleEdgeMark_interior (s : Fin (m + 3))
    (hzero : 0 < (s : ℕ)) (hlast : (s : ℕ) < m + 2) : twoDoubleEdgeMark m b s = 2

name: TauCeti.twoDoubleEdgeMark_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma twoDoubleEdgeMark_last :
    twoDoubleEdgeMark m b ⟨m + 2, by omega⟩ = if b then 1 else 2

name: TauCeti.twoDoubleEdgeMark_pos
statement: lemma twoDoubleEdgeMark_pos (s : Fin (m + 3)) : 0 < twoDoubleEdgeMark m b s

name: TauCeti.twoDoubleEdgeMark_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma twoDoubleEdgeMark_zero : twoDoubleEdgeMark m b 0 = 1

name: TauCeti.IsFiniteType.exists_equiv_forall_eq_doubleEdgeCartanMatrix
statement:
-- `degree` needs finite neighbour sets while the theorem type is elaborated, so this decidability
-- instance cannot be confined to the proof.
theorem IsFiniteType.exists_equiv_forall_eq_doubleEdgeCartanMatrix [DecidableEq B]
    (h : IsFiniteType A)
    (hconn : (diagramGraph A).Preconnected) (hdeg : ∀ i, (diagramGraph A).degree i ≤ 2)
    {u v : B} (hvu : A v u = -2) :
    ∃ p q : ℕ, 0 < p ∧ 0 < q ∧ ∃ e : B ≃ Fin p ⊕ Fin q,
      ∀ i j, A i j = doubleEdgeCartanMatrix p q (e i) (e j)

name: TauCeti.IsFiniteType.exists_equiv_forall_eq_doubleEdgeCartanMatrix_eq_one_or_eq_one_or_eq_two_two
statement:
-- `degree` needs finite neighbour sets while the theorem type is elaborated, so this decidability
-- instance cannot be confined to the proof.
theorem IsFiniteType.exists_equiv_forall_eq_doubleEdgeCartanMatrix_eq_one_or_eq_one_or_eq_two_two
    [DecidableEq B] (h : IsFiniteType A) (hconn : (diagramGraph A).Preconnected)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, (diagramGraph A).degree i ≤ 2)
    {u v : B} (huv : A u v * A v u = 2) :
    ∃ p q : ℕ, 0 < p ∧ 0 < q ∧ (q = 1 ∨ p = 1 ∨ (p = 2 ∧ q = 2)) ∧
      ∃ e : B ≃ Fin p ⊕ Fin q,
        ∀ i j, A i j = doubleEdgeCartanMatrix p q (e i) (e j)

    ∃ l' : List b.support, l'.Sublist l ∧ wordProd P b l' = wordProd P b l ∧
      l'.length = (inversions P b (wordProd P b l)).ncard

name: TauCeti.exists_wordProd_eraseIdx_eraseIdx_eq
statement:
theorem exists_wordProd_eraseIdx_eraseIdx_eq (l : List b.support)
    (h : (inversions P b (wordProd P b l)).ncard < l.length) :
    ∃ j k, j < k ∧ k < l.length ∧
      wordProd P b ((l.eraseIdx k).eraseIdx j) = wordProd P b l ∧
      ((l.eraseIdx k).eraseIdx j).length + 2 = l.length

name: TauCeti.ncard_inversions_wordProd_eq_length_iff
statement:
theorem ncard_inversions_wordProd_eq_length_iff (l : List b.support) :
    (inversions P b (wordProd P b l)).ncard = l.length ↔
      ∀ j k, j < k → k < l.length →
        wordProd P b ((l.eraseIdx k).eraseIdx j) ≠ wordProd P b l

name: TauCeti.RootPairingIsogeny.comp_assoc

    (hcoroot : ∀ i, Aᵀ *ᵥ Q.coroot (e i) = c i • P.coroot i) :
    (ofMatrix P Q hP hQ A e c hc hA hroot hcoroot).coweightMap = Aᵀ.mulVecLin

name: LinearMap.eq_prodMap_add_inl_comp_snd
statement:
theorem eq_prodMap_add_inl_comp_snd {R A C : Type*} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid A] [Module R A] [AddCommMonoid C] [Module R C]
    {fA : A →ₗ[R] A} {fC : C →ₗ[R] C} (F : (A × C) →ₗ[R] A × C)
    (hinl : F.comp (inl R A C) = (inl R A C).comp fA)
    (hsnd : (snd R A C).comp F = fC.comp (snd R A C)) :
    F = prodMap fA fC + (inl R A C).comp
      (((fst R A C).comp (F.comp (inr R A C))).comp (snd R A C))

name: LinearMap.trace_prodMap_add_inl_comp_snd
statement:
theorem trace_prodMap_add_inl_comp_snd {R A C : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [Module.Free R A] [Module.Finite R A]
    [AddCommGroup C] [Module R C] [Module.Free R C] [Module.Finite R C]
    (fA : A →ₗ[R] A) (fC : C →ₗ[R] C) (u : C →ₗ[R] A) :
    trace R (A × C) (prodMap fA fC + (inl R A C).comp (u.comp (snd R A C)))
      = trace R A fA + trace R C fC

name: LinearMap.trace_pi_of_apply_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.trace_pi_of_apply_eq (T : (ι → M) →ₗ[k] (ι → M)) (σ : ι → ι)
    (f : ι → M →ₗ[k] M) (hT : ∀ x i, T x i = f i (x (σ i))) :
    LinearMap.trace k (ι → M) T =
      ∑ i : ι, if σ i = i then LinearMap.trace k M (f i) else 0

name: LinearMap.trace_pi_of_apply_eq_dependent
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.trace_pi_of_apply_eq_dependent {M : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module k (M i)] [∀ i, Module.Free k (M i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Finite k (M i)]
    (T : ((i : ι) → M i) →ₗ[k] ((i : ι) → M i)) (f : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[k] M i)
    (hT : ∀ x i, T x i = f i (x i)) :
    LinearMap.trace k ((i : ι) → M i) T = ∑ i, LinearMap.trace k (M i) (f i)

statement:
theorem sum_mul_det_vandermonde_update_sub_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} (y : Fin m → R) :
    (∑ i, y i * (Matrix.vandermonde (Function.update y i (y i - 1))).det)
      = ((∑ i, y i) - ∑ i : Fin m, ((i : ℕ) : R)) * (Matrix.vandermonde y).det

name: TauCeti.sum_mul_prod_sub_update_sub_one
statement:
theorem sum_mul_prod_sub_update_sub_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (b : ℕ → R) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, b i *
        ∏ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∏ l ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) m,
          (Function.update b i (b i - 1) k - Function.update b i (b i - 1) l))
      = ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, b i) - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (i : R))
        * ∏ k ∈ Finset.range m, ∏ l ∈ Finset.Ico (k + 1) m, (b k - b l)
