@[simp]
theorem blowUpVertex_intersectionMatrix_some_some (w w' : V) :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).intersectionMatrix (some w) (some w') =
      P.intersectionMatrix w w' -
        (if w = v then (1 : ℤ) else 0) * (if w' = v then (1 : ℤ) else 0)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpVertex_neighborSet_none
statement:
theorem blowUpVertex_neighborSet_none :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).toSimpleGraph.neighborSet none = {some v}

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpVertex_weight_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpVertex_weight_none : (P.blowUpVertex v).weight none = -1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpVertex_weight_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpVertex_weight_some (w : V) :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).weight (some w) = if w = v then P.weight w - 1 else P.weight w

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpVertex_weight_some_of_ne
statement:
theorem blowUpVertex_weight_some_of_ne {w : V} (h : w ≠ v) :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).weight (some w) = P.weight w

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpVertex_weight_some_self
statement:
theorem blowUpVertex_weight_some_self :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).weight (some v) = P.weight v - 1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.exists_blowUpCovectorEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem exists_blowUpCovectorEquiv_eq (k : (P.blowUpVertex v).characteristicVectors) :
    ∃ (l : P.characteristicVectors) (ε : ℤ), Odd ε ∧
      blowUpCovectorEquiv v (l.val, ε) = k.val

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.intersectionForm_blowUpVertexEquiv
statement:
theorem intersectionForm_blowUpVertexEquiv (x y : V → ℤ) (s t : ℤ) :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).intersectionForm (blowUpVertexEquiv v (x, s))
        (blowUpVertexEquiv v (y, t)) =
      P.intersectionForm x y - s * t

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.intersectionForm_blowUpVertexEquiv_single_none
statement:
theorem intersectionForm_blowUpVertexEquiv_single_none (x : V → ℤ) :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).intersectionForm (blowUpVertexEquiv v (x, 0))
        (Pi.single (none : Option V) (1 : ℤ)) = 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.intersectionForm_single_none_self
statement:
theorem intersectionForm_single_none_self :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).intersectionForm (Pi.single (none : Option V) (1 : ℤ))
        (Pi.single (none : Option V) (1 : ℤ)) = -1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.isCharacteristicVector_blowUpCovectorEquiv_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isCharacteristicVector_blowUpCovectorEquiv_iff (k : V → ℤ) (ε : ℤ) :
    (P.blowUpVertex v).IsCharacteristicVector (blowUpCovectorEquiv v (k, ε)) ↔
      P.IsCharacteristicVector k ∧ Odd ε

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.sum_blowUpCovectorEquiv_mul_blowUpVertexEquiv
statement:
theorem sum_blowUpCovectorEquiv_mul_blowUpVertexEquiv (k x : V → ℤ) (ε s : ℤ) :
    ∑ a, blowUpCovectorEquiv v (k, ε) a * blowUpVertexEquiv v (x, s) a =
      (∑ w, k w * x w) + ε * s

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_add
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_add (k l x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator (fun v => k v + l v) x =
      P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x + ∑ v, l v * x v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_add_two_mul
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_add_two_mul (k l x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator (fun v => k v + 2 * l v) x =
      P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x + 2 * ∑ v, l v * x v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_canonical_single
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_canonical_single (v : V) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator P.canonicalCharacteristic (Pi.single v 1) = -2

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_def
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_def (k x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x = (∑ v, k v * x v) + P.intersectionForm x x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_single (k : V → ℤ) (v : V) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator k (Pi.single v 1) = k v + P.weight v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_add_two_mul
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_add_two_mul (k : P.characteristicVectors) (l x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight ⟨fun v => k.val v + 2 * l v, k.property.add_two_mul⟩ x =
      P.characteristicWeight k x - ∑ v, l v * x v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_canonical_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeight_canonical_single (v : V) :
    P.characteristicWeight
      ⟨P.canonicalCharacteristic, P.isCharacteristicVector_canonicalCharacteristic⟩
      (Pi.single v 1) = 1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_def
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_def (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight k x = -(P.characteristicWeightNumerator k.val x / 2)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_single
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_single (k : P.characteristicVectors) (v : V) :
    P.characteristicWeight k (Pi.single v 1) = -((k.val v + P.weight v) / 2)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeight_zero (k : P.characteristicVectors) :
    P.characteristicWeight k 0 = 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.even_characteristicWeightNumerator
statement:
theorem even_characteristicWeightNumerator {k : V → ℤ} (hk : P.IsCharacteristicVector k)
    (x : V → ℤ) : Even (P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.two_mul_characteristicWeight
statement:
theorem two_mul_characteristicWeight (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) :
    2 * P.characteristicWeight k x = -P.characteristicWeightNumerator k.val x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.base_mem_cubeVertices
statement:
@[simp]
theorem base_mem_cubeVertices (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    x ∈ cubeVertices x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicCubeWeight_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicCubeWeight_empty (P : PlumbingGraph V) (k : P.characteristicVectors)
    (x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicCubeWeight k x ∅ = P.characteristicWeight k x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicCubeWeight_le
statement:
theorem characteristicCubeWeight_le
    (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {n : ℤ}
    (h : ∀ y ∈ cubeVertices x S, P.characteristicWeight k y ≤ n) :
    P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S ≤ n

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicCubeWeight_le_iff
statement:
theorem characteristicCubeWeight_le_iff
    (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {n : ℤ} :
    P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S ≤ n ↔
      ∀ y ∈ cubeVertices x S, P.characteristicWeight k y ≤ n

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicCubeWeight_mono
statement:
theorem characteristicCubeWeight_mono
    (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {S T : Finset V} (hST : S ⊆ T) (x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S ≤ P.characteristicCubeWeight k x T

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_cubeVertex_le_characteristicCubeWeight
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_cubeVertex_le_characteristicCubeWeight
    (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {T S : Finset V} (hTS : T ⊆ S) (x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight k (cubeVertex x T) ≤ P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_le_characteristicCubeWeight
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_le_characteristicCubeWeight
    (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {y : V → ℤ}
    (hy : y ∈ cubeVertices x S) :
    P.characteristicWeight k y ≤ P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_le_characteristicCubeWeight_base
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_le_characteristicCubeWeight_base
    (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    P.characteristicWeight k x ≤ P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex_add_single_eq_insert
statement:
theorem cubeVertex_add_single_eq_insert {T : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ T) (x : V → ℤ) :
    cubeVertex (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) T = cubeVertex x (insert v T)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubeVertex_apply (x : V → ℤ) (T : Finset V) (v : V) :
    cubeVertex x T v = x v + if v ∈ T then 1 else 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex_def
statement:
theorem cubeVertex_def (x : V → ℤ) (T : Finset V) :
    cubeVertex x T = x + ∑ v ∈ T, Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubeVertex_empty (x : V → ℤ) : cubeVertex x ∅ = x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex_insert
statement:
theorem cubeVertex_insert {T : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ T) (x : V → ℤ) :
    cubeVertex x (insert v T) = cubeVertex x T + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex_subset_mem_cubeVertices
statement:
theorem cubeVertex_subset_mem_cubeVertices {T S : Finset V} (hTS : T ⊆ S) (x : V → ℤ) :
    cubeVertex x T ∈ cubeVertices x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertices_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubeVertices_empty (x : V → ℤ) : cubeVertices x ∅ = {x}

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertices_nonempty
statement:
theorem cubeVertices_nonempty (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    (cubeVertices x S).Nonempty

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertices_subset
statement:
theorem cubeVertices_subset {S T : Finset V} (hST : S ⊆ T) (x : V → ℤ) :
    cubeVertices x S ⊆ cubeVertices x T

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.exists_characteristicWeight_eq_characteristicCubeWeight
statement:
theorem exists_characteristicWeight_eq_characteristicCubeWeight
    (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    ∃ y ∈ cubeVertices x S, P.characteristicWeight k y = P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.mem_cubeVertices
statement:
theorem mem_cubeVertices (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) (y : V → ℤ) :
    y ∈ cubeVertices x S ↔ ∃ T ⊆ S, cubeVertex x T = y

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff
    {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {v : V} :
    P.characteristicLowerFaceExponent k x S v = 0 ↔
      P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S = P.characteristicCubeWeight k x (S.erase v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast
    {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {v : V} :
    (P.characteristicLowerFaceExponent k x S v : ℤ) =
      P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S - P.characteristicCubeWeight k x (S.erase v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff
    {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) :
    P.characteristicUpperFaceExponent k x S hv = 0 ↔
      P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S =
        P.characteristicCubeWeight k (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) (S.erase v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_natCast
    {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) :
    (P.characteristicUpperFaceExponent k x S hv : ℤ) =
      P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S -
        P.characteristicCubeWeight k (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) (S.erase v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicUpperFaceWeight_le
statement:
theorem characteristicUpperFaceWeight_le {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) :
    P.characteristicCubeWeight k (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) (S.erase v) ≤
      P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertices_upperFace_subset
statement:
theorem cubeVertices_upperFace_subset {x : V → ℤ} {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) :
    cubeVertices (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) (S.erase v) ⊆ cubeVertices x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicCubeWeight_eq_max_erase
statement:
theorem characteristicCubeWeight_eq_max_erase (x : V → ℤ) {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) :
    P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S =
      max (P.characteristicCubeWeight k x (S.erase v))
        (P.characteristicCubeWeight k (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) (S.erase v))

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicCubeWeight_insert_eq_max
statement:
theorem characteristicCubeWeight_insert_eq_max (x : V → ℤ) {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ S) :
    P.characteristicCubeWeight k x (insert v S) =
      max (P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S)
        (P.characteristicCubeWeight k (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) S)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertices_eq_union_erase
statement:
theorem cubeVertices_eq_union_erase {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) (x : V → ℤ) :
    cubeVertices x S =
      cubeVertices x (S.erase v) ∪ cubeVertices (x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)) (S.erase v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.min_characteristicFaceExponent_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem min_characteristicFaceExponent_eq_zero (x : V → ℤ) {S : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) :
    min (P.characteristicLowerFaceExponent k x S v)
      (P.characteristicUpperFaceExponent k x S hv) = 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.base_mem_vertices
statement:
@[simp]
theorem base_mem_vertices (C : PlumbingCube V) :
    C.base ∈ C.vertices

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) :
    characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C v = 0 ↔
      characteristicWeight P k C = characteristicWeight P k (C.eraseDirection v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_mk [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) (v : V) :
    characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) v =
      P.characteristicLowerFaceExponent k x S v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_mk_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_mk_singleton (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (v : V) :
    P.characteristicLowerFaceExponent k x {v} v =
      (max (P.characteristicWeight k x) (P.characteristicWeight k (x + Pi.single v 1)) -
        P.characteristicWeight k x).toNat

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) :
    (characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C v : ℤ) =
      characteristicWeight P k C - characteristicWeight P k (C.eraseDirection v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_eq_zero_iff [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k C hv = 0 ↔
      characteristicWeight P k C = characteristicWeight P k (C.upperFace v hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_mk [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ S) :
    characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) hv =
      P.characteristicUpperFaceExponent k x S hv

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_mk_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_mk_singleton (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (v : V) :
    P.characteristicUpperFaceExponent k x {v} (Finset.mem_singleton_self v) =
      (max (P.characteristicWeight k x) (P.characteristicWeight k (x + Pi.single v 1)) -
        P.characteristicWeight k (x + Pi.single v 1)).toNat

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_natCast [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k C hv : ℤ) =
      characteristicWeight P k C - characteristicWeight P k (C.upperFace v hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_eq_max_faces
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_eq_max_faces [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    characteristicWeight P k C =
      max (characteristicWeight P k (C.lowerFace v hv))
        (characteristicWeight P k (C.upperFace v hv))

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_eraseDirection_le
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_eraseDirection_le [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) :
    characteristicWeight P k (C.eraseDirection v) ≤ characteristicWeight P k C

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_lowerFace_le
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_lowerFace_le [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    characteristicWeight P k (C.lowerFace v hv) ≤ characteristicWeight P k C

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeight_mk [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    characteristicWeight P k ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) =
      P.characteristicCubeWeight k x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_mk_singleton
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_mk_singleton (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (v : V) :
    characteristicWeight P k ⟨x, {v}⟩ =
      max (P.characteristicWeight k x) (P.characteristicWeight k (x + Pi.single v 1))

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicWeight_upperFace_le
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_upperFace_le [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    characteristicWeight P k (C.upperFace v hv) ≤ characteristicWeight P k C

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.dimension_le_card
statement:
theorem dimension_le_card [Fintype V] (C : PlumbingCube V) :
    C.dimension ≤ Fintype.card V

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.dimension_lowerFace_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dimension_lowerFace_of_mem (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.lowerFace v hv).dimension = C.dimension - 1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.dimension_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dimension_mk (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    dimension ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) = S.card

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.dimension_upperFace_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dimension_upperFace_of_mem (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.upperFace v hv).dimension = C.dimension - 1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.eraseDirection_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eraseDirection_base (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) :
    (C.eraseDirection v).base = C.base

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.eraseDirection_directions
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eraseDirection_directions (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) :
    (C.eraseDirection v).directions = C.directions.erase v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.eraseDirection_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eraseDirection_mk (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) (v : V) :
    eraseDirection ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) v =
      ({ base := x, directions := S.erase v } : PlumbingCube V)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {C D : PlumbingCube V} (hbase : C.base = D.base)
    (hdirections : C.directions = D.directions) : C = D

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.lowerFace_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lowerFace_base (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.lowerFace v hv).base = C.base

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.lowerFace_directions
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lowerFace_directions (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.lowerFace v hv).directions = C.directions.erase v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.lowerFace_lowerFace_comm
statement:
theorem lowerFace_lowerFace_comm (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    (C.lowerFace v hv).lowerFace w
        (by rw [lowerFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne.symm hw) =
      (C.lowerFace w hw).lowerFace v
        (by rw [lowerFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.lowerFace_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lowerFace_mk (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ S) :
    lowerFace ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) v hv =
      ({ base := x, directions := S.erase v } : PlumbingCube V)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.lowerFace_upperFace_comm
statement:
theorem lowerFace_upperFace_comm (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    (C.lowerFace v hv).upperFace w
        (by rw [lowerFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne.symm hw) =
      (C.upperFace w hw).lowerFace v
        (by rw [upperFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.mem_vertices
statement:
theorem mem_vertices (C : PlumbingCube V) (y : V → ℤ) :
    y ∈ C.vertices ↔ ∃ T ⊆ C.directions, PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex C.base T = y

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.min_characteristicFaceExponent_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem min_characteristicFaceExponent_eq_zero [Fintype V] (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    min (characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C v)
      (characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k C hv) = 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.upperFace_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperFace_base (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.upperFace v hv).base = C.base + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.upperFace_directions
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperFace_directions (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.upperFace v hv).directions = C.directions.erase v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.upperFace_lowerFace_comm
statement:
theorem upperFace_lowerFace_comm (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    (C.upperFace v hv).lowerFace w
        (by rw [upperFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne.symm hw) =
      (C.lowerFace w hw).upperFace v
        (by rw [lowerFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.upperFace_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperFace_mk (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ S) :
    upperFace ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) v hv =
      ({ base := x + Pi.single v (1 : ℤ), directions := S.erase v } : PlumbingCube V)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.upperFace_upperFace_comm
statement:
theorem upperFace_upperFace_comm (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    (C.upperFace v hv).upperFace w
        (by rw [upperFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne.symm hw) =
      (C.upperFace w hw).upperFace v
        (by rw [upperFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.vertices_eq_union_faces
statement:
theorem vertices_eq_union_faces (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    C.vertices = (C.lowerFace v hv).vertices ∪ (C.upperFace v hv).vertices

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.vertices_eraseDirection_subset
statement:
theorem vertices_eraseDirection_subset (C : PlumbingCube V) (v : V) :
    (C.eraseDirection v).vertices ⊆ C.vertices

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.vertices_lowerFace_subset
statement:
theorem vertices_lowerFace_subset (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.lowerFace v hv).vertices ⊆ C.vertices

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.vertices_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertices_mk (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    vertices ({ base := x, directions := S } : PlumbingCube V) =
      PlumbingGraph.cubeVertices x S

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.vertices_upperFace_subset
statement:
theorem vertices_upperFace_subset (C : PlumbingCube V) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (C.upperFace v hv).vertices ⊆ C.vertices

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_add_lowerFace_comm
statement:
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_add_lowerFace_comm
    (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C v +
        characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k (C.lowerFace v hv) w =
      characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C w +
        characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k (C.lowerFace w hw) v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_add_upperFace_comm
statement:
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_add_upperFace_comm
    (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C v +
        characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k (C.lowerFace v hv)
          (v := w)
          (by rw [lowerFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne.symm hw) =
      characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k C (v := w) hw +
        characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k (C.upperFace w hw) v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast_lowerFace
statement:
theorem characteristicLowerFaceExponent_natCast_lowerFace
    (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    (characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C v : ℤ) =
      characteristicWeight P k C - characteristicWeight P k (C.lowerFace v hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_add_lowerFace_comm
statement:
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_add_lowerFace_comm
    (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k C (v := v) hv +
        characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k (C.upperFace v hv) w =
      characteristicLowerFaceExponent P k C w +
        characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k (C.lowerFace w hw)
          (v := v)
          (by rw [lowerFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingCube.characteristicUpperFaceExponent_add_upperFace_comm
statement:
theorem characteristicUpperFaceExponent_add_upperFace_comm
    (hv : v ∈ C.directions) (hw : w ∈ C.directions) (hne : v ≠ w) :
    characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k C (v := v) hv +
        characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k (C.upperFace v hv)
          (v := w)
          (by rw [upperFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne.symm hw) =
      characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k C (v := w) hw +
        characteristicUpperFaceExponent P k (C.upperFace w hw)
          (v := v)
          (by rw [upperFace_directions]; exact Finset.mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem hne hv)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingChain.degreePart_eq_bot_iff_card_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreePart_eq_bot_iff_card_lt (q : ℕ) :
    degreePart V q = ⊥ ↔ Fintype.card V < q

name: TauCeti.PlumbingChain.disjoint_degreePart
statement:
theorem disjoint_degreePart {q r : ℕ} (hqr : q ≠ r) :
    Disjoint (degreePart V q) (degreePart V r)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingChain.mem_degreePart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_degreePart (q : ℕ) (c : PlumbingChain V) :
    c ∈ degreePart V q ↔ ∀ C ∈ c.support, C.dimension = q

name: TauCeti.PlumbingChain.single_mem_degreePart
statement:
theorem single_mem_degreePart {q : ℕ} (C : PlumbingCube V) (a : PlumbingCoefficient)
    (hC : C.dimension = q) :
    Finsupp.single C a ∈ degreePart V q

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_neg_left
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_neg_left (k x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator (-k) x =
      2 * P.intersectionForm x x - P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_neg_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_neg_neg (k x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator (-k) (-x) = P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_conjugate_add
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_conjugate_add (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight (P.conjugate k) x + P.characteristicWeight k x =
      -P.intersectionForm x x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_conjugate_canonical_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeight_conjugate_canonical_single (v : V) :
    P.characteristicWeight
      (P.conjugate ⟨P.canonicalCharacteristic, P.isCharacteristicVector_canonicalCharacteristic⟩)
      (Pi.single v 1) = -P.weight v - 1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_conjugate_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeight_conjugate_neg (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight (P.conjugate k) (-x) = P.characteristicWeight k x

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.card_cubeVertices
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_cubeVertices (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    (cubeVertices x S).card = 2 ^ S.card

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertexSubsetEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubeVertexSubsetEquiv_apply (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) (T : {T : Finset V // T ⊆ S}) :
    (cubeVertexSubsetEquiv x S T).1 = cubeVertex x T.1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertexSubsetEquiv_apply_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubeVertexSubsetEquiv_apply_symm_apply (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V)
    (y : {y : V → ℤ // y ∈ cubeVertices x S}) :
    cubeVertex x ((cubeVertexSubsetEquiv x S).symm y).1 = y.1

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertex_injective
statement: theorem cubeVertex_injective (x : V → ℤ) : Function.Injective (cubeVertex x)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.cubeVertices_eq_image_powerset
statement:
theorem cubeVertices_eq_image_powerset (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    cubeVertices x S = S.powerset.image (cubeVertex x)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_add_right
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_add_right (k x y : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator k (x + y) =
      P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x + P.characteristicWeightNumerator k y +
        2 * P.intersectionForm x y

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_add
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_add (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x y : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight k (x + y) =
      P.characteristicWeight k x + P.characteristicWeight k y - P.intersectionForm x y

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_add_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicWeight_add_single (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (v : V) :
    P.characteristicWeight k (x + Pi.single v 1) =
      P.characteristicWeight k x - ((k.val v + P.weight v) / 2) -
        ∑ i, x i * P.intersectionMatrix i v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_single_add_single
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_single_add_single (k : P.characteristicVectors) (v w : V) :
    P.characteristicWeight k (Pi.single v 1 + Pi.single w 1) =
      P.characteristicWeight k (Pi.single v 1) + P.characteristicWeight k (Pi.single w 1) -
        P.intersectionMatrix v w

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_add_two_mulVec
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_add_two_mulVec (k : P.characteristicVectors) (m x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight
        ⟨fun v => k.val v + 2 * (P.intersectionMatrix.mulVec m) v, k.property.add_two_mul⟩ x =
      P.characteristicWeight k x - P.intersectionForm x m

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_add_two_mulVec_eq_sub
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_add_two_mulVec_eq_sub (k : P.characteristicVectors) (m x : V → ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight
        ⟨fun v => k.val v + 2 * (P.intersectionMatrix.mulVec m) v, k.property.add_two_mul⟩ x =
      P.characteristicWeight k (x + m) - P.characteristicWeight k m

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_add_two_mulVec_le_iff
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_add_two_mulVec_le_iff (k : P.characteristicVectors) (m x : V → ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) :
    P.characteristicWeight
        ⟨fun v => k.val v + 2 * (P.intersectionMatrix.mulVec m) v, k.property.add_two_mul⟩ x ≤ n ↔
      P.characteristicWeight k (x + m) ≤ n + P.characteristicWeight k m

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.le_sInfCharacteristicWeight
statement:
theorem le_sInfCharacteristicWeight {c : ℤ} (k : P.characteristicVectors)
    (hc : ∀ x : V → ℤ, c ≤ P.characteristicWeight k x) : c ≤ P.sInfCharacteristicWeight k

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.sInfCharacteristicWeight_conjugate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sInfCharacteristicWeight_conjugate (k : P.characteristicVectors) :
    P.sInfCharacteristicWeight (P.conjugate k) = P.sInfCharacteristicWeight k

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.sInfCharacteristicWeight_def
statement:
theorem sInfCharacteristicWeight_def (k : P.characteristicVectors) :
    P.sInfCharacteristicWeight k = sInf (Set.range (P.characteristicWeight k))

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel_mono
statement:
theorem characteristicCubeWeightSublevel_mono (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {N M : ℤ} (hNM : N ≤ M) :
    P.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel k N ⊆ P.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel k M

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.lowerFace_mem_characteristicCubeWeightSublevel
statement:
theorem lowerFace_mem_characteristicCubeWeightSublevel (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {N : ℤ} {C : PlumbingCube V}
    (hC : C ∈ P.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel k N) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    C.lowerFace v hv ∈ P.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel k N

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.mem_characteristicCubeWeightSublevel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_characteristicCubeWeightSublevel (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (N : ℤ) (C : PlumbingCube V) :
    C ∈ P.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel k N ↔ C.characteristicWeight P k ≤ N

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.upperFace_mem_characteristicCubeWeightSublevel
statement:
theorem upperFace_mem_characteristicCubeWeightSublevel (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {N : ℤ} {C : PlumbingCube V}
    (hC : C ∈ P.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel k N) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ C.directions) :
    C.upperFace v hv ∈ P.characteristicCubeWeightSublevel k N

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_cubeVertex
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_cubeVertex (k x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    P.characteristicWeightNumerator k (cubeVertex x S) =
      P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x + (∑ v ∈ S, k v) +
        (∑ v ∈ S, ∑ w ∈ S, P.intersectionMatrix v w) +
        2 * ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ i, x i * P.intersectionMatrix i v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_cubeVertex
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_cubeVertex (k : P.characteristicVectors) (x : V → ℤ) (S : Finset V) :
    P.characteristicWeight k (cubeVertex x S) =
      P.characteristicWeight k x + P.characteristicWeight k (∑ v ∈ S, Pi.single v 1) -
        ∑ v ∈ S, ∑ i, x i * P.intersectionMatrix i v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.intersectionForm_self_le_weight_add_degree
statement:
theorem intersectionForm_self_le_weight_add_degree (x : V → ℤ) :
    P.intersectionForm x x ≤
      ∑ i, (P.weight i + P.toSimpleGraph.degree i) * x i ^ 2

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.latticeAugmentationCoefficient_of_directions_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem latticeAugmentationCoefficient_of_directions_eq_empty (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {C : PlumbingCube V} (hC : C.directions = ∅) :
    P.latticeAugmentationCoefficient k C =
      Polynomial.X ^ (P.characteristicWeight k C.base - P.sInfCharacteristicWeight k).toNat

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.latticeAugmentationCoefficient_of_directions_ne_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem latticeAugmentationCoefficient_of_directions_ne_empty (P : PlumbingGraph V)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) {C : PlumbingCube V} (hC : C.directions ≠ ∅) :
    P.latticeAugmentationCoefficient k C = 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.latticeAugmentation_eq_zero_of_mem_degreePart
TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.latticeAugmentation_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem latticeAugmentation_single (P : PlumbingGraph V) (k : P.characteristicVectors)
    (C : PlumbingCube V) (a : PlumbingCoefficient) :
    P.latticeAugmentation k (Finsupp.single C a) = a * P.latticeAugmentationCoefficient k C

name: TauCeti.e8Plumbing_intersectionForm_self
statement:
theorem e8Plumbing_intersectionForm_self (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8Plumbing.intersectionForm x x =
      -2 * ∑ i, x i ^ 2 +
        2 * (x 0 * x 1 + x 1 * x 2 + x 2 * x 3 + x 3 * x 4 +
          x 4 * x 5 + x 5 * x 6 + x 2 * x 7)

name: TauCeti.e8Plumbing_neg_intersectionForm
statement:
theorem e8Plumbing_neg_intersectionForm (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    -840 * e8Plumbing.intersectionForm x x = ∑ i, e8SquareTerm x i

name: TauCeti.e8Plumbing_weight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem e8Plumbing_weight (i : Fin 8) : e8Plumbing.weight i = -2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_five
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_five (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 5 = 20 * (7 * x 5 - 6 * x 6 - 3 * x 7) ^ 2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_four
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_four (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 4 = 28 * (6 * x 4 - 5 * x 5 - 3 * x 7) ^ 2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_nonneg
statement: theorem e8SquareTerm_nonneg (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) (i : Fin 8) : 0 ≤ e8SquareTerm x i

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_one (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 1 = 140 * (3 * x 1 - 2 * x 2) ^ 2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_seven
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_seven (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 7 = 105 * x 7 ^ 2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_six
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_six (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 6 = 15 * (8 * x 6 - 3 * x 7) ^ 2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_three
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_three (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 3 = 42 * (5 * x 3 - 4 * x 4 - 3 * x 7) ^ 2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_two
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_two (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 2 = 70 * (4 * x 2 - 3 * x 3 - 3 * x 7) ^ 2

name: TauCeti.e8SquareTerm_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem e8SquareTerm_zero (x : Fin 8 → ℤ) :
    e8SquareTerm x 0 = 420 * (2 * x 0 - x 1) ^ 2

name: TauCeti.eq_zero_of_e8SquareTerm_sum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_e8SquareTerm_sum_eq_zero (x : Fin 8 → ℤ)
    (h : ∑ i, e8SquareTerm x i = 0) :
    x = 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_canonicalCharacteristic
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_canonicalCharacteristic (u v : V)
    (h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) :
    P.blowUpEdgeCharacteristic u v h
        ⟨P.canonicalCharacteristic, P.isCharacteristicVector_canonicalCharacteristic⟩ (-1)
          (by norm_num) =
      ⟨(P.blowUpEdge u v h).canonicalCharacteristic,
        (P.blowUpEdge u v h).isCharacteristicVector_canonicalCharacteristic⟩

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_val (u v : V) (h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v)
    (k : P.characteristicVectors) (ε : ℤ) (hε : Odd ε) :
    (P.blowUpEdgeCharacteristic u v h k ε hε).val =
      blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv u v (k.val, ε)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_apply_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_apply_none (u v : V) (k : V → ℤ) (ε : ℤ) :
    blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv u v (k, ε) none = ε

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_apply_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_apply_some (u v : V) (k : V → ℤ) (ε : ℤ) (w : V) :
    blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv u v (k, ε) (some w) =
      k w - if w = u ∨ w = v then ε else 0

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_canonicalCharacteristic
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_canonicalCharacteristic (u v : V)
    (_h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) :
    blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv u v (P.canonicalCharacteristic, -1) =
      (P.blowUpEdge u v _h).canonicalCharacteristic

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_symm_apply (u v : V) (k : Option V → ℤ) :
    (blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv u v).symm k =
      (fun w => k (some w) + (if w = u ∨ w = v then k none else 0), k none)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeEquiv_apply_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeEquiv_apply_none (u v : V) (x : V → ℤ) (s : ℤ) :
    blowUpEdgeEquiv u v (x, s) none = x u + x v + s

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeEquiv_apply_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeEquiv_apply_some (u v : V) (x : V → ℤ) (s : ℤ) (w : V) :
    blowUpEdgeEquiv u v (x, s) (some w) = x w

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdgeEquiv_symm_apply (u v : V) (y : Option V → ℤ) :
    (blowUpEdgeEquiv u v).symm y =
      (fun w => y (some w), y none - y (some u) - y (some v))

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdgeEquiv_zero_one
statement:
theorem blowUpEdgeEquiv_zero_one [DecidableEq V] (u v : V) :
    blowUpEdgeEquiv u v (0, 1) = Pi.single (none : Option V) (1 : ℤ)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_adj_none_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdge_adj_none_some (u v : V) (_h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) (w : V) :
    (P.blowUpEdge u v _h).toSimpleGraph.Adj none (some w) ↔ w = u ∨ w = v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_adj_some_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdge_adj_some_none (u v : V) (_h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) (w : V) :
    (P.blowUpEdge u v _h).toSimpleGraph.Adj (some w) none ↔ w = u ∨ w = v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_adj_some_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdge_adj_some_some (u v : V) (_h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) (w w' : V) :
    (P.blowUpEdge u v _h).toSimpleGraph.Adj (some w) (some w') ↔
      P.toSimpleGraph.Adj w w' ∧ ¬((w = u ∧ w' = v) ∨ (w = v ∧ w' = u))

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_degree_none
statement:
theorem blowUpEdge_degree_none [Fintype V] (u v : V) (h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) :

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_none_none
statement:
@[simp 1100]
theorem blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_none_none (u v : V) (_h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) :

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_none_some
statement:

theorem blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_none_some (u v : V) (_h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_some_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_some_none (u v : V) (_h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_some_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blowUpEdge_intersectionMatrix_some_some (u v : V) (h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v)
    (w w' : V) :
    (P.blowUpEdge u v h).intersectionMatrix (some w) (some w') =
      P.intersectionMatrix w w' -
        (if w = u ∨ w = v then (1 : ℤ) else 0) * (if w' = u ∨ w' = v then (1 : ℤ) else 0)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_neighborSet_none

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_weight_none

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_weight_some

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.blowUpEdge_weight_some_v

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeightNumerator_blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv
statement:
theorem characteristicWeightNumerator_blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv (u v : V)
    (h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) (k x : V → ℤ) (ε s : ℤ) :
    (P.blowUpEdge u v h).characteristicWeightNumerator (blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv u v (k, ε))
        (blowUpEdgeEquiv u v (x, s)) =
      P.characteristicWeightNumerator k x + ε * s - s * s

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_eq_iff
statement:

theorem characteristicWeight_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_eq_iff (u v : V)

    (P.blowUpEdge u v h).characteristicWeight
        (P.blowUpEdgeCharacteristic u v h k ε hε)
        (blowUpEdgeEquiv u v (x, s)) = P.characteristicWeight k x ↔ s = 0 ∨ s = ε

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_zero
statement:

theorem characteristicWeight_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic_zero (u v : V)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.characteristicWeight_le_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic
statement:
theorem characteristicWeight_le_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic (u v : V)
    (h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) (k : P.characteristicVectors) (δ : ℤˣ)

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.intersectionForm_blowUpEdgeEquiv

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.sum_blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv_mul_blowUpEdgeEquiv

    ∑ a, blowUpEdgeCovectorEquiv u v (k, ε) a * blowUpEdgeEquiv u v (x, s) a =

name: TauCeti.PlumbingGraph.two_mul_characteristicWeight_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic
statement:
theorem two_mul_characteristicWeight_blowUpEdgeCharacteristic (u v : V)
    (h : P.toSimpleGraph.Adj u v) (k : P.characteristicVectors) (ε : ℤ)

    2 * (P.blowUpEdge u v h).characteristicWeight
        (P.blowUpEdgeCharacteristic u v h k ε hε)

TauCeti.MeasureTheory.aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae'
statement:
-- The witness is the pointwise `limsup` of the strongly measurable representatives of the `f n`.
-- The order-codomain assumptions are inherited from `Measurable.limsup` (`BorelSpace.Order`):
-- unlike the ambient case, Mathlib has no pseudo-metrizable a.e.-limit lemma for a non-ambient `m`,
-- so the `limsup` witness is the only route. This lemma and the two below are consumed by the
-- reverse-martingale Lévy-downward theorem `MeasureTheory.tendsto_ae_condExp_iInf`.
lemma aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae'
    {α : Type*} {m₀ : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : @MeasureTheory.Measure α m₀} {m : MeasurableSpace α}
    {f : ℕ → α → β} {g : α → β} (hf : ∀ n, @MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable α β _ m m₀ (f n) μ)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (g x))) :
    @MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable α β _ m m₀ g μ

    (hf_meas : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ)

name: TauCeti.tendsto_eLpNorm_sub_of_eventually_eq
statement:
theorem tendsto_eLpNorm_sub_of_eventually_eq {α ι F : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {m : Measure α} [NormedAddCommGroup F] {l : Filter ι} [l.IsCountablyGenerated] {q : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ ∞) {f : ι → α → F} {g : α → F}
    (hf : ∀ᶠ n in l, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) m) (hg : MemLp g q m)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hbound : ∀ᶠ n in l, ∀ᵐ x ∂m, ‖f n x - g x‖ ≤ C * ‖g x‖)
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂m, ∀ᶠ n in l, f n x = g x) :
    Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (f n - g) q m) l (𝓝 0)

    Tendsto (fun i => ∫⁻ x, ‖f i x - g x‖ₑ ∂ν) l (𝓝 0)

name: TauCeti.MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_norm_prod_sub_prod
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_norm_prod_sub_prod {ι ι' R : Type*} [SeminormedCommRing R]
    [NormOneClass R] {l : Filter ι'} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {s : Finset ι}
    {F : ι → ι' → Ω → R} {g : ι → Ω → R}
    (hF_meas : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (F i j) μ)
    (hg_meas : ∀ i ∈ s, AEStronglyMeasurable (g i) μ)
    (hF_le : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖F i j ω‖ ≤ 1)
    (hg_le : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖g i ω‖ ≤ 1)
    (hconv : ∀ i ∈ s, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ ω, ‖F i j ω - g i ω‖ ∂μ) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun j => ∫ ω, ‖(∏ i ∈ s, F i j ω) - ∏ i ∈ s, g i ω‖ ∂μ) l (𝓝 0)

    (hadd : ∀ (g h : α → G), AEMeasurable g μ → AEMeasurable h μ →
      T (g + h) ≤ᵐ[ν] T g + T h)
    (hweak : ∀ (g : α → G), AEMeasurable g μ → ∀ s : ℝ≥0∞,
      s * ν {y | s < T g y} ≤ A * ∫⁻ x, ‖g x‖ₑ ∂μ)

name: TauCeti.sum_Icc_rpow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_rpow_mul_eq (c : ℕ → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (n : ℝ) ^ τ * c n =
      x ^ τ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, c n -
        τ * ∫ t in (1 : ℝ)..x, t ^ (τ - 1) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊, c n

name: TauCeti.tendsto_rpow_inv_mul_sum_Icc_rpow_mul

theorem tendsto_rpow_inv_mul_sum_Icc_rpow_mul {c : ℕ → ℝ} {κ τ : ℝ} (hτ : -1 < τ)
    (h : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ x⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, c n) atTop (𝓝 κ)) :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℝ ↦ (x ^ (τ + 1))⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (n : ℝ) ^ τ * c n) atTop
      (𝓝 (κ / (τ + 1)))

    (⋃ i ∈ t, g i).primeIdealZetaSum s = ∑ i ∈ t, (g i).primeIdealZetaSum s

name: NumberField.Set.primeIdealZetaSum_compl_le_univ_of_finite
statement:
theorem primeIdealZetaSum_compl_le_univ_of_finite (hS : S.Finite) (s : ℝ) :

name: NumberField.Set.primeIdealZetaSum_le_add_symmDiff
statement:
theorem primeIdealZetaSum_le_add_symmDiff {S T : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K))} {s : ℝ}
    (hT : Summable fun 𝔭 : T ↦ (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1.asIdeal : ℝ) ^ (-s))
    (hST : Summable fun 𝔭 : ↥(S ∆ T) ↦ (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1.asIdeal : ℝ) ^ (-s)) :
    S.primeIdealZetaSum s ≤ T.primeIdealZetaSum s + (S ∆ T).primeIdealZetaSum s

name: NumberField.Set.primeIdealZetaSum_union_le
statement:
theorem primeIdealZetaSum_union_le {S T : Set (HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K))} {s : ℝ}
    (hS : Summable fun 𝔭 : S ↦ (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1.asIdeal : ℝ) ^ (-s))
    (hT : Summable fun 𝔭 : T ↦ (Ideal.absNorm 𝔭.1.asIdeal : ℝ) ^ (-s)) :
    (S ∪ T).primeIdealZetaSum s ≤ S.primeIdealZetaSum s + T.primeIdealZetaSum s

name: NumberField.Set.primeIdealZetaSum_univ_sub_compl_le_ncard_of_finite
statement:

    (ha : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → Nat.Coprime p L → ∃ c d : R, ∀ m : ℕ, Nat.Coprime m L →
      a (p * m) = c * a m - if p ∣ m then d * a (m / p) else 0)

    (hmul : ∀ u v : ℕ, Nat.Coprime u v → Nat.Coprime u L → Nat.Coprime v L →
      a (u * v) = a u * a v)
    (hrec : ∀ r : ℕ, a (p ^ (r + 2)) = a p * a (p ^ (r + 1)) - d * a (p ^ r))
    (m : ℕ) (hm0 : m ≠ 0) (hmL : Nat.Coprime m L) :
    a (p * m) = a p * a m - if p ∣ m then d * a (m / p) else 0

name: DirichletCharacter.twistedDivisorSum_apply
statement:
theorem twistedDivisorSum_apply (e : ℕ) (psi : DirichletCharacter R u)
    (phi : DirichletCharacter R v) (n : ℕ) :
    twistedDivisorSum e psi phi n =
      ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, psi (n / d) * phi d * (d : R) ^ e

name: DirichletCharacter.twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime
statement:
theorem twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime (e : ℕ) (psi : DirichletCharacter R u)
    (phi : DirichletCharacter R v) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    twistedDivisorSum e psi phi p = psi p + phi p * (p : R) ^ e

name: DirichletCharacter.twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_of_dvd_left_level
statement:
theorem twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_of_dvd_left_level (e : ℕ)
    (psi : DirichletCharacter R u) (phi : DirichletCharacter R v) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpu : p ∣ u) :
    twistedDivisorSum e psi phi p = phi p * (p : R) ^ e

name: DirichletCharacter.twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_of_dvd_right_level
statement:
theorem twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_of_dvd_right_level (e : ℕ)
    (psi : DirichletCharacter R u) (phi : DirichletCharacter R v) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpv : p ∣ v) : twistedDivisorSum e psi phi p = psi p

name: DirichletCharacter.twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_pow
statement:
theorem twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_pow (e : ℕ) (psi : DirichletCharacter R u)
    (phi : DirichletCharacter R v) (r : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    twistedDivisorSum e psi phi (p ^ r) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        psi p ^ (r - j) * phi p ^ j * (p : R) ^ (j * e)

name: DirichletCharacter.twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_pow_of_dvd_left_level
statement:
theorem twistedDivisorSum_apply_prime_pow_of_dvd_left_level (e : ℕ)
    (psi : DirichletCharacter R u) (phi : DirichletCharacter R v) (r : ℕ) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p.Prime) (hpu : p ∣ u) :
    twistedDivisorSum e psi phi (p ^ r) = phi p ^ r * (p : R) ^ (r * e)

statement:
theorem eval_def (f : BinaryQuadraticForm R) (x y : R) :

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.eval_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_mk (a b c x y : R) :
    (⟨a, b, c⟩ : BinaryQuadraticForm R).eval x y = a * x ^ 2 + b * x * y + c * y ^ 2

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.eval_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_smul (γ : SL(2, R)) (f : BinaryQuadraticForm R) (x y : R) :
    (γ • f).eval x y = f.eval (γ 1 1 * x - γ 0 1 * y) (-γ 1 0 * x + γ 0 0 * y)

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.eval_zero_one
statement:

theorem eval_zero_one (f : BinaryQuadraticForm R) : f.eval 0 1 = f.c

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.mem_posDef
statement:

theorem mem_posDef {D : ℕ} [NeZero D] {f : BinaryQuadraticForm ℤ} :

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.smul_a
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_a (γ : SL(2, R)) (f : BinaryQuadraticForm R) :
    (γ • f).a = f.a * γ 1 1 ^ 2 - f.b * γ 1 0 * γ 1 1 + f.c * γ 1 0 ^ 2

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.smul_b
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_b (γ : SL(2, R)) (f : BinaryQuadraticForm R) :
    (γ • f).b = f.b * (γ 0 0 * γ 1 1 + γ 0 1 * γ 1 0) - 2 * f.a * γ 0 1 * γ 1 1 -
      2 * f.c * γ 0 0 * γ 1 0

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.smul_c
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_c (γ : SL(2, R)) (f : BinaryQuadraticForm R) :
    (γ • f).c = f.a * γ 0 1 ^ 2 - f.b * γ 0 0 * γ 0 1 + f.c * γ 0 0 ^ 2

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.coe_ofMatrixEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_ofMatrixEquiv_apply {t n : ℤ}
    (M : {M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ // M.trace = t ∧ M.det = n}) :

name: TauCeti.BinaryQuadraticForm.coe_ofMatrixEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_ofMatrixEquiv_symm_apply {t n : ℤ}
    (f : {f : BinaryQuadraticForm ℤ // f.discrim = t ^ 2 - 4 * n}) :
    ((ofMatrixEquiv t n).symm f : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) =
      !![(t - f.1.b) / 2, -f.1.c; f.1.a, t - (t - f.1.b) / 2]

theorem isIntertwiningMap_res_res {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL} [Monoid K] [Monoid L]
    (N : Rep.{uV} R H) {f₁ : K →* G} {f₂ : G →* H} {g₁ : K →* L} {g₂ : L →* H}
    (hfg : g₂.comp g₁ = f₂.comp f₁) :

name: Rep.isIntertwiningMap_res_res_toRes_naturality

theorem Rep.isIntertwiningMap_res_res_toRes_naturality {K : Type uK} {L : Type uL} [Monoid K]

    (hfg : g₂.comp g₁ = f₂.comp f₁) {N N' : Rep.{uV} R H} (ψ : N ⟶ N') :
    (isIntertwiningMap_res_res N hfg).toRes ≫ (resFunctor g₁).map ((resFunctor g₂).map ψ) =
      (resFunctor f₁).map ((resFunctor f₂).map ψ) ≫ (isIntertwiningMap_res_res N' hfg).toRes

TauCeti.TateCohomology.complexMap_comp
statement:
-- The underlying monoid homomorphism of `e₁.trans e₂` is only extensionally equal to the
-- `MonoidHom.comp` in `IsIntertwiningMap.trans`, so the right-hand side transports across that
-- equality.
@[reassoc]
theorem complexMap_comp {e₁ : G ≃* H} {e₂ : H ≃* K} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (N.ρ.comp (e₁ : G →* H)) φ) {ψ : N.V →ₗ[R] P.V}
    (hψ : N.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (P.ρ.comp (e₂ : H →* K)) ψ) :
    complexMap hφ ≫ complexMap hψ = complexMap (e := e₁.trans e₂) (φ := ψ ∘ₗ φ) (by
      convert IsIntertwiningMap.trans hφ hψ using 1
      ext x
      rfl)

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.complexMap_congr
TauCeti.TateCohomology.complexMap_f_zero
statement:

statement:
@[simp] theorem complexMap_id :
    complexMap (e := MulEquiv.refl G) (φ := LinearMap.id) (Rep.isIntertwiningMap_id M) =
      𝟙 (tateComplex M)

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.complexMap_refl
statement:
-- Deliberately not a `simp` lemma: its left-hand side subsumes that of the `@[simp]`
-- `complexMap_id`, and its right-hand side is a dead end for `simp`, which has no lemma carrying
-- `tateComplex.map (𝟙 M)` back to `𝟙 (tateComplex M)`.
theorem complexMap_refl {M N : Rep R G} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap
      (N.ρ.comp ((MulEquiv.refl G : G ≃* G) : G →* G)) φ) :
    complexMap hφ = tateComplex.map
      (Rep.ofHom ⟨φ, fun g ↦ by ext v; simpa using hφ.isIntertwining g v⟩ : M ⟶ N)

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.mapInvariants_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapInvariants_apply_coe {e : G ≃* H} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (N.ρ.comp (e : G →* H)) φ)

theorem mapKerNorm_apply_coe {e : G ≃* H} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}

    (x : LinearMap.ker M.ρ.norm) :
    ((mapKerNorm hφ x : LinearMap.ker N.ρ.norm) : N.V) = φ x

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.mapNormQuotient_mk
statement:

theorem mapNormQuotient_mk {e : G ≃* H} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (N.ρ.comp (e : G →* H)) φ) (x : M.ρ.invariants) :

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.map_comp
statement:
-- As in `complexMap_comp`, the right-hand side transports the generalized composition theorem
-- across the extensional equality of the two underlying monoid homomorphisms.
@[reassoc]
theorem map_comp {e₁ : G ≃* H} {e₂ : H ≃* K} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (N.ρ.comp (e₁ : G →* H)) φ) {ψ : N.V →ₗ[R] P.V}
    (hψ : N.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (P.ρ.comp (e₂ : H →* K)) ψ) (n : ℤ) :
    map hφ n ≫ map hψ n = map (e := e₁.trans e₂) (φ := ψ ∘ₗ φ) (by
      convert IsIntertwiningMap.trans hφ hψ using 1
      ext x
      rfl) n

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.map_comp_H0IsoNormQuotient_hom
statement:
theorem map_comp_H0IsoNormQuotient_hom {e : G ≃* H} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (N.ρ.comp (e : G →* H)) φ) :
    map hφ 0 ≫ (H0IsoNormQuotient N).hom =
      (H0IsoNormQuotient M).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (mapNormQuotient hφ)

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.map_comp_isoGroupCohomology_hom
statement:
theorem map_comp_isoGroupCohomology_hom {e : G ≃* H} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (N.ρ.comp (e : G →* H)) φ) (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    map hφ (n : ℤ) ≫ (_root_.TateCohomology.isoGroupCohomology n).hom.app N =
      (_root_.TateCohomology.isoGroupCohomology n).hom.app M ≫
        groupCohomology.map (e.symm : H →* G) (IsIntertwiningMap.ofRes hφ) n

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.map_comp_isoGroupHomology_hom
statement:
theorem map_comp_isoGroupHomology_hom {e : G ≃* H} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap (N.ρ.comp (e : G →* H)) φ)
    (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (hmn : m = -(n + 1)) [NeZero n] :
    map hφ m ≫ (_root_.TateCohomology.isoGroupHomology m n hmn).hom.app N =
      (_root_.TateCohomology.isoGroupHomology m n hmn).hom.app M ≫
        groupHomology.map (e : G →* H) (IsIntertwiningMap.toRes hφ) n

name: TauCeti.TateCohomology.map_refl
statement:
-- As for `complexMap_refl`, deliberately not a `simp` lemma: it would subsume the
-- `@[simp]` `map_id` and leave `simp` stuck on the identity, since `Rep.ofHom ⟨LinearMap.id, _⟩`
-- has no `simp` route to `𝟙 M`.
theorem map_refl {M N : Rep R G} {φ : M.V →ₗ[R] N.V}
    (hφ : M.ρ.IsIntertwiningMap
      (N.ρ.comp ((MulEquiv.refl G : G ≃* G) : G →* G)) φ) (n : ℤ) :
    map hφ n = (tateCohomologyFunctor n).map
      (Rep.ofHom ⟨φ, fun g ↦ by ext v; simpa using hφ.isIntertwining g v⟩ : M ⟶ N)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.Formation.levelConjEquiv_comp_apply_coe

    {U₁ U₂ U₃ U₄ : OpenSubgroup G}
    (hh : ∀ x : G, h * x * h⁻¹ ∈ U₂ ↔ x ∈ U₁)
    (hg : ∀ x : G, g * x * g⁻¹ ∈ U₃ ↔ x ∈ U₂)
    (hgh : ∀ x : G, (g * h) * x * (g * h)⁻¹ ∈ U₄ ↔ x ∈ U₁) (a : F.level U₁) :
    (((F.levelConjEquiv g hg) (F.levelConjEquiv h hh a) : F.level U₃) : F.toRep.V) =
      ((F.levelConjEquiv (g * h) hgh a : F.level U₄) : F.toRep.V)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateCoefficientEquiv_conjugateCoefficientEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
theorem conjugateCoefficientEquiv_conjugateCoefficientEquiv_apply_coe (x : F.level L.top) :
    (((L.conjugate h).conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g (L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F h x) :
        F.level ((L.conjugate h).conjugate g).top) : F.toRep.V) =
      (L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F (g * h) x : F.level (L.conjugate (g * h)).top)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateCoefficientEquiv_rep_apply
statement:
theorem conjugateCoefficientEquiv_rep_apply (γ : L.Gal) (x : F.level L.top) :
    L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g ((L.rep F).ρ γ x) =
      ((L.conjugate g).rep F).ρ (L.conjugateGalEquiv g γ) (L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g x)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateCoefficientEquiv_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateCoefficientEquiv_symm_apply_coe (y : F.level (L.conjugate g).top) :
    (dsimp% only ((L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g).symm y : F.toRep.V)) = F.toRep.ρ g⁻¹ y

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateCohomologyIso_one
statement:
theorem conjugateCohomologyIso_one (n : ℕ) :
    L.conjugateCohomologyIso F 1 n = eqToIso (by rw [conjugate_one])

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateCohomologyIso_trans_conjugateCohomologyIso
statement:
theorem conjugateCohomologyIso_trans_conjugateCohomologyIso (n : ℕ) :
    L.conjugateCohomologyIso F h n ≪≫ (L.conjugate h).conjugateCohomologyIso F g n =
      L.conjugateCohomologyIso F (g * h) n ≪≫ eqToIso (by rw [conjugate_conjugate])

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGalEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateGalEquiv_mk (u : L.ground) :
    L.conjugateGalEquiv g (QuotientGroup.mk u) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (L.conjugateGroundEquiv g u)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGalEquiv_one
statement:
theorem conjugateGalEquiv_one :
    (L.conjugateGalEquiv 1).trans
        (MulEquiv.cast (M := fun K : NormalLayer G => K.Gal) L.conjugate_one) =
      MulEquiv.refl L.Gal

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGalEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateGalEquiv_symm_mk (v : (L.conjugate g).ground) :
    (L.conjugateGalEquiv g).symm (QuotientGroup.mk v) =
      QuotientGroup.mk ((L.conjugateGroundEquiv g).symm v)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGalEquiv_trans_conjugateGalEquiv
statement:
theorem conjugateGalEquiv_trans_conjugateGalEquiv :
    (L.conjugateGalEquiv h).trans ((L.conjugate h).conjugateGalEquiv g) =
      (L.conjugateGalEquiv (g * h)).trans
        (MulEquiv.cast (M := fun K : NormalLayer G => K.Gal)
          (L.conjugate_conjugate g h).symm)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGroundEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateGroundEquiv_apply_coe (u : L.ground) :
    ((L.conjugateGroundEquiv g u : (L.conjugate g).ground) : G) = g * u * g⁻¹

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGroundEquiv_conjugateGroundEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
theorem conjugateGroundEquiv_conjugateGroundEquiv_apply_coe (u : L.ground) :
    (((L.conjugate h).conjugateGroundEquiv g (L.conjugateGroundEquiv h u) :
        ((L.conjugate h).conjugate g).ground) : G) =
      (L.conjugateGroundEquiv (g * h) u : (L.conjugate (g * h)).ground)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGroundEquiv_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateGroundEquiv_symm_apply_coe (v : (L.conjugate g).ground) :
    (((L.conjugateGroundEquiv g).symm v : L.ground) : G) = g⁻¹ * v * g

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_apply_coe (x : F.level L.ground) :
    (dsimp% only (L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g x : F.toRep.V)) = F.toRep.ρ g x

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
theorem conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_apply_coe (x : F.level L.ground) :
    (((L.conjugate h).conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g (L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F h x) :
        F.level ((L.conjugate h).conjugate g).ground) : F.toRep.V) =
      (L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F (g * h) x : F.level (L.conjugate (g * h)).ground)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateGroundLevelEquiv_symm_apply_coe (y : F.level (L.conjugate g).ground) :
    (dsimp% only ((L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g).symm y : F.toRep.V)) = F.toRep.ρ g⁻¹ y

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_mk (x : F.level L.ground) :

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_one
statement:
theorem conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_one :
    (L.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv F 1).trans

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_symm_mk (y : F.level (L.conjugate g).ground) :
    (dsimp% only ((L.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv F g).symm (Submodule.Quotient.mk y))) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ((L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g).symm y)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_trans_conjugateNormQuotientEquiv
statement:
theorem conjugateNormQuotientEquiv_trans_conjugateNormQuotientEquiv :
    (L.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv F h).trans
        ((L.conjugate h).conjugateNormQuotientEquiv F g) =
      (L.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv F (g * h)).trans
        (AddEquiv.cast (M := fun K : NormalLayer G => K.NormQuotient F)
          (L.conjugate_conjugate g h).symm)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateTateIso_one
statement:
theorem conjugateTateIso_one (r : ℤ) :
    L.conjugateTateIso F 1 r = eqToIso (by rw [conjugate_one])

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugateTateIso_trans_conjugateTateIso
statement:
theorem conjugateTateIso_trans_conjugateTateIso (r : ℤ) :

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugate_conjugate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_conjugate : (L.conjugate h).conjugate g = L.conjugate (g * h)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.conjugate_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_one : L.conjugate 1 = L

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.degree_conjugate
statement: theorem degree_conjugate : (L.conjugate g).degree = L.degree

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.groundLevelEquiv_conjugateCohomologyIso_zero_apply
statement:
theorem groundLevelEquiv_conjugateCohomologyIso_zero_apply (x : L.H F 0) :
    (L.conjugate g).groundLevelEquiv F
        ((groupCohomology.H0Iso ((L.conjugate g).rep F)).hom.hom
          ((L.conjugateCohomologyIso F g 0).hom x)) =
      L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g
        (L.groundLevelEquiv F ((groupCohomology.H0Iso (L.rep F)).hom.hom x))

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.isIntertwiningMap_conjugateCoefficientEquiv
statement:
theorem isIntertwiningMap_conjugateCoefficientEquiv :
    (L.rep F).ρ.IsIntertwiningMap
      (((L.conjugate g).rep F).ρ.comp
        ((L.conjugateGalEquiv g : L.Gal ≃* (L.conjugate g).Gal) : L.Gal →* (L.conjugate g).Gal))
      ((L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g : F.level L.top ≃ₗ[ℤ] F.level (L.conjugate g).top) :
        F.level L.top →ₗ[ℤ] F.level (L.conjugate g).top)

statement:
theorem map_normSubgroup_conjugateGroundLevelEquiv :
    (L.normSubgroup F).map (L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g).toLinearMap =
      (L.conjugate g).normSubgroup F

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.map_relativeTop_conjugateGroundEquiv
statement:
theorem map_relativeTop_conjugateGroundEquiv :
    L.relativeTop.map (L.conjugateGroundEquiv g) = (L.conjugate g).relativeTop

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.mem_ground_conjugate
statement:
-- Both steps are definitional in Mathlib: `Subgroup.mem_comap` and `MulAut.conj_symm_apply`.
@[simp]
theorem mem_ground_conjugate {x : G} : x ∈ (L.conjugate g).ground ↔ g⁻¹ * x * g ∈ L.ground

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.mem_top_conjugate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_top_conjugate {x : G} : x ∈ (L.conjugate g).top ↔ g⁻¹ * x * g ∈ L.top

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.norm_conjugateCoefficientEquiv
statement:
theorem norm_conjugateCoefficientEquiv (x : F.level L.top) :
    (L.conjugate g).norm F (L.conjugateCoefficientEquiv F g x) =
      L.conjugateGroundLevelEquiv F g (L.norm F x)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.NormalLayer.tateHZeroEquivNormQuotient_conjugateTateIso_apply
statement:
theorem tateHZeroEquivNormQuotient_conjugateTateIso_apply (x : L.TateH F 0) :
    (L.conjugate g).tateHZeroEquivNormQuotient F ((L.conjugateTateIso F g 0).hom x) =
      L.conjugateNormQuotientEquiv F g (L.tateHZeroEquivNormQuotient F x)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRefinement.cohomologyInfl_def
statement:
theorem cohomologyInfl_def (T : LayerRefinement old new) (F : Formation G) (n : ℕ) :

statement:

theorem cohomologyInfl_self {L : NormalLayer G} (T : LayerRefinement L L) (F : Formation G)

statement:

statement:
theorem degree_mul_relativeDegree (T : LayerRefinement old new) :

statement:
theorem exists_commonRefinement {L₁ L₂ : NormalLayer G} (h : L₁.ground = L₂.ground) :

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRefinement.galHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galHom_mk (T : LayerRefinement old new) (w : new.ground) :

      QuotientGroup.mk (Subgroup.inclusion T.same_ground_toSubgroup.ge w)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRefinement.galHom_mk_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem galHom_mk_eq_one_iff (T : LayerRefinement old new) (w : new.ground) :

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRefinement.galHom_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galHom_self {L : NormalLayer G} (T : LayerRefinement L L) :
    T.galHom = MonoidHom.id L.Gal

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRefinement.galHom_surjective
statement: theorem galHom_surjective (T : LayerRefinement old new) : Function.Surjective T.galHom

statement:
theorem galHom_trans (T : LayerRefinement a b) (T' : LayerRefinement b c) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem groundEquiv_apply_coe (T : LayerRefinement old new) (F : Formation G)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRefinement.groundLevelEquiv_cohomologyInfl_zero_apply
statement:
theorem groundLevelEquiv_cohomologyInfl_zero_apply (T : LayerRefinement old new)
    (F : Formation G) (x : old.H F 0) :
    new.groundLevelEquiv F
        ((groupCohomology.H0Iso (new.rep F)).hom.hom (T.cohomologyInfl F 0 x)) =

        ((groupCohomology.H0Iso (old.rep F)).hom.hom x))

statement:
theorem level_top_le (T : LayerRefinement old new) (F : Formation G) :

statement:
theorem ofOpenNormal {V V' : OpenNormalSubgroup G} (h : V' ≤ V) :

statement:

statement:

statement:

theorem repHom_hom_apply_coe (T : LayerRefinement old new) (F : Formation G) (x : F.level old.top) :

statement:
theorem repHom_self_toLinearMap {L : NormalLayer G} (T : LayerRefinement L L)
    (F : Formation G) :
    (T.repHom F).hom.toLinearMap =
      (𝟙 (L.rep F) : L.rep F ⟶ L.rep F).hom.toLinearMap

statement:
theorem repHom_trans_toLinearMap (T : LayerRefinement a b) (T' : LayerRefinement b c)
    (F : Formation G) :
    ((T.trans T').repHom F).hom.toLinearMap =
      (((Rep.resFunctor T'.galHom).map (T.repHom F) ≫ T'.repHom F).hom.toLinearMap)

statement:
theorem same_ground_toSubgroup (T : LayerRefinement old new) :

statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem tateInfl_comp_tateHIsoH_hom (T : LayerRefinement old new) (F : Formation G) (r : ℕ)

    T.tateInfl F r ≫ (new.tateHIsoH F r).hom = (old.tateHIsoH F r).hom ≫ T.cohomologyInfl F r

statement:
theorem tateInfl_def (T : LayerRefinement old new) (F : Formation G) (r : ℕ) [NeZero r] :

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRefinement.tateInfl_self

@[simp]
theorem tateInfl_self {L : NormalLayer G} (T : LayerRefinement L L) (F : Formation G) (r : ℕ)

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRestriction.cohomologyRes_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cohomologyRes_self {L : NormalLayer G} (T : LayerRestriction L L) (F : Formation G)
    (n : ℕ) : T.cohomologyRes F n = 𝟙 (L.H F n)

statement:

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRestriction.galHom_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem galHom_self {L : NormalLayer G} (T : LayerRestriction L L) :

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRestriction.groundInclusion_self

statement:
theorem repIso_inv_comm_apply (T : LayerRestriction small big) (F : Formation G)
    (g : T.galHom.range) (x : F.level big.top) :
    (T.repIso F).inv.hom.toLinearMap (((big.rep F).ρ.comp T.galHom.range.subtype) g x) =

statement:
theorem relTransfer_map_sub_mem {G' V' : Type*} [Group G'] [AddCommGroup V'] [Module R V']

name: Rep.coinvariantsMk_coindToInd_unit
statement:
theorem coinvariantsMk_coindToInd_unit (M : Rep k G) (S : Subgroup G) [S.FiniteIndex]
    (m : M.V) :
    Representation.Coinvariants.mk (Representation.ind S.subtype (res S.subtype M).ρ)
        (coindToInd (res S.subtype M) (((resCoindAdjunction k S.subtype).unit.app M).hom m)) =
      Representation.Coinvariants.mk (Representation.ind S.subtype (res S.subtype M).ρ)
        (Representation.IndV.mk S.subtype (res S.subtype M).ρ 1
          (Representation.relTransfer M.ρ S m))

statement:
theorem cohomologyCor_def (T : LayerRestriction small big) (F : Formation G) (n : ℕ) :

      TauCeti.groupCohomology.corestriction T.galHom.range (big.rep F) n

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRestriction.cohomologyCor_trans
statement:

    (T.trans T').cohomologyCor F n = T.cohomologyCor F n ≫ T'.cohomologyCor F n

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRestriction.cohomologyRangeIso_def
statement:
theorem cohomologyRangeIso_def (T : LayerRestriction small big) (F : Formation G) (n : ℕ) :
    T.cohomologyRangeIso F n =
      groupCohomology.mapIso (B := small.rep F)
        (A := Rep.res T.galHom.range.subtype (big.rep F))
        (MonoidHom.ofInjective T.galHom_injective)
        (Representation.equivOfIso (T.repIso F)).toLinearEquiv
        (fun g ↦ by
          apply LinearMap.ext
          intro x
          exact Rep.hom_comm_apply (T.repIso F).hom g x) n

name: TauCeti.ClassFieldTheory.LayerRestriction.tateRangeIso_hom

              Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective (f := (f : R →+* R')) f.injective,

    χ.generalizedBernoulli n =
      algebraMap ℚ R ((N : ℚ) ^ ((n : ℤ) - 1)) *
        ∑ a : ZMod N, χ a *
          algebraMap ℚ R

        algebraMap ℚ R (((if a = 0 then N else a.val : ℕ) : ℚ) / N)) -

name: reducedInvarDenom_def
statement:
theorem reducedInvarDenom_def : reducedInvarDenom b c d m =
    if m % 6 = 0 then
      (normEDS b c d 5 - d ^ 2) * complEDS b c d 6 (m / 6) *
        normEDS b c d (m + 1) * normEDS b c d (m - 1)
    else if m % 6 = 1 then
      (normEDS b c d 5 - d ^ 2) * complEDS b c d 6 ((m - 1) / 6) *
        normEDS b c d (m + 1) * normEDS b c d m
    else if m % 6 = 5 then
      (normEDS b c d 5 - d ^ 2) * complEDS b c d 6 ((m + 1) / 6) *
        normEDS b c d m * normEDS b c d (m - 1)
    else if m % 6 = 2 then
      complEDS b c d 3 ((m + 1) / 3) * complEDS b c d 2 (m / 2) * normEDS b c d (m - 1)
    else if m % 6 = 4 then
      complEDS b c d 3 ((m - 1) / 3) * complEDS b c d 2 (m / 2) * normEDS b c d (m + 1)
    else
      complEDS b c d 3 (m / 3) * complEDS b c d 2 ((m - 1) / 2) * normEDS b c d (m + 1)

      normEDS b c d m * normEDS b c d (m - 1)

name: TauCeti.IsLipschitzParametrizable.exists_ncard_smul_add_inter_le
statement:
theorem exists_ncard_smul_add_inter_le {d : ℕ} {S : Set E}
    (hS : IsLipschitzParametrizable d S) (L : AddSubgroup E) [DiscreteTopology L]
    {B : Set E} (hB : IsBounded B) :
    ∃ A ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∀ c : ℝ, 1 ≤ c →
      (((c • S + B) ∩ (L : Set E)).ncard : ℝ) ≤ A * c ^ d

name: TauCeti.IsLipschitzParametrizable.finite_smul_add_inter
statement:
theorem finite_smul_add_inter {d : ℕ} {S : Set E}
    (hS : IsLipschitzParametrizable d S) (L : AddSubgroup E) [DiscreteTopology L]
    {B : Set E} (hB : IsBounded B) (c : ℝ) :
    ((c • S + B) ∩ (L : Set E)).Finite

name: TauCeti.IsLipschitzParametrizable.isBigO_ncard_smul_add_inter
statement:
theorem isBigO_ncard_smul_add_inter {d : ℕ} {S : Set E}
    (hS : IsLipschitzParametrizable d S) (L : AddSubgroup E) [DiscreteTopology L]
    {B : Set E} (hB : IsBounded B) :
    (fun c : ℝ ↦ (((c • S + B) ∩ (L : Set E)).ncard : ℝ)) =O[atTop] fun c : ℝ ↦ c ^ d

name: TauCeti.GeometryOfNumbers.addSubgroup_inter_box_finite_and_ncard_le_of_separated
statement:
theorem addSubgroup_inter_box_finite_and_ncard_le_of_separated (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (Λ : AddSubgroup (ι → ℂ)) {ρ : ℝ} (hρ0 : 0 < ρ) (hρ2 : ρ ≤ 2)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ Λ, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, ρ * r i < ‖x i‖) : ((Λ : Set (ι → ℂ)) ∩ box r 2).Finite ∧
      (((Λ : Set (ι → ℂ)) ∩ box r 2).ncard : ℝ) ≤ (8 / ρ) ^ (2 * Fintype.card ι)

name: TauCeti.GeometryOfNumbers.box_mono

name: TauCeti.GeometryOfNumbers.finite_and_ncard_le_of_subset_box_of_separated
statement:
theorem finite_and_ncard_le_of_subset_box_of_separated (r : ι → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    {c ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hεc : ε ≤ c) {S : Set (ι → ℂ)} (hS : S ⊆ box r c)

    S.Finite ∧ (S.ncard : ℝ) ≤ (4 * c / ε) ^ (2 * Fintype.card ι)

name: TauCeti.abs_ncard_inter_mul_sub_measureReal_le
statement:
theorem abs_ncard_inter_mul_sub_measureReal_le
    (hF₀ : (0 : E) ∈ F) (hFpc : IsPreconnected F) (hFb : IsBounded F) (hFm : MeasurableSet F)
    (hFu : ∀ x : E, ∀ w₁ ∈ (L : Set E), ∀ w₂ ∈ (L : Set E), x - w₁ ∈ F → x - w₂ ∈ F → w₁ = w₂)
    (hFe : ∀ x : E, ∃ w ∈ (L : Set E), x - w ∈ F)
    (hXb : IsBounded X) :
    |((X ∩ (L : Set E)).ncard : ℝ) * μ.real F - μ.real X| ≤
      (((frontier X + -F) ∩ (L : Set E)).ncard : ℝ) * μ.real F

name: TauCeti.exists_abs_ncard_smul_inter_vadd_sub_le
statement:
theorem exists_abs_ncard_smul_inter_vadd_sub_le {D : Set E} (hDb : IsBounded D)
    (hDfr : IsLipschitzParametrizable (finrank ℝ E - 1) (frontier D)) :
    ∃ A ≥ (0 : ℝ), ∀ (ξ : E) (c : ℝ), 1 ≤ c →
      |(((c • D) ∩ (ξ +ᵥ (L : Set E))).ncard : ℝ) -
          μ.real D / ZLattice.covolume L μ * c ^ finrank ℝ E| ≤ A * c ^ (finrank ℝ E - 1)

name: TauCeti.isBigO_ncard_smul_inter_sub
statement:
theorem isBigO_ncard_smul_inter_sub {D : Set E} (hDb : IsBounded D)
    (hDfr : IsLipschitzParametrizable (finrank ℝ E - 1) (frontier D)) :
    (fun c : ℝ ↦ (((c • D) ∩ (L : Set E)).ncard : ℝ) -
        μ.real D / ZLattice.covolume L μ * c ^ finrank ℝ E) =O[atTop]
      fun c : ℝ ↦ c ^ (finrank ℝ E - 1)

name: HeckeCoset.doubleCoset_rep_mk
statement:
-- The second `@[simp]` rule eliminating `rep`, and no competition with `mk_rep`: that one cancels
-- `mk` applied to a `rep`, this one `rep` applied to a `mk`.
@[simp] lemma doubleCoset_rep_mk (w : Δ) :
    doubleCoset (((mk H₁ H₂ w).rep : Δ) : G) H₁ H₂ = doubleCoset (w : G) H₁ H₂

statement:
@[simp] lemma map_id (D : HeckeCoset Δ H₁ H₂) :
